sgrig pa po'o gtam/ — slob dpon chen mo dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho mchog ni/deng dus bod mi rigs spyi'i gtsug tu mchod pa'i mkhas dbang chen po zhig red/ khong gis sku tshe gang bor rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas la thugs zhen zab bzhes ngos nyams pa sor chud/ ma nyams gong 'phel/ shes rig yar rgyas kyi don du brtse gzigs zol med/ brtson pa lhod med/ gsung dbyangs 'gag med kyis rang nus gang yod phul ba'i bka' drin ni bsam brjod yul las 'das pa zhig red/ lhag par du khong gis nga tshor bzhag pa'i rig gzhung gi shul bzhag rin po che la bltas kyin bltas kyin mos gus mchi ma rab tu 'khrigs/ bsam bzhin bsam bzhin rin thang gzhal du med pa shes/ nga rang tsho mi rigs dpe skrun gyi las ka byed mkhan zhig yin pa'i ngos nas bshad na/ slob dpon chen mo 'di ba'i phyag rtsom mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig bsgrigs nas par du bskru na na ni rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas bang mdzod la rin chen nor bu 1

zhig bsnan pa lta bu'i dgi mtshan chen po ldan zhing / lar blo gsal gzhon nu'i tshogs la rig pa'i dngos po phun sum tshogs pa zhig mngon par bstabs pa'i phan yon shini tu mi dman pa zhig yod par mthong nas de lugs kyi brtson pa lhur len pa'i 'dun pa drag po snying la bcags khar/ nye lam rje nyid kyi sku sring bde mchog skyid dang khong gi yang tsha grwa btsun bslab gsum rgya mtsho zung gis sa thag ring bo'i dka' sdug la ma 'dzems par rje nyid kyi gsung rtsom mtha' dag dre'u khal du longs pa zhig dngos su khur nas rang re'i dpe skrun khang du slebs shing / —khyed dpe skrun khang gi rtsom sgrig spus tshad legs pas gzhan su dang gang la'ang ma sprad par khyed cag la gtad pa yin zhes gsung 'bum dpar skrun gyi dngos shugs dbang cha yod tshad nga tshor phul ba dang / khyad par rdu nged dpe skrun khang la ma dngul gyi 'khos ka zhan pa mthong na/sa/ gcen po'i gsung 'bum par du btab nas bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas la phyar ba gru 'degs kyi nus pa thon na de las che ba med ces gsungs te gcen rin po che'i brtsams yon skar gcig kyang med pa'i thog da dung gzhan las zhal 'debs dngul sgor khri gnyis tsam bsdus nas gun gsab kyi rogs skyor byas pa la nga tsho sems 'gul chen po dang skul ma chen lha

po thebs ngate/ — gzhi nas shākhong gi gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig sgrig r+pā'i 'char gzhi dngos bstar byas pa yin/da cha nga tshos par du bskrun pa'i gsung 'bum 'di la khyon bsdoms pod drug tu bkar/ pod dang po ni gtso cher rnam thar skor yin/ 'di'i nang du nga tshos de snga sus kyang mjal ma myong ba'i mdo smad bstan pa'i bdag po rje bla kho rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rnam thar lo rgyus mjal thub par ma zad/ rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi byung ba lo rgyus las mkhas chen dam pa zhig thos sbyang gi stobs ga 'dra zhig la brten nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i tshul la rgyus mnga' lon cing rang nyid la sbyang stobs che ru bskyed pa'i skul ma thebs chinges yin/ pod— gnyis pa ni gtso cher gzhung 'grel skor te/— 'di'i nang nas rtsom pa po rang nyid nang don rig pa'i mkhas dbang zhig yin pa'i ngos nas deng gi 'chad grwa'i gzhung khrid kyi dka' gnad la dmigs nas tshig don gnyi sa— gsal gyi 'grel bshad gnang yod/ po gagasuyi pa ni gtso cher lo rgyus skor te/ 'di'i nang du bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas dar tshul gyi lo rgyus sogs bkod yod pas/ nga tshos lo rgyus 'di dag las rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi phul byung grub 'bras mthong thub par ma zad/ / mkhas pa gzhan gyi 3

gsung na med pa'i legs bshad btso ma'i gser lta bu'ang mi nyung ba zhig zin rgyu yod do/ /pod bzhi ba ni gtso cher sgra snyan ngag skar rtsis kyi skor yin/ 'di'i nang du slob dpon 'di bas srol rgyun rig gnas kyi bslab bya so so rgyas bsdus 'tsham zhing go bde ba'i lam nas bkral yod pas las dang po ba rnams la nye bar mkho zhing 'jug bde ba'i gnas dam pa zhig tu 'khums so/ /pod lnga ba ni gtso cher sum rtags dag gsum skor yin/ 'di'i nang nas nga tshos rtsom pa po'i deng rabs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i brda sprod kyi gzhung lugs dang lta ba gsar ba/ lag len gyi rin thang ldan zhing nye bar mkho ba'i bshad pa gsar ba shes rtogs byed thub pa yin/ pod drug pa ni gsung thor bu'i skor te/'di'i nang nas nga tshos rtsom pa pos gdul bya'i blo gang la gang 'tsham du sbyar ba'i shes bya sna tshogs/ dri ba dris lan/ chab shog sogs mjal thub la/ gsung tsag tsig la snang chung mi byed par zhib tu bklags na ni bye ma'i gseb nas gser rdo rnyed pa lta bu'i dga' snang skye'ang srid do/ /mdor na/ khong gi gsung 'bum la brjod don zab kyang tshig 'grel gsal ba/ rig pa'i gnas la 'jug pa'i las dang po ba rnams kyi blor 'tsham zhing go sla ba/ gnas lnga rig pa'i 4 —

snying bcud 'dus shing 'jug bde ba/ shes ldan rgan pas bklags na blo skyed gsar ba thob pa/ a gsar gzhon nus bklags na mos gus dbang med 'chor ba'i yon tan gyi mdzod chen po zhig yin pas/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi dge ba'i bshes dang brtse ba'i grogs su gyur cig gu/ / zhes 'di ga'i rtsom sgrig khang nas/spyi lo1996zla8tshes3la phul/5

bcu phrag 'dab ldan ge sar reg tsam gyis//zung ldan 'dab ma'i snyan 'gyur 'aldad dgu ru// 'byung ba'i dpal ldan dri bsung mngar bo yis jiyangs pa'i skyed tshal khyon de mdzes gyur cig / gang zhig skul byed dbyu gus yongs bskul na //ldir ba'i sgra dbyangs 'byu nga ba'i rdza rnga bzhin / /bsil ldan brda skad tshul lugs nor 'ga' zhig / byis pa rtse dga'i ga zigs mor 'grems dgos byung //de yang sum cu ba dang rtags 'jug gi rtsa ba'i tshig 'grel zhig slar 'bri 'dun gyis 'dir yi ge'i rnam bzhag spyi don gyi tshul du 'chad pa la/ byung ba mdo tsam bshad pa dang / yi ge'i rnam bzhag gnyis/ 3

dad bro byud da nado tsan dazhad pu/gangs can bod yul zhes grags pa'i yul lje sa 'dir gna' snga mo'i duse su yul thams cad chus gang nasali'i 'gro ba med par bshad/ de rjes rim gyis chu bri nas ri brag nga nags tshal gyi yul/ glang chen dang / spra dang / spre'u sog/ gcan gzan ri dwags kyis gang bar bshad/ de rjes yul 'dirimi'i 'gro ba chags nas yun ring zhig la rgyal bo med la/ bod kyirgyal bo'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po yin zer/ gnya' khri btsanapo dang / de'i sras mu khri btsan po/ de'i sras deng khri btsan pode'i sras sho khri btsan po/ de'i sras mer khri btsan po/ de'isras gdags khri btsano po/ de'i sras srib khri btsanā po ste bdun la gnam gyi khri bdun zer/ srib khri'i sras gri gum btsan po/de'i sras spu de gung rgyal gnyis la bar gyi steng gnyis su grags/snga ma blon po dang 'thab pa'i dus su bod du khrab kyi thog ma byung ba dang / rgyal bo 'di gnyis kyi dus su zhing la chu 'dren pa dang / sa bon 'debs pa sogs byung zer/ yang 'di'i dus stag gzig 'ol mo lung ring nas gshen rab mi bor grags pa 4 sto — ṅka

byung nas bon dar yang yi ge 'bri ba'i lam lugs sogs med par mngon/ spu de gung rgyal gyi sras e sho legs/ de'i sras de sho legs/ de'i sras thi sho legs/ de'i sras gu ru legs/de'i sras 'brong zhi legs/ de'i sras i sho legs te drug la sa'i legs drug zer/ de nas za nam zin lde/ lde 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ se snol gnam lde/ se snol bo lde/ lde snol nam/ lde snol bo/ lde rgyal bo/ lde sprin btsan rnams la lde brgyad zer/de nas rgyal to ru long btsan/ khri btsan nam/ khri sgra dpung btsan/ khri thog rje btsan bzhi la 'og gi btsan bzhi zer/ khri thog rje btsan gyi sras lha tho tho ri yin la/ de'i dus su pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi yang thog tu/ spang skong phyag rgya ba dang mdo sde za ma tog sogs/ nam mkha' nas babs pas chos kyi dbu brnyes zer la bshad tshul gzhan zhig kyang yod/ lha tho tho ri'i srasatshukhri gnyan gzung btsan/ de'i sras 'brong gnyan lde'u/ de'i sras stag ri gnyan gzigs/ de'i sras gnam ri srong btsan/ de'i sras chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po yin la/ 'dis rgya bza' kong jo dang / bal bza' khri btsun gnyis khab tu bzhes pa las/snga mas jo bodzishākya mu no dang / phyi mas jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje gdan drangs nas gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ mtha' 'dul yang 'dul 5

ru gnon gyi lha khang grangs rimang bo bzhengs/ mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims btod/ dmar bo'i rir pho brang bakhyigs te chab srid bskyangs pas/ mtha' dbus kyi rgyal phran du mas gus 'dud lhur blangs/ blon chen thon mi sam bho ṭa rgya gar du mngags/ glon chen des rgyal bo'i bka' dang du blangs nas bram ze yig mkhan legs byin karir dang paṇ+ḍi ta lha rig pa'i seng ge sogs slob dpon du ma bsten nas/ yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / sgra mthar phyin par bslab/ 'phags yul du'ang mkhas pa'i grags pa 'bar/ bod du phebs nas sku mkhar ma rur nā ga ra'i yi ge dper byas te bod yig gi gzugs brtsams te yig phud du rgyal bor bya dka' ba'i lam nas drangs pa'i bustod pas ched du brjod pas dgyes shing / rjes su rgyal bos kyang slob dpon thon mi las yi ge bslab/ slob dpon gyis kyang brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos brgyad mdzad/ mdo rgyud du ma bod skad du bsgyur/ yi ge dang rig gnas shin tu dar bar byas pa sogs sku drin shin tu che/ srong btsan sgam po'i sras che—ba gung ru gung btsan rgyal sar bzhag kyang / lo bco brgyad la gshegs stabs/ slar yang rgyal bo rang nyid rgyal sar bsdad/ de rjes mang srong mang btsan/ de'i sras 'dus srong mang rje/ de'i dus rtsal bo 6

che'i mi bdun rgyung zer/ de'i sras khri lde gtsug brtan/ de la sras 'jang tsha lha dpon skyes pa la/ rgya rje li'i sras mo khab tu bsus kyang / ma 'byor gong du rgyal bu 'das pas/ 9 khri sde gtsug brtan gyi btsun mor byas/ rgyal bo de la mes ag tshom yang zer/ de'i sras khri srong lde btsan/ 'di'i dus su mkhan slob chosabyugasum gyis bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ sde snod gsum bsgyur/ rab byung gi sde btsugs nas/ bstan pa rgyas par byas/ de rjes mu ne btsan po byung / 'di'i dus su dbul phyug lan gsum bsnyams zer/ de'i rjes su mu tig btsan po byung / de la sras lnga yod pa'i chung ba mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyis rgyal sa bzung / 'di ba bstan pa la shin tu dad/ rgya bod bar du rdo—ring btsugs/ mkhas pa du ma bskul te bod yig skad gsar bcad kyis dag bcos mdzad/ de rjes de'i gcen glang dar ma zhes pa'i rgyal bo des paṇ+ḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba du ma ciyul phud btang nas chos khrims rgya'artsi khrims thams cad nyasnams par byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon thon mir+sha gsung gi brdathusprod bstan bcos gzhan rnams kyang nub/ chos srid rig gnas sogs nyams par byas/ lugs spod kyi—sa gnya' gnon byas pa'i rkyen las rim gyis 'bangs gyen log byung / de nas bzung bod 7

khyab la dbang ba'i rgyal bo zhig ma byung / phyis su hor jin gur gyis rgya nag sogs la dbang bsgyur skabs/ sa skya bas bod la dbang bsgyur pa sogs 'pho 'gyur sna tshogs shig byung ngo / /'on kyang glang dar mas rgyal khrims dang chos khrims bsnubros pa'i — rjes su— slob dpon thon mi'i gsung gi brda sprod pa'i gzhung gzhan ma rnyed kyang sum cu ba dang rtags kyi 'jug pa gnyis gzhir bzhag nas mkhas pa du mas dag yig dang / dgongs 'grel sogs kyi gzhung rtsom mang ngo gahaṃs pu gi gezhi rnam brazhag thazhad pu/yi ge'i rnam bzhag dngos dang / rnam dbye brgyad 'asbos dang bcas pa bshad pa dang / tshig phrad gzhan bshad pa/ rtags kyi 'jug tshul bshad pa/ blo sgo 'byed pa'i phyir mtha' dpyad pa/ zhar byung rtsom lugs kyi rnam bzhag cung zad bshad pa dang bcas sa bcad drug gi sgo nas bshad pa la/ dang bo/ yi ge'i rnam bzhag dazas bshad ba/bod yig gi rnam bzhag ni slob dpon thon mis legs sbyar 8

gyi yi ge dbair byas nas bathos ba yin la/ de yang lalca daspir byas nas bod kyi yi ge dbu can/ wartu dper byas nas bod yig dbu med bzos par grags so/ /rgya gar la dbyangs bcu drug dang / gsal byed so bzhi yod la/ de dag bod kyi yi ge'i gzugs su 'bri ba'i thabs tshul sngon gyi lo tsā ba dag gis mdzad pa 'di ltar/ dbyangs bcu drug ni/ a ā i ā u lca ṛ dzā t+pa skṛ e i o au i aḥ rnams so/ /de dag las/ a i u ṛ lo rnams mig 'dzum gcig gi yun la 'bod dgos stabs yi ge thung ngu zer/ ā yī u rī rmā e o rnams mig 'dzum gnyis kyi yun la 'bod dgos stabs yi ge ring bo zer zhing / de'i snga ma lnga la ring cha can zer/ i au gnyis mig 'dzum gsum gyi yun la brjod dgos stabs shin tu ring bo ke sha can zer/ i la sna ldan nam rjes su nga ro can dang / aḥ la rnam bcad can zer ro/ /gsal byed so bzhi ni/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dzo dzha nya/ṭa ṭha ḍa r+ha ṇa/ ta tha da snya na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/sha dzi sa ha/ k+ṣa/ rnams so/ /slob dpon gyis de'i nang nas 'dor len ji ltar byas tshul ni/ bod la ring thung gi rnam bzhag med stabs/ dbyangs bcu drug nang gi ā ā lca i au i aḥ dang ṛ dzā lo lī rnams dor/ dbyangs dang bo a yig gsal byed du — 9

bsgrun/ lhag ma rme u e lo bzhi la dbyangs yig gi— nges pa mdzad — pa yi na/ gsal byed so bzhi las snya dzha bha dha bha ste 'a thug po lnga dang / ṭa ṭha ḍa ṇasmoste log papagazhi dang / dro ba dzi yig dang /spatharir —be+ed kyi yi ge k+ṣa ste bcu gcig dor/ de'i lhag ma shasal byed nyer gsum gyi thog tu dbyangs nas blangs pa'i a yig dang / stod du ca cha ja gsum dang / smad du —zha za 'a gsum ste yi ge drug gsar du bsnan nas/ gsal byed kyi yi ge grangs sum cur nges par mdzad do/ /de'i phyir deng dus slob deb 'ga' zhig gi nang du 'thug po lnga'i steng du yig gsar re snon khul gyis 'asnyog po drug zer ba dang / log yig lnga sogs bod kyi skad yig yin khul gyis bris te dpe brjod sogs 'jog pa ni bod rang skad kyi gdangs la ma brtags shing / slob dpon thon mis 'dor len —ji ltar byas tshul sogs la brtag dpyad ma zhugs par snang ngo / /sam bho ṭa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta sogs bris pa yod do zhe na de dag ni legs sbyar gyi skad yin la/ de ltar 'phags yul gyi skad gdangs bod yig tu brisabyutshad 'jog ridagos na/ dbyangs bcu drug dang /gsal byed so bzhi thams cad bod kyi skad du byed dgos pa ma zad/ rgya nag sog po/ phyi gling ba sogs kyi skad gdangs bod yig tu bri dgos pa du ma zhig bod yig gi dbyangs gas/la gang 10

rung zhig tu bsnan nas/ dbyangs bzhi las lhag pa dang /gsal byed brgya phrag du ma yod par 'gyur ro/ /gong gi legs sbyar gyi dbyangs bcu drug dang / gsal byed so bzhi bod kyi yig gzugs su bris pa yang / legs sbyar gyid+ku skad dang gzungs sngags sogs/ brdzod pa dang 'don ched de ltar 'bri ba'i/ phyag srol sngon gyi lo tsā ba dag gis gnang ba yin gyi/ bod rang gi skad la 'a thug po dang / ring thung sogs yod pa ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis slob dpon thon mis dor ba yin no/ /yang rgya nag gi skad gdangs thon phyir/ h+pha dang h+phu lta bu'i yi ge kha shas bstan 'gyur dkar chag nor bu'i phreng ba sogs su yod pa ltar gna' dus nas yod pa bzhin/ deng dus su'ang mkhas pa du mas lag len du yod par snang / slob dpon thon mis ca sogs yi ge drug gsar du rnyed pa'i rkyen ni/ khong gis 'phags yul gyi skad rnams bod du bsgyur ba'i tshe/ bod yig 'phags yul ba'i yi ge ltar byas na de'i nang du bod la mi mkho ba du ma zhig yod pa dang / bod skad kyi gdangs 'phags yul ba la med pa du ma zhig yod stabs/ bod yig bzo zhing legs sbyar bsgyur dka' ba byung nas/ kha sbub tu gzims te bzhugs pa na/ sngar cha med pa'i mi zhig slebs par khyed sa/nga nas byon dris par/ zhang zhung las 11

'ongs zer/ gang du 'gro dris par/ za 'or du 'gro zer/ci byed du 'gro dris pas/ ja nyo ru 'gro zer/ nam 'ongs dris pas/ ci cha zer ba'i tshig zur la brtags te/ zhang zhung nas 'ongs zhes pa'i tshig zur las zha yig rnyed/ za 'or du 'gro zhes pa'i tshig zur las za yig dang 'a yig gnyis rnyed/ ja nyo ru 'gro zhes pa'i tshig zur las ja yig rnyed/ ci cha zhes pa'i tshig zur las ca yig dang cha yig gnyis rnyed de/ yi ge drug 'phags yul ba'i skad gdangs la med mod/ bod skad la med du mi rung bar dgongs nas de drug gsar du bsnan par grags so/ /de ltar bod rang skad la dbyangs bzhi dang / gsal byed sum cu dgos shing / de las mang mi dgos pa ni bod kyi mtha' dbus yul skad gtso che ba rnams su/ yi ge de rnams nges par yod la/ des mi 'dang ba med par sems so/ /'on kyang bod rigs yin kyang skad zur ba yod pa/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong ba dag lta bu yod do zhe na/ rgyal rong gi skad sngar bod skad yin mod/ bar skabs shig skenas/ — yul dus kyi dbang gis kha bral nas/ bod gzhan dag dang thug 'phrad cher med par dus yun ring bo song bas rim gyis 'gyur song ba yin te/ da dung kho tsho'i skad kyi nang du bod skad shin tu mang la/ kho tsho'i rang skad dag 12 — —

kyang bod skad kyi sgra 'gyur ba yin pa gsal bor shes nus pa dang / ming phal cher a mdo 'brog pa'i skad gdangs dang thag nye bar yod pa dang brda rnying mang bo yod/ 'phros don cung zad bshad nas dkyus la 'jug pa la/ de ltar bod yig la dbyangs bzhi dang / gsal byed sum cu yod pa slob dpon gyis gtan la phab pa'i dbyangs bzhi'i go rim ni/ i u e o/ gsal byed sum cu'i go rim ni/ ka kha ga nga / /ca cha ja nya/ /ta tha da na/ /pa pha ba ma/ /tsa tsha dza wa/ /zha za 'a ya/ ra la sha sa/ /ha a/ /rnams te gsal byed la sde ba phyed dang brgyad yod/ sde ba re la yi ge bzhi bzhi byas so/ /gsal byed sum cu'i nang nas/ ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra la sa bcu ni rjes 'jug gi yi ge dang / da sa gnyis rjes 'jug tu ma zad yang 'jug kyang yin la da drag sa drag kyang zer/ rjes 'jug bcu'i nang gi ga da ba ma 'a lnga ni sngo na 'jug yin la/ 'phul yig kyang zer/rjes 'jug yin pa ma zad/ sngon 'jug kyang yin/ de'i lhag ma gsal byed nyi shu ni sngon rjes gang la yang mi'ajug pa'i ming gzhi tsha na yinano/ /dbyangs bzhi ni gsal byed kyi yi ge la zhugs nas don sto na dgos la/ dper na/ ki ku ke ko/ zhes ka la dbyangs bzhi rim bzhin zhugs pa dpe 'dis mtshon nas gsal 13

byed gzhanarnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /rjes 'jug yi ge bcu 'jug tshul ni/ dper na/ ngas khadwa / tshadu/ nyaspya/ khabyā/lasdu/ dganya/ shadz+wa/ nyadzi/ nag lta bu'o/ /da drag gam da yangatsojug can ni/ dper na/ pha rol phyi nād/ 'dir byond/ ba/zang bor gyuradu/ skad bsgyuradu/ bka' stsold /lta bu'o/ /sa drag gam sa yang 'jug can ni dper na/ legag/yangs/ babag/ khamaswā/ lta bu'o/ /sngon 'jug lnga 'jug tshul ni/ dper na/ kyitso/ duga'/ byāsam/ — sakhas/ ༷khor/ lta bu'o/ /rjes 'jug bcu ni gsal byed sum cu bo la khyad med du 'jug yang 'jug da drag ni/ rjes 'ju ga na ra la gsum dang / yang 'jug sa drag ni ga nga ba ma bzhi'i rjes su 'jug gi gzhan la mi 'jug spyir mtha' med can dag la yang rnam dbye sogs sbyor tshe 'a mtha' yod pa'i dbang du byed dgos shing / skad gar+sār bcad skabs nas bzung 'a mtha' dor lugs ni/ ming gzhi'i yi ge rkyang ba sngon 'jug can la nges par 'a mtha' dges pa dadzeper na/ gta'/ dpa'/ mkha'/ bca'/gda'/ mtha'/ gnya'/ gza'/ dga'/ lta bu/ sha gu/zhabs kyu/ 'greng bu/ na ro can rnams dang / ra la sa yi mgo can dang / ya ra la wa'i 'dogs can rnams la/ 'a mtha' 14

spang dgos pa yin noska /sngon 'jug ga yig ni/ ca nya ta da na tsa zha za ya sha sa ste bcu gcig tsam gyi sngon du 'jug da yig ni/ ka ga nga pa ba ma ste drug tsam gyi sngon du 'jug ba yig ni/ ka ga dwa ca kau nyu ta da na tsa dza zha za ra sha sa ste bcu drug tsam gyi sngon du 'jug gor k+tags rnyin rnamarmo mgo 'dogs can las rkyang ba la mi 'jug ma yig ni/ kha ga nga cha ja nya tha da na tsha dza ste bcu gcig gi sdon du 'jug 'a yig ni/ kha ga cha ja tha da pha ba tsha dza ste bcu'i sngon du 'jug go/ /dper na/ gnam lta bu la/ ga sngon 'jug na ming gzhi/ ma rjes 'jug shar lta bu la/ sdon 'jug med la /sha ming gzhi/ ra rjes 'jug gang lta bu la/ ga ming gzhi/ nga rjes 'jug ngag lta bu la/ nga ming gzhi/ ga rjes 'jug ste go ldog pa yin/ lho lta bu la/ sngon rjes gang yang med pas rkyang ba zer/ 'on kyang mtha' med can rnams la don gyis 'a mtha' thob kyang yig tshogs skyung phyir skad gsar bcad kyi tshe blangs pa yin no/ /mgo can/ 'dogs can/ wa zur can bcas yod pa'i ra la sa yi mgo gsum las ra mgo can bcu gnyis ni/ rka rga rnga r+sā rnya rta rda rna rba rma rtsa rdza/ la mgo can bcu/ ni/ lka lga lnga lca lja lta 15

lda lpa sba lha/ sa mgo can bcu gcig ni/ ska sga snga snya sta sda sna spa sba sma stsa/ ya btags ra btags la btags wa btags bzhi las ya btags bdun ni/ kya gya khya pya phya bya mya/ ra btags bcu gcig ni/ kra khra gra tra dra thra pra phra bra sra hra/ la btags drug ni/ kla gla bla zla rla sla/ wa btags bcu gnyis ni/ kwa kha ga nywa dwa tshwa zhwa grwa rwa lu shwa hwa/ rtswa sngon dang / phywa g.yang lta bu mgo 'dogs can kha shas yang yod pa shes par bya'o/ / ride dag gi sdom ni/ rke ) mkhas mchog thon mi sam bho ṭas// chi rgya gar yi ge dper blangs nas// bod yig 'bri ba'i srol chen btod// dbyangs bzhi gsal byed sum cu dang //gsal byed nang nas rjes 'jug bcu// ga nga da na ba ma 'a// rto ra la sa dang de'i nang nas// ga da ba ma 'a lnga bo// sngon du 'jug pa'i yi ge yin//da sa gnyis ni yang 'jugakren//rjes 'jug ming gzhi kun la 'jug / 1ba

—ming gzhi rkyang ba 'phul can la//'a mtha' nges par thob pa yin//dbyangs ldan mgo dang 'dogs can la//'a mtha' spang dgos shes par bya//yang 'jug da ni na ra la//sa ni ga nga ba ma bzhir// sngon 'jug ga ni ca nya ta// da na tsa zha za ya sha/ sa bcas bcu gcig sngon du 'jug /da ni ka ga nga pa ba// ma ste drug gi sngon du 'jug / ba yig ka ga nga ca ja nya ta da na tsa dza zha// za ra sha sa bcas bcu drug / ma yig kha ga nga cha ja//nya tha da na tsha dza bcas /bcu gcig kho na'i sngon du 'jug /'a yig kha ga cha ja tha// da pha ba tsha dza ste bcu// 17

ra la sa yi mgo can dang //ya ra la wa'i 'dogs can bcas// sa mgo bcu gnyis la mgo bcu// sa mego bcu gcig ya btags bdun//ra btags bcu gcig la btags drug /wa zur can ni bcu gnyis so// zhes byang bar bya'o/ /yi ge'i rnam bzhag dngos bshad zin to// // gnyis pa/ rnam dbye brgyad 'phros dang bcas pa bshadapa/ rnam dbye brgyad yod de/ dang bo ngo bo tsam ston pa/gnyis pa las su bya ba/ gsum pa byed pa/ bzhi ba dgos ched/lnga ba 'byung khungs/ drug pa 'brel sgra/ bdun pa gnas gzhi'am rten gnas/ brgyad pa 'bod pa'am bod pa ste brgyad do //1 rnam dbye dang be+e dzo bo tsam ston pa bshad pa/rnam dbye dang bo ngo bo tsam ston pa ni ming tsam las logs su med la/ don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa ming dang / don gyi ngo bo kṛ8

dang khyad par s+hor nas ston pa tshig yin te/ dper na khang ba zhes pas khang ba'i ngo bo tsam las khyad par gang yang mi ston stabs ming tsam yin/ khang ba'i ka ba zhes pasi khang—ba'i ngo bo dang de'i khyad par ka ba gnyi sa bar rnam dbyesasnrur nas ston pa'i sgra yin stabs/ ming tshig gnyis su phye sa pa'i tshig yin la/ming tshig gnyis su phyes pa'i ming dang chig gnyis 'gal mod/spyir ming dang tshig gnyis mi 'gal te/ khang ba'i ka ba zhes pa ming yang yin la tshig kyang yin pa'i phyir/ gyu de blozhin du ka ba zhe sa pa ming dang / ka ba'i zur zhes pa ming tshig gnyis su phyes pa'i tshig yin pa shes par bya'o/ / le gas sbyar la rnam —dbye dang bo'i gcig tshig nyis tshig sogs logs su yod mod/ skubod 'dir don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i ming la rnam dbye dang bo zhes ming/ 'dogs pa las/ logs su rnam dbye dang bo me da/ 'on kyang / mi dag bod dag ces pa lta bu'i dag sgra nyis tshig dang / mi rnams/ bod rnams lta bu'i rnams sgra mang tshig yin mod/ dper na rang re'i mkhas pa snga ma dag gis 'di ltar gsungs zhes pa lta bu'i dag sgra mang tshi ga la 'jug pa yang skabs du mar yod pa shes sla/rnam dbye dang bo ming tsam gyi dper brjod ni/ lha/ mi/19

mgo yan lag mchog bzang / thon skyed/ sprin/ rgyab/rgyal khab/ lam/ mda'/ gser/ skyed tshal/ g.yas/dbus/ pha rol lta bu'o/ /rnam dbye dang bo dang 'brel ba'i rdzogs tshig ni/ go ngo do no bo mo 'o ro lo so rnams dang / da drag gi dbang gis to bcas bcu gcig yod/ rdzogs tshig dang /slar sdud/ zla sdud rnams ni ming gi rnam grangs yin la/ de dag ni rjes 'jug rang 'drar sbyar dgos/ dper na/ mgo ni yan lag mchog go /shin tu bzang ngo / /thon skyed byed do/ /kha zas sbyin no/ /sa bon btab po/ /'di ni gzhung lam mo/ /'di ni mo'o/ /nga ni dga' 'o/ /gser ro/ /rgyal khab 'di ni rang re'i mes rirgyal lo/ /gzhung 'bru 'bul lo/ /bya ba byas so/ /pho brang du phebs so/ /pha rol tu phyin to/ /lta bu/ don de re zhig rdzogs par ston pas rdzogs tshig zer ba las don yongs su rdzogs par ston mi dgos/ rang gi rjes de ma thag tu slar yang rang gi tshig grogs 'byung ba sdud pa'am mi 'byung bar byas pas slar sdud ces brjod/ rang gi mjug de ma thag tu tshig rang gi zla bo'am grogs po 'byung ba bsdus pa'am mi 'byung bar byas pas na zla sdud zer/ rdzogs tshig de dag gi rjes su tshig gzhan 'byung yang / snga ma'i tshig grogs min la/ 'di'i zla sdud ces pa'i 20

sdud ni/ 'byed sdud kyi sdud min gyi mjug sdud kyi sdud yin no/ /'on kyang go sogs yod tshad rdzogs tshig min te/ byed pa bo/ tshor ba bo/ lta bu bdag sgra dang / yin par go lta bu khong du chud pa'am shes pa'i don dang / 'di ko zhes pa nges bzung dang / btsun mo/ yu mo/ ma mo/ bu mo lta bu mo rtags dang / spyi bo lta bu ming zur yin pas de sogs la ma 'khrul ba dgos so/ /2 rnam dbye gnyis pa sogs bshad pa/ rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba dang / bzhi ba dgos ched/ bdun pa gnas gzhi gsum dang / rnam dbye brgyad gang rung ma yin pa'i tshig phrad/ de nyid dang / bden pa yang zer/tshe skabs/ dus ston pa'ang zer ba ste don lnga la 'jug pa ni/su ru du na la rnams dang / ru bsdus pa'i ra yig dang / da drag sogs kyi dbang gis thob pa tu yig ste bdun yod la/ 'di dag gi tshab tu phal cher la yig 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis la don yang zer la/ su ru tu du rnams ni sngon ma'i rjes 'jug la ltos pas phrad gzhan dbang can yin la/ na la gnyis sngon ma'i mtha' la mi ltos pas phrad rang dbang can zer/ 'di dag ming mtha' gang la 'jug pa ni/ lha1

sposu ga badzād drag stso / / / nga da na ma ra la cwa // 'a dang mtha' rten med mthar ྅/ / 'di dang ra mtha' bya ba gtsig /na la gnyis ni rang dbang can//zhes pa ltar/ sa mtha' rten can gyi rjes su sdo dang / ga ba da drag mtha' rten can la stso/ nga da na ma ra la mtha' rten can la stso/ 'a mtha' rten can dang rjes 'jug med pa dag gi rjes su ru dang / ru bsdus nas de'i tshab tu ra rjes 'jug gi tshul du rnojog pa dang / na la gnyis mtha' p+tan nges pa med par 'jug pa sogs dper brjod kyis shes par bya'o/ /3 la don de rnams rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya bar 'anug tshul/ /na rnam dbye gnyis pa sbyar sa'i gzhi de la bya ba gzhan zhig byas pa'am byed bzhin pa dang / byed 'gyur 6gang rung ston pa zhi ga dgos te/ dper na/ g.yas su nyal zhes pa'i g.yas bya ba byed sa'i gzhi dang / nyal ba ni gzhi de la byed pa'i bya ba yin par rnam dbye sta yig gis go ba lta bu/ rnam dbye sta yig med na/ g.yas nyal zhes brjod dgos la/ g.yas nyal ba'i gni ཿlha

yin par mi go bar/ nyal ba bor go bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du/ shar du 'gro zhes par shar gzhi dang / de la 'gro ba'i mab byed 4 go ba rnam dgerga yig gi nus pa yin la/ rnam dbye gnyis pas rnam par dbye rgyu yang bya ba'i gzhi dang bya ba gnyis so sor phyesponas go bar byed pa yin par snyam/dper na rjes 'jug sa'i rjes su sta yig yong ba'i rnam dbye gnyis pa ni/ dbus su 'gro/ rtswa lhas ga rtswa btu/ rang gi sdod gnas sta gad bdar byedi/ bod ljongs tre srid dbang 'dzugs/rang khongs sta srid don byed/ mdo khams snga ja shing 'dzugs lta bu/ 'a dang mtha' med mthar ru yong ba'i rnam dbye gnyis pa/nam mkha' sdo gnam gru 'phur/ ༷rgya mtsho sdo nya mo rtse/ sa gzhi sdo 'bras 'debs/ khang ba ru ༷tshon rgyagaslob grwa ru slob sbyong byed lta bu/ru bsdus pa'i dpe/ nam mkha rnyadzogan ma gru 'phur/ rgya mtshor nya mo rtse/ sa gzhir 'bras 'debs/ khong bar tshon rgyag slob grwardi slob sbyong byed/ lta bu/ ra mtha' can ༷dang ru bsdus pa'i re yig gnyis ma nor ba dgos/ ga ba datswa drag rnams kyi rjes su tu yong ba'i dpe las/ ga mtha' rten can ni / lag tu smyu gu badzung /ngag t+yā srid don bshad/ 'brog t+t+waṃ 'tsho skyong byedo/ khang thog stso bro 'khrab lta bu dang / ba mtha' rten can ni/ rgyal khab shrī 23

bzo las byed/ thab tu me btang / nub tu rgyugs ra bzos/rgyab t+yā gos gsar gyon ༷lta bu/ da drag can sno/ phyi rold tu ༷ gra sgrig byed/ pha rold cwa me mda' 'phangs/ lta bu/ nga da na ma ra la rnams kyi rjes su du 'ong ba dper na/ nga mtha' can ni/ nang rga yi ge 'bri/ ༷rtswa thang rga lug 'tsho/ slob khang rga rig gnas slob/ zhing nang cwa 'bras 'debs/ lta bu/ da mtha' can ni/ dmangs khrod stso las don bsgrubs/ gnas de nyid duX dpe cha brtsams/ ri sked stso shing btsugs/ thog shod stso mjal 'phrad gnang lta bu/ na mtha' can ni/ mdun du ri mo bris/ g.yon du dpe cha klog lam chen du phyin/ lha ldan stso yang yang song /༷ gnas gzhan sdi lta skor rla song / lta bu/ma mtha' can ni/ gzhung lam du rta drel song / sgrom du— gser dngul bcug gsham s+t+ri ang rtar+ghaṃs brgyab/ kho bo'i gam sdi gtam bshad/ lta bu/ ra mtha' can ni/ chu yur snyi chu drangs/pe cin mkhar cwa 'thus mi mngags/ ri bar rga ri dwags song / shar sdo 'bras zhing btab/ lta bu/ la mtha' can ni/ skyed tshal snyi shing btsugs/ bzhugs gral ṣ+yo gtam bshad/ grong dkyil sdo rtags brgyab/ rab gsal sto glog sgron sbar lta bu/ na yig mtha' nges med du 'jug pa ni/ dbus spya 'gro/ mdo 24

khams na ja shing 'dzugs/ nam mkha' ni gnam gru 'a phur/ sa gzhi na 'bras 'debs/ slob grwa na slob sbyong byed/ lag na smyu gu bar+bhang / 'brog na 'tsho skyong byede/ thab na me btangardzi/ ༷phyi rol nu gra sgrig byas/ ༷ nang nu yi ge 'bri/ hūṃg shod na0 mjal 'phrad gnang / rta lam chen naX brgyugs/ gsham na yi ge bris/pe cin mkhar nā 'thus mi mngags/ grong dkyil na ༷tshong khang btsugs lta bu/ la yig de dag gi tshab tu mtha' nges med du 'jug pa ni/ dbus laX 'gro/ sdod gnas ༷ gad bdar byed/nam mkha' lda bya 'phur/ rgya mtsho ༷ gru btang / rgya nag la song /khang thog lda 'edzegs/ 'brog la hūṃgs 'tshos/ theb la me btang / rgyab la gos gyon/ phaX rol lta rdo 'phangs/ thaje lalug 'tsho/ zhidza ༷ sa bon 'debs/ ri sled sa lam bzos ༷lha ldan lta song / sa gzhan ༷ yang phebs/ gnam ༷ bya 'phur/dre'u 'dam lda zug ras dkar dzo tshon brgyab/ lcags dpar la bzo bcos shāgyis/ rang yul swo skad btang / 'grim 'grul zlo yi ge bskur lta bu'o/ / rnam dbye bzhi ba dgos ched la 'jug tshul/rnam dbye sbyar sa'i gzhi de la bya ba byas tsam mam byed pa 25

tsam zhig ston pa ma yin par/ rnam dbye sbyar sa'i gzhi de'i ched du'am don du bya ba ci rigs ston pa zhig dgos te/ dper na/rgyal khab 'phel thabs su bzo grwa 'dzugag zhesapa'i rgyal khab 'phel thabs rnayodabye kyir sa'i gzhi dang / gzhi de la bzo grwak+ṣ-i 'dzugs pa'i bya ba byed pa tsam ston pa yin na/ de'i rnam dbye su de gnyis pa las su bya bar 'gyur mod/ de ltar ma yin par rgyarmo4 khab 'phel thabs kyi ched du'am de'i don du bzo grwa ngadzugs par ston pa yin la/ de rnam dbye stocosgra'i nus pas go ba yin /tshigs bcad sogs kyi skabs/ su med na/ rgyal khab 'phelnga thabs bzo grwa 'dzugs/ zhes brjod tshe rnam dbye su bsdus pa yin par shes dgos/ gos sdo ras 'thag lta bu la/ rnam dbye sdo med na gos ras 'thag ces pa gos kyi ched du ras 'thag pa mi go bar/ ras 'thag pa tsam du 'gyur ro/ / la don bzhi ba dgos ched la 'jug pa/ dper na/ rgyal 'phel thabs snga bzo grwa 'dzugs/ gos sta ras 'thag kha zas su 'bras nyos/ sdod gnas sta khang ba brtsigs/ ri dwags bda' s+t+ri ri mgor song / grogs dga' ru rogs ram byed/yon tan lon pa ru brtson 'grus bskyed/ dgra 'gog pa ru mtshon cha bsgrig 'tsho ba rni ngal rtsol byed/ lo thog legs pa ngh+ru lud 26 jiX ji

sdug ri dwags bda' bar ri mgor phyin/ yon tan lon pan brtson 'grus bgyis/ ༷dgra 'gog rmor mtshon cha bsgrig 'a6 ༄khasangal rtsol byas/ lo thog legs baṃr lud rdzug grogs dga' b.ri rogs ram byed/ lo thog tu zhiji rmo/ dgra 'gog tu sngogalaX song / gra sgrig t+yā las byed rbo 'tshogs/ me tog stso chu jengs/lto rgyab tu zhing las byas/ don 'grub tu 'bad brtson bgyis/las dorno sgrub tu zhing grong la song / ༷khang thog 'geb tu rdza gyo bzos/ 'grul r+sha pha rol sgrold tu chu khar song / dpal rmobyorad+ku'apheld snye bzo zhing la 'bad/ ༷ skad yig bsgyurd tu pe cin la song / rirgo gnas mthar phyind tu hur brtson byas/ 0sa zhing du sa rgod brkos/ zhing nang bongaX ma brdung du song / rgyal khar+sha srung skyob stso mtsho dmag bsgrig zhib dpyod hūṃ mi kha shas song /rtsad gcod sdo mi mngags/ don 'grub ched s+t+ri 'bad 'bungs bgyis/ snyan sgron spro yi ge phul/ yi ge len du song / sman rtswa spang spos brkos/ skyin du mu tig nyos/ tshoṭ+wāṃ bgam du gtarme dris/ pha rol bo la tshod ༷bgam du0 phyin/ khyams rar zhashā 'dzom s+t+ri phyin/ bca' lag g.yar duX song / gros bsdur duX 'tshogs/chu yur stso sa rko/ bzhes phor sdi dkar yol nyos/ mtshams sbyor du yi ge bris/ nad sel du sman pa bsten/ 'ching 'grol du 9 pa lha7 ༷

'thab rtsod byed/ 'od gsal stso sge'u khung bton/ skom na ja 'thung / zas g.yo ba nā me 'bud/ rig pa slob na /brtson 'grus byed/ lta bu/ la yig de kun gyi tshab tu 'jug pa ni/ rgyal khab 'phel thabs skya bzo grwa 'dzugs/ gos ༷ ras 'thag yon tan len pa sa brtson 'grus dgos/ 'tsho ba lta ngal rtsol byed/mgron po ldu me btang / nad pa ༷ sman byin/ dgra 'gog sa sngon du song / gra sgrig lda las byed 'tshogs/ me tog la chu 'dren/ rig pa slob pa la brtson 'grus byed/ zas g.yo dṛ la me 'bud/ don sgrub sdu r+shartson/ skad yig bsgyur la pe cin ṭaṃ song / bong ma brdung ldu song / zhib dpyod ༷ song / rtsad gcod ༷ song / yi ge len lta song / rgyan ༷ mu tig nyos/ tshod bgam ༷ dka' gnad 'dri/ gros bsdur lta song / bzhes phor ༷ dkar yol nyos/ nad sel ༷ sman pa bsten/ spyi tshogs ring lugs ༷ 'bad brtson bgyis lta bu'o/ /zas g.yo ba na bya ba ci sgrub dgos zhes dris pa'i lan du/ zas g.yo ba na me gtong zhes pa'i na yig ni dgos ched yin la/ zas g.yo ba'i dus su me gtong ba la bsams nas zas g.yo ༷ na me gtong zhes pa'i na yig tshe skabs yin/ de bzhin du skom pas gdung ba'i mi la/ skom gdung sel ched du ja 'thung / zhes brjod 'dod nas/ skom na lha8

ja 'thung zhes brjod pa'i na yig ni dgos ched yin te/ sgra ni brjod 'dod rjes 'brang phyir/ /gsungs pa ltar ro/ /5 rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi la 'anug tshul/rnam dbye sbyar sa'i gzhi de la bya ba zhig byas pa'am byed pa dang / gzhi de'i ched du byas pa dang byed 'gyur gang yang mi ston par/ gzhi de la chos shig gnas par ston pa tsam ste/dper na/ rtswa lhas na rta yod ces pas gzhi rtswa lhas su rta yod pa tsam las/ gzhi rtswa lhaXs la bya ba zhig byas pa'am byed pa dang /rtswa lhas kyi ched du byas pa'am byed 'gyur lta bu gang yang mi ston/bar gyi rnam dbye med na rtswa lhas rta yod ces rtswa lhas dang rta gnyis so sor yod pa ston pa las/ rtswa lhas de nyid rta gnas sa'i gzhi yin par go mi nus/ rnam dbye sbyar bas rtswa lhas rten dang rta brten pa yin par go nus so/ /la don bdun pa gnas gzhi la 'jug pa dper na/ shar phyogs su yod/ lho phyogs su yod/ nam mkha' ru nyi zla yod/lho snge rgya mtsho yod/ nam matrer nyi zla yod/ lhorno rgya mtsho yod/thashā shrī me yod/ khri thog nā b.rūgs yod/ lag t+t+waṃ ‘smyu gu yod/byang snye rlung che/ zhing spro myu gu skyes/ lcags ri tshun chad du mi 4 bye9

khyim mang / bar shod du mi mang / g.yon du dpe cha yod/mdun sdo dkar yol mdzebaṃ/ gnam cwa 'ja' tshorno bkra/ lam du mi mang / mkhar du bzo las yod/ shar rtswa 'phrul 'khor rmeng / rgya yul s+t+ri‘ 'byornge ba che/ skyed tshal stso rme tog bzhad/nam mkha' na nyi ma shar/ sa gzhi na rtsi shing rgyas/ ri na ri dwags gnas/ thab na me yod/ spang 3 me tog bzhad/ byang na rlung che/ bar shod na mi mang / snod na dngos rdzas mang /rmedun nu dkar yol mardzis/ gnam spya 'ji' tshon bkra/ lam na mi yod/ mkhar na —bzo grwa yod/ skyed tshal na rma bya yod/ lta ṭaṃ'o/ /la yig ni/ shar phyogs la yod/ narme mkha' ༷ nyi zla yod/ lho swā rgya mtsho yod/ byang la lhags pa che/ khri thog lka thazhugs yosdo/ rgyab la mi yod/ ༷thab la me 'bar/ lcagasalde tshun chad la sdi khyim ma( / g.yon ༷ dope cha yod/ mdun sa snag bum yod/ rgyal yongs sa mi rigs mang / gnam ༷ nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms/ mkhar lha tshong khrom che/ rang yul la bde skyid 'dzoms lta bu'o/ / shā6 de nyid la 'jug tshul/rnam dbye sbyar sa'i gzhi de la bya ba zhig byas pa dang / r+pād 30

pa ston pa ma yin pa dang / rnam dbye sbyar sa'i bya ba'i gzhi dang /bya ba gnyis so sor med pas gnyis pa min tshol/ rnam dbye sbyar sa'i gzhi de'i ched du bya ba byas pa dang byed pa ci rigs ston pa ma yin pa dang / rnam dbye sbyar sa'i dgos ba bsgrub yul gyi gzhi dang de'i dgos pa gnyis so sor med stabs bzhi ba dgos ched yang min/ rnam dbye sbyar sa'i gzhi de la chos gzhan zhig gnas par ston pa tsam ma yin pa dang / rten pa'i gzhi dang brten pa so sor med stabs/ bdun pa gnas gzhi'am rten gnas kyang min no/ /des na de nyid ni la don gyi tshig phrad sbyar sa de nyid kyi ngo bong grub pa'am sbyar sa de nyid kyi ngo bostid du grub par ston pa zhig dgos te/ dper na/ gsal du btang / zhes pa'i tshig phrad sbyar sa'i gsal ba de'i ngo bor baXtang ba'am de'i ngo bo je gsal du btang ba'i don yin gyi/ g.yas su nyal lta bu'i bya ba'i yul dang bya ba gnyis so sor yod pa lta bu ma smrin la/ tshig phrad s+t+ri yig med na gsal btang zhes brjod tshe gsal ba gzhan du btang ba lta bu zhig las go rgyu med par 'gyur ro/ /la don de nyid la 'jug pa/ dper na/ shes sdi bcugadangos snga shes/ rgyas sta bcug 'dus byas snga grub/ zhing las mnyam las su gyur/ legs su btang / mems dpa' ru nges/9 9 ༷ 31

kho dga' ru bcug bden pa ru grub/ bya ba chen po ru nges/—rin po che pru nges/ sems dparmo nges/ bden par grub0/ chen por nges/ ༷ rin po cherū gsarlo/ rgyal khab cherno por gyur/masdug sto gyur/ bden ts+tshag shrī gnas/ drago kyā 'khrug ༷rab stso grub/ kun khyab tu spel/ je zab tu btang / shind tu bden /sems 'gyurd shrī r+sha/ cug rbab la rmegrild swo bcug rji mang s+t+ri btang / thang rgod sa zhing du gyur/ 'od rtswa 'tsher/ lugs ngan zad snyi bcug gnyid thed cwa rbacug mi tha chad sdi gyur/ rje bor 'phrad byu bcug kho bo bzhad du bcug don gal chen du gnas/ zlog pa sprin duX song / dgra bo'i nus pa je zhan sdu ༷ btang / rgyal khab sra brtan gi gyur/ phye zan sdi byas nas zos/ras rkyang stan duX byas nas nyal/ 'jig rten zhi 'jam sdi song / mi rigs 'dra mnyam sdi gyur/ thag pa dam gi bzung / sems je 'jam cwa gyur/ me je 'bar s+t+ri gyur/ chu 'khyags dar sdo gyur/'ob de chu yur sdi btang / gser snyi grub/ gangs kyi ri bo tshar cwa dngar/ la yig gi dpe/ zhing las mnyam las sa bsgyur/ je legs lha btang / tshig de bden pa la gnas/ chos de 'dus byas lta grub / rim gyis mi dmangs la r+shan pa'i las 'gul chen po sdu gyur/ deng sang rgyal khab chen po zhig swā gyurazla 32 6

'dug ji zab swā btang / ji gtsang ༷ gyur/ thang chen zhing ༷ bsgyur/ tha snyad swā grub/ mi tha chad lta gyur/ bod skad swā bsgyur/ don ༷ gnas/ smug pa sprin ༷ gyur/ ji 'jam sa song / mi rigs 'dra mnyam ༷ gyur/ tshong las so nam ༷ bsgyur/ chu dar lta log lcags gser sa gyur/ je gsal ༷ btang / yang tshad ma'i gzhung rnams su ba lang la ba lang ma yin pa med gsungs pa'i la yig gi zlas drangs na ba lang lta/ dkar zal yod/ shing la tsan dan yod/ bod mi la —mkhas pa yod/ 'bru rigs la gro rmid/ lta bu/ ba lang lda dz+wa yod/ces pa'e la yig bduni pa gnas gzhi yin la/ ba zlong la dkar zal yod/༷ ces pa'i la yig de nyid yin/ shing la lam̐ ma yod ces pa'i la yig gnas gzhi yin mod/ shing la tsanaX dan yod/ces pa'i la yig de nyid yin/ bod yul la rmokhas pa yod ces pa'i la yije gnas gzhi yin mod/ bod mi rlo mkhas pa yod ces pa'i zlo yig de nyid yin/ bang stadzod nangaX la gro yod/ ces pa'i zlo yig gnas gzhi yin la/ 'bru rigs rnyi gro yod/ ces pa'i la yig de nyid yin/ phyi ma rnams de'i ngo bor gyur pa'i de nyid rtse yod pa la bsam dgos so/ /na yig gi dpe/ ming gis btags tsam na snang / de ka rang na 'dug de kho na nyid/cho jiñca 33

so na gnas/ nad pa kha mal na yod/ khyim tshang bde thog yag thog ༷na yod/ bsam gtan daje bo na thams cad/ /mi ljog sed na dga' ma gtogs/ /lta bu'o/ /nad pa kha mal na yod/ ces pa'i na yig de nyid yin/ ru ba kha ma la na yod cerme pa'i na yig gnas gzhi yin te/ snga ma nad pa'i ngo bo rmepho 'gyur cher ma byung bar sngar ltar gyi ngo bor gnas yod pa'i don dang /phyi ma 'brog pa'i ru ba sngar gyi lhas na yod ba'i don lpen no/ /7 tshe skabs la 'anug tshul/de'i tshe dang / de'i dus dang / de'i skabs zhes pa lta bu'i tshe dang dus dang skabs kyi tshab tu dus tsam ston pa la/ la don rnams gong bzhin du 'jug pa las/ bya ba dang dgos pa dang / gzhi gzhan zhig la chos gang yang rung ba gnas pa ston pa dang / ngo bo nyid du grub par ston pa gang yang min stabs/ gong ma bzhi ka dang mi 'dra zhing / de bzhi gang yang ma yin pa shes sla'o/ /dper na/ gna' dus sta/ deng skabs zhwa/ rgyun chags rga/ nyin 'ga' ru/ gna' snga mo sdo/ dus tshod dang bo snge tshogarme 'tshogs/ durla tshod lnga ba sdo grorla/ nyin 'gaṭā /gna' snga mor/ dus tshod dang bor/ dus tshod lnga bar grol/tshi ༷ 9 4

de ma thag tu grol/ rtag tu dran shes bsten/ nyi nub tu tshogs grol/ skarbos kund stso dogarmo zon byed/ nyin gung du/ ༷ nyin phyed stso/ dpyid durmi sta /sa bon 'debs/ ston s+t+risge zhing brnga/mtshan s+t+ri/ dus gzhan sdi/ sngon sdo/ rgyun stso dpeltas byed/lo gsum stso bskyar sbyong byas/ dbyar cwa au tog mang / nyi shar snge slebs/ phyed yol sto thon/ gna' dus na/ deng skabs ne+e/ de dus na/ dus rgicig na 'di mthong /0nyi nub na slebs/nyin gung na thon/ lo gsum na— slob sbyong byas/ gna' dus lta/dus tshod dnge bo lda/ de dus rme/ nyin 'ga' lta/ nyi nub sde/ snga dro la/ nyin spyod la/ phyedaX yol lnga sbyon/ phyi lo la/ lo gsurmi lta/ gle lnga ༷ bzo grwaX du ma zhig grub/ — lo gsum gyi ༷rjes ༷ bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ngo / /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar la yig ni su sogs la don gzhan /rnams kyi tshab tu yang las sogs don lnga la khyad med du 'jug ba gong gi dpe brjod rnams su bkod pa ltarakren la/ de 'i rgyu mtshan gyis rtsa bar yang bzhi ba dgu ba dngos kyang sto//las dang ched dang rten gnasadang //de nyid tshe skabs la sgra yin// 35

zhes gsungs so// 8 la don rnams las na la gnyis kyi 'jug tshul gzhan bshad pa/de ltar bshad ma thag pa'i la don rnams las/ na la gnyis 'jug tshul gzhan yang yod de/ na yig ni/ dmigs kyis 'byed pa/ rgyu mtshan/ rgyu mtshan don gyis bstan pa/ tshig phyi ma'i don tshig snga ma'i bstan bya dang 'gal bar ston pa/ 'os par dka' ba mchog tu 'dzin pa dang de las ldog pa/ 'gal dang mi 'gal ston pa/ smon pa'i gzhi ston pa/ the tshom gyi gzhi rnams la yang 'jug pa las/ dang bo dmigs kyis 'byed pa la/ gal 'dzugs dang /gzhung 'dzugs gnyis yod pa'i dang bo ni/ dper na/ kho la rig gnas kyi yon tan chen po ldan nam mi ldan/ ldan na slob grwa chen po'i dge rgan du 'os/ mi de mkhas pa yin nam min/ yin na ngas slob dpon du bsten dgos/ sang nyin lam grogs e yod/yod grang na e cag 'gro/ lta bu'o/ /gzhung 'dzugs pa ni/dngos su na/ mdor na/ mdo rtsa bshad na0/ mdo don bshad na/lta bu gzhung don khyad par du bton nas dmigs 'byed pa'o/ /dmigs kyis 'byed ces pa ni dmigs kyis bsal ba'i don yin 36

pas/ dgar ba dang don gcig par gsungs/ rīganyis pa rgyu mtshan ni/ dper na/ rgyu rkyen gyis byas naX/mi rtag lta bu dang / rgyu yod pa na 'bras bu 'byung lta bu tshe skabs la'ang 'jug go /gsum pa rgyu mtshan don gyis bstan pa ni/ dper na/gzhan la gnas der du ba med par sgrub pa la dngos su/ 'dir me med na du ba ji ltar yod ces brjod pa lta bu ste/ na yig gis du ba yod pa me yod pa'i rgyu mtshan du don gyis ston pa'o/ /bzhi ba/ tshig phyi ma'i don tshig snga ma'i bstan bya dang 'gal bar ston pa ni/ 'di sngon slob sbyong la midaga' ba zhig yin na/da ni slob sbyong la shin tu spro ba zhig tu gyur 'dug go/ /'di sngon blun po zhig yin na'ang / da mkhas par gyur 'dug gang du mtshe'u yod pa de na hūṃ yod pa yin na/ thang 'di nitshochus dben pa'i thang ngo / /lta bu'o/ /༷lnga ba 'os par dka' ba'am mi 'os pa mchog tu 'dzin pa ni/ dper na/ mkhas pas log bshad byed na/ blun— pos lta ci smos lta bu ste/ snga ma mi 'os pa'i tshig gis/༷ tshig phyi ma de'i rdon nges par byed pas na/ phyi tshig nges par 'byed pa'ang zer/mkhas pas log bshad byed pa shin tu mi 'os par 'dzin pa la/37

mi 'os pa mchog tu 'dzin pa zhes btags pa yin/ de las ldog pa snga ma 'os pa'i tshig gis/ phyi —ma'i tshig don nges par byed pa ni/ drun pos yi ge shes na mkhas pas lta ci smos lta bu'o / / drug pa 'gal dang mi 'gal ston pa ni/ dper na/ gsel yin nu ra gan min/ dngulko yin na zha nye min/ rtag par yod 1 mi rtag par ni yod pa min no/ ༷ /lta bu ste/ rtag mi rtag gnyis 'gal bar ston cing / mi rtag par yod pa dang / rtag par med pa gnyis mi 'a gal bar ston pas na/ 'gal dang mi 'gal ston pa zhes brjod par gsungs/bdun pa smon pa'i gzhi ni/ dper na bdag mkhas par gyur spya ci ma rung / lta bu'o/ /brgyad pa thetshemarkegyi gzhi ni/ dper na/ skad cha de bshad spya 'grig gam mi 'grig ngas slob sbyong hur brtson byas na /mkhas par 'gyur ram mi 'gyur/ lta bu'o/ /la yig lhag bcas la 'jug pa yod de/ dper na/ nang rtswa' groji la zas za/ lta bu'o/ /9 rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra/ kyi gi gyi 'i dang tshigs bcad kyi rkang ba skong tshe yi yang thob 38

pas/ kyi gi gyi 'i yi lnga bo 'brel sgra la 'jug ste/ rnam dbye sbyar sa'i khyad gzhi de la/ khyad chos gang yang rung ba zhig ldan pa'am de dang 'brel ba ston pas na 'brel sgra zer/ dper na/ bdag gi mig ces brjod tshe/ bdag khyad gzhi dang / de la rnam dbye sbyar nas mig ces brjod pa na/ mig de nyid bdag dang 'brel ba'am bdag gi yin pa go ba bzhin no/ /rnam dbye gi med na/bdag mig ces bdag dang mig gnyis so sor go ba tsam las yan lag can dang yan lag gi tshul du 'brel ba go mi nus so/ /kyi gi gyi 'i yi rnams rtags mtha' gang la 'jug tshul yang /da ba sa kyi ga nga gi// na ma ra la'i rjes su gyi //'a dang mtha' rten med mthar 'i//rkang ba skong tshe yi zhes 'thob//ces pa ltar/ da ba sa rjes 'jug can rnams kyi rjes su 'brel sgra sbyor dgos tshe kyi thob/ ga nga gnyis mtha' rten can la gi thob/ na ma ra la mtha' rtenacan la gyi thob/ 'a mtha' can dang mtha' rten med pa dag gi rjes su 'i thob la/ tshigs su bcad pa'i tshig gi kha skong dgos tshe 'a mtha' can dang mtha' med mthar 'brel sgra yi bzhag chog go/ /39

de yang 'brel ba la bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba dang /yan lag dang yan lag can gyi 'brel ba dang / bdag po dang yul gyi 'brel ba/ rten dang brten pa'i 'brel ba bcas bzhi yod pa las/ dang bo dper na/ yid kyi dran pa/ bde skyid k+shi 'tsho ba/ gangs kyi— ri/ zhag gi kha zarmo/ ngag gi smra brjod//bras chan sdi zas/ gser sdi burme pa/ shel sdi snode/ bgrod dka' ba'i lam/ pags pa'i gos/ lta bu/ yan lag dang yan lag can gyi 'brel ba ni/ dper na/ khyed sdi lag pa/ rgya khab kyi mig ri rab k+shi rtse/ lus kyi yan lag ras kyi kha tshar/bdag sdi mgo shing gi yal ga gzhin sdi smin ma/ ༷zam sdi ka ba/ gur sdi thag pa/ nyal thul sdi phyi ma/ na bzasri dum bu/khang bsdi ka ba/ lta bu/ bdag po dang yul gyi 'brel ba ni/dper na/ khyed kyi rgyu nor/ rgyal khab k+shi dngos rdzas/ bdag gi nor/ khong giX ca lag spyi mthun ñji s+t+waṃng sa/ yum gyi rgyan cho/ dpal 'khor sdi ca lag gzhung sgor sdi spyi rdzas/ 'ijam dpal sdi lcags sgyug dpa' bo'iX mtshon cha/ lta bu/ rten dang brten pa'i 'brel ba ni/ dper na/ bang mdzod kyi 'bru/ yal 'dab ñji bye'u/ gangs k+shi seng ge brag gi 'ug pa/༷ zhing nang sdi myu gu/ khang steng sdi mi/ lung chen dzha chu/ lam gyi nyagrul 40

ba/ ge sar gyi sbrang ma/ nags dkyil sni ri dwags/ pad tshal sdi ngang ba/ ༷nam mkhaldi bya/ rgya mtshodz+wa nya mo dang / da drag thob pa'i dbang gis/ phyi rold kyi mi lta bu'o/ /tshig rkang gi kha skong tshe yi thob pa ni/ dper rno/ dpal ldan sa yi dbang phyug che/ /lta bu yin la/ tshigs bcad kyi rkang ba skong tshe ma gtogs yi mi thob bo/ /kyi la sogs pa rnarmes rnam dbye'i don ma yin pa gzhan la'ang 'jug pa yod de/ dper na/ 'di nyid bden sgyi‘/ gzhan ni gti mug go/ /nged cag ni rang rgyal gyi mi yin gyi/ phyi rgyal ba ma yin no/ /de lta mod kyi sogs/ mi mthun shā'i tshig rgyan la 'jug pa yod/ nam mkhe'i nyi ma lta bu 'a mtha' can la nam mkha' 'i nyi ma zhes thob mod/ skad gsar bcad la yi ge zor yang ba'i ched du 'a mtha' phal cher bsdus pa bzhin 'dir yang 'i sbyar tshe 'a mtha' de bsdus pa yin no/ /10 rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa/sngar gyi kyi gi gyi 'i yi lnga la mtha' rten sa sbyar ba'i kyis gis gyis 'is yis rnams 'jug pa yin la/ byed pa bo gtso bor ston pas na/ byed pa zhes brjod/ dper na/ bdag kis dpyad ces brjod tshe/ rnam dbye sbyar sa bdag byed pa bo dang / dpyad 41

pa byed pa bo des byas pa'i bya bar go ba ltabu'o/ /dbair na/ khyed sdis bshad/ yab gis gsung / sra sa sdis nyan/ bdag gis zhus/ krung dbyang gig thag bcad/ kun sdis dang len byas/ khem sdis phyar/ gser stis nyos/ zhal sdis bzhes/ltaribu dang / da drag gi mthar kund sdis bshad/ lta bu dang /ral gri'is gtub lta bu skad gsar bcad la ral grisru gtub lta bu/ lag paX bzung / mgo bos btud sogs lta bu dang /rkang ba skong tshe/ nam mkha'i lam nas cho 'phrul du ma ༷ga — /lta bu'o/ /kyis sogs rnam dbye gsum pa ma yin pa la'ang 'dṛsha pa yod de/ dper na/ khra lam gyis mthong zhes pa'i gyis ni mthong tshul ston pa'i tshig phrad tsam dang / rim gyis bsgrub lta bu'i chogyis ni sgrub tshul ston pa'i tshig phrad tsam dang 4/ yud kyis song lta shu'i kyis ni 'gro ba'i myur tshad ston pa'i tshig phrad tsam dang / lhun gyis grub lta bu'i gyis ni grub tshul ston pa'i tshig phrad tsam mo/ /11 rnam dbye de dag gi tha ge'i spyor tshul las 'dzos nas dzig rgyan sogs bshad pa/ kyang 'ang yang gsum ni/ mthun pa'i tshig rgyan dang mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan dang / sdud pa ste gsum la 'jug go / /4pho

de dag ming mtha' gang la sbyor tshul ni/ri ga da ba sa da drag mthar//kyang thob nga na ma ra la'i mtha' ru yang ni sbyor ba ste// rjes 'jug med dang 'a yig mthar//'ang dang yang gnyis ci rigs sbyor//zhes pa ltar/ ga da ba sa rnams dang / da drag mabyārokyang sbyor ba dang / nga na ma ra la rnams kyi mtha' can la ༷nga sbyor la/mtha' med dang 'a mtha' can gyi mthar 'ang sbyor/ tshigs bcad kyi rkang ba kha skong dgos tshe 'a mthar yang lkang gi sgra sbyar bar bya ste/ dper na/ rtag kya5 / bcad ༷nga / bkab kyāng /byas snging / bstand snging / 'ond kyāng / btsald kyāng /gang ༷nga / lam skyang / yin ༷nga / char ldung / gsal swāng /dge3ng / bde'ang / lta bu daro/ tshigs bcad kyi rkang ba skong tshe dang 'a mtha' can dang / mtha' med mthar yang thob pa'i dpe ni/ bdag ni dga' yang khyed ci ltar/ /zhes dang /sgra yang grags la mi ༷nga yod/ /lta bu'o/ /de dag mthun pa'i tshig rgyan du sbyor ba ni dper na/ gsal yang gsal/ mdzes shīd mdzes/ mdzes swānyang yin la mdog sding dkar/ /dpal 43

yang 'bar la yid kyung 'phrog lta bu ste/ mthun pa'i chos gnyis jezhi gcig tu sdud cung khyad par du tsheg mdzes par byed pa'o/ /mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan du sbyor tshul ni/ dper na/ btud kyāng khro/ phyug zhwang ser sna che/ mdzaXng bslu/ dmangs la brtse'ang dgra bo 'joms/ lta bu ste/ mi mthun pa'i chos gnyis gzhi rgecig tu sdud cing / khyad par tshig mdzes par byed pa'o/ /tshig rgyan du mi 'gyur ba'i sdud pa la/ khyad gzhi dang khyad chos gnyis ka phan tshun gzhi mthun du sdud pa/ gong mas 'og ma sdud pa dang / 'og mas gong ma sdud pa dang gsum yod pa las/dang bo ni dper na/ ut+pal swāng yin la sngon ponyang yin/zhes pa ut+pal dang sngon po gnyis gzhi mthun du sdud pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni dper na/ yon tan skyang dran te/ yon tan ma yin pa min no/ /spyi sems ging che ste/ sger sems can ni min no/ /lta bu/ gsum pa ni dper na/ rgya mis yon tan la slob ste bod kyis rgang slob bo/ /ngas bshad la khyod kyis kyang shod lta bu'o/ /gnen yang / yang sgra ni kyang 'ang gnyis ding 'jug pa mi mthun pa bskyar ba dang / bsnan pa gnyis la'ang 'jug ste/ bskyar ba ni/ dper na/ swāng nas swāng / yad ༈nga / slar jiskyang / de nas jipyang / sdung gsungs pa/ jiyang 44

dang swāng / zhes pa lta bu/ don snga ma nyid bldabs pa'i don du 'jug pa la bskyar ba zer/ bsnan pa ni dper na/ yad na 'di ltar bya ste/ gzhan rtaldung / lta bu rnam grangs gnyis la sogs pa bsnan pa la 'jug go/ /12 lhag bcas bshad pa/ ste te de la nas rnams ni lhag bcas la 'jug ste/ ming tshig gang gi mthar sbyar yang tshig don snga ma ma rdzogs par slar yang tshig lhag ma yod par ston pa la 'jug pa/ de dag ming mtha' gang la sbyor ba ni/da de na ra la sa dang //da drag can mthar te rkyang thob//ga nga ba ma 'a rnames dang //mtha' rten med mthar sa ste thob//la dang nas ni rang dbang can//zhes pa ltar/ rjes 'jug da mthar de dang / na ra la sa da drag can rnams kyi mthar te rkyang dang / ga nga ba ma 'a rnams dang /mtha' rten med pa dag gi rjes su ste thob la/ la dang nas gnyis rjes 'jug la mi ltos pa'i phrad rang dbang can yin no/ /dper 45

na/ gzhag ste/ byung sne/ bkab sne/ lam ste/ dga' ste/bya sne/ mdurno du sne/ yin te/ 'gyur te—/༷ gsal rto/bstend te/ gyur8 skre/ bsarlod sne/ byas p+ta/ bsgrubs snye/ yod de/ ༷ bshad de/ —byas lta/ yirnobe+e/ byarmo rgas/ brjodi nag glegs so/ ༷/lhag bcarme kyi gong sgo dus kyi dbye ba yod pa'i tshig rnams la 'das pa kho na 'ong ste/ dper na/ gad dar byas nas gdan 'ding / lta bu'o/ /de yang lhag bcas la/ mtsha mas sbyor ba'i lhag bcas dardo / dam bca' ba'i lhag bcas dang / gzhan 'dren pa'i lhagabyubaca 'khadang gsum yod/dang bo ni tshig snga phyi mtshams sbyor byed dang / lhag bcas gnyis ka yin stabs/ mtshams sbyor bcusalhag bcas zer de la rim can du mtshams sbyor ba dang / cig car du mtshams sbyor ba gnyis las/ dang bo ni dper na/ lag pa brkyangs lha bzung /phyag 'tshal skre bshad/ mda' 'phangs nyu phog dzog pa bsnyal ༷ zas za/ lag pa brkyangs nas bzung / phyag 'tshal dz+was bshad/mda' 'phangs naXs phog lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ dper na/gshog pa brkyangs skre 'phur/ 'ur sgra dang bcas k+to song / mig bgrad rdu‘ bltas/ lta bu/ mda' 'phangs te phog lta bu/ mda' 46

'phangs ba'i rjes su phog dgos stabs 'phangs pa phog pa rim tsan yistopas skye sgrasade la rim can du mtshams sbyor ba'i lhag bcas zer la/ gshog ba brkyangs k+to 'phur lta bu gshog pa brkyangs pa dang 'phur ba dus mnyamroyin stabayote sgra de cig car du sdutshams sbyor ba'i lhagahobacas yin zer ro/ / gnyis pa dam bca' ba'i lhag bcas ni/ tshig de dam bca' ba de'i gsal byed da ma sgrub byed 'dren pa'i lhag bcas yin la/ de la rgyu mtshan 'drenatshopa dang / nges tshiga'adren pa/rnam grangs kyi dbye ba 'dren pa gsum yod/ dang bo ni dper na/ mi rtag snu/ byas pa'i phyir lta bu ste / mi rtag pa yin par da ma bcas nas/ de'i rgyu mtshan du byas ba ni ste sgras 'dren pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni dper na/ 'di la gsarobyung zhes bya tsū/gsar du byung ba'i dngos po yin pas so/ /ltabu ste gsar byung gi nges tshig gam sgra don nam sgra baṭad 'dren pa'o/ /gsum pa ni dper na/ dbang bo ni lnga tshe migadang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus kyi dbang bo rnams hūṃ lta bu/ de gsumardzini mi rtag par dam bcas pa dang / gsar byung zer bar dayobacas pa dang / dbang bo lnga yod par dam bcas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bar gyi lhag bcas rnams la dam bca' ba'i lhag bcas zer ro/ /47

gsum pa gzhan 'dren pa'i lhag bcas ni/ daspir na/'di ni ra gan te/ 'di ni gser ro/ /'di ni zha nye ste/ 'di ni dngul yin no/ /lta bu'o/ /sdud pa/ bsnan pa/ ༷bskyar ba/ lhag bcas rnams kyi khyad par ni/ bskyar ba don snga ma nyid yang bskyar bldabs pa tsam yin la/ bsnan pa ni/ don snga ma nyid bldabs pa ma yin par snga ma'i steng du gzhan zhig bsnan pa yin/ sdud pa ni don snga ma bldabs pa dang don snga ma'i steng du gzhan zhig bsnan pa ma yin par/ bya ba dnge byed pa dang dgag pa dang sgrub pa la sogs pa'i khyad par rnams don snga phyir sbyor ba sdud par byed pa yin la/ de yang don gyi gzhi snga mar gang sbyar ba'i bya ba la sogs pa'i khyad par de dag phyi ma yang nges can du sbyor bar ston te/ dper na bod mis 'dzugs skrun byed rdu/ sog pos kyang 'dzugs skrun byed do/ /zhes pa lta bu bya ba'i khyad par 'dzugs skrun byed pa ga—zhi gnyis ka la sbyar nas gnyis ka'am gang rung la sdud tshig sbyar rung gi bod mis 'dzugs skrun byed do/ /sog pos phyugs 'tsho'o/ lta bu 'dzugs skrun byed pa dang / phyugs 'tsho ba khyad par mi mthun pas/ gzhi mi mthun pa la sdud tshig sbyar mi rung ngo / /lhag bcas ni khyad par gcig lta bu gzhi tha dad du ma la sbyor ba'i nges bzung mi dgos 48

par/ don snga ma ma rdzogs par lhag ma yod pa tsam ston nga/'o/ /13 'byed sngud sogs bshad pa/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu bo la ma yig sbyar bas/ gam/ ngam/dam/ nam/ bam/ mam/ 'am/ ram/ lam/ sam/bcu dang / da drag sga/ dbang gis thob pa tam dang bcu gcig 'byed sdud gnyis la 'jug cing / mingamatha' gang la 'byung ba ni//'byed sdud skabs su rjes 'jug bcur//rang 'drar ma yig sbyar ba dang //da drag thob mthar ta dang sbyar//zhes pa ltar/ rjes 'jug bcu bo'i mthar rang 'drar ma yig thob pa dang / mtha' med mthar 'a yig la ma yig sbyor zhing /da drag mthar ta yig la ma yig sbyar bar bya la/ dbye gzhi gcig las rnam grangs du mar 'byed pa/ brtag pa dang 'dri ba'i sgo nas rnam grangs gzhan dang 'byed pa/ gdam nga'i sgo nas rnam grangs gzhan dang 'byed pa ste gsum mo/ /dang bo ni dper na/phung bo ni lnga ste/ gzugs gam/ tshor ba'as/ 'du shes srum/'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa'o lta bu dang / dbang bo lnga mo 49

ste/ mig gam/ rna bltam/ sna3m/ lcinya/ma/ lus so lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ nad las thar ram mi thar/ shes rab cheXm mi che lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ rgeser len nam dngul len/zas dgos sdum gos dgog lta bu'o/ / —sdud pa la yang gsum de/ phyogs gcig tu sdud pa/snga mar sbyar ba'i chos phyi mar sbyar ba sdud pa/ phyi mar sbyar ba'i chos snga mar sbyor ba sdud pa'o/ /dngar+shabo ni/ gser rwam/ dngul ༷ma/ zangs srum/ lcags ni rin po che'o/ /lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ mu tig ni rin thang che ste/ lamen 1ma/ byu ru yang ngo / /lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ mu tig gām/ mu men naXm/byu ru yang rin thang che'o/ /lta bu dang / da drag gi dbang gis thob pa/ 'dzind 7ma/ phyind t+tam/ gyurd 7sa/ bstsald tam/ lta bu'o/ / 14 rnam dbye lnga ba sogs ba /da pa/nas las gnyis ni rnam dbye lnga ba 'byung khungs dang /dgar ba dang / sdud pa gsum 'a/ 'jug pa las/ dang bo rnam debye lnga ba 'byung khungs la 'jug pa ni/ gzhi gang zhigalas gang zhig bral ba'am 'byung ba ston pa'i don du 'jug la/ de dag 5tu

phrad rang dbang can yin gshis/ sbyor tshul rjes 'jug gi khyad par la mi ltos par thams cad kyi mthar ci rigs par sbyar bar bya ste/ dper na/ nam mkha' nag char babs/ nam mkha' sas char babs/ sa gzhi 1sa lo tog 'khrungs/ sa gzhi ༷sa lo tog 'khrungs/ lta bu 'byung khungs dang / rta thog nag lhung /rta thog swās lhung / stan nas lding / stan lag langs/ ltabu'ang 'byung khungs yin la/ gtso 'dzin mchog nāg 'di ltar gsungs lta bu yang 'byung khungs yin no/ /dgar ba la/ rigs dang / bya ba dang / yon tan dadzordzas kyi sgo nas dgar ba bzhi yod de/ dang bo ni/ mes rgyal gyi mi rigs thams cad ༷sa rgya rigs mang / grangs nyung mi rigs nang spyas bod rigs ni mtho sgang la gnas/ lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ bya ba thams cad kyi nang nag gzhan don byed pa mchogalas thams cad las gzhung las gtso/ lta bu/ gsum pa ni/thams cad las yon tan che ༷ba'i mi de/ slob grwa chen po'i nang rgas rtsis la rmikhas pa de/ bzhi ba ni/ rgyal chen bzhi'i nang nus/ rgyal mtshan can ni rnam sras so/ /mi 'di dag las r+ghaṃng rtags can ni dmag go/ /lta bu ste/ mchog tu dgare ba dang / mang bar dgar ba dang / yon tan che bar dgar ba/51

nyung bar dgar ba dang / dman par dgar ba'ang yod do/ /nus sdud pa la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ krung dbyang nas sa gnas bar/ gcig nas brgya'i bar/ khrin tu'u nas lha sa'i bar/ mtsho sngon nas lha sa'i bar/ khrin tu'u nag rnga ba'i bar lta bre/ ༷sa sdud r+sha la 'jug pa ni/ dper na sngorno gyi yig rnying phal mo cher byung ba ltar/ gzugs ༷/ sa sogs pa dang / mig ltas sogs pa/ de dag lhas stsogs pa/ zhes pa lta bu/ 'on kyang rjes su rim gyis brda dang yig gzugs 'gyur nas/ lastsogs pa zhes par tsheg mi byed par gyur pa dang / yang la sogs pa zhes brda skad dang yi ge gnyis kar la rkyang las rjes 'jug sa med par gyur pa yin zhing / slob dpon thon mis brda sprod pa'i gzhung mdzad skabs las sogs pa zhes las sdud pa la 'jug pa'i brda ma 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ dgar dang sdud pa'ang de bzhin no/ /zhes nas las gnyis dgar sdud 'byung khungs gsum la khyad med du 'jug par gsungs pa yin mod/ deng dus la sogs pa zhes sgra dang / yig gzugs gnyis ka 'gyur ba sor bzhag byed na'ang 'di'i la yig sdud pa la 'jug par byed dgos snyam/ 'on kyang gzugs sogs zhes la sgra med skabs la yig bsdus pa yin par shes dgos te/ rnam dbye gzhan dag 5lha

kyang bsdus pa shin tu mang rnga / /mda' 'phangs nas phog lag pa brkyangs nas bzung / phyag 'tshal nas bshad lta bu'i nas mtshams sbyor dang / lhag bcas gnyis ka la 'jug pa gong du bshad pa ltar la/ rgyu swās 'bras bu 'byung lta bu'ang 'byung khungs dngos yin no/ / ‘ 15 rnam dbye brgyad pa 'bod pa'i sgra bshad pa/ming gi thog mar sbyar ba'i kye zhes pa'i sgra lta bu ste/ kye rgyal bo chen po/ kye grogs po/ spre gtso bo po/ lta bu dang ༷/sras mo gi lta bu mije gi mthar sbyar ba'ang yod la/ k+ta ye grogs po lta bu dang / phal skad kyi ༷ ye lta bu dang / k+ta'i sgra dag kyang / zur gyis ston pa dang / bskul ba dang / glu len pa dang 'phya ba lta bu sgeg chos dang drag shul la sogs pa dang 'brel ba'i 'bod pa'i sgra yin par gsungs so/ /de ltar na/ la don gyi de nyid tshe skabs gnyis dang / rgyan sdud kyi kyang 'ang yang gsum dang / lhag bcas kyi ste te de gsum dang / 'byed sdud kyi gam ngam dam na ma bam mam 'am ram lam sam tam rnams dang / dgar sdud kyi nas las gnyis rnams rnam dbye las 'phros pa yin no/ / 53

de dag gi sdom ni/rnam dbye brgyad ni go rim bzhin//dang bo ngo bo gnyis pa las / gsum pa byed pa bzhi ba dgos// lnga batsho'abyung khungs drug pa 'brel// bdun pa gnas gzhi brgyad pa 'bod//gang zhig ngo bo tsam brjod pa//rnam dbye dang bo yin te dper//bum pa ka ba zhes brjod bzhin//de dang 'brel ba'i rdzogs tshig ni//go ngo do no bo mo 'o /ro lo so to bcu gcig go//slar sdud zla sdud ces kyang bya//la don rnam pa bdun yod de//su ru du tu na ra la// gnyis pa bzhi ba bdun pa dang //de nyid tshe skabs rnams la 'jug /sa su ga ba da drag tu//nga da na ma ra la du//

'a dang mtha' rten med mthar ru//'di dang ra mtha' bya ba gcig / na la gnyis ni skabs dang sbyar//rnam dbye sbyar sa'i gzhi de la// bya ba byas dang byed pa tsam// ston pa rnam dbye gnyis pa yin//rnam dbye sbyar sa'i gzhi de yi//ched du'am dgos pa ston pa de//rnam dbye bzhi ba dgos ched yin//rnam dbye sbyar sa'i gzhi de la//chos shig gnas tsam ston pa de//rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi yin//rnam dbye sbyar sa de nyid kyi// ngo bo nyid du grub ston pa//de nyid ces bya'i dzig phrad do//dus tsam ston pa'i la don de //tshig phrad tshe skabs zhes bya yin//drug pa 'brel sgra khyad gzhi dang //khyad chos gang dag 'brel byed pa'i//55

kyi gi gyi 'i yi lnga bo//rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa ni//byed po gang gis bya ba zhig /byas dang byed pa ston byed pa'i// kyis gis gyis 'is yis rnams so//da ba sa kyi ga nga gi//na ma ra la'i rjes su gyi// 'a dang mtha' rten med mthar 'i//rkang ba skong tshe yi zhes thob// rgyan sdud kyang 'ang yang gsum ni//mthun dang mi mthun chos gnyisajini// gzhi gcig la ni nyer tsod cing //khyad par tshig ni mdzes byed la//mthun dang mi mthun rgyan gnyis zer//ga da ba sa da drag mthar//spyang thob nga na ma ra la'i /mtha' ru yang ni sbyor ba ste//rjes 'jug med dang 'a yi mthar rmo'ang dang yang gnyis ci rigs stor//56 tsho

yang ni bskyar dang bsnan la'ang 'jug /ste te de gsum nas la bcas /bstan bya tshig gi lhag ma tsam// 'dren pa'i lhag bcas la 'jug go//da de na ra la sa dang //da drag can mthar te rkyang thob/ /ga nga ba ma 'a rnams dang //mtha' rten med mthar sa ste thob//la dang nas ni rang dbang can//'byed sdud skabs su rjes 'jug bcu//rang 'drar ma yig sbyar ba dang //da drag thob mthar ta dang sbyar//nas las gnyis ni 'byung khungs dang //dgar dang sdud pa gsum la 'jug /gang zhig gang las byung ston pa'i//nas las gnyis ni 'byung khungs yin//kye dang kwa ye 'bod pa'i sgra//phal cher ming gi thog mar sbyar//skabs 'gar mtha' mar sbyar ba'ang yod// 57

ces byang bar bya'o/ /rnam dbye 'phros dang bcas pa bshad zin to// tshogasun pu tshig sdod gzhan dazhad ska/1 ni sgra dgar brnan gyi sgra la 'jug tshul bshad pa la/dgar ba ni dgar gzhi gzhan las logs su dgar ba dang / brnan pa ni nan tan du brnan pa'am nges bzung gi tshig phrad du 'gyur ro/ / dgar ba la rigs mthun las dgar ba dang / rigs mi mthun pa las dgar ba gnyis/ dang bo ni/ rta mchog ni/ rta gzhan las 'gros mgyogs lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dper na/ rta ni ba lang las 'gros mgyogs lta bu'o/ /dgar gzhi dngos su ma smos kyang ni dgar tshig la 'jug pa/ dper na/ yon tan chen po dang ldan pa 'di ni khob dpon chen po'o/ /lta bu/ yang dgar ba la mchog tu dgar ba/ dman par dgar ba/ tha dad tsam du dgar ba gsum las/ dang bo ni/ bsam 'phel dbang rgyal spyi nor bu rnams kyi mchog go/ /lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ rta dang bong bu gnyis las 58

ni bong bu dman no/ /lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang bo ni/ lta bu dang / bum pa ni ka ba las gzhan no/ /lta bu/ 'grel ba snga ma dag las 'di ltar bshad mod/ni ma sbyar na yang las dgar tshig yin pas dpyad gzhi yod do/ /brnan pa'am nges bzung la 'jug pa ni/ khrab ni gyon/ gri niX btags/ mdung ni bzung / lta bu dang / rang re'i rgyal khab la mi ni mang / stobs ni che/ sa khyon ni yangs/ thon khungs nibhe mang / lta bu'o/ / 2 dang sgra bshad pa/sdud pa/ 'byed pa/ rgyu mtshan/ tshe skabs/ gdams ngag ste lnga la 'jug pa las/ ༄dang bo sdud pa la 'jug pa ni/ gam la sogs pa'i skabs ltar phyogs gcig tu sdud pa dang / snga mar sbyar ba'i chos phyi mar sbyor ba sdud pa dang / phyi mar sbyar ba'i chos snga mar sbyor ba sdud pa gsum las dang bo ni/ mig dad / rna ba da5 / sna data / lce dang / lus rnams ni dbang bo'o/ /lta bu/ gnyis shā ni/ nyi rmo ni 'od daXng ldan te/ glog sgron da5 zla ba yang ngo / /lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ nyi ma da5 zla ba dāng nor bu las 2 3 59

kyang 'od 'phro'o/ /lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa 'byed pa la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ dbang bo ni lnga ste/ mig da5 / rna ba da5 / sna daXng / lce da5/ / lus rnams so/ /lta bu ste/ gzhi gcig las rnam grangs tha dad pa'am/ rnam grangs du ma 'byed pa gam la sogs pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa rgyu mtshan la 'jug pa ni/ gtan tshigs ston pa ste/ na yig gi 'jug pa dang don 'dra ba yin te/ dper na/ du ba mthong ba sweng me yod par shes so/ /brtson 'thus brtsams pa dung mthar phyin/ lta bu dang / rgyu yod pa dang 'bras bu 'byung lta bu dus dang rgyu mtshan lhan gcig tu ston pa'ang yod do/ /bzhi ba tshe skabs la 'jug pa ni/ nyi ma shar ba dang tshogs 'du 'tshogs/ sgo phyes pa da5 nang du song / 'khor h+phi bskor ba dung mnyam du sgra grags/ lta bu'o/ /lnga ba gdams ngag la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ 'di gyis darngo / nyon daXng / slobs dāng / brtson 'grus rtsoms dung mkhas par 'gyur/ yid la zungs dung rang la phan/ lta bu ste/bya ba la bskul ba'i phyir na yig gi 'jug pa dang don 'dra bar gdams ngag 'doms pa'o/ /60

3 sgra bshad pa/gang zhes pa spyi sgra yin la/ de la yang thog mar don de dmigs su ma bzung bar spyir smos nas/ phyis yon tan sogs kyis khyad par du byas nas dmigs su 'dzin pa dang / rigs can kun la khyab pa'i spyi tsam brjod pa dang / spyir 'dri ba dang /the tshom nas 'dri ba dang / gdam nga la 'jug pa rnams yod pa las dang bo ni/ dper na/ gang gis sgra dbyangs gsungs pa r+yā/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la/ /༷zhes dang / skang gis ming gzhi sdon gsungs pa'i/ /rtag zhi ba la/ lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ dper na/ gdung 'degs pa gad yin pa de ni ka ba'o/ /lta bu ste/ shing gi ka ba sogs ka ba'i bye brag thams cad la khyab pa'i ka ba'i spyi tsam brjod pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dper na/ mi 'di rnams las las byed pa ni skang yin/ bzo ba ni gad yin/ zhing ba ni gang yin/ lta bu jong / khyod gang du 'gro rgyu yin zhes 'dri ba lta0 bu/bzhi ba ni/ dper na ngas bya ba swād byas na legs zhes pa ste the tshom pa lta bu/ 61

lnga—ba ni dper na/ zas 'di rnams kyi nang nas khyed kyis gang za/ zhes 'dem du bcug pa ste dri ba'ang yin/gzhan yang / su/ ci/ nam/ ji rnams kyang gang sgra las khyab chung ba ma gtogs gang dang 'jug pa phal cher mthun la/ su sgra ni gang zag brjod pa'i spyi sgra yin te/ dper na/khyod su yin/ de rga red/ su yong rgyu red/ lta bu/ ci sgra ni don r+sharjod pa'i spyi ṭ+wāṃ ste/ deper na/ don ci la 'ong ci dgos/ ni yin rung / ni yod/ ༷ ci'i phyir/ snya bu/ nam sgra sno dus brjod pa'i spyi sgra ste/ dper rno/ khyed nam 'gro/ dus nadze+e 'ong / nasdu zhig 'di 'dra 'byung lta bu/ ji sgra ni dpe brjod pa'i spyi sgra ste/ dper na/ pha yul sbyi 'dra yin/ji ltar yin rung / khyod ji 'dra ba de 'drar lta bu'o/ / 4 bdag sgra bshad pa/ pa ba po bo can ldan rnams te/ pa ba po bo rnams don pho brjod pa la gtso cher sbyor bas na/ skyes pa'i rtags sam pho'i rtags zhes bya zhing / pho'i rtags de rnams ming mthar sngar med pa la gsar du sbyor tshe bdag po'i sgrar 'gyur ba yin la/ pa ba po bo can ldan rnams ming mtha' gang la sbyor tshul ni /62

ga da no ba ma sa dang //da drag can mthar pa dang po//nga 'a ra la mtha' med mthar//ba dang bo nyid sbyor ba ste// can ldan nges med skabs dang sbyar//zhes pa ltar ga da na ba ma sa dang da drag can rnams la pa dang po sbyar zhing / nga 'a ra la dang mtha' med can rnams la ba dang bo sbyar la/ can ldan dag ming mtha' nges pa med par skabs thob kyis sbyar bar bya'o/ /dper na/ dbus pā/ so nam pā/ lho brag pā// ri dwags pā lta bu dang / zhing byā/mda' sdu/ mgar byā/ bya yul bha/ bzo sdu/ slob grwa byā lta bu dang / yi ge'i byed 1/ spyi nor len sdo/ byed pū blo/ gtong ba dz+wa/ lta bu dang / yon tan rtan/ sma ra rtan/dbyug pa zin/ blo lhan/ 'byor ldan/ shes ldaXn/ lta bu'o/ /'di la bshad tshul mang yang 'di ltar rtags mtha' 'dren tshul la sbyar na legs par sems/ yod pū/ med pa/ bum pā/ ka byā/ spyi sdo/ lta bu'i pa ba deng po bo mithe gi cha shas yin pas/ bdag sgra min la/ grangs ldan ri yi 'phreng ba/ lta bu dang / lha khang ka ba shing lo can/ lta bu'i ldan dang can 63

dag kyang bdag sgra dang mtshungs pa'i tshig phrad yin mod/ bdag sgra dngos min te/ bdag sgra ni bdag po'am ldan pa'i gang zag de ston byed cig dgos/ pa ba bo bo can ldan yod tshad bdag sgra yin mi dgos pa shes dgos so/ / 7 — 5 dgag sgra bshad ba/ —— ma mi med min rnams te/ ma ni byung zin sgebakag pa'i dgag sgra dang / mi ni 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa'i dgag sgra dang /med dang min ni dus gsum gar sbyor rung ba'i dgag sgra yin la/ma mi gnyis ni ming gi thog mar sbyor ba dang / med min gnyis ni ming gi mthar sbyor ba yin te/ dpe brjod rim bzhin bzhag na/ sngu skyes/ swā 'gag dz+wa mthong / swā yong / lta bu dang /mi skye/ mi rung / mi —'gro lta bu dang / skyon me5/ dgra d+med/ drir chad ltid/ yod pa min/ yong rgyu n+nin/ log spyodi pa sdin/ lta je ste skyes pa dbaṃ mthong ba sogs ṭ+wāṃ‘gag pa'i sgra'o/ /sgrol ma/ mdzes sdo/rwa chang swā/ khyim bdag ma/ bu gso ma sogs doXn mo brjod r+sha la gtso ts+tshar ma yig sbyor ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de 'asamo rtags sam bud med kyi rtags zhes bya zhing /phal cher mor go bar byed pa'i mo rtags ma yig de ming gi thog 64

mar sngar mid gsar du sbyar tshe/ dgag sgrar 'gyur ba yin gyi pho sko'i tags gang yin thams cad bdag sgra dang dgag sgrar bshad pa min te / ma mo/ ma he lta bu'i ming gi cha shas su thog ma nas grub pa'i ma yig lta bu dgag sgra ma yin pa dang / bla ma/ slob ma/ gro ma/ lta bu'i ma yig mo rtags dang dgag sgra gang yang ma yin pa'ang yod/ lha zhes pa dang / mi zhes pa lta bu pho mo gnyis ka'i spyi brjod pa yin stabs/ re re'i rtags su mi 'gyur mod/lha mo zhes bya ba'i zla dang tshogs na/ lha zhes pa phor go ba dang /de bzhin du bu dang bu mo/ mi dang mi mo/ rgya dang rgya mo sogs kyi zla bo phyi ma la mo rtags sbyar ba'i nus pas/ snga ma phor go ba lta bu'o/ / 6 de sgra bshad pa/ de sgra ni jidon dgu la 'jug ste/ tha snyad kyi dbang gis gsum dang / dngos po'i dbang gis bzhi/ dus kyi dbang gis gnyis la 'jug go/ / de la tha snyad dbang du byas pa gsum ni/ tha snyad 'das pa dang / rnam grangs gzhan brjod pa dang / lhag bcas te gsum mo riri 65

dang bo tha snyad 'das pa la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ bod yul ni sa mtho'o/ /rdu la gangs ri dang brag ri/ mang ngo lta bu dang / me 'khor ni shin tu che'o/ /dī rlangs 'khor las mgyogs/ rdu skyel 'dren la shin ā+oṃ gal che/ lta bu ste/ don de 'das ma 'das gang yin yang rung midz+wa gi tha snyad tsa ma 'dasasmo pa la ming de slar 'dren mi dgos par de zhes brjod pas go ba lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa rnam grangs gzhan brjod pa la 'jug pa ni/dper na/ lto ldir ba gang dang gang yin pa rdu dang deX ni bum pa'o/ /gdung 'degs pa gang dang gang yin pa de dang rdu ni ka ba'o/ /lta bu ste/ bum pa dang / ka ba'i rnam grangs gzhan du ma yod pa gang sgra dang de sgras go bar byed pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa lhag bcas la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ yod rdu‘/ brjod rdu/ lta bu sngar lhag bcas kyi skabs kyisu bshad pa rnams te don snga ma las gzhan zhig 'dren rgyu yod med la mi ltos par tshig gi tha snyad lhag ma tsam 'dren cing ston pa'o/ /'di gsum ni ming tshig gi tha snyad dang brjod bya'i dngos po gnyis kyi nang nas/ gtso bor tha snyad kho na la 'jug pas na tha snyad la 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ / gnyis pa de sgra dngos po la 'jug pa bzhi ni/ bden pa 66

dang / gsang ba dang / bdag gi ba dang / pha rol bo la 'jug pa ba zhi las/ dang bo bden pa la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ de bzhin nyid/ de kho na nyid/ chos rnams kyi de nyid/ lta bu'i bahūṃd bya'i dngos hūṃ de'i ngo bo nyid dam rang bzhin nam bden par ston par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa gsang ba la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ de ma bshad/ dī ma ston/ de su la'ang ma ston/ lta bu gsang byi'i dngos po dz+wa'i brda sngar rming zin pas gang zag la gsang bya de bshad tshe/ gsang bya'i rang ming mi smos par/ de zheris brjod pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa bdag gi ba la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ rang gi yo byad sogs la mig gtad de/ kho'i de/ bdag gi de/ bdag nyid kyi de/ rang gi de/rngo'i de lta dzu bdag gi ba'armi bdag dang 'brel r+sha'i dngos po zlo de sgra 'jug pa la zer zhing / bdag nyid la de sgra mi 'jug go/ /bzhi ba pha rol bo la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ mi rdu/ rta de/bod de/ rgya de/ khyed kyi de/ gzhan gyi de/ lta bu ste gang zag pha rol bo dang / de dang 'brel ba'i dngos po gnyis ka la de sgra 'jug go/ /brjod bya'i dngos po'i ngo bo nyid rang ming gis brjod ma brjod la ma ltos par de zhes brjod pas go bar byed pas na 'di bzhi la 'jug pa'i de sgra dngos po la 'jug pa zhes 67

bshad do/ /gsum pa dus kyi dbang gisaganyis la 'jug ba ni/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa la 'jug pa gnyis te/ dang bo 'das pa la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ sngon gyi bskal gardu la/ dus rabs sngon ma de'i skabs/ lo dī'i nang / zla ba sdomardu la/ kha sang gi dus rdu la/ da nangs snga dro'i dus rdu la/ sngar 'das ma thag gi dus rdu /la/ lta bu ste/ bskal ba dang / lo dang /zla ba dang / zhag dang / za pogang rung zhig dus da ltabar bzung ba'i 'das pa thams cad la de sgra 'jug go/ /gnyis pa ma 'ongs pa la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ sang gi dus rdu tsam na/ zla ba rjes ma rdu la/ lo jes ma rdu la/ ma 'ongs gung khran ring lugs kyi skabs rdu la/ lta bu ste bskal ba 'di da lta ba byas tshe/ bskal ba sngon ma yan chad 'das pa dang / bskal ba rjes ma phan cha da ma 'ongs pa dang / lo 'di da lta bar bzung tshe/ lo snga ma 'das pa dang / lo rjes ma ma 'ongs pa dang /de bzhin du da lta'i skad cig ma 'di la ltos nas/ skad cig snga ma 'das pa dang / riskad cig phyi saum 'ongs par 'jog dgos pa sogs gcig gcigal ltos nas 'jog dezheskya3 dngos po'i nang nas bdag la mi 'jug dus kyi nang nas da ltab la mi 68

'jug ste/ bdag la/ nga rang / nga / kho bo/ bdag nyid zer ba las de sgra mi 'jug la/ bdag dang 'brel ba'i dngos bo la 'jug pa gong bzhin no/ / 7 'azhi sgra bshad pa/ 'di sgra ni/ dus da lta ba la/ bskal ba 'dī/ lo 'di/ zla ba 'di/ zhag 'di/ dus tshod 'di/ zhes 'di sgra 'jug pa las de sgra mi 'jug la/༷ 'on kyang da lta dri'i dngos po la mi 'jug pa ma yin te/ bdag nyid ma gtogs dus gsum ka'i dngos po la 'jug pa dpe brjod snga ma rnams kyis shes par bya'o/ /tha snyad la 'jug pa'i skabs su bshad pa ming tshig gi thi snyad tsam 'das pa dang /'dir dus 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa la de sgra 'jug tshul bshad pa yin stabs/ snga ma la tha snyad 'das pa zhes brjod pa dang /'dir dus kyi dbang gis gnyis zhes bshad pa yin/ sngar lhag bcas kyi skabs su lhag ma 'dren tshul gyi sgo nas bshad/ dgos pa mi 'dra ba yod gshis/ zlos skyo na mi 'byung ba shes dgos so/ /'di zhes pa'i tshig phrad dus gsum gyi nang nas da lta ba dang / dngos po nye ring gnyis kyi nang nas nye ba dang / mngon lkog gnyis kyi nang nas mngon sum dang / bdag gzhan gnyis 69

kyi nang nas gzhan la 'jug cing / dngos po'i dbang du byas na 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dngos po la yang 'jug par smra sgo las bshad la de las gzhan la mi 'jug go/ /duspu da lta ba la 'jug pa ni/ lo 'ani la/ zla ba 'di'i nang / bskal ba 'di la lta bu/ dngos po nye ba la 'jug rme ni/ dper na/ gserno 'aXdi/ 'khor lo 'di/ mi 'di/ zhes rang gi nye bar yod pa dang mngon sum du yod pa dag la 'di sgra 'jug la/ ring ba dang / mngon du ma gyur pa dag la 'di sgra mi 'jug par de sgra 'jug ste/ gser de/ 'khor lo de/ mi de zhes brjod dgos stabs/ 'di sgra la snye tshig dang de r+ghaṃ la ring sbyig zer ro/ /da zhes pa'i tshig phrad ni brjod bya ston pa'i tshig phrad yin te/ dus 'das pa dngagam 'ongs pa la mi rmyer ro/ /dper na/ du ni dkyus la 'jug par bya ste/ lta bu dang / dus( 5 nas bzung ste/ da skabs/ da lan/ da thengs/ lta bu'o/ /da ci byed ces pa dā nas bzurja bya ba ci lgog byed ces pa'i don yirnomostabs du de da lta ba la 'jug la/ da dung dang da rung zhes pa'i da gnyis ni da lta ba la 'jug pa min te/ de'i don ni/ des mi tshad gzhan zhig yod pa'i don no/ /70

8 ga zad gnan dbang can0 byung sogs thob tshul bshadapha/ ri ga da ba dang da drag mthar// —cing ces ce'o ce na cig/ nga na ma 'a ra la dang //mtha' rten med pa'i rjes dag tu//zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig/sa mthar dmigs bsal zhes ma gtogs// /shing dang she'o she na shig/ ces pa ltar/ ga da ba dang da drag can gyi mthar cing sogs lnga bo sbyor tshul dper na/ drag cing / drag stes/drag ce'o/ drag ce na/ zhog cig deje cing / brjod rjos/bstodz+wa cesdo/ ba|da ce na/ rgod cig ༷brgyab ging / bskyib cespra/ ༷—rab ce'o/ ༷khyab ce na/ ༷khob gig reld cing /ro lad twes/ rormid ce'o/ ram̐ld cig lta bu/ nga na ma 'a rno la'i mtha' rten can rnams dang / mtha' med pa dag la zhing sogs lnga bo sbyor tshul ni/ dper na/ bzang sang / gsung nes/ gsung zhe'o/ gang zhe na/ gang zhig nyan zhing / ston zhes/ ston zhe'o/ byin zhe na/ ༷rin zhig ༷bsam zhing / ༷ bsam 3 3 ༷3 71

zhisdo/ bsam zhephyo/ bsam ne na/ nam zhig lta bu dang /daṅka' zhid / dz+wapa' nas/ ༷ dga' swogle// dga' twe na/'ba' zhig lta bu dang / 'bar ༷nga / 'char zhos/ 'char spre'o/ 'bar twe na/ dngul dkar sdig lta bu dang / mjal gīng / grol zhes/ grol zhe'o/ thul ) na/ dmigs bsal zhig lta bu'oX/ /spro snyibaṃ / bde zhes/ sgra zhe'o/ spro zhe na/jeng ba zhig lta bu'o/ /sa mtharaX shing sogarme lnga sbyor tshul ni dper na/ mkhas ༷nga shes na/ gyis ༷ga lta bu dang /dmigs shig bsags shī na/ bgos shīg lta bu/ sa mthar shes zer ba mi bde bas zhes dmigs bsal gyis thob pa yod la/ 'di'i cig zhig shig rnams la skul tshig yin min ci rigs yod pa dang / kha cig lhan sdig sogs kyi ming mtha' la yod pa'i cig sogs tshig phradi ma yin r+sha shes par bya'o/ /'o 'u 'am gyi tsheg khyim yang // rkang ba skong dang mi skong dbye//zhes pa ltar/ tshigs bcad kyi kha skong ba'i dgos pa yod tshe tsheg bar byed pa dper na/ khye 'u me tog tshal la rtse ba 'am/ /yang na chu skyes mgo lcog ldem pa 'o/ /zhes pa lta bu/ tshigs bcad kyi kha skong ba'i dgos pa med tshe tsheg bar mi byed par 72

dper na/ khye'u me tog gi tshal la rtse ba'am/ yang na chu skyes rlung gis bskyod pas mgo spyog ldem pa'o/ /lta bu/ 'di las 'phros te/ rngomi dang mi bo mi 'u dang // nya dang nya bo nye 'u dang // sha dang sha bo sha 'u dang //rnga dang rnga bo ngo 'u dang //mda' dang mda' bo mde 'u dang // —rdo dang rdo bo rde 'u dang //rdza dang rdza bo rdze 'u sogs// dang bo dngos po rang bab dang //bar ba chen po'am mchog la 'jug /tha ma chung ngu'am dman pa'i ming //spra dang spre 'u bya bye 'u//sta re ste 'u gri gri 'u// mthe bong mthe 'u khri khri 'u//khang ba khang bu sgo sge 'u//mtsho dang mtshe 'u la sogs pa//snga ma dngos po rang ming dang //73

snyi ma di rnams chung ngu'i ming //rnga mong je 'u rta rte 'u/ // sha ba she 'u ba be 'u// — ra ma re 'u khyi khyi gu// lug dang lu gu la sogs pa'i//snga ma sems can rang ming dang //phyi ma phru gu'i ming du grags//zhes pa 'di'ang shes dgos pa zhig go// 9 yig mgo dang shad sogs bshad pa /lalca dang wartu sogs sngon rgya gar gyi yig rigs thams cad la yig mgor dbu khyud nyis shad dang bcas pa 'jog pa bzhin/bod 'dir yang yig mgor dbu khyud nyis shad can/(༄tsho/ / ) 'di thob/ chig shad(/ ) dang / nyis shad(//) dang / bzhi shad(// //) dang / rin chen spungs shad(/ )dang / sbrul 'khyil ba lta bu'i sbrul shad (༈)rnams yod/ lhug pa'i rnam grangs so so dang / don tshan re re'i mthar chig shad 'bri/lhug pa'i rdzogs tshig na ro can gyi mtha' dang tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang mthar nyis shad bya/ sde tshan chen po rdzogs mtshams dang 74

le'u mtshams lta bur bzhi shad 'thob/ yig phring gi mgor yig rdog gcig dang gnyis byung tshe tshugs thub pa'i chen du rin chen spungs shad bri la/ le'u snga phyi'i mtshams dang / lde rītshan che khag gi mgor nyis shad dang / bzhi shad kyi bar du sbrul shad 'thob pa yin no// dmigs bsal ka ga sha ste phyi rkang can gyi yi ge gsum rkang mthar thon tshe shad gcig gi go chod stabs/ chig shad can la logs su shad 'bri mi dgos la/ nyis shad la gcig ma gtogs mi dgos pa dang / bzhi shad la gsum gyis chog pa yin/ nga rkang mthar thon tshe/ shad kyi gong du tsheg gcig thob la/ nga yig ma gtogs gzhan la mi dgos so/ /de dag gi sdom ni/ ni sgra dgar dang nan tan gyi// brnan pa gnyis la 'jug pa yin//dang sgra sdud dang 'byed pa dang //rgyu mtshan tshe skabs gdams ngag lnga'o//gang su ci ji spyi sgra yin//gang ni kun gyi spyi sgra la//su sgra gang zag ci ji gnyis/ /— 75

rim bzhin don dang dpe'i spyi sgra//pa ba po bo can ldan rnams//bdag po ston byed bdag sgra yin//ga dar ba ma sa dang //da drag can mthar pa dang po//nga 'a ra la mtha' med mtha'//ba dang bo nyid sbyor ba 'o//can ldan‘nges med skabs dang sbyar//ma mi med min rnams dgag sgra//ma mi gnyis ni sngon la sbyar//med min gnyis ni ming mthar sbyor//de sgra don dgu la 'jug ste//tha snyad dbang du byas pa gsum//dngos po'i dbang du byas pa bzhi//dus kyi dbang gis gnyis te dgu//dang bo tha snyad 'das pa dang //rnam grangs gzhan brjod lhag bcas gsum//gnyis pa bden dang gsang ba dang //bdag gi ba dang pha rol bzhi//76
