gsum pa 'das dang ma 'ongs gnyis//de sgra dngos po bdag dang dus// da lta ba la mi 'jug go/ / 'di zhes bya ba'i tshig phrad de//dus gsum nang nas da lta ba/ /dngos po nye ring gnyis las ni//nye ba kho nar 'jug pa yin// mngon lkog gnyis las mngon gyur dang //bdag gzhan gnyis las gzhan la 'jug/'di sgra la ni nye tshig dang // de sgrar ring tshig zer ba 'o//de zhes bya ba'i tshig phrad de//brjod bya ston pa skabs babs pa'i//tshig phrad yin phyir dus gsum gyi/da lta ba la 'jug pa yin//'das dang ma 'ongs la mi sbyor//cing sogs tshig phrad sbyor tshul ni//ga da ba dang da drag mthar//cing ces ce 'o ce na cig/77

nga na ma 'a ra la dang // mtha' rten med pa'i rjes dag tu//zhing zhes zhe 'o zhe na zhig/ sa mthar dmigs bsal zhes ma gtogs//shing dang she 'o she na shig/'o 'u 'am gyi tsheg khyim yang d+ngha rkang ba skong dang mi skong dbye//'phags yul yi ge ji bzhin du//yig mgor dbu khyud 'bri srol yod//lhug pa'i rnam grangs so so dang // don tshan mtha' la chig shad dang // tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang mtha' dang //rdzogs tshig can mthar nyis shad bya/ /sde tshan chen po rdzogs mtshams dang //le'u mtshams lta bur bzhi shad 'thob //phyi rkang can gyi yi ge rnams//mthar byung rkang ba shad rer brtsi//rkang mthar nga yig ma gtogs pa'i//shad gong rnams su phyi tsheg spang //78

rin chen spungs shad sbrul shad dag/ skabs thob sbyar tshul shes par bya zhis byang bar bya'o/ /tshig phrad gzhan bshad zin to//brazhi bu rtags kyi zhadug tshulka dgad pu/yi ge spyi'i rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa dang / sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa dang / rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa dang gsum/ dang bo/ yi ge spyi'i rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa/spyir ka sogs gsal byed sum cu ni pho dang i sogs dbyangs bzhi ni mo yin rno/ /ka sogs gsal byed sum cu bo la'ang nang gses kyi dbye ba lnga ste/ pho dang ma ning dang mo dang shin tu mo dang mo gsham ste lnga yod de/ ka ca ta pa tsa lnga ni pho dang / kha cha tha pha tsha lnga ni ma ning dang / ga ja da ba dza wa zha za 'a ya sha sa ste bcu gnyis ni mo dang / nga nya na ma bzhi ni shin tu mo dang / ra la ha gsum ni mo gsham yin la de gsum la ma 79

ning mtshan med kyang zer/ a yig ni rtags med yin no/ /sdom ni/ / sbyir btang ka sogs sum cu pho//rī i sogs dbyangs bzhi mo yin no//ka sogs gsal byed sum cu la//nang gses dbye ba lnga phye ste//ka ca ta pa tsa lnga pho//kha cha tha pha tsha ma ning //ga ja da ba dza dang wa//zha za 'a ya sha sa ste//mo yi yi ge bcu gnyis yin/ /nga nya na ma shin tu mo// ra la ha gsum mo gsham ste//ming gzhan ma ning mtshan med zer//a yig 'dir ni rtags med yin//zhes byang bar bya'o// yi ge pho dang mo sogs kyi khyad par ni/ skad gdangs drag zhan gyi sgo nas bzhag pa yin te/ ka sogs pho lnga ni rjod pa'i rlung shugs drag cing dam pa dang / kha sogs ma ning lnga ni rjod 80

pa'i rlung shugs grim lhod ran pa dang / ga sogs mo'i yi ge bcu gnyis ni rjod pa'i rlung shugs lhod pa dang / nga sogs shinatu mo bzhi ni rjod pa'i rlung shugs shin tu lhod ba dang / ra sogs mo gsham gsum ni ches shin tu lhod pa yin la/ a yig ni rang dbang ba'i brjod pa can yin pas sde tshan lnga bo gang du'ang mi gtogs pas na rtags med du 'dod do/ /gsal byed sum cu'i nang nas rjes 'jug bcu byung ba dang rjes 'jug bcu'i nang nas sngon 'jug lnga byung ba dang / de dag gang la 'jug pa dang mi 'jug pa'i tshul ni yi ge'i rnam bzhag dngos bshad pa'i skabs su mdor bsdus te bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa/ sngon 'anug gi rtags kyi 'anug ba bshad pa/sngon 'jug lnga la dbye ba 'byed tshul dang / tshul ji ltar 'jug pa dang / dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa bshad pa gsum las/1 sngon 'jug gi yi ge lnga la nang gses kyi dbye ba 'byed tshulabashad pa/sngon 'jug lnga yang ming gzhi'i yi ge'i sngon du song ba na de'i dbang gis skad gdangs drag par 'gyur ba pho dang / skad 81

gdangs ran par 'gyur ba ma ning dang / skad gdangs cung zad zhan par 'gyur ba mo dang / de las kyang zhan par 'gyur ba shin tu mo ru bzhag pa yin pas na/ ba sngon 'jug gi pho yig dang / ga da gnyis sngon 'jug gi ma ning / 'a sngon 'jug gi mo/ ma sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo yin no/ /ba pho ga’da gnyis ma ning / /'a mo ma ni shin tu mo/ /zhes byang bar bya'o/ /2 sngon 'artsag tshul ji ltar 'jug pa bshad pa/sngon 'jug gi pho ba yig ni/ rang gi 'jug yul ming gzhi'i yi ge la skad gdangs drag pa'i tshul gyis 'jug ste/ dper na/ sgrub lta bu la/ sngon 'jug ba bzhag nas bsgrub ces brjod tshe/ sngon 'jug ba'i dbang gis sgra drag por song ba lta bu/sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga dang da yig ni/ skad gdangs ran pa'i tshul gyis 'jug ste/ dper na/ cog lta bu la/ sngon 'jug ga bzhag nas/ gcog ces brjod tshe/ sngon 'jug ga'i dbang gis sgra ran par song ba lta bu dang / kon lta bu la/ sngon 'jug da bzhag nas/ dkon zhes brjod tshe/ sngon 'jug0da'i dbang gis sgra ran par 'gro ba lta bu/ sngon 'jug gi mo 'a yig ni/skad gdangs zhan pa'i tshul gyis 'jug ste/ dper na/ phul lta 82

bu la/ sngon 'jug 'a bzhag nas/ 'phul zhes brjod tshe/ sngon tsho'ajug 'a'i dbang gis sgra zhan par 'gro ba lta bu/ sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo ma yig ni/ skad gdangs shin tu zhan cing lhod pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa yin te/ dper na/ tshar lta bu la/ sngon 'jug ma bzhag ste/ mtshar zhes brjod tshe sngon 'jug ma'i dbang gis sgra shin tu zhan par 'gro ba lta bu'o/ /3 sngon 'anug dgos pa ci'i phyir 'acag pa bshad pa/'di la thog mar bdag gzhan dang / dus gsum shes dgos la/ bdag gzhan shes pa la bya byed las gsum gyi khyad par shes dgos/ bya byed las gsum ni/ dper na/ bzo ba zhig gis 'phrul 'khor zhig bzo ba'i tshe/ 'phrul 'khor bzo ba bya ba/ bzo ba kho rang byed pa bo/ 'phrul 'khor las yin haṃ/ mi zhig gis bzo ba ༷de la/ khyod kyis bya ba ci byelda kyin ā+od/ ces dris na/ ngas 'phrul 'khor shāzo bzhin yod/ces lan 'debs/ mi gzhan zhig la 'phrul 'khor 'di bzo ba'i bya ba byed pa bo su red/ ces dris na/ bzo ba 'di red/ces lan 'dz+wabs/ yang bze ba khyod kyis ༷sa rgyu bo ci red/ces dris na/ 'phrul 'khor red/bye ces lan 'debs so/ /byibye

yang zhing ba zhig gisathong gshol bzo ba'i tshe/ thong gshol bzo ba bya ba/ zhing ba kho rang byed pa bo/ thong gshol las yin/ de rbozhin du mi zhig gis yi ge 'ebri ba'i tshe/ yi ge 'bri ba bya ba/'bri mkhan kho rang rmud pa bo/ yi ge lhas yin/ mgar rbo zhig gis lcags rdung ba'i tshe/ lcags brdung ba byā ba/ rdung mkhan mgar ba sdid pa bo/ lcags swās yin/ byed pa la gnyis yod de/ byed pa bo dang / byed pa gnyis/ mgar ba ni byed pa bo dang / rdung byed tho ba ni byed pa yin/ yi ge 'bri tshe/ 'bri mkhan ni byed pa bo dang / 'bri rgyad smyu gu ni byed pa yin/ sa rko ba'i tshe/ rko mkhan ni byed pa bo dang / rko byed 'jor ni byed pa yin/ lag pas 'phrul 'khor skor ba'i tshe/ skor mkhan ni byed pa bo dang / lag pa ni byed pa yin/ bdag gzhan gyi khyad par ni/ rang dang gzhan la go rgyu ma yin par/ bya byed las gsum gyi nang gi byed pa bo dang byed pa gnyis la bdag zer/ bya ba dang las gnyis la gzhan zer/ des na 'phrul 'khor bzo ba bo dang / 'phrul 'khor bzo /byed kyi lag cha gnyis bdag yin la/ 'phrul 'khor bzo ba'i bya ba dang / 'phrul 'khor gnyis gzhan yin/ de bzhin du/ yi ge 'bri mkhan dang / 'bri byed smyu gu gnyis bdag yin la/ yi ge 'bri ba'i bya ba dang / yi ge byi4

gnyis gzhan yin/ de'i stabs kyis 'phrul 'khor skor ba bo zhes rjod pa'i sgra de byed po bdag rjod kyi sgra dang / 'phrul 'khor skor byed ces rjod pa'i sgra de byed pa bdag rjod kyi sgra dang /'phrul 'khor skor bar byed ces rjod pa'i sgra de byed pa'i las rjod pa'i sgra yin zer dgos shing / de gsum ni skabs 'di'i bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang gi bdag gi phyogs su gtogs pa yin/ de'i stabs kyis tshig de gsum gyi nang gi skor zhes pa gsum ga la sngon 'jug ba mi thob ste/ 'og tu 'chad 'gyur ltar sngon 'jug gi pho ba yig ni bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang gi bdag la mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ 'di rnams la bdag 'brel gyi sgra'ang zer/bskor bya zhes pa bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan rjod kyi sgra dang / bskor bar bya zhes rjod pa'i sgra 'di la bya ba'i las rjod pa'i sgra zer/ 'di gnyis ka bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang gi gzhan yin stabs sngon 'jug ba thob ste/ ba bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang gi gzhan la 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /'di lta bu la gzhan 'brel gyi sgra'ang zer/ de bzhin du rjod pa bo/ rjod byed/ rjod par byed rnams bdag 'brel gyi sgra yin gshis bas 'phul med la/ brjod bya/ brjod par bya/ brjod bya'i gtam rnams gzhun brjod kyi sgra yin gshis bas 'phul thob bo/ /85

dus gsum ni/ byas zin 'das pa dang / byed bzhin pa da lta ba/ bya 'gyur ni ma 'ongs pa yin/ gong gi bdag gi phyogs su gtogs pa'i byed rjod kyi sgra de/ da lta ba ston pa'i sgra yin la/ gzhan gyi phyogs su gtogs pa'i bya las ston pa'i sgra de/ ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i sgra yin/ byed pa bo ston pa'i sgra dang / gzhan rjod kyi sgra gnyis dus gsum gang du mi gtogs/bdag gzhan gnyis gang du'ang mi gtogs pa'i dus gsum la 'jug pa du ma yod de/ dper na/ gyur zhes pa/ 'das pa dang / 'gyur bzhin pa zhes pa da lta ba dang / 'gyur 'gro zhes pa/ma 'ongs pa la 'jug pa lta bu mang mod 'og nas shes par bya'o/ /spyir byed pa bo gzhan dang 'brel ba'i las dang / byed pa bo gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i las gnyis yod la/ de gnyis kyi khyad par niru/ byed pa bo gzhan gyis dngos su sgrub par byed pa zhig yin na/ de la byed po gzhan dang 'brel ba'i las zhes brjod par bya ste/ dper na/ ras yug dkar bo zhig la tshos brgyab ste mdog dmar bor bsgyur ba la mtshon na/ byed pa bo tshos mkhan dngos su yod stabs byed pa bo dang 'brel ba'i tshig brjod par bya dgos te/dmar bor bsgyur bya'i ras yug sa/zhan/ 86tre

dmar bor sgyur ba bo/ byed pa bo/dmar bor sgyur byed tshon/ byed pa/dmar bor sgyur bar byed/ byed pa'i las/dmar bor bsgyur bar bya/ bya ba'i las/dmar bor bsgyurd zin/ 'das pa/dmar bor sgyurd cig bskul tshiga'adi lta bu la bya byed tha dad pa'ang zer/ las dang bya ba gang zhig byed pa bo gzhan dngos su med par rang gi ngang gis 'grub par snang ba lta bu yin na/ de la byed pa bo gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i las zhes bya ste/ dper na/ sos kar drod kyi dbang gis ri lung kun tu rtswa sngon rgyas te sngo ljang du gyur pa lta bu la/sngo ljang du 'gyur rgyu'i ri lung / gzhan/sngo ljang du 'gyur bzhin pa/ da lta ba/sngo ljang du 'gyur nges/ ma 'ongs pa/'di lta bu la bya byed tha mi dad pa'ang zer/4 sngon 'jug lnga bo dargos pa gang gi phyir 'jug pa bshad pa/sngon 'jug gi pho ba yig ni/ dus gsum gyi nang nas 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa la 'jug bdag gzhan gnyis kyi 87

nang nas gzhan la 'jug dus da lta ba dang / dngos po bdag dang bskul tshig la mi 'jug dper na/ bya ba bsgrubs lta bu sngon 'jug ba dang / yang 'jug sa gnyis ka'i dbang ji/sa 'das par song la/ bsgrub bya'i bya ba lta bu dngos po gzhan la sngon 'jug ba 'jug la yangagyi'ajug med/ bsgrub par bya/ lta bu'ang bya ba'i las rjod pa'i sgra yin la/ 'di lta bu la bya ba bsgrub pa'i phyir 'jug pa yang zer/ sgrub pa bo dang sgrub byed/lta bu bdag dang 'brel ba la ba sngon du mi 'jug sgrub bzhin pa lta bu dus da lta ba la'ang ba sngon du mi 'jug sgrubs shig lta bu'i bskul tshig la'ang sngon 'jus/ ba mi 'jug go/ / sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga dang da gnyis ni/ dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis dang / dus da lta ba ston pa'i ched du 'jugasngon 'jug gi mo 'a yig ni/ dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis las gtso cher bdag la 'jug pa dang / dus gsum las da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i ched du 'jug go/ /sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo ma yig ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis dang / dus gsum ga la khyad med du mnyam par 'jug pa yin no/ / / sdom ni/ ji pho ni 'das dang ma 'ongs dang // 88 zi

dngos po gzhan dang gzhan bsgrub phyir//ma ning gnyis ka bdag gzhan gnyis//dus kyi da lta ba la 'jug/mo ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis//dus kyi da lta ma 'ongs la /shin tu mo ni bdag gzhan dang //dus gsum kun la mnyam par 'jug/ces byang bar bya'o//pya sngon 'anug gi pho ba yig 'das pa la 'jug tshul bshad pa/dper na/ bang mdzod 'bru rigs kyis bkang / dmangs kyis rab tu byākur/ mi ngan logs su byākar/༷ mang phyogs rang phyogs su byākug yig cha'i dgongs pa byākral/ mang tshogs kyi re ba byāskangs/ nyam chung gi srog snguskyabs/ bzo grwa gsar du byāskrun/ khang ba rgya ༷skyed/ lto ba zas kyis byārgyags/ lag pas 'phrul 'khor byāsgul/ rgya yig bod yig tu gasgyur/ gsar brje'i las dorno bsgrubs/ dar cha mthon por /rdasgrongs/ ston gyi btsas ma brngas/ rin chen lag tu bhacangs/ mo sgor mo snod du bcug ༷mig gis de la bltas/ ma la du gdan bting / nor ci 89

lug thang mar byārdal/ lag pas thal mo sdurdabs/ bro bas bro ba3rdungs/ kha zas byāldad/ dbang du byāsdus/ phyag tu dpe cha byāsnams/ thabra tu lug sha byātsos/ yig cha 7byārtsams/ lag pas bzhabyās/ thang la ḍizhag mdzo mo dwazhos/ lag pas byāzung / khug ma sazed/ g.yul ngo byāzlog char chus ༷rlan/dgra bo byārlags/ legs par byāshad/ zas nor byāshams/ rgyu nor byāsags/ skyon byāsal/ ngal sdusos/ yo ba byāsrangs/rig pa byāslabs/ lta bu dang / de dag las/ bkang lta bu sngon 'jug gi dbang gis 'das tshig tu grub pa yin la/ bsgrubs/bskangs/ bskyabs/ bsgrags/ lta bu sngon 'jug pho yig dang 'brel dgos mod/ gtso cher yang 'jug gi dbang gis 'das tshig tu grub pa yin te/ yang 'jug med na/ bsgrub/ bskang /bskyab/ bsgrag nams ni/ dngos po gzhan dang / bsgrub par bya sogs bya las ma 'ongs par 'gyur ro/ /ba yig dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ bkang bya/ bkang bya'i mdzod/ bkur bya/ bkur bya'i slob dpon/ bkar bya/ bkar bya'i mi ngan/ bkug bya/ bkug bya'i shing / bkral bya/ bkral 90

bya'i dgongs pa/ bskang bya/ bskang bya'i re ba/ 7snabaskyab bya/ bskyab bya'i nyam chung / bskrun bya/ bskrun bya'i bzo grwa/ bsgul bya/bsgul bya'i 'phrul 'khor/ bsgyur bya/ bsgyur bya'i gzhung /—bsgrub bya/ bsgrub bya'i gsar brje/ bsgreng bya/ bsgreng bya'i dar cha/ brnga bya/ brnga bya'i btsas ma/ bcang bya bcang bya'i nor bu/ bcug bya/ bcug bya'i sgor mo/ blta bya/ blta bya'i ltad mo/ bting bya/ bting bya'i gdan/ bstab bya/bstab bya'i zas/ brdung bya/ brdung bya'i rnga/ bldad bya/ bldad bya'i zas/ bsdu bya/ bsdu bya'i lo thog bsnam bya/bsnam bya'i dpe cha/ btso bya/ btso bya'i sha bzho bya/ bzho bya'i mdzo mo/ lag pas bzung bya/ bzung bya'i dpe cha/ mig gis bzung bya/ bzung bya'i gzugs/ bzed bya/ bzed bya'i snod/ bzlog bya/ bzlog bya'i g.yul ngo / brlag bya/ brlag bya'i dgra/ bshad bya/ bshad bya'i srid jus/ bsal bya/bsal bya'i skyon/ bslab bya/ bslab bya'i rig gnas/ lta bu'o/ /bskang bya/ bskyab bya/ bskrun bya/ zhes bya tshig yod pa tsam gyis dngos po gzhan te bya ba'i yul la go bar 'gyur la/bskang bya'i re ba zhes tshig grogs byung tshe lhag par gsal zhi nga /bskang / bsgrub/ lta bu bya tshig dang tshig grogs gnyis ka med 91

na'ang / sngon rjes dang brjod sgra'i dbang gis dngos po gzhan la go bar 'gyur te/ sngon 'jug ba'i dbang gis dngos po bdag la mi 'khrul/ yang 'jug med pa'i dbang gis 'das pa la mi 'khrul ba'i phyir ro/ / gzhan yang / bya tshig gis gsal mi dgos par dngos po gzhan la go nus pa/ dper na/ (gos sogs la/ ) bgo ba/(bzhon rta la) bcib pa/ (chang sogs la)btung ba/(spos la)bdug pa/ (zas la)bza' ba/ (bslab bya la)bslab pa sogs ma ning mo sogs kyi skabs su shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du ba yig bya ba'i las sam/ bya ba bsgrub pa'i phyir 'jug pa/ dper na/ bkang bar bya/ bkur bar bya/bkar bar bya/ bkug par bya/ dgongs pa bkral bar bya/ re ba bskang bar bya/ bskrun par bya/ bsgyur bar bya/ bsgrub par bya sogs gong du bshad pa de rnams la bya tshig sbyar ba rnams yin/ de dag gi 'jug tshul tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas rim bzhin brjod na/ bkang ngo bkang bya bkang bar bya// bkurd to bkur bya bkur bar bya// bkard to bkar bya bkar bar bya /9lha

0 bkrald to bkral bya bkral bar bya//bskrund to bskrun bya bskrun par bya//bskyed do bskyed bya bskyed par bya//bskyabs dang bskyab bya bskyab par bya//bskyangs dang bskyang bya bskyang bar bya//bskums dang bskum bya bskum par bya//bskuld to bskul bya bskul bar bya//brkyangs dang brkyang bya brkyang bar bya//bskurd to bskur bya bskur bar bya// dpon bskos bsko bya bsko bar byasposnum bskus bsku bya bsku bar bya// nor brkus brku bya brku bar bya//don bsgrubs bsgrub bya bsgrub par bya//mna' bsgags bsgag bya bsgag par bya//ras brgyangs brgyang bya brgyang bar bya// bsgard to bsgar bya bsgar bar bya//bsgrald to bsgral bya bsgral bar bya//brgyand to brgyan bya brgyan par bya//zhing brngas brnga bya brnga bar bya / 93

brjod zin brjod bya brjod par bya//bsnyad zin bsnyad bya bsnyad par bya//mig bltas blta bya blta bar bya// ngag bsdams bsdam bya bsdam par bya//sman bsdebs bsdeb bya bsdeb par bya /don bsdus bsdu bya bsdu bar bya//mtshon bsnams bsnam bya bsnam par bya//sha btsos btso bya btso bar bya//grangs brtsis brtsi bya brtsi bar bya//bzhar zin bzhar bya bzhar bar bya//bzhos dang bzho bya bzho bar bya//bzlas zin bzla bya bzla bar bya//rig bslabs bslab bya bslab par bya//bshad zin bshad bya bshad par bya//rdzas bshams bsham bya bsham par bya /bsres dang bsre bya bsri bar bya// mer bsregs bsreg bya bsreg par bya// khyim bsrungs bsrung bya bsrung bar bya /zhes sogs lta bu ste rim bzhin dus 'dwas pa dwang dngos po 94

gzhan dang bya ba'i las la 'jug pa'o/ /rjes 'jug na ra la gsum gyi rjes su da drag thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis slar bsdu sbyar tshe to thob pa yin la/ 'das tshig min tshe/ bskon no/ bskur ro/ bsgral lo/ zhes 'byung ba las slar bsdu'i to sgra mi 'byung /bskon no/ bskur ro sogs/ bskon par bya/ bskur bar bya/zhes sogs kyi don du 'jug pa yin la/ deng sang cher mi 'bri yang shes par bya dgos pa'i gnas yin no/ /de dag gi zlas drangs pa'i byed pa bo dang / byed pa'i las dang byed pa la bas 'phul med de/ skyed pa bo/ skyed par byed/ skyed byed/skyong ba bo/ skyong bar byed/ skyong byed/ skyob pa bo/ skyob par byed/ skyob byed/ dpon sko ba bo/ sko bar byed/ sko byed/nor rku ba bo/ rku bar byed/ rku byed/ mang tshogs skul ba bo/ skul bar byed/ skul byed/ gtam sgrog pa bo/ sgrog par byed/ sgrog byed/ sgom pa bo/ sgom par byed/ sgom byed/sgrub pa bo/ sgrub par byed/ sgrub byed/ sgrolo ba bo/sgrol bar byed/ sgrol byed/ phreng ba rgyud pa bo/ rgyud par byed/ rgyud byed/ yig cha sgyur ba bo/ sgyur bar byed/sgyur byed/ zhing rnga ba bo/ rnga bar byed/ rnga byed/ —rjod pa bo/ rjod par byed/ rjod byed/ lta ba bo/ lta bar byed / lta 95

byid/ sdud pa bo/ sdud par byed/ sdud byed/ sdom pa bo/sdom par byed/ sdom byed/ rtsom pa bo/ rtsom par byed/ rtsom byed/ grangs rtsi ba bo/ rtsi bar byed/ rtsi byed/ khardo ba rtsig pa bo/ rtsig par byed/ rtsig byed/ me lajisro ba bo/ sro par byed/ sro byed/ sol ba sreg pa bo/ sreg par byed/ sreg byed/ ces sogs dang bskul tshig la'ang bas 'phul med de/dper na/ skyongs shig skyobs shig dpon skos shig mang tshogs skuld cig srid jus sgrogs shig sgoms shig sgrubs shig sgrold cig rtsis phreng rgyud cig yig cha sgyurd cig rjod cig ltos shig sdoms shig rig gzhung rtsoms shigagrangs rtsis shig khang ba rtsigs shig tshong rdzas shoms shigame la sros shig sregs shig sogs lta bu ga nga ba ma rjes 'jug can phal cher la yang 'jug sa thob pa dang / mig gis lta ba'i bskul tshig ltos lta bu la'ang sa mtha' thob pa dang / na ra la'i mtha' can la da dwag thob pa yin/ sa drag dang da drag gi dbang gis cig dang / shig ma sbyar yang bskul tshig tu go bar 'gyur te/ skyongs/ skyobs/ dpon skos/ mang tshogs skuld/srid jus sgrogs/ bya ba sgrubs/ gnang ba stsold/ lta bu'o/ /bya dang byed kyi tshig gnyis gang yang ma sbyar ba/ bskyangs/96

bskyang/ skyong/ skyongs/ sogs 'byung tshe rim bzhin/ 'dasargopa dang / bskyang bya dang / skyong ba bo'am skyong byed dang /bskul tshig tu go ba sogs gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /6 sngon 'anug gi ma jing ga dang da gnyis dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa bshad pa/dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis ka dang / dus da lta ba ston pa'i ched du 'jug pa gtso che ste/ gas 'phul dngos po bdag ste byed pa bo dang / byed pa la 'jug pa/ dper na/ gcir ba bo/ gcir byed/ gcu ba bo/ gcu byed/ gcod pa bo/gcod byed/ gcog pa bo/ gcog byed/ don gnyer ba bo/gnyer byed/ khrag gtar ba bo/ gtar byed/ chu gtig pa bo/gtig byed/ se gol gtog pa bo/ gtog byed/ gtod pa bo/gtod byed/ gtong ba bo/ gtong byed/ thug pa gdu ba bo/gdu byed/ kha gdang ba bo/ gdang byed/ gri gdeng ba bo/gdeng byed/ gnon pa bo/ gnon byed/ gtsag bus gtsag pa bo/ gtsag byed/ gzhal ba bo/ gzhal byed/ blos gzhig pa bo/ gzhig byed/ lam du gzhug pa bo/ gzhug byed/dgra gzhom pa bo/ gzhom byed/ gzar ba bo/ gzar byed/97

g.yeng ba bo/ g.ying byed/ rlung yab g.yob pa bo/ g.yob byed/ zas g.yo ba bo/ g.yo byed/ gos g.yog pa bo/g.yog byed/ ring thung gshib pa bo/ gshib byed/ shing gshog pa bo/ gshog byed/ dril bu gsil ba bo/ gsil byed/ gsung ba bo/ gsung byed/ shing gse ba bo/ gse byed/ dgra gsod pa bo/ gsod byed/ nor gsog pa bo/gsog byed/ sogs lta bu dang / byed pa'i las la 'jug pa/gcod par byed/ gcu bar byedakyi gnyer bar byed/ gsog par byed/ lta bu'o/ /ga yig dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa ni/ gcir bya/ gcu bya/ gcod bya/ gcog bya/ gnyer bya/ gtar bya/ gtig bya'i chu/ gtod bya/ gtong bya/ gdu bya/ gnon bya/gtsag bya/ gzhal bya/ gzhig bya/ gzhom bya/ gzhug bya/gzar bya/ g.yog bya/ gshib bya/ gse bya/ gsod bya/gsog bya/ lta bu dang / gzhan bya ba'i las la 'jug pa ni/gcir bar bya/ gcu bar bya/ gcod par bya/ gnyer bar bya/gtong bar bya/ gdu bar bya/ lta bu'o/ /sngon 'jug da yig dngos po bdag dang byed pa la 'jug pa ni/ skud pa dkri ba bo/ dkri byed/ rta kha dkyu ba bo/ dkyu 98

byid/ rol mo dkrol ba bo/ dkrol byed/ dkrug pa bo/dkrug byed/ gad mo dgod pa bo/ dgod byed/ mdud pa dkrol ba bo/ dkrol byed/ dngang ba bo/ dngang byed/(skrag slong ba) tshad dpog pa bo/ dpog byed/ dpyod pa bo/dpyod byed/ rdos dbur ba bo/ dbur byed/ mdung dbyug pa bo/ dbyug byed/ gzhan la dmod pa bo/ dmod byed/ dngos rdzas dbul ba bo/ dbul byed/ ces pa lta bu dang / da yig dngos po gzhan dang bya ba'i las la 'jug pa ni/ dkri bya'i skud pa/ skud pa dkri bar bya/ dkyu bya'i rta/ rta kha dkyu bar bya/ dkrol bya'i rol mo/ dkrol bar bya/ dkrug bya/ dkrug par bya/ dgod bya/ dgod par bya/ dkrol bya'i mdud pa/mdud pa dkrol bar bya/ dngang bya/ dngang bar bya/ blos dpog bya/ dpog par bya/ dpyod bya/ dpyod par bya/dbur bya/ dbur bar bya/ dbyug bya/ dbyug par bya/ dmod bya/ dmod par bya/ dbul bya'i 'tshams rtags/ dbul bar bya/ zhes sogs dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis ka la 'jug ma ri'adra'o/ /bya tshig gis gsal mi dgos par yul gyi sgra mtshon nus pa gdam bya la gdam pa/ yul la gzung ba sogs kyang bya ba yul la 'jug pa yin/

sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga da gnyis dus da lta ba la 'jug tshul ni/ spyir dngos po bdag la 'jug pa'i skabs kyi/ gcod par byed/ gnyer bar byed dang / dkri bar byed/ dgod par byed sogs byed pa bo bdag dang 'brel ba'i byed pa'i tshig rnams dus kyi nang gi da lta ba'i tshig yin la/ gcod par bya/gnyer bar bya/ dkri bar bya/ dgod par bya sogs bya ba yul dang 'brel ba'i bya tshig rnams ni/ bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan dang / dus gsum kyi nang nas ma 'ongs pa yin par gsungs/ bdag gzhan gyi khongs su ma gtogs pa'i dus da lta ba la 'jug tshul ni/ ga yig da lta ba la 'jug pa/ dper na/shing gcod kyin 'dug bya ba gnyer gyin yod/ zil gyis gnorno gyin mchis/ sman gdu bzhen gda'/ nor gsog gin 'dug sbyin pa gtong dṛzhin yod/ zas g.yo bs+t+waṃn 'dug sogs lta bu'o/ / 4 4da yig da lta ba la 'jug pa/ dper na/ skud pa dwakri bzhin yod/ rig pas dpyod kyin 'dug zho dkrog gin 'dug rol mo dak+koskya bzhirno 'tshogs/ dgod bat+t+waṃn bshad sogs lta bu'o/ / rme — 3 100

ri 7 sngon 'jug gi mo 'a yig dgos pa ci'i sbyir 'anug pa bshad pa/dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis las/ gtso bor bdag ston byed du 'jug pa dang / gzhan la'ang 'jug dus gsum las gtso bo ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i phyir 'jug la/ da lta ba la'ang 'jug dngos po bdag ste byed pa bo dang byed pa la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ skud pa 'khel ba bo/ 'khel byed/ khur 'khur ba bo/ 'khur byed/ gzhan du 'khyer ba bo/ 'khyer byed/ lam du 'khrid pa bo/ 'khrid byed/ dri ma 'khrud pa bo/ 'khrud byed/ rtsam skya 'gam pa bo/ 'gam byed/ tshur 'gugs pa bo/ 'gugs byed/ khal 'gel ba bo/ 'gel byed/ 'gog pa bo/ 'gog byed/ 'god pa bo/ 'god byed/ g.yul 'gyed pa bo/ 'gyed byed/ ja 'grem pa bo/ 'grem byed/ srid jus 'chad pa bo/ 'chad byed/zhags pas 'ching ba bo/ 'ching byed/ lag tu 'chang ba bo/ 'chang byed/ las 'tshol ba bo/ 'tshol byed/ khri tses 'jal ba bo/ 'jal byed khri tse/ 'jib pa bo 'jib byed kha/ 'ju ba bo/ 'ju byed/ 'o ma 'jo ba bo 'jo 10‘

byed/ gnas su 'jog pa bo/ 'jog byed/ dgra 'joms pa bo/ 'joms byed/ 'thab pa bo/ 'thab byed/ phye 'thag pa bo/ 'thag byed/ ja 'thung ba bo/ 'thung byed/ thun bu 'thu ba bo/ 'thu byed/ tshur 'then pa bo/ 'therge byed/gus pas 'dud pa bo/ 'dud byed/ dgra 'dul ba bo/'dul byed/ yar 'degs pa bo/ 'degs byed/ rjes su 'ded pa bo/ 'ded byed/ 'dogs pa bo/ 'dogs byed/ phyir 'don pa bo/ 'don byed/ gdams ngag 'ardoms pa bo/ 'doms byed/ 'dor ba bo/ 'dor byed/ 'dri ba bo/ 'dri byed/ nor gyis kha 'drid pa bo/ 'drid byed/ shing 'drud pa bo/ 'drud byed/ 'dren pa bo/ bedren byed/'phen pa bo/ 'phen byed/ gzhan 'phya ba bo/ 'phya byed/'phrog pa bo/ 'phrog byed/ las la 'bad pa bo/ 'bad byed/rtswa 'bal ba bo/ 'bal byed/ shing 'bigs pa bo/ 'bigs byed/ nor 'bul ba bo/ 'bul byed/ dung 'bud pa bo/'bud byed/ 'bod pa bo/ 'bod byed/ sgo 'byed ya bo/'byed byed/ sa la 'brad pa bo/ 'brad byed/ 'bri ba bo/'bri byed/ kha 'tshab pa bo/ 'tshapa byed/ gzhan la 'tshe ba bo/ 'tshe byed/ 'tshol ba bo/ 'tshol byed/ phyugs 'tsho ba 102

bo/ 'tsho byed/ lus 'tsho ba bo/ 'tsho byed/ 'dzin pa bo/'dzin byed/ 'dzugs pa bo/ 'dzugs byed/ sogs lta bu dang / byed pa'i las la 'jug pa ni/ 'khur bar byed/'khyer bar byed/ 'khrid par byed/ 'chad par byed sogs lta bu'o/ / 'di dag ni bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gtso cher bdag la 'jug pa'i dpe brjod yin la/ gzhan la'ang mi 'jug pa ma yin te/ gzhan la 'jug pa/ dper na/ 'khyer bya'i dngos po/ 'gam bya'i rtsam pa/ 'thab yul gyi dgra/ 'phen bya/ 'phya bya/ 'phrog bya/ 'bud bya sogs la 'jug la/gzhan mang che bar/ bdag la 'jug la gzhan la mi 'jug ste/dper na/ 'khur ba bo// khur bya/ 'khrid pa bo/ khrid bya/'khrud pa bo/ bkru bya/ 'gog pa bo/ dgag bya/ g.yul ragyed pa bo/ bkye bya/ 'chad pa bo/ bshad bya/ 'ching ba bo/ bcing bya/ 'jib pa bo/ gzhib bya/ 'o ma 'jo ba bo/bzho bya/ 'jog pa bo/ bzhag bya/ 'joms pa bo/ gzhom bya/ 'thung ba bo/ btung bya/ 'then pa bo/ then bya/ 'dud pa bo/ btud bya/ 'dul ba bo/ gdul bya/ 'dor ba bo/dor bya/ 'dri ba bo/ dri bya dri ba/ shing 'bugs pa bo/ phug 103

bya/ 'bul ba bo/ phul bya/ 'tshab pa bo/ tshab bya/ 'tshol ba bo/ btsal bya/ 'dzin pa bo/ gzung bya/ zhes sogs snga ma bdag brjod rnams la 'a yod kyang / phyi ma gzhan brjod rnams la 'a 'dor ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis gtso cher bdag la 'jug par gsungs so/ /de dag ni bya byed tha dad pa'i dbang du byas la/ bya byed tha mi dad pa'i dbang du byas na'ang byed pa bojidang /byed pa la 'jug ste/ dper na/ 'khun pa bo/ 'khun byed/gdan la 'khod pa bo/ 'khod byed/ 'khor ba bo/ 'khor byed/ 'khyil ba bo/ 'khyil byed/ 'khyug pa bo/ 'khyug byed/ 'gying ba bo/ 'gying byed/ 'gyur ba bo/ 'gyur byed/ 'gro ba bo/ 'gro byed/ 'chi ba bo/ 'chi byed/ 'jug pa bo/ 'jug byed/ 'du ba bo/ 'du byed/ 'dug pa bo/'dug byed/ 'drog pa bo/ 'drog byed/ 'phag pa bo/ 'phag byed/ 'phar ba bo/ 'phar byed/ 'phur ba bo/ 'phur byed/ 'byung ba bo/ 'byung byed/ 'byon pa bo/ 'byon byed/ 'dzul ba bo/ 'dzul byed/ so gas lta bu/ 'di rnams bya byed tha mi dad pa yin/ sngon 'jug gi mo 'a yig bdag gzhan gyi dbye bas ma bsdus pa'i dus da lta ba la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ 'khur bzhin gda'/ 'khyud kyin snang / 'khor bzhin 104

yod/ skedan la 'khod kyin 'dug srang la 'jal bzhin yod/gdan 'ding gin 'dug rgyan 'dogs kyin gda'/ sems 'du la bzhin mchis/ nang du 'dzul gyin yod/ char 'bab kyin 'dug nyi ma 'char bzhin yod/ lta bu'o/ /sngon 'jug gi mo 'a yig ni bdag gzhan gyi dbye bas ma bsdus pa'i dus ma 'ongs pa la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ 'phrul 'khor ༷khor bar 'gyur/ ༷gim par 'gyur/ /༷khyil bar 'gyur/ yid 'asngil bar 'gyur/ 'asngin par 'gyur/ glog 'khyug par 'gyur/ nyakhrungs par 'gyur/— ༷khod par 'gyur/༷khum par 'gyur/ /nyakhums par 'gyur/ ༷khyog par 'gyur/༷khyor bar 'gyur/ phrukhrol bar 'gyur/ ༷gag 'gyur/ ༷gas ༷gyur/ ༷grib 'gyur/ ༷gul 'gyur/ 'grub 'gyur/ ༷/char ༷gyur/ ྅jug 'gyur/ ༷jo 'gyur/ ༷phyo 'gyur/ ༷byar ༷gyur/ ‘༷bab 'gyur/ 'akyāng 'gyur/ ྅tsho 'gyur/ lta bu'o/ / ( 8 rdzon 'jug gi zhin tu mo ma yig dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa bshad pa/ bdag gzhan dang / dus gsum tshang ma la mnyam par 10bya

'jug ste/ bdag la 'jug pa ni/ dbair na/ srid jus la sdakhas pa bo/ gachong ba bo/ ma—thong ba bo/ sdangag pa bo/ṭaṃdud pa bo/ ṅgedzad pa bo/ lta bu/ byed pa zlo 'jug pa/sdekhas byed/ swār+bhang byed/ swāthong byed/ swādud byed/ lta bu/ byed pa'i las la 'jug pa/ mkhas par byed/ mchong bar byed/ mthong bar byed/ mngag par byed/ mdud par byed/ lta bu/ dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa ni/ mkhas bya/mchong bya/ mthong bya/ mtshon bya/ lta bu/ bya ba'i las la 'jug pa/ mkhas par bya/ mchong bar bya/ mthong bar bya /mdud par bya/ mtshon par bya/ lta bu/ dus 'das pa la 'jug pa/ mkhas zin/ mthong zin/ mdud zin/ mngags zin/ mchod par byas/ mthong bar gyur/ lta bu/ ma 'ongs pa la 'jug pa/ mkhas par 'gyur/ mthong bar 'gyur/ mkhyen par 'gyur/ mdzad par 'gyur lta bu/dus da lta ba la 'jug pa/ mkhas bzhin pa/ stakhyen gyin snang / mthong gin 'dug mngag gin yod/ mdzad kyin snang / lta bu'o/ / 106

gsum pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'anug pa bshad ba/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa dang / de'i 'jug pa rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ tretsho dang bo/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa/ rjes 'jug bcu'i nang gi da ba sa gsum ni rjes 'jug gi sgru pho dang / ga nga na ma ra la drug ni mo/ 'a rjes 'jig gi ma ning yin/ de la'ang nang gses kyi pho la skyes bu rab 'bring tha ma gsum/ mo la mo tsam dang shin tu mo gnyis/ ma ning 'a yig gcig po grogs kyi dbang gis 'gyur ba ma ning dang mtshan gnyis ma ning dang / mtshan med ma ning ste gsum du 'gyur bar bshad/pho yig skyes bu rab 'bring tha gsum ni/ sa skyes bu rab/ da skyes bu 'bring / ba skyes bu tha ma yin la/ mo gnyis ni ga ra la gsum ni mo tsam dang / nga na ma gsum ni shin tu mo yin/ 'a yig gcig pu grogs kyi dbang gis gsum gar 'gyur ro/ /sdom ni/da ba sa gsum pho yin te//ga nga na ma ra la drug/ dze 107

mo yin 'a ni ma ning ngo //sa rab da 'bring ba tha ma /ga ra la gsum mo tsam dang //nga na ma gsum shin tu mo//'a yig ma ning gsum gar 'gyur// zhes byang bar bya'o/ / gnyis pa/ de'i 'artsag pa rgyas par bshad pa/gang la 'jug pa dang gang gis 'jug pa bshad pa/ tshul ji ltar 'jug pa bshad pa/ dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa bshad pa dang gsum/ 1 gang la 'jug pa dang gang gis 'jug pa bshad pa/sngon 'jug dang mi 'dra bar/ ming gzhi'i yi ge sum cu bo tshang ma la rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu bo re re bzhin 'jug ste/dper na/ kag kang / kad/ kan/ kab/ kam/ka'/ kar/ kal/ kas/ de bzhin du thams cad la khyad par med par 'jug mod/ ming dang tshig tu grub ma grub kyi khyad par yod de/ dper na/ dbyang zhes pa sngar gang la'ang 108

mi 'jug kyang / deng sang krung dbyang zhes rgya skad kyi tshab tu bris tshe don ston par 'gyur ba bzhin no/ / 2 tshul ji ltar 'jug pa bshad pa/ 'di la gnyis te/ sgra'i 'jug tshul dang / don gyi 'jug tshul lo/ /rjes 'jug zhugs pa'i sgo nas sgra drag zhan du 'gyur ba sgra'i 'jug tshul dang rjes 'jug zhugs pa'i sgo nas don ci zhig ston pa don gyi 'jug tshul yin/ dang bo sgra'i 'jug tshul bshad pa/ sgra drag zhan spyi'i 'jug tshul ni/ pho yig da ba sa gsum ni skad gdangs drag pa'i tshul dang / mo tsam dang shin tu mo skad gdangs zhan pa'i tshul dang /ma ning skad gdangs bar ma'i tshul gyis 'jug go/ /nang gses kyi 'jug tshul ni/ sngon 'jug ming gzhi rjes 'jug gsum rang gi sder gtogs kyi pho yig tsheg bar gcig la 'tshogs pa na/ drag pa gsum kho na phrad pas sgra drag pa 'byung ste/ dper na/ bkas zhes pa sngon 'jug gi pho ba/ ming gzhi'i pho ka rjes 'jug gi pho sa ste drag pa gsum nang 'phrad byung bas/ sgra drag pa 'byung la/ sa rjes 'jug gi pho gsum gyi nang gi skyes bu rab yin gshis/ drag pa'i drag pa yin/ de bzhin du/ bkad/ lta109

bu'i rjes 'jug da yig skyes bu 'bring yin phyir drag pa'i 'bring dang / bkab lta bu'i rjes 'jug ba yig skyes bu tha ma yin phyir drag pa'i zhan pa yin/ de bzhin du/ bcas/ btus/btsas rnams ni drag pa'i drag pa dang / bcad/ btod/btsud rnams drag pa'i 'bring dang / bcab/ btab/ butsab rnams ni drag pa'i zhan pa ste/ rim bzhin skyes bu rab 'bring tha gsum rjes su zhugs pas so/ /sngon rjes ming gsum po mo yig kho na 'tshogs pa zhan pa yin la/ de yang rjes 'jug mo tsam dang phrad pa zhan pa'i drag pa yin te/ dper na/ 'gaga'agar/ 'gal/ 'dag 'dar/ 'jal lta bu/ shin tu mo dang phrad pa zhan pa'i zhan par 'jog ste/ dper na/ 'gang /'don/ 'jam/ 'bang / 'gan/ 'dzam/ lta bu/ de bzhin du kab lta bu la sngon 'jug med mod/ ming rjes gnyis ga pho yin gshis sgra drag pa dang / kan lta bu de las zhan par gyur pa dang / phab lta bu sgra drag pa dang / bab lta bu ming gzhi mor gyur stabs de las zhan pa dang / ban lta bu ming rjes gnyis ka mor gyur pas de las kyang zhan par gyur pa mngon sum gyis grub pas shes sla'o/ /'di dag rtsa bar/ drag pa gsu ma nyid nang phrad das/ /gal te zhan pa nang phrad na/ /de la'ang glu10

nang gi cha shas kyis/ /de yang drag zhan gnyis su dbye/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /ma ning 'a yig 'jug tshul ni/ bka'/bca'/ bta'/ btsa' lta bu sngon 'jug dang ming gzhi pho yig dang phrad pa dang / dka'/ gta'/ lta bu sngon 'jug ma ning yin kyang ming gzhi pho dang phrad pa dang / ka'/ ca'/ ta'/pa'/ tsa' lta bu sngon 'jug med kyang ming gzhi pho yin pa dang phrad na'ang sgra drag par 'gyur ba dang / 'ga'/ 'ja'/'da'/ 'ba'/ mda'/ mdza' lta bu sngon 'jug dang ming gzhi gnyis ka mo yin pa dang / gda'/ — dga'/ gza'/g.ya'/ gsha' lta bu sngon 'jug ma ning yin kyang ming gzhi mo dang 'phrad pa dang / mkha'/ mcha'/ mtha'/ lta bu/ ming gzhi ma ning yin kyang sngon 'juka mo dang phrad pa dang / ga'/ja'/ da'/ sha'/ zha'/ za' lta bu sngon 'jug med kyang ming gzhi mo dang phrad na'ang zhan par 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'gyur ba ma ning zer ba dang / bda'/ bza'/ bsha'/ lta bu sngon 'jug pho dang ming gzhi mo ste pho mo gnyis ka dang phrad na drag zhan gnyis ka'i cha dang ldan pa'i phyir mtshan gnyis ma ning zer la/ kha'/ cha'/ tha'/ pha'/ tsha' ste ming gzhi ma ning dang 'phrad na drag zhan gang du'ang mi 'gyur bas na mtshan 111

med ma ning zhes bya ste/ 'a yig gcig pu grogs kyi dbang gis 'gyur che ba yin gyi ngo bo'i sgo nas min no/ /'di ni/ rtsa bar/ drag dang phrad na drag par 'gyur/ /zhan dang phrad na zhan par 'gyur/ /gnyis ka dag dang ma phrad na/ /gang du yang ni mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /ming rkyang rjes 'jug med pa'i mthar yang 'a yig thob kyang skad gsar bcad skabs blangs pa yin mod/ don gyis thob pa'i dbang du byed dgos te/ rtsa bar/ rjes 'jug bcu bo ma zhugs na/ /ming gzhan sbyor ba yod mi srid/ /ces gsungs so/ /'di dag la bshad tshul mang yang / 'og tu mtha' dpyad pa'i skabs su dpyad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa don gyi 'jug tshul la/ snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba dang / phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba gnyis las/ dang bo snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba bshad pa/ snga ma ste rjes 'jug rnams rang nyid gang la zhugs pa'i ming de'i don gang ltar te ji ltar ston par 'gyur zhe na/ de ni sngar sngon 'jug gi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ bdag gzhan dang dus gsum sogs la 'jug pa yin te/ dper na/ sgru zhes pa la sngon 'jug ba bzhag na/ bsgru zhes grub pa'i steng du rjes 'jug ba bsnan pas bsgrub 112

ces grub pa'i tshe/ rjes 'jug gi ba des kyang sngon 'jug gis bstan pa ltar ston par 'gyur bas sngon rjes gnyis ka ming gzhi der zhugs pa'i stobs kyis bsgrub bya'i yul dang bsgrub par bya ba ston pa dang / bsgrubs zhes yang 'jug sbyar tshe rjes 'jug dang yang 'jug gnyis kas sngon 'jug dang mnyam du 'das pa ston par 'gyur/ de bzhin du bkod ces pa'i rjes 'jug da des sngon 'jug dang thun mong du 'das pa ston/ de bzhin du rjes 'jug de dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa/ dper na/ 'god bya/ bkad bya/ lta bu dang / bdag po la 'jug pa/ 'god pa bo/ gcod pa bo/ gcod par byed sogs sngar sngon 'jug gi skabs su bshad pa'i dpe brjod rnams ltar/ sngon 'jug gis gang bstan pa ltar rjes 'jug gis kyang bdag gzhan dang 'das ma 'ongs sogs kyi don ston par 'gyur stabs rtsa bar/ snga ma sngon 'jug lnga bzhin sbyar/ /gsungs so/ /'di ni sngon 'jug yod pa'i dbang du byas la/ sngon 'jug med kyang ming gzhi la rjes 'jug zhugs pa'i dbang gis don ston pa dper na/ yod/ byas/phab/ gab/ gyis/ dag gang / mang / spungs/ snang sogs yod pa shes sla/ yang 'jug da drag ni rjes 'jug na ra la gsum gyi rjes su 'das tsheg dang bskul tshig la nges par thob 113

ste/ dper na/ bcoled/ bsgyurd/ bskrund/ phyinadasuto/ /bskord to/ /thard to sogs 'das tshig dang / byond cigasgyurd cig yi ge skurd cig gsold cig skord cigalta bu bskul tshig la 'jug 'das tshig dang bskul tshig min kyang skad kyi gdangs la da drag gi sgra thob pa'i ming tshig dper na/stond ka kund/ dkond cog skyild krung / kland ka berd ka thald ka nand tur/ rind cen/ mnga' rold/pha rold/ land cig shind tu/ 'ond kyang sogs mang mod/rim/da cen sogs 'ga' zhig phyis su sgra 'gyur nas da drag gi sgra mi thon par gyur gshis rin chen zhes 'bri ba lta bu yod/ gnyis pa phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba la/ phyi ma ste rjes 'jug de'i mthar sbyar ba'i ming mtha'i phrad 'dren tshul dang / de'i sgo nas don gang ltar ston par 'gyur ba bshad pa yin la/dber na/ sos zhes pa'i rjes 'jug sa de so zhes pa'i ming gzhi la zhugs pa'i stobs kyis sos zhes rma lta bu sos pa'am —drag par go la/ rjes 'jug sa des rtags mtshungs ka drangasacate/ sos ka zhes grub pa na/ phrad phyi ma ka de'i dbangagis/ sos zhes nga/ des kyang ka dang thun mong du/ sosaka'am/ dpyid dus ston par 'gyur ba'o/ /de'i phyir phyi ma114

gang ltar 'gyur ba zer ro/ /de la dbye na/ ming mtha' drag zhan 'dren tshul/ rnam dbye snga shugs 'dren tshul/ de'i nang gses 'jug tshul gsum ste/ dang bo la/ rtags mtshungs 'dren pa dadi / sgra mtshungs 'dren pa gnyis/ dang bo ming mtha' drag zhan 'dren tshul bshad pa/ rjes 'jug gi pho mo ma ning gi nus pas/ rang gi mtha'i phrad dag kyang rang dang rtags mtshungs 'dren pa yin la/ rjes 'jug gi pho sa'i rjes su pho drangs pa ni/ dper na/ thugs ka sos ka gnyis kagazhis ka thugs ka chas ka stabs ka yungs kar/ zhabs kyu/thabs cig nges tig zhabs tog byas pa/ brtags pa/dgongs pa/ gtams pa/ dngos po/ dgos pa/ goms pa/bzlos pa/ dmigs pa/ chags pa/ mkhris pa/ pags pa/lta bu/ rjes 'jug pho da'i rjes su pho drangs pa ni/ dper na/dpyid ka thad ka berd ka stod kor/ klad kor/bstod pa/ bcad pa/ stod pa/ nod pa/ glod pa/ chad pa/rtsod pa/ skad cig skyild krung / dkond cog lhand cig kund tu/ nand tur/ rind cen/ yond tan/ shind tu/ pha rold tu/ lta bu/ rjes 'jug pho ba'i rjes su pho drangs pa ni/ dper na/ thab ka nub ka115

'thab krol/ bab col/ thob pa/ 'grub pa/ thub pa/ zab pa/ gab tse/ khyab pa/ khyab ste/ chub pa/ lta bu/rjes 'jug mo ga'i rjes su mo drangs pa ni/ dber na/bdag gi/ gcig pu/ lag gi/ nyag ga snyog dra// gtsag bu/ tsog pu/ khug ma/ khog ma/ sig ge sig khyug se khyug 'khyug ge/'khyog ge 'khyog ge 'gro/ gug gu/ gyag gyog de 'grig gamangag rgyu/ cag ge/ tsog ge sdod/ nyag nyog nyag nyig bag ma/ nyag ma/ rtog ge ltag ga stog ma/ ltag ma/ lhag ma/ thog bu/ thog gu/ dog mo/ ldag gu/ sdug gu/ nag nog nag bgaphog gu/ sbrag ma/ mig bu/ mog mog zeg ma/ rtsig bu/rtseg ma/ gzhug gu/ shog bu/ shog gu/ sig sig sig ge sig seg ma/ sog ma/ gseg ma/ rug ge yod lta bu/mo nga yig gis mo drangs pa/ dper na/ khang ba/ drung gi/ gang ba/ byung ba/ mthong ba/ gsung ba/ 'byung ba/ gtong ba/ bskang ba/ bzang ba/ 'thung ba/ snying ga mthong gamathing ga ring bo/ rlung bu/ thang ga zhing ba/ nyung ma/ ljang gu/sprang ma/ dang ma/ gdung ma/ rang ga stong ba/ bzang bo/dang bo/ 'byung bo/ gyong bo/ lta bu/ mo na yig gis mo drangs pa/ dper na/ skyin gor/ nyan ga lan ga gzhan gyi/116

rgyan gyi/ mgron du/ mgron bu/ gan rgya/ rkun bu/ rken bu/'dun ma/ sen mo/ 'khun bu/ smin ma/ nyin mo/ mtshan mo/ chen mo/ sngon bu/ mngon sum/ ngan ngon/ srin bu/kun dong / man ngag lhun gyis grub/ lta bu/ mo ma yig gis mo drangs pa/ dper na/ 'dam ga gsum ga tham ga gsham du/ gam du/ bsam gyin/ bsam gyi/ gtam gyi/ 'a/ma ga'adem rgyu/ thum bu/ tshom bu/ snam bu/ sham bu/ lam bu/ldum bu/ lta bu/mo ra yig gis mo drangs pa/ dkar bo/ dar ba/shar ba/ dgar ba/ bstar ba/ mthar gyi/ nor bu/ sor mo/ ther zug gar ba/ gar mo/ gzar bu/ khur bo/ mkhar ba/ mgar ba/ phur ma/ phur ba/ phur bu/ yur ba/ thor bu/ sder ma/ g.yer ma/ snar ma/ zar ma/ shur ma/ thur ma/ ther ma/ dar ma/ bser bu/ skar ma/ gor mo/ sgor mo/ mkhur ba/ 'ur ba/ dur ba/ mngar mo/ sgyur bo/ nur bo/ nur mo/ tshar bu/ sar ba/ zur ba/ gsar ba/ sgar ba/ bskur ma/ thar ba/ char ba bcar ba bar ma ngar ma/ 'gyur ba/ sbyar ba/ lta bu'o/ /mo la yig gis mo drangs pa/ dper na/ dpal ldan/①ram̐7

dpal rma/ yul ba/ zal ba/ rul ba/ 'jal ba/ mjal ba/ nyal ba/ ril bu/ nyul ma/ myul ba/ thal ba/ thul ba/ dal ba/ dal mo/ dul ba/ dal bu/ nal ma/ phal ba/ 'phel ba/ tshal bu/ zhal ba/ yal ba/ tshil bu/shal bu/ gsal ldan/ sil bu/ bsal ba/ sol ba/ sil ma/ lta bu/ ma ning gis ma ning drangs pa/ dper na/ 'da' kha/ skye kha/ dga' kha/ bu btsa' kha/ zas 'ju kha/ ka cha/ga cha/ gla cha/ me cha/ rgyu cha/ rgyu chas/ go cha/ a pha/bza' tsho/ lta bu yin la/ 'on kyang / ma ning 'a yig ni grogs kyi dbang gis 'gyur che pas/ rtags mtshungs 'dren pa'i nus pa rjes 'jug gzhan rnams dang mi 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa sgra mtshungs 'dren pa ni/ ming gzhi dang sngon 'jug dbyangs ci rigs kyi dbang gis rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi nus pa cung zad 'gyur ba'i dbang gis rtags mtshungs mi 'dren par sgra mtshungs 'dren par 'gyur te/ dper na/ god kha/ zhes brjod tshe rtags mtshungs 'dren na/ rjes 'jug da'i rjes su ming gzhi'i pho ka 'dren dgos mod/ de ltar mi 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan ming gzhi'i ga de ming gzhi'i mo yin la/ de la na ro sbyar ba go de nyid sgra zhan pa'i dbang gis rjes 'jug da'i sgra drag par 'gyur ba'i 118

rnus po'adz+wa cung zad nyams par myas stabs/ ming mtha' phyi ma pho ka ma drangs par ma ning kha drangs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du/ston kha/ dgun kha/ dbyar kha/ gtar kha/ mtshon cha/lang tsho/ mel tshe/ gsol kha/ rgyal kha/ sogs mo'i rjes su ma ning drangs pa dang / dong tse/ rlum po sogs mo'i rjes su pho drangs pa dang / do ker/ be con/ de tsug sogs ma ning gi rjes su pho drangs pa rnams ni/ sngon rjes ming gzhi dbyangs sogs yi ge'i skye gnas dang dam lhod pha na tshun bsdebs pa sogs kyi dbang gis rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi nus pa'ang cung zad 'gyur bas rtags mtshungs ma drangs par sgra mtshungs pa yin no/ / gnyis pa rnam dbye snga shugs 'dren tshul bshad pa/ ming mtha' rjes 'jug de nyid skye sgra'i nus pa'am shugs kyis rtags mtshungs dang sgra mtshungs kyi rnam dbye dang tshig phrad rnams 'dren te/ sngar rnam dbye sogs bshad pa'i skabs su bshad zin pa ltar/ rim bzhin bshad na/ la don gyi skabs sa mthar su thob pa ni sgra mtshungs 'dren pa yin te/ rtags mtshungs 'dren na sa rjes 'jug gi pho yin pas ming gzhi pho zhig 'dren dgos la/la don gyi nang pho yig tu ma gtogs med/ tu dang rjes 'jug gi sa gnyis sgra mi mtshungs te/ sa'i skye gnas so dang rkan yin 119

la/ byid pa rlu'i rtsi rmo dang nyi ba tsam yin/ ta'i skyi gnas so yin la/ byed pa lce'i rtse mo yin gshis sa'i rjes su tu ngag tu mi thon— par/ rjes 'jug sa rang nyid dang skye gnas byid rtsol sogs kyi dbang gis sgra mtshungs pa'i su drangs pā yin no/ /ga'i rjes su tu drangs pa'ang de dang 'dra bar sgra mtshungs drangs pa yin/ ba dang da drag gi rjes su tu drangs pa ni/ rtags mtshungs drangs pa yin/ byed rtsol sogs kyis sgra mi mtshungs par ma byas pas so/ /nga na ma ra la rnams kyi rjes su du drangs pa yang rtags mtshungs drangs pa yin/ da'i rjes su du drangs pa'ang / sa'i rjes su su drangs pa dang 'dra bar sgra mtshungs drangs pa yin/ 'a dang mtha' rten med mthamo ru thob pa ni/ sgra mtshungs drangs pa yin/ na la gnyis ni rnam dbye rang dbang can yin gshis rtags mtha' la ltos pa med par 'jug go/ /rnam dbye gsum pa dang drug pa'i skabs/ da ba sa'i rjes su kyi dang ga nga'i rjes su gi dang / na ma ra la'i rjes su gyi thob pa rnams ni rtags mtshungs drangs pa yin zhing / 'a dang mtha' rten med mthar 'i thob pa ni/ sgra mtshungs 'dren pa yin la/rkang ba skong tshe yi thob pa ni dmigs bsal rang dbang can yin/rnam dbye lnga ba'i nas las gnyis dang lhag bcas kyi la dang nas 120

rnams rkyang rang dbang can yin/ rgyan sdud kyang 'ang yang gsu.oṃ gyi ga mthar kyang thob pa ni sgra mtshungs drangs pa yin la/ da ba sa dang da drag rnams kyi mthar kyang thob pa dang / nga na ma ra la'i rjes su yang sbyor ba rnams ni rtags mtshungs drangs pa yin zhing / 'a dang mtha' rten med mthar 'ang thob pa ni sgra mtshungs drangs pa yin/ lhag bcas kyi da mthar de dang / na ra la'i rjes su te rkyang dang ga nga ma 'a dang mtha' rten med mthar ste thob pa ni sgra mtshungs drangs pa dang / sa dang da drag gi rjes su te thob pa 7dang / ba'i rjes su ste thob pa ni/ rtags mtshungs yin no/ /'byed sdud skabs rjes 'jug rang 'drar ma yig sbyar ba dang rdzogs tshig skabs rang 'drar na ro sbyor ba rnams kyang gtso cher rtags mtshungs yin pa shes sla/ ni sgra/ de sgra/ dang sgra/ spyi sgra sogs phrad rang dbang can yin/ming mtha'i pa ba po bo rnams thob tshul/ da ba sa dang da drag can mthar pa dang po thob pa ni/ rtags mtshungs drangs pa yin la/ ga na ma'i mthar pa dang po thob pa ni sgra mtshungs drangs pa yin/ nga ra la'i rjes su ba dang bo thob pa ni rtags mtshungs drangs pa dang / 'a dang mtha' rten med mthar ba dang bo drangs pa ni sgra mtshungs drangs pa yin/ tshig phrad cing sogs 121

ni/ da ba dang da drag can mthar cing sogs thob pa ni rtags mtshungs drangs pa yin la/ ga mthar cing sogs thob pa ni sgra mtshungs yin/ nga na ma ra la'i rjes su zhing sogs thob pa ni rtags mtshungs dang / 'a dang mtha' rten med pa'i rjes su zhing sogs thob pa dang / sa mthar shing sogs dang dmigs bsal zhes thob pa dag ni sgra mtshungs yin/ 'di dag la yi ge'i skye gnas dang byed rtsol sogs shes pa gal che bas logs su re'u mig yod par ltos/ rtags mtha'i skye gnas dang byed rtsol sogs kyi dbang gis phrad 'dren dgos pa la rtog dpyod tsam yang ma zhugs par/ yul skad re 'ga' ba re gzhir bzung nas bod spyi skad la dbang za bar byed pa ni/ rdzob las kyang rdzob chen bskyal ba'o/ /gsum pa de'i nang gses 'a—jug tshul bshad pa/ rnam dbye dang tshig phrad de dag gang dang gang 'jug pa ni/ ming tshig sdon ma so so'i 'phyo la de ma thag sbyar rgyu'i tshig don 'og ma de'i nus pas shes dgos te dper na/ bzo khang zhes pa ni rnam dbye dang bo ngo bo tsam brjod pa yin la/ ༷de'i mthar lcags brdung zhes pa lta bu'i rnam dbye gnyis pa'i don can gyi tshig sbyar rgyu yod na/bar du rnam dbye gnyis pa du sbyar tshobs/ bzo khang du lcags 122

brdung zhes grub pa dang / bzo ba zhes pa'i mthar bzo las byed ces pa lta bu rnam dbye gsum pa'i don can gyi tshig byung tshe/ rnam dbye gsum pa sbyar dgos pas/ bzo byās bzo las byed ces grub/ yang ming de'i mthar/ khang ba rtsig lta bu bzhi ba dgos ched kyi don can gyi tshig yod na/ bar du bzhi ba sbyar te bzo ba sa khang ba rtsig ces dang / yang bzo khang zhes pa'i ming de'i mthar sbyar ba'i tshig blangs lta bu 'byung khungs kyi don can yod tshe/ lnga ba 'byung khungs sbyar dgos pas/ bzo khang swās blangs zhes grub pa lta bu/ yang ming de'i mthar/ ka ba lta bu drug pa'i don can yod tshe/ drug pa sbyar dgos pas/ bzo khang ki ka ba/ zhes pa lta bu/ yang ming de'i mthar/ yod lta bu bdun pa'i don can gyi tshig yod tshe/ bdun pa sbyar dgos pas/ bzo khang du yod/ ces grub pa/ de bzhin du/bzo ba zhes pa'i mtharam̐ 'phrul 'khor skor cig ces pa lta bu'i 'bod pa'i don can gyi tshig yod tshe/ sngon rjes gang rung du/kye sbyar dgos pas/ kye bzo ba 'phrul 'khor skor cig dang / bzo ba kye 'phrul 'khor skoram̐ cig lta bu'o/ /ga0zhan yang tshig phrad 'dren pa ni/ tshig don 'og ma las gong ma'i lhag ma bsdu rgyu yod pa lha sa'i bar zhes pa lta bu yod na/shā23

ming snga ma'i mthar/ nas lta bu sdud pa'i sgra 'dren te/ pe cin nas lha sa'i bar/ zhes pa lta bu dang / don lhag ma bsdu rgyu med na gzugs so/ /tshor ba'o/ /lta bu slar bsdu'i sgra 'dren no/ /ming tshig gi rnam grangs/ dag bkod pa ni/ dper na/'dam skyes rnams ni rab tu phye/ /'dab rgyas ge sar so phreng dgod/ /dri bsung 'thul bas phyogs kun khyab/ /bung ba'i dga' ston rnam par 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ rab tu phye/ ri rgyas/ dgod/ 'thul/ khyab/ 'phel rnams don pad ma kha phyes nas rgyas pa la 'jug pas don bskyar yang tshig mi 'dra bas bskyar bldab kyi skyon med la/ khyung sngon skyes bzang rab rgyas pas/ /'od zer stong ldan rnam par bzhad/ /kun gsal snang ba'i rtse dga' dgod/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i dpal du shar/ /zhes pa'ang gong gi de ltar du/ bzhad/dgod/ shar rnams don nyi ma shar ba la bskyar kyang tshig mi 'dra bas bskyar bldab kyi skyon med pa dang / nyi ma'i 'od kyis pad ma bzhad/ /'dab brgya'i ze'u 'bru bzhad pa'i bcud/ /rkang drug 'thungs pas stobs bzhad de/ /zir zir dbyangs kyis bzhad cing 'phur/ /zhes pa lta bu bzhad ces tshig bskyar kyang don so so ba yin pas bskyar bldab kyi skyon med pa glulha4

dang / dran cing dran bzhin bos pa na/ /dgane zhing dga' bzhin skad lan btab/ /bshad cing bshad bzhin gros byas pas/ /don de don thog khel ba byung / /zhes pa lta bu tshig don gnyis ka bskyar kyang zlos skyon med pa lta bu'o/ /ming tshig gang gi mthar pho sgra ste bdag sgra sngar med pa la gsar du sbyar yod na/ ming snga ma bdag po'i sgrar 'gyur zhing / mo sgra ste dgag tshig sngaraphamed pa la gsar du sbyar yod na/ming snga ma de nyid dgag sgra can du 'gyur/ rgyan du gyur pa'i kyang 'ang yang gsum ni/ don mthun pa yin na ming snga ma la mthun pa'i tshig phrad sbyar ba/ dper na/ mdzes kyang mdzes la 'od kyang 'tsher/ /lta bu dang / tshig snga phyi mi mthun na mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan sbyor te/ dper na/ gnyen la byams kyang dgra la sdang / /'dzum gyis bsu yang zhe nas sdang / /lta bu dang / tshig gi rgyan la'ang don logs su ston rgyu yod na/ nges par sbyor dgos te dper na/ bdag gis kyang bya ba sgrub la khyod kyis kyang sgrubs shig lta bu/ don lhag pa snyegs sa med na'ang tshig gi kha skong ngam mdzes byed tsam du sbyar chog ste/ dper na/rang rgyal ni rgya ni che/ thon khungs ni phyug lta bu la/ rang rgyal ni rgya ni rab tu che/ thon khungs ni shin tu phyug thon skyed ni rnam 125

par dar/ 'tsho ba ni kun nas bzang / lta bu/ rab tu/ shin tu/rnam par/ kun nas sogs ma sbyar na yang don ston mod/ tshig mdzes pa dang / kha skong ba sogs kyi ched du sbyar chog pa bzhin no//gzhan yang / don snga ma'i 'phro de ma thag tu bstan bya lhag ma yod na lhag bcas kyi sgra sbyor zhing / bstan bya lhag ma med na slar bsdu'i sgra sbyar ro/ /rnam dbye snga shugs 'dren tshul ni/ snga ma'i mtha'i rjes 'jug gi nus pas rnam dbye sogs 'dren tshul yin la/ de'i nang gses 'jug tshul 'di ni/ don 'og ma'i nus pas ming snga ma la rnam dbye dang tshig phrad 'thob tshul bshed pa yin pas khyad par yod/ ming mtha'i rjes 'jug gi shugs kyis rnam dbye dang tshig phrad 'dren tshul dang de'i sdom tshig sogs gong du bshad zin pas der blta bar bya'o/ /rnam dbye zhes pa ni/ chos gnyis ma 'dres par so sor 'byed pa'i sgra'i cha shas sam tshig phrad cig la zer ba yin la/ tshig phrad ni/ tshig snga phyi'i bar du mtshams sbyor byed du 'byung ba shas che ba la zer ro//3 de'i 'jug pa rgyas par bshad pa'i sa bcad gsum pa dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa bshad pa/spyir yi ge ni ming tshig brjod pa thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi 126

yin te/ yi ge re re ba 'dus pa'i khongs nas ming phyungs/ming 'dus pa las— tshig phyungs nas berjod bya'i don thams cad ston par byed pa'i phyir/ tshig ni ming gzhi la rjes 'jug gang yang rung ba zhi/ga ma zhugs na rnam dbye dang tshig phrad sbyar ba sogs mi srid de/ rjes 'jug gi shugs kyis rnam dbye dang tshig phrad 'dren pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sgra tshad spyi 'gros ltar bshad na/ rang 'bras ming tshig gnyis kyi rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i skad kyi gdangs de/ yi ge'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ dbyangs dang /gsal byed gnyis yod/ don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i sgra de/ming tshig gnyis su phye ba'i ming gi mtshan nyid/ dper na/ mi/khang ba/ gos/ zas zhes pa lta bu/ de 'dra ba'i sgra de/ mi dang khang ba'i ngo bo tsam ston pa'i sgra yin pa'i phyir/ don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par sbyar nas ston pa'i sgra de/ ming tshig gnyis saphye ba'i tshig gi mtshan nyid/ dper na/ mi'i mgo/ khang ba'i ka ba/ gos kyi gong ba/ zhes pa lta bu/ mi'i mgo zhes pa'i sgra de don gyi ngo bo mi dang khyad chos mgo gnyis sbyar nas ston pa'i sgra yin pa'i phyir/ mi'i mgo zhes pa/ spyir ming yin mod/ming tshig gnyis su phye ba'i ming ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ mtshan nyid kyi zur du/ ming tshig gnyis su phye ba'i ming dang tshig ces k+ṣelha7

zhib cha bton pa shes par bya'o/ /legs sbyar la dbyangs yig srog tu ma zhugs na don mi ston mod/ bod yig 'dir dbyangs yig srog zhugs kyi tha snyad med la/ de'i tshab tu slob dpon thon mis rjes 'jug gi rig pa 'di mdzad pa yin/ rtsa ba las/rjes 'jug bcu bo ma zhugs na/ /ming gzhan sbyor ba yod mi srid/ /ces dang / rjes 'jug ni yi ge thams cad la 'jug par bshad pa dang / 'jug par bcas pa med na ni/ /ming dang tshig kyang gsal mi nus/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rjes 'jug gzhan dgu bo gang rung med pa'i mthar 'a yig re nges par 'jog pa sgra sgyur snga ma rnams kyis mdzad la/dper na ka zhes brjod pa'i tshe rjes 'brel du 'a yig gi sgra mi gsal ba'i tshul du yod pa'i phyir ro/ /skad gsar bcad la/dga'/ mda'/ bka'/ dpa'/ lta bu yig rkyang 'phul yig can la 'a mtha 'a rten du dngos su med na ming gzhi rjes 'jug tu 'khrul sa 'ga' yod gshis dngos su yod dgos la/ brtsegs pa dang 'dogs can la 'khrul gzhi med pas/ yig tshogs skyung ba'i ched ma bzhag pa yin te/ rngog lo chen po'i dag yig nyer mkho bsdus pa las/ rkyang ba 'phul la 'a mtha' dgos/ /brtsegs pa bu drug can la spang / /zhos gsungs so/ /bu ①28

drug ni gug gu sogs bzhi dang ra btags ya btags bcas drug la bshad do/ /rtags kyi 'jug pa'i skabs bshad zinazhe to/ /lnga zha tho sdo zhakhyed puzhi py-in nathashā dpyad blod+ngha/'dir gleng bar bya ba ni/ slob dpon thon mis bod yig gi dbyangs gsal sngon rjes mgo 'dogs sogs gtan la phab pa nas bzung rim gyis yar rgyas byung ste/ yig gzugs legs bcos thengs kha shas dang / skad gsar bcad kyis legs bcos thengs gsum sogs dang / 'bangs gyen log chen po byung nas bod kha 'thor byung ba'i rjes su'ang mdo dbus gtsang gsum nas mkhas pa shin tu mang bo byung ste rgya gar nag sogs phyi'i rig gzhung sgra snyan ngag rtsis sa ris bzo gso zlos gar sogs kyi ci gzhung mang bo bod yig tu bsgyur te chos dang rig gnas shin tu dar bar byas/ de mtshungs rngog lo chen po sogs mkhas pa du mas bod yig la'ang legs bcos zam mi 'chad par byas/ der brten rim gyis bod yig de cha tshang zhing chos 'jig rten gang la'ang bkol du rung zhing / spyi 'i skad yig tu gyur par ma zad phyi rgyul gyis kyang yi ge sngon thon gyi gras su bzhag ste/ 'dzam glu29

gling rig gnas kyi ya gyal du bgrangs shing brtsi mthong chen po byas te da lta'i bar du zhib 'jug byed bzhin pa 'di lags so/ /bci5sa 'grol sngon gyi lo ngo brgya phrag kha shas ring gzhi rtsa'i thog 'pho 'gyur ches che ba byung be+ed mod/ — rje yab sras byung phyin gyi yig cha dag ni go bde zhing nges pa ster tshab che ba'ang je legs la song ba'i rtags yin no/ / de ltar mkhas chen zam mi chad pa byung nas chos srid gnyis kar bod rang gi yi ge bed spyad pas/ rim gyis bod yig de nyid bod spyi'i thun mong gi skad yig zhig tu lhun chags pa byung /rong 'brog dang yul gru so sor skad kyi gdangs dang brjod tshul mi 'dra ba re yod na'ang / yig thog nas gcig gyur byung ste/dbus gtsang gi mi zhig gi rtsom dang / mdo smad kyi mi zhig gi rtsom la bltes na yul skad kyi bye brag med par/ yul gcig gi mi'i rtsom lta bu zhig yin/ de ni gcig gyur byung ba'i rtags yin no/ / mi rigs gzhan gyi mi la las/ bod kyi mi rig gnas zhan pa 'ga' re dang lab gleng byas pa'i gtam khungs med 'ga' gzhir bzung nas/ bod yig gi brjod tshul de/ rgya'i gna' dus kyi yi ge'i rtsom stangs lta bu red/ mi dmangs kyi skad dang trī30

gtan nas mi mtshungs zer ba ni rgyus med kyi rgyus gtam yin te/rgya'i gna' yig ni nye char dpar btab pa'i h+pha lugs kyi yig cha yin zer ba'i dpe dag la bltas na bsgyur yig zhig med tshe mi go stabs bsgyur yig bkod 'dug bod kyi rtsom dag la bsgyur yig 'bri dgos sa zhig gtan nas med/ shin cang dang tun hong sogs nas phyi rgyal gyi mis rko rnyed byung ba'i bod kyi yig rigs dag ni de ltar 'dug mod/ de dag ni skad gsar bcad sngon gyi yig rigs yin gshis deng sang de 'dra mthong rgyu shin tu dkon no/ /des na deng dus kyi yig skad ni slob dpon thon mi'i gzhung dang / rjes 'brang mkhas pa mang bo'i dgongs 'grel dang dag yig che chung sna tshogs pa'i brda sprod pa'i gzhung gi khungs dang ldan zhing mang tshogs kyi skad kyi rmang gzhi mthug la zab pa'i spyi skad du gyur —'dug pa bsnyon du med pa yin/ de'i phyir bod yig de chos srid gang thad nas bstud mar bed spyad pas dar rgyas dang legs bcos byung gshis cung zad cha tshang zhing mang tshogs kyi skad dang nye ba'i spyi skad du song stabs/ rgya'i gna' yig dang 'dra ba'i da lta go mi thub pa zhig gtan nas min te/gna' dus su bsgyur ba'i bka' 'gyur nang gi mdo mdzangs blun sogs la bltas na go sla ba mngon sum gyis grub po/ /mang tshogs 131

kyi go mi go yi gi'i brjod tshul la'ang rag las mod/ de kho narajim nges te mang tshogs rang gi yon tshad dang dril bsgrags kyis 'dang ma 'dang la'ang rag las te/ mang tshogs la yon tshad nges can zhig yod pa dang / chab srid rig gnas kyi ming brda dag dril bsgrags kyisatho rna lam du byang bar byas tshe go sla bar 'gyur ro/ /dper na/ rgya'i grong khyer chen po'i mi dag sngon nas slob grwar zhugs myong bas yon tshad nges can re yod pa dang /chab srid dang rig gnas sogs kyi brda dang tshig rna lam du byang bas rgyang bsgrogs dang tshags par sogs go sla ba dang / zhing grong gi yig rmongs go thos nyung ba dag la yig cha sogs 'grel bshad zhib rgyas ma byas na mi go ba lta bu red/ bod kyi sa char sngon dus sa cha re gnyis ma gtogs bod byings la bla grwa sogs las gzhan gyis yi ge slob pa'i srol cher med la/ bcings 'grol rjes su tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi 'od stong 'phros 'og mang tshogs kyis rig gnas slob pa'i las 'gul khyab brdal byas rung / de yang bar chad sna tshogs kyi dbang du song nas tang gi thugs bzhed ltar 'grub dka' ba byung ba dang / sa cha la la'i srid jus dang gnas tshul dril bsgrags byed mkhan gyi las byed pa dag kyang 'ga' zhig mi rigs gzhan yin gshis bod skad ji 132

bzhin shod dka' ba dang / bod rigs yin yang rgya bod gnyis ka'i skad yig gi yon tshad dma' stabs/ dril bsgrags dang slob gso rgetong tshe rgya skad bod skad sra ma bsre'i skad cha khra li khro le re bshad pas/ gang yin yang go brda ji bzhin 'phrod dka' bas/ mang tshogs kyis go ba len tshab chung zhing / rgya skad cha tshang mi go la/ bod skad kyang cha tshang mi go ba zhig tu gyur/ khul rdzong hre 'ga' zhig gis skad bsgyur las don la'ang do snang mi byed gshis/ mang tshogs kyir+sā gzhung don dang srid jus go ba la tshad nges can zhig gi shugs rkyen thebs/ des na mang tshogs kyis go mi go yi ge kho na la rag las pa min pa shes sla la/ rlabs chen gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhis‘‘skad yig de yang slob dgos/ ma bslabs par rang shugs kyis shes mi thub’’gsungs pa ltar/ mang tshogs kyis kyang yi ge'i don shes pa la yi ge slob dgos/ de ltar min par gang yang ma bslab ci yang mi shes pa'i mi zhig gi rna lam du bsgrags ma thag don go bar 'gyur ba'i skad yig zhig bzo rgyu ni rngo mi thogs par sems so/ / yi ge de yang thog mar skad la brten nas bzos pa yin la/skad kyi ched du bzos pa yin gshis/ yi ges skad la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos shing / de yang ming tshig brjod pa kun yig 133

thog tu 'bri zhing klog pa tsam du ma zad/ yi ge'i rnam bzhag brda sprod pa'i gzhung sogs yar rgyas byung bas/ skad ril rogs ram byas te/ ming tshig brjod pa mi tshang ba tshang bar byed pa dang / brjod tshul je blugs dang snyan zhing 'jebs pa/ tshig 'dus shing rdzob med par byed/ dper na/ bod rang la dngos po de med pas ming yang med pa seṅge/ pad+ma/ ka to ra sogs yig thog nas bod spyad pas rim gyis bod rang gi skad du gyur te mang tshogs kyis shes shing rjod par byed bzhin la/ phyi'i snyan ngag sogs bod du 'gyur nas/ dpe rgyan dang gzugs can gyi rgyan sogs snyan tshig gi rang bzhin ldan pa'i ming tshig du ma gsar du thon pa dang / sngar yod je legs su song ba dang /rgya nag gi rtsis bod du 'gyur nas lo skor bcu gnyis/ lo rgan drug cu/ 'byung ba lnga sogs yig thog nas bed spyad pas de dag gi ming dang tshig dag bod rang gi thun mong gi skad du gyur pa dang / de bzhin du rgya gar nas skar rtsis 'gyur nas gza' bdun rgyu skar nyer bdun dus tshod dang chu tshod chu srang sogs yig thog nas bed spyod pa brgyud mang tshogs kyi spyi skad du chags pa dang / bcings 'grol byas nas bzung lhag par brda dang tha snyad mang bo zhig byung ste/ mar le ring lugs/ spyi tshogs ring 134

lugs/ ma'o tse tung gi dgongs pa/ 'byor med gral rim gyi srid dbang sger 'dzin/ gung khran ring lugs sogs dang / me 'khor/ rlangs 'khor/ 'drud 'then 'khor lo/ 'khor stegs 'khor gdan sogs mang du byung zhing 'phel ba ni/ yi ges skad la zhabs 'degs zhus te skad yig gnyis mnyam du rim gyis 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i ngang tshul yin no/ /rgyal yongs bcings 'grol btang rjes/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi 'od stong 'phros 'og bod yig yang yar rgyas gong 'phel byung zhing / khyad par du ma'o kru'u zhis‘‘rang rgyal mi rigs so so'i rig gnas/ chos lugs/ dad mos bcas la brtsi srung byed dgos par ma zad/ btsan shed kyis rgya yig dang rgya skad slob tu 'jug mi rung la/ mi rigs so sos rang gi skad yig bed spyad nas rig gnas slob gso byed par rgyab skyor byed dgos ’zhes gsungs pa'i bka' slob gzhir bzung nas/ bod rigs 'dus sdod kyi sa char bod yig gi slob grwa sngar med gsar 'dzugs dang / sngar yod gong 'phel gnang zhing mar le dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung rtsom sogs gsar brje 'i rig gzhung mang bo bod yig tu bsgyur/ dus mtshungs su/ spyi skad ma yin pa'i yul skad go dka' ba dag 'dor ci thāb byas te/ spyi skad dang nyu35

mthun zhing brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang yang mthun ci thub byas pa dang / mtshan nyid rig pa/ gtan tshigs rig pa/ tshan rig sogs kyi ming brda sngar nas bod rang la yod pa dag sor bzhag gsar bzo byed dgos pa dag gsar bzo/ g.yar skad bed spyod dgos pa dag la g.yar skad bed spyod pa sogs kyi sgo nas bod rang gi skad yig rig gnas de yar rgyas byung zhing mang tshogs kyis dga' bsu zhus shing dpe deb nyo mkhan 'tshang kha shig shig byas so/ / ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i’’nang / lin pe'o dang /‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’ gis/ 'thab thig so sor gtor brlag dang dkrug shing tshabs chen byas pa dang mnyam du/ mi rigs srid jus la spyo ham gyis ngo rgole dang gtor brlag tshabs chen byas te/yul gru 'ga' zhig tu mi rigs slob grwa gtor/ bod yig slob mtshams bcad/ bod yig cung zad bed spyod pa dag la'ang bod yig bcos bsgyur byed pa dang / rnying bzhi gtor ba/ mang tshogs kyi skad dang thag nye bar byed pa dang / 'byor ldan gral rim la dgag pa rgyag pa sogs kyi dgos mkho yin zer nas/ rang bsom gang 'dod kyis brda sprod pa'i gzhung gi khungs med cing /mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi med pa'i yig rdzob chu yan rgyas pa bzhin ①36

'phel du bcug de dag byas pa ni gsar brje dang / byid mkhan tsho ni g.yon ru ba red ces gzengs su bstod/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang mthun zhing spyi skad dang mthun pa re bris tshe/ rnying gso dang / ltag log rgyag pa red zer ba sogs zhwa che zhing mtho ba bzos nas 'khyer yong gin 'dug de'i skabs su su zhig gis dag yig dang brda sprod pa'i gzhung 'bri phod/tang krung dbyang gis‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’rdul du brlags rjes rkang 'dzin rgyal bcos kyi 'thab jus bkod jus kyi khrid ston 'og mi rigs srid jus don thog tu 'khel ba byung zhing / rig gnas phyogs la‘‘me tog mnyam bzhad ’dang‘‘mkhas brgyas 'gran gleng misogs ma'o kru'u zhi'i srid jus rabs dang rim pa slar gso byung skabs 'dir bdag kyang yid dga' spro dang spobs pas khengs te/ bod yig la'ang skya chad sngo sdug byung yod pa slar gso byed pa sogs kyi sgo nas rang rgyal gyi deng rabs can bzhi mngon du 'gyur ba la rang nus gang yod 'bul lo snyam pa'i bsam pa skyes te/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung rtsom pa'i bya ba la zhugs retho/ / ‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’gi 'dre lag rkyong ba'i skabs su/ bod yig la'ang gnod skyon dang shugs rkyen ngan pa phog mod/ 'on 137

kyang rgya che'i rig gnas las byed pa rnams kyis mu mthud nas rtsom bsgyur sogs kyi bya ba byas te/ rig gnas mi nyams pa'i lag rjes bzhag yod la/ khyad par du‘‘mi bzhi shog khag’’rdul du brlags rjes rim gyis legs bcos dang rtsom lugs bsgyur lugs sogs je legs su 'gro bzhin yod pa dang / zhing chen kha shas nas brda sprod pa'i gzhung khungs dag dang mthun pa'i tshig mdzod dang slob deb dang sman gzhung sogs dpar du skrun bzhin yod par sku drin che zhu'o/ / rlabs gtso 'dzin dang slob dpon ma'o kru'u zhis‘‘yi ge de nges par cha rkyen nges can zhig gi 'og tu bcos bsgyur dang / skad de nges par du mang tshogs dang nye bar byed dgos ’gsungs sa ltar/ deng skabs rgya yig bcos bsgyur byed bzhin pa yin la bcos bsgyur byed rgyu de yang yig gzugs rdzob la stabs mi bde ba dag stabs bder bsgyur ba ma gartogs/ brda sprod gzhung dang rnam dbye tshig phrad sogs dang / skad bsgyur ba ni min te/ skad ni sngar gyi spyi skad de gtso bor bzung ba ma zad/da dung spyi 'gro'i skad de khyab brdal byed dgos zer bzhin yod/ mang tshogs dang nye bar byed dgos gsungs pa yang spyi 'gro'i skad dang mthun par byed dgos gsungs pa yin la/ spyi 'gro'i skad 1bye8

dang mthun pa mi byed par yul gru 'ga' zhig gi skad re ga'ir bzung na skad yig gcig gyur du 'gro ba'i dgos pa stor bar 'gyur ro/ /rgya skad la chag bzhag na/ pe cin gyi skad de gzhi 'dzin sa byed mod/ 'on kyang cha kun nas pe cin gyi yul skad kho na byed pa min par sems te/ rgyang bsgrags sogs la nyan na sdeb sbyor dang sgra gdangs sogs la khyad par yod pa 'dra'o/ /bod kyi spyi 'gro'i yig skad de yang gtso bo dbus gtsang gi skad la chag bzhag pa yin mod/ cha thams cad nas dbus gtsang gi yul skad ltar 'bri dgos pa min te spyi skad kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /〈〈gnad bsdus〉〉zer ba rtsom pa bo sogs kyis/ ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung btus de drangs nas/ bod kyi yi ge bcos bsgyur byed dgos zer zhing / yig gzugs bcos bsgyur byed pa min par/ bod kyi skad dang / brda sprod pa'i gzhung / rnam dbye tshig phrad sogs bcos bsgyur byed khul byas/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje dang / lhag par du 'byor med gral rim gyi rig gnas gsar brje chen po byas pa nas bzung / bod skad la 'gyur ldog chen po byung zhing / mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi kha skad nang tshig phrad mi nyung ba zhig rim bzhin med par gyur pa dang / yang 139

no rnyog rdzob chi ba nas starbas bdi boratshosong ba/ bya tshig gi dus ri'agyur rnams la'ang 'gyur ldog chen po byung yod/ ces sgrub byed bkod pa ni dngos don dang mi mthun pa'i stong bshad yin te/bcings 'grol dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsgyur bkod sogs brgyud nas/ dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi la rtsa ba nas 'gyur ldog byung ba'i rjes su 'brangs te steng gi bkod pa chab srid sogs la'ang 'gyur ldog byung ba los yin mod/ skad ni gzhi rtsa'i thog sngar gyi skad rang yin/ 'on kyang bod skad la 'gyur ba dang bo/nga 'phel byung yod pa ni/ dper na/ spyi tshogs ring lugs/gung khran ring lugs/ gung khran tang / gung khran ring lugs kyi phugs re/ mar le ring lugs/ ma'o tse tung gi dgongs pa/spyi'i lam thig rtsa ba'i lam thig mi rigs srid jus sogs dang /mtho gnon 'phrul chas/ 'khor stegs/ 'drud 'then 'khor lo/ me 'khor/ rlangs 'khor sogs gsar du byung zhing dar rgyas 'byung bzhin pa yin/ rmang gzhi'i dpal 'byor la 'gyur ldog byung ba'i rjes su 'brangs te/ steng gi bkod pa la'ang 'gyur ldog byung ba ltar/ skad la glo bur du 'gyur ldog 'byung mi srid de/ gsar brje byung ba dang ma byung gong gi skad la khyad par med pa dang / mi rigs gang gi skad la'ang glo bur du 'gyur ldog 140

byung ba gtan nas med do/ /gzhan yang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje sogs brgyud nas/ dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi dang / steng gi bkod pa/ chab srid dang bca' khrims sogs rnying ba rnams gtor nas gsar ba zhig chags yod mod/ 'on kyang skad ni bcings 'grol sngon dang lo brgya phrag kha shas kyi sngon gyi skad dang khyad par cher med de/ rje yab sras dus kyi dpe dag la bltas na tshig sbyor legs shing go bde ba dang / ge sar sgrung gi tshigs bcad dang / tshig lhug kun kyang go sla zhing nyan spro ba zhig yin gshis/mi dmangs kyis dga' bsu byed/ go mi sla zhing rna bar mi snyan pa zhig yin tshe dga' bsu thob pa'i gnas med do/ /deb ther dkar bo las kyang / lhag par rje rin po che'i sku dus tsam nas bzung dpe cha rnams dpar 'debs byed pa'i srol de dar khyab che bar gyur cing / deng sang shing dpar 'bor chen bod yul na yod pa 'di tsam sa steng gzhan gang du'ang med par grags/dpar las byed pa'i 'go tshugs pa de nas bzung yig gzugs dang dag cha sogs kyang phal cher srol lugs gcig las cung zad kyang ma 'gyur bar gnas pa tsam byung / zhes phal cher cung zad kyang ma 'gyur bar bshad/ lo brgya phrag du ma'i sngon gyi skad dang 14/

deng dus kyi skad la khyad par shin tu dkon/ 'dzam gling gi mi —rigs gang dang gang yin yang skad la 'gyur ldog chen po byung med pa bzhin/ bod skad la'ang de dang 'dra ste/rtso thon mi sam lha ṭas mdzad pa'i sum rtags dang / rjes kyi mkhas pa rim par byon pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i dgongs 'grel dag yig brda 'grol sotso/sa kyi 'gro lugs dang / brda sprod tshul/ rtsa ba'i tha snyad bcas ni tshang ma ha lam sngar bzhin gnas yod pas/ deng sang bod kyi skad yig gi gzhi rtsa yin no/ /des na bod rigs kyi yi ge dang skad kyang dus skabs ring bo zhig gi nang du chags pa dang / dar ba dang / rgyas pa/zhun bdar chod pa byas nas byung ba yin pas/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje dang / lhag par 'byor med gral rim gyi rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i lo re gnyis kyi nang du 'gyur ldog chen po zhig byung yod zer nas/ rnam dbye dang tshig phrad/lhag par brda sprod pa'i gzhung sgyur gang thub byed pa la/ rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi khungs dang / brda sprod pa'i gzhung gi khungs med la mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi'ang med do/ /gzhan yang tshig phrad mi nyung ba zhig med par gyur pa dang /stabs bde bor song ba dang / bya tshig dus 'gyur la 'gyur 142

ldog chen po —byung zer nas/ tshig phrad mang bo zhig med par byas pa dang / dus gsum bdag gzhan gyi khyad par med par byas stobs/ tshig brjod mi bde zhing rna bar mi snyan la/ tshig rengs shing gyong ba zhig tu gyur nas/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor zlos gar/sgrung sogs la nyams mi thon zhing / 'gyur khug sogs kyi ngag med par gyur/ 'di dag ni/ bod yig mi shes pa dang phyogs tsam shes pa 'ga' zhig gis/ bod rigs kyi skad yig gcig gyur la gtor brlag byed pa yin la/ 'ga' zhig ni g.yam la rgyugs pa'i byed tshul yang snang ngo / /deb dkar las kyang /deng sang mtha' mi 'ga' zhig gis/ dbus kyi phal skad/ la dwags kyi phal skad sogs snang bar gang dran gyi skad mdzod dang glegs bam sdeb pa 'di rigs/ rmo brgya la dar srol che ru song na/ yul so so'i phal skad mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis/ bod kyi skad spyi yang dum bur chad de/ nam zhig na yul so so'i skad dang yi ge phan tshun brda mi 'phrod pa zhig 'ong nges/ zhes pa ltar/deng skabs je bzang la cung zad song yod pa ma gtogs/ bar skabs shig ste bdun cu tham pa dang / don gcig lo yar mar gyi dar dmar dus deb sogs bod yig tu bsgyur ba'i thog nas —go brda 'phrod dka' ba byung / lo ngo stong phrag gi ring la bsags 143

pa'i rtsa ba'i tha snyad smrad par bzos nas/ rdus skabs thung dzu zhig la rtsa ba'i tha snyad bzo thabs med pa smos ci dgos/ de ni kun gyis shes gsal ltar yin/ yang 'ga' zhig gis bod yig la 'khyog bshad 'di 'dra byas te/ rig gnas gsar brje'i sngon gyi lo bcu bdun ring gi bod yig gi gsar brje'i rtsom yig dang bsgyur lugs dang skad yig sogs ni/ rnying zhen bag 'khum/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi skad yig yin rkyen/ bzo zhing dmag gsum gyi skad dang mi mthun pa red/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i nang re bdun dang re brgyad de lo gnyis lhag gi ring la bod skad la 'gyur ldog chen po byung / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis skad gsar bcad gtan 'bebs byas pa yin zer/ de ni dngos don 'khyog bshad byas pa yin te/ lo gnyis lhag gi ring la bod skad la 'pho 'gyur chen po zhig byung med pa mngon sum gyis grub la/ dus thung de tsam la glo bur du skad la 'gyur ldog 'byung mi srid do/ /spyir bod yig la yig dkar yig nag gnyis/ rgyugs bris bcas yod/ yig nag la skong yig sogs yod pas/ cung zad nyams pa de dag la'ang zhib 'jug byas nas legs bcos dang legasadzhacha bsdus na chog ste/ deng sang rgya yig bcos bsgyur 144

byid paneng / rgyugs n+d+ras stabs bdi'i legs cha bsdus pa zhin tu mang / 'on kyang tshang ma rgya yig gi lad mo byed dgos pa min te/ bod yig ni dbyangs gsal can dang / sbyor klog can gyi yi ge yin/ nye char〈〈mi dmangs nyin re'i tshags par〉〉gyi rgya yig bcos bsgyur skor gyi ched brjod nang du/ rgya yig ni rim gyis sbyor klog can du bsgyur dgos la/ de'i sngon du yig gzugs legs bcos byed dgos par gsungs/ 'on kyang bar skabs shig tu bod yig rtsa ba'i yi ge la sbyor klog mi dgos zer ba'i slob deb kyang bzos/ bod yig rang la sgra dang gzugs gnyis ka yod pa'i sdud tshig dri tshig rgyan sdud/ 'byed sdud/dgar sdud/ lhag bcas/ rdzogs tshig sogs yod pa phal cher dor nas/ gzugs tsam las sgra med pa'i bshad rtags/ dri rtags/ tshig rtags/ mtshams rtags/ 'byed rtags/tshigs rtags/ rdzogs rtags rnams bkod pa ni/ d+ngha bzo zhing dmag gsum gyi skad dang bstun pa yin nam/gzhan ciyang / mang tshogs kyi skad dang mthun par byed dgos zhes 'ur rgyag mod/ don la ni mang tshogs kyi skad dang mthun par byed e thub mi lta bar/ bod kyi spyi 'gro'i ming tshig dorate/ yul skad kyi ming tshig re khyer yong nas spyi skad kyi tshab byed 145

dzi ni/ skad yig gcig gyur du 'gro ba la gigs bye/ da pa'i nyin kha zhig yin par sems/ dber na/ stabs/ phyir/ gshis rnams ston nas rgyu mtshan 'phen pa'i spyi skad du chagasayod pa de dag dor nas/ de dag gi tshab tu tsang zhes pa bzhag sgrub byed/ gcod byed/ len byed ces byed ces pa spyi skad du chags yod pa de dor nas/ de'i tshab tu yas zhes pa bzhag pa dang /khyad par zhes pa spyi skad du chags yod pa de dor nas/ de'i tshab tu he bag zhes bzhag pa dang / brgyab dang / rgyag dang / rgyob ces pa spyi skad du chags yod pa de dor nas/ de'i tshab tu gzhu zhes bris pa dang / zer zhes pa spyi skad du chags yod pa de dor nas de'i tshab tu ze 'bri ba dang / de bzhin du sbar gyi tshab tu spar 'bri ba/ zas kyi bro ba la dro ba zhes 'bri ba sogs mang / sngar spyi skod la med pa'i ming dang brda 'ga' zhig yul gru 'ga' zhig la yod na/ thun mong du yig thog nas be+ed spyad na rim gyis spyi skad du 'gyur bas mi 'grig rgyu med myod/ sngar spyi skad yod pa dag dor nas yul skad re khyer yong na dka' tshegs gtad pa las med la/ skad yig gcig gyur du 'gro ba la phan pa las gnod pa che snyam/ 'di dag ni mang tshogs kyi skad dang thag nye bar byas pa'i grangs su bgrang mi nus so/ /146

gzhan yang rnyog rdzob che ba nas stabs bde bor song ba zer yang tsā dngos don thog stabs bde ba nas rnyog rdzob chen por gyur 'dug ste/ dper na/ med ces par/ yod pa ma red/yod pa yin pa ma red/ yod ces par/ yod pa red/yod pa yin pa red/ dgos zhes par/ dgos pa red/dgos gi red/ dgo sa pa yin pa red/ gnang zhes par gnang gi yod pa red/ ces sogs yig 'bru gcig ṣ+katshab la yig 'bru gsum re/ bzhi re/ lnga re bris pa dang / byed tshig gi thog tu byed tshig brtsegs nas/ je mang je rdzob tu btang bas/ yig tshogs dang dpe deb kyi bam kha ches por gyur par brten/ mi rigs gzhan pa la las/ a ya bod yig ni nyog rdzob chen po red zer ro/ /tshig sdud kyi skabs su'ang / tshig gtso bo dang tshig grogs sogs kyi khyad par shes dgos te/ dper na/ chab srid la/srid gtso bo dang chab tshig grogs yin/ de'i phyir tshig sdud byed tshe/ srid gzhung / nor srid/ srid 'gyur/ srid don/nang srid/ srid blon sogs zer rgyu las/ chab gzhung / chab 'gyur/ chab don/ nang chab/ chab blon sogs zer srol med la/ de bzhin dur+sā7waṃsrid gros khang nes bsgyur rgyu las chab 147

gros khang zhes bsgyur na shin tu mi legs/ chab rkyang ba ni chu'i ming dang gcin la'ang chab zer te/ chab bsang chab tho/chab rdza zer ba red/ chab gros khang zer ba/ de las kyang tshig bsus tshe chab khang du 'gyur/ dpal 'byor la'ang / dpal tshig grogs dang 'byor gtso bo yin gshis tshig sdud byed tshe/'byor ldan/ 'byor med/ zer rgyu las/ dpal ldan/ dpal med mi zer/ rig gnas la'ang rig gtso bo dang gnas tshig grogs yin gshis/ sman rig tshan rig sogs zer rgyu las/ sman gnas/ tshan gnas sogs mi zer ba bzhin kun la rigs 'gre sbyar shes dgos/ tshigs bcad sogs kyi tshe rnam dbye rnams kyang bsdus chog ste/ sum cu ba las/ tshigs su bcad pa'i mtshams sbyor rnams/ /cung zad bsdus pa yod na yang / /de ni de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar red/ 'on kyang bsdus chog mi chog gi dbye ba shes dgos te/ dper na/ nga tsho'i sems nang gi mi nub pa'i nyi ma/ zhes pa'i tshig gi 'brel sgra gi de bsdu mi rung ste/ de bsdus na/ sems nang mi nub pa'i nyi ma zhes bris na/ go ba log par 'gyur te/ sems nang mi 'gro ba'am sems nang mi sim pa'i don du 'gyur/ chu nang mi nub pa'i gru zer ba lta bu/ deng sang sku dpar re'i kha byang la/148

sems nang mi nub pa'i nyi ma zhes bris pa mthong nas mi mang bos/a ha/ zer gyin 'dug spyir tshig sdud kyang / legs sbyar sgra gzhung gi tshig sdud drug dang / snyan ngag skabs kyi tshig sdud kyi skyon yon sogs legs par bslabs te dpyad nas byed dgos pa las hod rgyug byed mi rung /gzhan yang / la la na re/ ‘‘snga rabs la bstod bsngags dang deng rabs la skur 'debs byed rgyu cig dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gi dug rgyun gang la'ang bstod bsngags byed rgyu cig ma red/ mi dmangs mang tshogs dang gzhon nu slob grwa ba rnams la cha bzhag na/ gtso bo khong tsho khrid nas mdun phyogs la lta ru bcug pa ma gtogs/ kho tsho khrid nas rgyab phyogs la lta ru bcug rgyu yod pa ma red/ mi zer nas/ rig gnas gsar brje'i sngon gyi bod kyi rig gnas kun bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dug rgyun du lta zhing / gzhon nu rnams la sngon gyi rig gnas bslab na rgyab phyogs la lta ru bcug pa red/ zer zhing / 〈〈bod yig sum rtags gi slob deb〉〉(〈〈྾r+sāhās+dza lko.oṃ〉〉) zer ba brtsams te/sum cu ba dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i nang don cha tshang meg med du btang nas/ rgya yig brda sprod rig pa rnams zhwa dpe lham 'gebs kyi tshul du mi 'grig bzhin du bsgrigs shing / yod/ ces par ram̐49

ya'o/ 'bri ba lta bu yul skad kyi dpung tshogs shig bsgrigs nas/ bod mang tshogs dang / slob grwa ba mang tshogs spyi skad gtan nas mi go ba'i lam du khrid pacisogs ni nyen kha che'ang dgag 'os su mi che la dpyad kyis mi lang ngo /yang sngar bod kyi skad yig la skad gsar bcad kyis legs bcos byed myong la/ da skabs yang skad yig bcos bsgyur byas ci'i phyir mi chog ce na/ bcos bsgyur byas mi chog sus kyang zer gyin med la/ phan yod kyis bcos bsgyur byas na tshang mas dga' bsu zhu nges yin mod/ phan med kyi rnyog dra bzos pa dag la ni dga' bsu mi zhu ste/ deng skabs mdo dbus kun tu ngo rgol gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod la/ sra 'dzin byed mkhan nyung shas las med/ bod kyi brda sprod pa'i gzhung sum cu ba dang rtags kyi 'jug pa gnyis kyang / bod rang gi skad phyi yul gyi chos nyid la yod pa dag phyogs sdom byas pa yin la/ rjes 'brang gi brda sprod gzhung dag la yan lag kha shas thog lta tshul dang / dpyod tshul/ blo kha mtho dman sogs kyi khyad las mi mthun pa'i cha dang / rtsod gleng sogs yod mod/ rtsa ba'i thog nas brda sprod rtsa ba'i dgongs pa las mi 'gongs pa yin te/de las 'gongs na phyi yul gyi chos nyid las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /150

de'i rgyu mtshan yang brda sprod gzhung sgo brjod bya/ ming tshig /dang bod rang gi skad kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos rnam dbye brgyad dang / tshig phrad gzhan rnams rang gi skad la yod pa dag phyogs sdom byas pa yin te/ brda sprod rtsa ba las/ de bzhin yi ge'i 'jug tshul rnams/ /smra ba kun la gnas gyur kyang / /rang tshul de nyid mi shes pas/ /don la sbyor ba ga la shes/ /de phyir smra ba'i dbang phyug gis/ /rjes smras 'di kun rtogs gyur cig /ces gsungs so/ /khyed cag gis bcos bsgyur byas pa ni/ phyi yul bod rang gi spyi skad la yod pa dag la 'khyog bshad byas te/ yul skad dam mi dag pa'i skad re khyer yong nas bod dmangs kyi skad kyi tshab byed pa red de/ dper na/ ngas slob sbyong byed/ ces pa'i tshig 'di bod byings kyi skad yin te/ deb dkar las gsungs pa ltar/ stod mnga' ris nas a mdo'i mtha'i bar du khyer yang / thams cad kyis lhogs shing go thub pa yin mod/de dor nas/ de'i tshab la/ nga slob sbyong byed gi yin/ zhes rnam dbye chad pa'i tshig rdzob ring bo zhig bris/ 'di ni yul skad dam bod skad ji bzhin ma lob pa zhig gi skad yin du chug kyang /spyi skad ni min te/ spyi skad la rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa can 151

gye gong sgo rdzig de kho na 'phroṃ'o/ / gzhan yang / nga 'gro/ zhes par/ ngas 'gro gi yin/ zhes rnam dbye gsum pa sbyar te/ byed pa bo dang bya ba ngobo gcig tu song ba 'di rigs la rnam dbye gsum pa mi thob stabs/ skad la'ang med pa tsam yang mi tshor bar zad/ 'ga' zhig gis kha skad la rnam dbye gsum pa med pa tshor nas/ nga yar la 'gro/ bya nam mkha' la 'phur/ rta lam du rgyugs/ sogs la/ngas/ byas/ rtas/ zhes gsum pa thob kyang / skad la med pa ni shugs la bstan pa yin zer ba ni/ zer rgyus phongs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang / yod ces par/ ga'i ya'o/ 'bri ba dang / slob sbyong nan tan byed rgyur mi 'dang / zer bsam nas/ byed rgyur mi 'dang zhes la sgra sbyar ba dang / 'brel gzhi 'brel chos gnyis 'brel tshul zer bsam nas/ 'brel gzhi 'brel chos bar gis gtogs tshul zer ba dang / bod kyi brda sprod sngon ma/ zer bsams nas/ snga ma bod gi brda sprod/ces tshig mgo mjug slog ste/ snga ma bod kyi brda sprod yin la/phyi ma mi rigs che ge mo'i brda sprod yin zer rgyu 'dra ba bris/dmigs bsal gyi tshig grub tu byas nas zhes zer 'dod nas/152
