mig sgrub byas nas/ zhes rang gi kha la/ grub dang / sgrurba gnyis kyi khyad par med pa'i rtags mtshan mngon du gyur pa dang /brtsi rgyu med zer 'dod nas/ rtsis rgyu yod pa ma red ces rtsis zhes ming tsam sbyar/ rtsis/ brtsis/ brtsi sogs ming tsam dang / 'das ma 'ongs kyi khyad par da lta'ang bod byings kyi skad ngag la ma 'gyur bar yod/ sbyar yig gtong mkhan zer 'dod nas/ btang mkhan zhes 'das tshig sbyar ba dang / skad gtong byed zer 'dod nas/ skad gtong yas gi zhes dang / la las skad gtong yag gi zhes bris pa dang / sngon gyi sum rtags zer 'dod nas/ sngon ma'i sum rtags zhes bris pa dang / bod kyi sum rtags sngon ma zer 'dod nas/ sngon ma bod gi sum rtags/ zhes tshig mgo mjug slog pa dang / sngon ma bod kyi sum rtags yin la/ phyi ma mi rigs che ge mo'i sum rtags red zer rgyu 'dra ba bris/ spyir btang dang sgra sbyar chog zer 'dod nas/ spyir btang yin na dang sgra byas chog zhes bris pa dang / dang sgra sbyar tshe zer 'dod nas/ dang sgra sbyar ba byas byung tshe/ zhes bris pa dang / slob sbyong byos shig ces par slob sbyong byed shig ces bris pa sogs mtha' yas shing / mang tshogs kyi skad dang mthun rgyu phar zad/ yi ge shes pa dag gis kyang 153

'phral du mi go la/ la la gtan nas go mi thub pa 'de dag bod rang mtshan pa zhig gi tshig min pa gsal zhing / skad yig bcos bsgyur byed do zhes spyi skad dag dor nas/ yul skad re bris tshe/dbus gtsang gis rang gi yul skad re bris/ khams kyis rang gi yul skad re bris/ a mdos rang gi yul skad re bris/ rong bas rong skad re bris/ 'brog pas 'brog skad re bris na/ skad yig so sor gyes par gyur nas phan tshun brda mi 'phrod pa zhig tu 'gyur ba ni/ sngon dbyi rigs kyi yi ge 'thor nas/ spyis be+ed spyod mi thub pa zhig tu gyur pas kyang shes la/ ci deb dkar las kyang / deng sang mtha' mi 'ga' zhig gis/ dbus kyi phal skad/ bla dwags kyi phal skad sogs snang bar gang dran gyis skad mdzod dang glegs bam sdeb pa 'di rigs/ brgya la dar srol che ru sodza na/ yul so so'i phal skad mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis/bod kyi skad spyi yang dum bur chad de/ nam zhig na yul so so'i skad dang yi ge phan tshun go brda mi 'phrod pa zhig 'ong nges/gsungs pa don la gnas so/ /gzhan yang bod kyi sum rtags sogs brda sprod pa'i gzhung rnams ni rnyog rdzob can red zer ba dang / bod kyi rnam dbye brgyad de tshan rig dang mthun mi mthun brtag dgos/ zer 154

nas bod kyi brda sprod pa'i gzhung gi 'gro lugs sum cha gnyis tsam re med par byas pa ni/ bcos bsgyur byed pa min par mes rgyal gyi rig gnas kyi ya gyal bod kyi skad yig gi rig gnas me+eg med du gtong rtsis red snyam/ rnam dbye brgyad dang tshig phrad gzhan dag bcas ni/ bod rang skad la yod pa zhig yin pas/ tshan rig dang mi mthun no zhes 'dor rgyu ga la yod/ rgya yig la 'brel sgra tshigacig pu tsam las med pas/ bod yig la'ang gi gcig pus chog go zer ba dang / rgya yig la rnam dbye gzhan med pas/ bod yig la'ang med par byed dgos zer rgyu ni de bas kyang mi 'thad do/ /yang la la na re/ sngon gyi brda sprod pa'i gzhung dag ni/bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin pa dang / chos lugs pa 'di dang 'di zhes bya bas brtsams pas/ ngo rgol byed rgyu las de dag la bstun gtan nas mi rung / zer nas/ gna' bzang deng spyod la ngo rgol byed pa dang / nged cag gi 'di yi ge bcos bsgyur gyi bya ba yin pas/ kha phyogs chen po ma nor zer ba ni/ lan don mthun 'debs rgyu med pa'i rtags mtshan no/ /rnam dbye tshig phrad sog sa la cung zad dpyad na/ 'ga' zhig gis rnam dbye dang bo rnam dbye min zer mod/ rnam dbye 155

dang bo don gyi ngo bo tsam brjod pa/ khang ba zhes pa'ang / khang ba'i ngo bo chos gzhan dang ma 'dres par 'byed pa'i sgra'i cha shas shig yod spru khas len dgorme la/ de ltar na/ ngo bo tsam brjod pa la rnam dbye dang bo zhes btags pa la skyon ci zhig yod/ spyir ming tshig gnyis mi 'gal te khang ba'i ka ba/ zhes pa ming tshig gnyis ka yin mod/ ming tshig yi ge gsum du phyes pa'i ming dang tshig gnyis 'gal ba yin te/ khang ba zhes pa ming dang / khang ba'i ka ba zhes pa tshig yin/ 'ga' zhig gis/ deng sang ming tshig ces gnyis ka gcig tu bsdus te mtshan gzhi la/ mi/ rta/phyugs/ glang dang / khang ba/ ka ba sogs 'jog pa ni/ bod skad la ma byang ba'i rtags yin te/ bod skad la/ 'di'i ming la ci zer/ khyod kyi ming la ci zer/ zer ba las/ 'di'i ming tshig la ci zer/ zhes mi 'dri la/ lan 'debs tshe'ang 'di'i ming la gser zer/ 'di'i ming la dngul zer/ nga'i ming la tshe ring zer/ zhes zer ba las/ 'di'i ming tshig la gser zer/ nga'i ming tshig la tshe ring zer/ zhes mi brjod pa mngon sum gyis grub bo/ /de lta bu'i nor 'khrul 'byung ba'ang / rgya yig la oṃ7zhes yi ge gnyis yod do snyam nas zhwa dpe lham la bkab pa yin no/ /ming gi rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i yi /56

ge dang / tshig gi rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i ming / zhes sogs kyi tha snyad bod rang gi brda sprod dang tshad ma'i gzhung dag tu grags shing yod pa dag ma mthong zhing / mthong na'ang mi shes par/tshig gi thog ma'i rnam pa/ zhes dang / tshig grub nang 'jug rgyu zhes sogs kyang rang nyid bod kyi brda dang tha snyad la ma byang ba'i rtags yin la/ skabs 'gar tshig grub dang / skabs 'gar tshig sgrub ces sgrub dang grub gnyis khyad med byas pa ni rang nyid la bod yig gi dag cha med par ma zad/ sa mgo yod med kyi sgrub dang grub gnyis kyi sgra'i khyad par yang kha ra mi thon pa'i rtags so/ / 'brel sgra'i skabs/ kyi dang gyi gtan 'phud byed skabs/rjes 'jug ga nga da na ba/ /ma ra la sa'i rjes su gi/ /'a dang mtha' rten med mthar 'i/ /rjod bde kha skong yi ru thob/ /ces sdom tshig bkod/ yi ru thob/ ces ru sbyar ba ni/ brda sprod gzhung dang mi mthun mod/ de khyod kyis gsar brje byed yul yin pas bstun mi srid la/ mang tshogs kyi kha skad dang bstun pa yin na/ su'i kha skad dang bstun pa yin/ lan smos shig 'brel sgra dang gsum pa byed pa 'jug tshul gyi sdom tshig bkod par ma zad/ re'u mig kyang bkod de/ gis kho 157

na bris chog pa red ces thag bcad mod/ yang rang rkus rang gis phud pa bzhin du/ ‘‘bsam gyis mi khyab/ lhun gyis grub lta bu gnas tshul dang bstun te/ dmigs bsal gi tshig grub byas nas rang 'jags su bzhag chogami’zer/ gnas tshul dang bstun tshul/ de'i spyir btang dmigs bsal gyi tshig grub byed tshul ji ltar yin/ gzhan yang ming chog rang bzhin gis sgrub pa'i gtan 'jags tshig bya tshig rang bzhin gis sgrub pa'i gtan 'jags tshig zer bas/ sgrub byed gang gis/ bsgrub bya gang sgrub pa red/ ming tshig dang ming tshig can gi tshig gang zhig la zhes sogs/ rdol gtam smra ba lta bu ches mang bas dpyad kyis ga la lang brda sprod gsar ba las/ 'brel sgra'i go don bshad tshe/'brel gzhi 'brel chos gtogs tshul bar gi mtshams sbyor zhes bod skad yin min mi shes pa 'di 'dra zhig bris 'dug don la 'brel gzhi dang 'brel chos bar gyi mtshams sbyor byed zer 'dod pa 'dra la/ de ltar na/ 'brel sgra yod tshad khyad gzhi dang khyad chos bar gyi 'brel bar 'gyur bas/ gser gyi rna rgyan/zhes pa'i 'brel sgra'ang khyad gzhi dang khyad chos bar gyi 'brel sgrar thal lo/ /'dod na/ gser khyad gzhi dang / rna rgyan de'i 158

khyad chos su 'gyur/ 'o na 'brel sgra de ci zhig yin zhe na/ de ni rang bzhin dang rang bzhin can gyi 'brel sgra yin pa shin tu gsal/ khyod kyi dpe brjod kyang bsgyur tshul mi 'grig pa dang khyod kyi zhe 'dod dang mi 'byor te/ myaskya740rgo༅tshiṣ+ṭha367za༅ṅgeṭha༅s+dzaṭ+wāṃ'adi'i don ni/ rang re'i las don gyi 'go khrid byed mkhan srog shing du gyur pa'i stobs shugs ni krung go gung khran tang red/ces pa yin la/ khyed cag gis srog shing gi stobs shugs/ zhes bsgyuro yod/ de ltar na/ srog shing ni 'brel gzhi dang stobs shugs ni 'brel chos su thal lo/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ khyod kyis 'brel sgra'i go don 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ srog shing du gyur pa'i stobs shugs zhes pa'i 'brel sgra 'i ni/ rang bzhin dang rang bzhin can gyi 'brel sgra yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du dpe brjod gzhan gyi rgya yig bsgyur tshul la'ang skyon dang mi rigs pa shin tu mang mod/ logs su darmed par 'dod do/ /‘‘ming tshig dang tshig rgyan bar gi 'brel ba’’zer nas/ dpe brjod la/ rdo yi chu rags le bar khri phrag yod/ ces pa bzhag 'dug rdo ni khyod kyis zer ba'i ming tshig dang / chu rags ni tshig rgyan e red/ de yin na/ 'brel sgra'i 'og gi ming dang tshig gang rung yin na tshig rgyan yin pa'i khyab par thal lo /snye59

khyed cag gis rdo/ zhes pa de ming tshig gi mtshan gzhir 'dod mod/ nged cag bod rang gi tha snyad ga sa/ rdo/ chu/ me/zhes pa sogs la ming zer la/ ming rkyang yang zer/ ming tshig gnyis su phyes pa'i ming dang tshig gnyis 'gal ba yin la/ ming rkyang thams cad tshig yin mi zeraci/ khyed cag gis ming rkyang thams cad la ming tshig zer ba ni/ mi rigs gzhan zhig gi bshad tshul la gzhigs nas bod spyis de ltar bshad dgos zhes bshad pa yin mod/ dgos pa yod na khas blang chog na'ang /dgos pa ci yang med pas/ tha snyad de bsgyur mi dgos snyam mo/ /'bri rgyu yin na zer 'dod nas/ bris pa yin na/ zhes bris pa dang / de dag gi sngon du dang sgra nges par 'jog dgos zer ba sogs mang tshogs kyi kha skad dang bstun pa yin na/ mang tshogs de gang du 'dus sdod byas yod/ spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas dga' bsu zhu/ zhes pa'i nas de gsum pa byed pa yin zer ba ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ spro sems 'khol ba yod bzhin du dga' bsu zhu/ zhes pa yin gyi/ spro sems de dga' bsu zhu ba'i byed pa bo min te/ byed pa bo ni rang nyid yin/ des na de'i nang gi nas de nyid dga' bsu zhu tshul ston pa'i tshig phrad tsam yin/ khra lam gyis mthong zhes pa'i gyis dang / lhun gyis 160

grub ces pa'i gyis lta bu'o/ / 'brel sgra dang byed sgra'i skabaṭa/ su/ kyi gyi dang kyis gyis dor ba ni/ dgos pa med la gnod pa yod pa zhig yin pa lo shas rang gi lag len gyis shes nus/ yul 'ga' zhig tu kha skad la de dag gi tshab tu gi dang gis zer ba yod na'ang thams cad min te/ rong khul du ma zhig dang / 'brog khul rgya chen por khyod kyi zhes pa'i tshab tu khyo'i dang / khyod kyis zhes pa'i tshab tu khyos zer ba dang / sa cha la lar/ rgya skad ki bod skad ki zhes ga kha phyes kyi sgra thon/ ri 'i mgo chu 'i zam pa zhes sogs yul skad mi 'dra ba sna tshogs shig yod mod/ de dag tshang ma khyer yong nas spyi skad kyi tshab byas na/ skad yig gcig gyur du 'gro ba la gnod pa las/ phan pa ci yang med/ khyad par du yul skad de dag gi tshab la kyi sogs spyi skad du chags nas kun gyis shes shing bed spyod bzhin pa'i skames su glo bur du bsgyur ba la dgos pa med de/ yig tshogs nyung ba'i dgos pa med la/skad gcig gyur du 'gro ba'i dgos pa'ang med/ mgo rnyog med pa'i dgos pa med la/ spyi skad dang mthun pa'i dgos pa'ang med/ dang bo grub ste/ kyi kyis gyi gyis rnams dor nas/ gi gis bris na'ang yi ge mang nyung snga ma ltar las/ je nyung la ma 16①

song ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ da ba sa na ra la'i rjes su gi dang gis thon pa ni/ yul 'ga' zhig las thams cad min te/ yul du ma zhig tu/ bde legs kyis/ bder gshegs kyis/ zhes sa mthar kyi sgra thon pa dang / rim gyis yar rgyas byung zer ba las/ rim gis yar rgyas byung mi zer/ des na gi gis kho na bris na'ang gcig gyur du 'gro mi thub la/ de las sngar nas yig thog nas gcig gyur byung bas/ bod spyi'i skad yig tu gyur yod pa rang sor bzhag na gnod pa ci yang med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ mgo rnyog med pa'i dgos pa med par ma zad/ mgo je rnyog la btang 'dug ste/ ga nga da na ba/ ma ra la sa'i rjes su gi zhes dang / gis kho na bris chog pa red/ zer yang / brjod kyis mi lang sogs kyi kyis rang sor 'jog dgos zer ba dang / gnas tshul dang bstun nas bzhag chog zer ba dang / dmigs bsal gyi tshig grub byas nas bzhag chog zer ba sogs nges med kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa dang brjod kyis mi lang sogs/ zhes pa'i sogs sgra'i nang du bsdu rgyu ci 'dra yod nges gtan med pa dang / gnas tshul dang bstun nas zer ba las/ gnas tshul ji 'dra zhig la bstun dgos nges med hor rgyug tu song ba dang / dmigs bsal gyis zer ba tsum /sgolha

las/ spyir btang dmigs bsal gyi bye brag ci yang med pa'i ham bshad byas pas/ gsar bu rnams mgo 'khor byed tsam du zad la/ gzhan yang rang nyid kyang mgo 'khor te/ 'i'i tshab tu gi bris pa/ dper na dmangs gtso gi lta bu du ma zhig byung ste/ mgo rnyog chen por gyur/ bzhi ba grub ste/ spyi skad ni stod mnga' ris nas/ smad a mdo'i mtha'i bar du gang du khyer yang bod mi yi ge shes pa dag gis shes rgyu'i skad yig zhig la spyi'i skad yika zer te/ da ba sa kyi ga nga gi/ /na ma ra la'i rjes su gyi/ /'a dang mtha' rten med mthar 'i/ /rkang ba skong tshe yi zhes thob/ /ces pa ltar bris pa'i gzhung rnams bzhin no/ /kyi gyi'i tshab tu gi sha stag bris pa dag ni/ yul 'ga' zhig tu go yang / yul 'ga' zhig tu mi go ba dang / yul 'ga' zhig gi skad dang mthun yang yul 'ga' zhig gi skad dang mi mthun pa dang / yul 'ga' zhig gi rna bar snyan yang yul 'ga' zhig gi rna bar mi snyan pa'i stabs kyis spyi skad dang mthun pa'i dgos pa ci yang med do/ /kyi sogs bsgyur ba la/ dgos pa med par ma zad/ gnod pa yod de/ gang yin sa la gi bzhag ste/spyi tshogs ring lugs gi/ dmangs gtso gi/ a pha gi/ a ma gi/khyod gi mgo/ nga gi lag pa/ ta kra'e gi/ bcas gi/ byings 163

gi/ tshul gis/ rim gis 'gyur sogs/ an yo'i shing bzo'i bod skad lta bur gyur/ da dung yi ge'i 'gro lugs nges med du gyur nas/ yul phyogs 'dis go yang / yul phyogs gzhan zhig gisasna mi go ba'i slob grwa'i slob deb kyang 'acedra min sna tshogs shig byung / gzhan yang / snyan ngag sdeb sbyor/ blos gar/sgrung dang glu gzhas sogs kyi tshig nyams dang / 'gyur khug snyan cha sogs med par/ tshig gyong la rengs par gyur/ gzhan yang kyi sogs gtan phud btang nas/ shul du gi 'i yi gsum bzhag mod/ de dag kyang rtags mtha' gang la bstun dgos pa sogs la mgo 'thom nas gsar skrun mkhan rang nyid kyang yig rmongs su gyur/ gzhan yang / yongs su grags pa'i ming rnams kyang bsgyur dgos byung ste/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ chos gi rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi grags pa la/ chos gi grags pa/ phyogs kyi glang bo la/ phyogs gi glang bo/ dbyangs kyi dga' ston la/dbyangs gi dga' ston/ dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs la/dpyid gi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ dpyid kyi ko ki la la/ dpyid gi ko ki la/ dbyangs kyi bdag po la/ dbyangs gi bdag po/dpal gyi dbang phyug la/ dpal gi dbang phyug tshogs kyi bdag po la/ tshogs gi bdag po/ sems kyi rang gsal la/ sems 164

gi rang gsal/ gangs kyi ri bo la/ gangs gi ri bo/ dpal gyi ri la/ dpal gi ri sogs/ ming grangs las 'das pa btsan bsgyur byas te/ mang tshogs la rgyus med pa'i minge du ma zhig mang tshogs kyi mgor btsan 'jog byas te/ mang tshogs kyi skad dang bstun pa yin no zhes zer ba sogs kyi spyod tshul ni/ mthar gtugs na rīrang nyid kyis bod skad ji bzhin mi shes pa'i rtags so —gzhan yang / yi ge sgyur mkhan dang 'bri mkhan gsar bu dag kyang mgo 'thom du bcug stabs/ gcig mthun gyi lam lu gas shig med par gyur te/ la las 'brel sgra la gi gcig pus chog pa 'dra zer/ la las mi chog ste/ gtan 'jags dang /tshig grub dang / dmigs bsal can yod zer bas gang byung du gi 'bri mi chog pa 'dra zer/ la las gnas tshul dang yang tshul/ dmigs bsal dang yang bsal tsho mi shes/ kho tshos bshad pa ltar gi 'jog zer nas/ gang yin sar gi bzhag ste/dpar ngos gcig la gi bcu phrag du ma byung / de ltar 'brel sgra dang byed sgra bsgyur ba la dgos pa med par ma zad/ gnod pa yod pa zhig yin la/ ma bcos par sor bzhag byas na/ gnod pa med par ma zad/ phan pa yod pa zhig yin te/ yul so 165

so'i skad mi 'dra yang 'brel sgra dang byed sgra'i 'gro lugs ni bod byings kyi goms gshis su chags zin pas/ stod mnga' ris nas smad a mdo'i mtha'i bar du yi ge klog mkhan dag gis klog shes par ma zad/ don yang go nus la/ rna bar yang snyan pa dang / yi ge'i thog nas skad yig gcig gyur byung zin pa dag srung 'dzin byed pa dang / yul so so'i yul skad kyi dbang du song nas skad yig kha bral du 'gro ba 'gog pa dang / snyan ngag dang rtsom dang sgyu rtsal sogs kyi ngal gso dang nyams 'gyur dod pa sogs kyi phan pa che la/ stabs yang bde ste/ da ba sa kyi ga nga gi/ /na ma ra la'i rjes su gyi/ /'a dang mtha' rten med mthar 'i/ /rkang ba skong tshe yi zhes thob/ /ces gtan 'khel ba'i tshul gyis 'bri rgyu las/ gtan 'jags yin min/ tshig grub yin min/ dmigs bsal yod med/ gnas tshul la gzhig pa sogs ci yang midagos so/ /gzhan yang / snyan ngag gi tshig bcad/ bcad lhug spel ma sogs kyi skabs su'ang / rtags mtshungs dang / sgra mtshungs ci rigs 'dren pa'i lugs ltar bris na/ snyan cing 'jebs la 'gyur khug gi nyams sogs thon par 'gyur/ de ltar ma yin par/ gi sha stag bzhag tshe snyan rgyu phar zad/ tshig 166

rengs shing gyong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yin min dngos yod kyi gnas tshul la ltos dang / 'di ltar byed dgos so/ /zhes bka'i re'u mig rtsom bsgyur las khungs dag la bkram nas de ltar bris na'ang / mang tshogs kyis yig bskur dang / ma yig bshu ba/ sman dang rig gnas sogs gsar rtsom yig rnying bskyar dpar sogs la'ang / khyed cag gi de ltar mi byed par ma zad/slob deb 'ga' zhig khyed cag gi rjes su 'brangs nas bsgrigs pa la'ang / mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char mang bas a bcos yang bcos mi byed ka med byung ngo / /la don gyi skabs su/ brda sprod gsar ba zer ba sogs su/ su ru ra dang na la du/ /la sgra rnam pa drug yin te/ /sa su ga ba nga da na/ /ma ra la brgyad rjes su du/ /de nyid 'jug pa phud rjes su/ /la yig kun gi rjes su 'jug /na yig skabs dang stun nas sbyar/ /zhes tshig gyong la rengs pa'i sdom tshig cig bkod nas/ gsar skrun gyi nyams dang bcas te dam bcas par ma zad/ re'u mig kyang bkod mod/ yang rang rkus rang gis phud pa bzhin/ rtag tu/ rab tu/ shin tu rnams rgyun 'jags tshig sgrub dang / gnas tshul dang stun pa dmigs bsal gi tshig sgrub/ zer nas bzhag de dag la tu 167

bzhag chog na/ khab tu/ spyi khyab tu/ byang chub tu/ khag tu/ngag tu/ lag tu/ kun tu/ rgyab tu/ 'gab tu/ zhib tu/'gag tu sogs la ci'i phyir mi chog dmigs bsal gyi tshig sgrub min zer na/ khyed kyis tshig sgrub ma byas pa e rem khyed kyis rtag tu la dmigs bsal btang nas/ 'di dag la dmigs bsal mi gtong dgos don ci red/ yang de nyid 'jug pa phud rjes su/ zhes pa'i tshig rdzob 'dis/ la yig de nyid la mi 'jug pa bshad pa yin tshod red mod/ 'og tu gtan la 'bebs zhes pa'i la yig de nyid la 'jug par bshad nas/ rang gis rang la 'gram lcag cig brgyab/'gro phyogs ston pa'i bya tshig ces gsar skrun gyi bzo lta ston/ 'o na da dung las phyogs/ rdung phyogs/ mgar phyogs/byed phyogs/ rgyag phyogs/ slob phyogs/ bshad phyogs/'phen phyogs ston pa'i bya tshig sogs las kyi dbye ba brgya phrag stong phrag gsar skrun byas na sku zhabs gzi brjid ga 'dra che ang / yang kho na re/ de min dmigs bsal gi bya tshig dper na/ dgos/ mkho/ thob/ lon/ rag phog thebs/byung / rnyed/ zer/ thug skye la sogs pa gang zhig gang la gnas pa'am yod pa'i don bstan pa de la gnas gzhi ston pa'ang rngo6byi

phrozer chog zer ba ni zer rgyus phongs shing / gnas gzhi ston pa'i sgra'i don ma go bar zad de/ yod dang / gnas zhes pa gnas par ston pa'i sgra yin pa las/ gnas gzhi ston pa'i sgra gang nas yin/ dper na/ nang la mi yod ces pa'i la yig des nang de mi gan sa sa'i gzhi yin par ston pas na bdun pa gnas gzhi zer/ yod ces pas gnas pa tsam las gnas gzhi ston tshul med/ des na gong gi dgos dang mkho sogs la gnas gzhi ston pa'i sgra zer mi chog pa shin tu gsal/ gnyis pa las su bya ba ni/ rnam dbye rang nyid sbyar sa'i gzhi de la bya ba zhig byas par ston pa'i sgra de la rnam dbye gnyis pa zer la/ khyed cag gis rnam dbye gnyis pa'i go don bshad tshe/byed pa bos bya ba gang 'dra cig byas par bya ba byed yul bstan pa de la las su bya ba zer/ zhes tshig nyog la ring ba zhig bris mod/gang 'dra cig byas par bya ba byed yul bstan pa/ zhes pa 'di go rgyu ci yang med/ mi kha shas gis ngo 'dzin byed rgyur/ zer ba dang / yul tshig la rtsis rgyu yod pa ma red/ ces pa dag ni tshig skyon shin tu che ba shes sla la/ mdor na/ shar phyogs su 'gro zhes pa lta bu bya byed tha mi dad pa'i tshig yin stabs/ la don de gnas gzhi byas na 'grig zer ba ni/ las su bya ba'i la 169

don gyi don gtan nas ma go bar zad de/ las su bya ba'i rnam dbyes yul gang zhig la ge ba zhig byas par ston pa tsam las/byed pa bo dang bya ba gnyis ngo bo gcig mi gcig ston mi dgos pas/ ri bong gnam rdib kyi dogs pa byed mi dgos te/ nga shar phyogs su 'gro zhes pa'i la don des/ gzhi shar phyogs la nga rang 'gro ba'i bya ba byed par ston pa yin la/ nga rang dang 'gro ba'i bya ba gnyis ngo bo tha dad mi dad gang yang mi ston no/ /des na shar phyogs su 'gro zhes pa lta bu'i la don de gnyis pa las su bya ba yin la/ bya byed tha dad mi dad kyi gnad don ni gsum pa byed pa'i thad du yod de/ dper na/ ngas zas za/ zhes brjod tshe/ za ba'i bya ba de nyid yul zas dang ngo bo gcig pa'i tshul gyis 'brel ba las/ nga dang ngo bo tha dad pa'i stabs kyis gsum pa byed pa sbyar dgos la/ nga 'gro zhes brjod tshe/ 'gro ba'i bya ba de nga dang ngo bo gcig pa'i tshul gyis 'brel yod pa las/ 'gro sa'i yul dang ngo bo gcig pa'i tshul gyis 'brel yod pa min pas/ de la ni rnam dbye gsum pa sbyar mi dgos so/ /de bzhin du rta lam du rgyug bya nam mkhar 'phur/ 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor/ bsam 'grub gdan la bzhugs/ rnams la rnam dbye gsum pa sbyar mi dgos stabs/ kha cig gis de dag gi skabs su rmi70

gsum pa byed pa shugs la bstan zer ba ni rang gi de nyid bstan pa'o/ /rtas rtswa zos/ byi'us 'bu zos/ 'khor los dpe cha dpar/ bsam 'grub kyis yi ge bris/ zhes pa rnams la rnam dbye gsum pa sbyar dgos te/ bya ba de byed pa bo dang ngo bo gcig tu ma song bar/ bya ba'i yul dang ngo bo gcig tu song ba'o/ /gnad rags pa 'di tsam la'ang rmongs bzhin du/ skad yig bcos bsgyur byed do/ /mang tshogs kyi skad dang mthun par byed do/ /zhes yig log spel ba ni byis pa'i rol rtsed du zad de/ mang tshogs kyi skad las dpag tshad 'bum brgal to/ / bdun pa gnas gzhi'i skabs/ bya ba gang 'dra cig byed par rung de byed sa'i sa cha bstan pa de la gnas gzhi ston pa zer/ zhes pa'i byed par zhes la sgra mi dgos sar la sgra sbyar ba dang / byed sa'i sa cha bstan pa la gnas gzhi zer ba mi 'thad de/ bdun pa gnas gzhis bya ba byed sa'i sa cha bstan pa min par bdun pa gnas gzhi'i la don rang nyid sbyar sa'i gzhi de la chos shig gnas pa tsam ston pas na bdun pa gnas gzhi zer/tsam sgras/ rang nyid sbyar sa'i gzhi de la bya ba zhig byas pa dang /gzhi de'i ched du byas pa ston pa gcod/ dper na/ rgyal sa ru 171

gtso 'dzin bzhugs/ zhis pa'i ru des rnam dbye rang nyid sbyar sa'i rgyal sa de gtso 'dzin gnas sa'i gzhi yin pa dang / gtso 'dzin ni gzhi der gnas pa'i gnas chos yin par ston pa'o/ /de ba'i/na du sa la rtswa skyes/ zhes pa'i la yig des/ sa ni rtswa gnas sa'i gzhi yin pa dang / rtswa gnas der skyes zin nas yod par sto/na pa'o/ /rnam dbye med na sarten gzhi dang rtswa brten pa yin par go mi nus so/ /me mda' brgyab pas stag la skrag dngangs skyes/ nga la dga' spro skyes/ zhes pa'i la yig gnyis ka gnas gzhi yin te/ stag de skrag dngangs kyi blo skyes yod pa'am gnas pa'i gzhi'am rten yin par ston pa dang / nga dga' spro'i blo skyes pa'am gnas sa'i gzhi'am rten yin par ston pa'o/ /nga stag la skrag gtso 'dzin la dga' zhes pa'i la yig ni bdun pa gnas gzhi min te/ stag la brten nas rang rgyud la skrag dngangs kyi blo skyes pa dang / gtso 'dzin la brten nas rang rgyud la dga' ba'i blo zhig skyes pa'i don yin pas/ stag dang gtso 'dzin ni skrag pa dang dga' ba skyes pa'am gnas pa'i rten min rna/ /des na de'i la yig de gang zhig yin zhe na/ smra sgo las/smon dang tshad 'dzin gzhi dang ni/ /gsungs pa ltar gzhi 'dzin pa'i tshig phrad yin te/ skrag pa skye ba'i gzhi ni stag dang dga' 172

ba skye ba'i gzhi ni gtso 'dzin yin par ston no/ /gnas gzhi'i gzhi dang gzhi 'dzin pa zhes pa'i gzhi gnyis mi 'dra ste/ gnas gzhi zhes pa'i gzhi ni gnas pa'am yod pa ston pa'i gzhi de la go dgos la/ gzhi 'dzin pa zhes pa'i gzhi ni gang la brten nas skyes pa'i gzhi de la go dgos pa las/ rang gang la gnas pa'i gzhi de nyid mi ston te/ stag la skrag pa'i blo de rang rgyud la gnas la las stag la yod pa min/ des na de la skrag de la dga'/de'i ming la bkra shis zer/ sgrub thub min 'go khrid la thugadape cha de nga la dgos/ gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog byung sogs kyi la yig ni gzhi 'dzin pa'i phrad yin no/ /de yang yin te/ sa la rtswa skyes zhes brjod tshe/ sa rten gzhi dang rtswa de la brten nas yod pa'i don spyi 'char/ sa nas rtswa skyes zhes brjod tshe/ rtswa skye sa'i 'byung khungs sa yin pa'i rnam pa 'char ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du mi zhig la dmigs nas de la shod/ ces bshad tshe/ gzhi pha rol bo de la don zhig brjod pa'i bya ba byed dgos par go bas/la de las su bya ba yin la/ dngos po zhig la dmigs nas/ de la yod ces brjod tshe/ dngos po de gzhi pha rol bo de la yod pa'amachoganas par go bas/ la de gnas gzhi yin la/ nga de la dga' zhes brjod tshe/ gzhi pha rol bo de la dmigs pa'i dga' 173

ba'i blo zhig kho rang gi rgyud la yod par go bas/ de gzhi 'dzin pa'i phrad yin no/ /sa la rtswa skyes/ khang thog la rtswa skyes/ khang shul la rtswa skyes/ gyang thog la rtswa skyes/ zhes pa'i la yig rnams bdun pa gnas gzhi yin te/ gzhi de dang de la rtswa gnas par ston pa yin la/ rtog pa la'ang de ltar 'char/ mo la bu zhig skyes/ zhes pa'i la yig de dag dang mi 'dra ste/ de'i la yig gis bu skye sa'i gzhi ngos 'dzin pa tsam las/ bu de gnas sa'am yod sa ston pa min te/ci mo la bu zhig skyes te mal sar yod/ces pa'i la yig gzhi 'dzin sa'i phrad dang ru bsdus pa'i ra yig de gnas gzhi yin/ khang thog la rtswa skyes te khang zhabs na yod mi zer la zer don yang med pas/ mo la bu zhig skyes zhes pa'i la yig dang / khang thog la rtswa skyes zhes pa'i la yig gnyis mi 'dra ba shes/ de dag ni rtog pa la 'char tshul dang sbyar nas dpyad dgos te/ sgra rtog rang yul la sel 'jug yin pas/ sgra tshad zung du 'brelaciba'i rigs lam nas 'dren dgos so/ /la la na re/ mo la bu skyes sogs kyi la yig ni/ lnga ba 'byung khungs yin te/ spre'u mar la bzos pa min/ /'dab chags lcags la bzos pa min/ /zhes pa'i la yig ni 'byung khungs yin pa bzhin no zer mod/ de lta bu'i spyi'i rtsom lugs dang mi 174

mthun pa 'ga' re byung ba ni khungs su bya mi 'os te/ brda sbod pa'i gzhung dang yang mi mthun la/ 'ga' re ni yul skad kyi dbang du song ba'ang yod de/ yul la lar la rkyang dang las —gnyis sgra gcig pas/ de'i dbang gis 'bri tshe'ang shan shor nas khyad med du bris pa yod la/ der ma zad/ sa skya'i legs bshad las/ skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi/ /nor la rang nyid len dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa'i la yig kyang rtsom skyon yin par mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis bshad de/ de sgra'i tshab la la sgra bzhag 'dug zer/ sgra gzhung las/ sdeb sbyor las ni si sogs thams cad du'o/ /nes pa ltar tshig gi nyams dod pa'i phyir sbyar ba yin na ma gtogs spyi'i rtsom lugs dang mi mthun no/ /'go khrid la thug nga tshor dgos/ 'di la srid dbang sger 'dzin zer sogs kyi la yig ni bdun pa gnas gzhi min pas/ de'i dper brjod du bzhag pa mi 'grig la/ mar khe si ring lugs gi srid tang cig la gong 'phel byung / zhes pa 'di/ rgya min bod min gyi skad du gyur 'dug gong 'phel byung ste mar khe si le nyin ring lugs kyi srid tang zhig tu gyur ces brjod na bod skad ngo ma red/ de'i la don de yang gnas gzhi min la de nyid yin no/ /dgos ched skabs/ de nyid las/ dmigs yul dgos 175

po gang zhig gi/ /ched du sgrub pa'i bya ba zhig /byas pa gtso bor bstan pas na/ /dgos ched gsal byed sgra ru brjod/ /ces go don bshad mod/ ra sgra chad pa dang / 'das tshig sogs tshig rdzob tshul shes sla/ gzhan yang kho na re/ slob sbyong byed du 'gro zer ba'i dper brjod la mtshon nas bshad na/ slob sbyong byed pa ni dgos pa dang / de'i ched du 'gro ba'i bya ba ston pa lta bu zhes zer/ de ni yul dang dgos pa gnyis go ldog pa yin te/slob sbyong byed pa yul dang / 'gro ba ni de'i dgos pa'am de'i ched du yin/ slob sbyong byed pa la slob grwar 'gro dgos zer ba las/ 'gro ba la slob sbyong byed dgos mi zer/ gzhan yang dper na/ mgron po la khang ba gra sgrig gyis zhes pa'i mgron po ni lul dang / khang ba gra sgrig byed pa ni yul de'i dgos pa sgrub pa red/ 'tsho ba'i ched du zhing las byed/ ces par mtshon na/'tsho ba ni yul dang / zhing las byed pa de'i dgos pa'am dgos mkho red/ bzhi ba dgos ched ces pa/ rnam dbye rang nyid gang la sbyar ba'i yul de'i dgos pa zhig ston pas na dgos ched zer ro/ /gzhan yang / khams skad nang mang che bar sar lha sa'i skad nang mang che ba/ kag gis tshab byed/ zer ba ni rgyus med kyis rgyus gtam yin te/ mdo khams stod smad gnyis 176

su phyis pa'i mdo khams stod la'ang / li gtsang / gsir thal/brag mgo'i gtsang mda' sogs 'brog sde/ mgar thar gyi 'brog sde/ nyag rong 'brog sde/ li thang g.yon ru sogs 'brog sde rgya chen po dag gi skad ni/ mtsho sngon/ kan su'u/ rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul sogs kyi kha skad dang gcig pa yin la rong khul la'ang de dag gi kha skad dang nye ba shin tu mang / dbus gtsang gi yang mnga' ris mtha' mtshams kyi dge rtse nas bzung /bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon mtha' mtshams bar gyi 'brog sde dag gi kha skad kyang gong gsal de dag gi kha skad dang 'dra ba yin gshis/ mtha' gcig tu mdo khams stod kyi skad 'di yin/mdo khams smad kyi kha skad 'di yin/ zhes kha tshon gcod rgyu med de/ mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi kha skad dag kyang yul so so'i nang du 'dres nas yod do/ /de ltar phyi rol yul gyi chos nyid khong du ma chud par kha tshon gcod pa ni shes bya la bsnyon 'ding ba'o/ /des na lha sa'i skad 'di yin/ khams skad 'di yin/am skad 'di yin zer nas spyi skad gtor ba'i las la mi 'jug par zhu/ bcings 'grol dmag mis zhing las la rgyab skyor byed du phebs pa red/ ces mi la gsum pa byed pa sbyar ba ni/ bya byed tha dad mi dad kyi don ma go bar ma zad/ bod skad la'ang 177

rma/pying bar gsal lo/ /gzhan yang kho na ri/ dgaus pa gsal6byed kyi sgra/ don durdzi/ ched du/ phyir du/ slad du bcas gis la don gi tshab byed chog ces pa'ang ma brtag par gsal te/tshig de dag gi du rnams ni la don dngos yin pas tshab gang nas yin/ de nyid dang tshe skabs kyi thad/ de nyid las/ la sgra'i sngon rjes yi ge dag /yul dang bya tshig 'brel mi ston/ /la sgra'i sngon du yi ge des/ /bya tshig tshod 'dzin kha snon dang / /tshig rgyan sprad de don gcig ston/ /de la de nyid brjod pa zer/ /zhes dang / go don la sgra'i sngon la yod pa'i tshig dang la sgra'i rjes la yod pa'i bya tshig de gnyis/ sngon la yod pa'i tshig de/ri bya ba'i yul ston pa min par/ rjes la bya tshig kha snon rgyag pa dang tshad 'dzin byed pa/ tshig rgyan sprad pa nus pa bstan nas don gcig ston pa ma gtogs gzhan gang yang med/ de la de nyid zer/zhes rtsa 'grel gnyis bkod de/ mang tshogs kyi kha skad dang bstun pa yin zer mod/ rnam dbye tshig phrad dang bral bas mang tshogs kyis mi go bar ma zad/ rig gnas yod pa dag gis kyang go dka' bar 'dug la/ bod skad yin min ha go dka' ba 'di dag ni/ zhabs 'degs yin nam/ zhabs 'dren yin dpyod 178

ldan rnams kyis dpyad par 'tshal/ yang / de nyid byed pa'i la don mjug la 'gro ba'i bya tshig ces sogs dang / khong gi rang don spu tsam med la/ zhes dang / gong gsal gi don du de rgyas par bshad na/ zhes gi dang du sogs mi dgos sar bzhag pa dgos sar chad pa 'di 'dra gzhan yang mang ste/ kha tshang bshad pa zhes par/ kha tshang du bshad pa/ zhes rgyang bsgrags sogs las thos pa dang mthong rgyu'ang yod do/ /rnam dbye brgyad pa 'bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra ni/ ming gang yang rung ba zhig gi thog ma'am tha ma gang rung du sbyar ba'i kye sogs la 'bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra zer/ dper na/ kye slob dpon chen po/ bdag la rig pa'i gnas ston cig lta bu dang /slob dpon chen po kye/ bdag la rig pa yang dag pa'i lam las drangs pa'i brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs ston cig lta bu/ kwa ye grogs po dag wa ye grogs po lags/ zhes sogs rtsom dang glu gzhas/ zlos gar sogs kyi skabs su tshig gi nyams dod pa dang bcas te yod pa de dag yin/ khyed kyis kho na re/ a rogs/phun tshogs rnams dpe brjod la bzhag pas/ ming yin na brgyad pa 'bod pa'i sgra yin pas khyab par 'gyur la/ yang kho na re/sger tshugs gi grub cha cig yin pa las tshig gzhan dang mnyam 179

grub gi 'brel ba med pas red/ zer ba ni phyogs tsam ma ge bar gsal mod/ — da dung / sngar yod brda krod gi gzhung rnying tshang mas/ zhes brda sprod gzhung yod tshad la 'phyas gdags pa ni ham pa ha cang che ba shin tu gsal lo/ /tshig phrad skabs/ kho na re/ deng skabs skad cha rgyun mi 'chad par 'phel rgyas dang 'pho 'gyur 'gro bzhin yod zer nas/ kyang 'ang yang gsum rjes 'jug la ltos mi dgos par bshad de/ re'u mig kyang bkod mod/ yang rang rkus rang gis phud pa bzhin/ snyan tshig dang kha dpe/ bshad srol rgyun 'jags chags pa'i tshig grub la sngar gi sbyar tshul ltar sbyar chog gi red/ ces nges med kyi gtam thon te rnyog dra bzos 'dugad ba sa gsum gyi rjes su kyang thob pa ni rtags mtshungs dang /ga'i rjes su kyang thob pa ni sgra mtshungs yin la/ nga na ma ra la rnams kyi rjes su yang thob pa ni rtags mtshungs yin mod/ khyod kyi lugs la yi ge'i skye gnas dang byed rtsol/ rtags mtshungs dang sgra mtshungs mi mtshungs sogs snang med du bzhag nas byung rgyal du bod kyi skad yig ham bsgyur byas chog 'dug 'o na/ gang kyang med la/ gyong kyang sra/ byed yang byed la/ sim kyang sim/zhes bris chog par thal/ rjes 'jug la ma bstun par gang byung 180

du sbyar chog pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de su'i skad kyi 'gro lugs red/ nged cag gi mthong thos kyi yul dang yuladheskad la de 'dra mi 'dug 'on kyang ma mthong phyir na med pa min/ /gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ nged cag gis ma mthong ba yin na nged cag la ston par zhu/ gzhan yang / 'on kyang / dang / 'on te ni rjes 'jug la ma ltos pa red zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ 'on/kun/ shin sogs la da drag thob pas rtags mtha' 'dren tshul yang de ltar yin/ yul skad dag pa rnams su de dag la da drag gi sgra thon bzhin yod/ yang / kyang 'ang yang gsum yod tshad tshig rgyan du 'dod pa dang / der ma za da / phar bzhag phud/de'i mi tshad sogs tshig rgyan du khas blangs nas tshig rgyan gsar skrun gyi ched mkhas par rlom mod mi 'thad de/ der ma zad dang / de'i mi tshad sogs ni/ rgyan sdud kyi phrad kyang 'ang yadz+wagasum dang gtan nas mi 'dra/ mthun pa'i tshig rgyan ni/ mthun pa'i chos gnyis gzhi gcig tu sdud cing tshig mdzes par byed pa ste/ dper na/ mdzes kyang mdzes/ snyan yang snyan/ zhes pa lta bu yin la/ mdzes par ma zad mdzes/ snyan par ma zad snyan/ zer srol med/ mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan ni/ mi mthun pa'i chos gnyis gzhi gcig tu sdud cing4 tshig mdzes par byed pa ཿ81

ste/ dper na/ dmangs la brtse'ang dgra bo 'joms/ /lta bu/dmangs la brtse ba phar bzhag dgra bo 'joms/ zhes brjod na ci 'drar 'gyur soms shig /khyed kyis don mtshungs pa'i rgyan tshig gnyis bar dang / yang na/ bya tshig gnyis bar kyang 'ang yang gsum gang rung zhig sbyar nas tshig don snga phyi gnyis gcig mthun yin par ston pa ni mthun pa'i rgyan zer/ zhes go don bshad nas de'i dper brjod la/ ri bshad kyang rdzogs mi thub la rtsis kyang grangs mi thebs pa red/ ces bzhag 'o na/ bshad dang rdzogs gnyis tshig rgyan red dam/ de gnyis kyi don gcig mthun yin nam/ de gnyis kyi don gcig mthun yin tshul med la/ rtsis dang grangs mi thebs pa gnyis kyang rgyan tshig min pa dang / don gcig mthun min pa shin tu gsal/ de bzhin du dpre brjod du/ med na'ang mi 'grig ces pa bkod pa'i 'ang gi snga phyi'i tshig gnyis tshig rgyan yin tshul med la/ don gcig mthun yin tshul yang med de/ med na zhes pa med pa yicha/ na zhes pa'i don dang / mi 'grig ces pa skabs 'di'i rgya yig gi go don ltar na mi rung zhes pa'i don yin pas/ med na dang mi 'grig ces pa'i tshig 'di gnyis tshig rgyan yin tshul med la/ don 'dra tshul yang med 18lha

pa 'es sla/ 'de dag bsgyur tshul yang mi ligs mod/ logs sabashad par 'dod do/ /med na'ang mi 'grig ces pa'i 'ang de nyid tshig rgyan du mi 'gyur ba'i sdud pa tsam yin/ de'i mtshon nas khyod kyi dpe brjod dag mi 'grig pa shes par gyis/ spyir mthun pa'i tshig rgyan zer ba ni/ dper na/ chu las skyes pa'i pad+ma 'di/ /mdzes kyang mdzes la dri'ang bzang / /'khor ba'i ra yig gnyis pa'i glu/ /snyan zhing 'jebs la yid kyang d+ngha'aphrog /ces pa lta bu dgos la/ mdzes kyang zhes pa'i kyang sgras gzhi pad+ma gcig po'i dpe'i steng du chos mthun pa mdzes pa snga phyi gnyis bsdus shing tshig mdzes par byed na tshig don gnyis ka mthun pa'i tshig rgyan yin la/ dri'ang bzang zhes pa'i 'ang sgras gzhi pad ma gcig po'i steng du chos mthun pa mdzes pa dang dri bzang ba gnyis ka bsdus shing tshig mdzes par byed pas na tshig mi mthun na'ang don mthun pas mthun pa'i tshig rgyan yin te/mdzes pa dang dri bzang ba gnyis mi mthun pa med pas so/ /mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan ni/ dper na/ mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i mi gtso 'di/ /dmangs la brtse yang dgra bo 'joms/ /'ud shob can gyi sdar ma 'di/ /dpa' skad sgrog kyang dgra la zhum/ /zhes pa lta bu/ chos mi mthun pa brtse ba dang dgra 'joms pa 183

gnyis gzhi mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i mi gcig po'i lteng du bsdus shing tshig mdzes par byed pas na mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan zhes bya la/ de bzhin du chos mi mthun ba dpa' skad sgrog pa dang dgra la zhum pa ga nyis gzhi sdar ma gcig po'i steng du bsdus shing tshig mdzes par byed pas na mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan zer ro/ / phud ces pa khyed cag gis ma zad ces pa dang don gcig par go nagrede'i tshab tu 'bri bzhin yod mod/ de ni gtan nas min te/ phud ces pa ni/ grangs nas phud/ yul nas phud/ snod nas phyir phud pa/ go sa nas phar phud pa/ khang ba'i nang nas phyir phud pa/ tshong rdzas tshong khrom du phud pa sogs las/ rgyan sdud la mi 'jug la/ khyod kyi dpe brjod du/ ched las slob sbyong byed dgos pa phud bsam blo'i thog ya ra thon n+d+rang ba cig byed dgos gi red la/ zhes pa'i phud de mthun pa'i tshig rgyan gyi dpe brjod du bzhag pa mi 'thad la bsgyur tshul 'di'ang shin tu mi legs te/ ched las slob sbyong byed dgos pa phud pa ste phar phud nas mi dgos par byas te/ bsam blo'i thog yar thon yong ba zhig byed dgos pa kho na'i chog ces pa'i don du song / de lta bu'i srid jus de su'i srid jus red/ de yang dpe brjod du/khong gi bsam blo dang rig gnas thog yar thon chen po byung yod 184

pa ma zad/ gung chin thon nang la zhugs pa red/ cis pa mthun pa'i tshig rgyan gyi dpe brjod du bzhag mod/ de'i ma zad dang / yang / gnyis ka sdud pa tsam las tshig rgyan min la/ khong —ni bsam blo dang rig gnas thog yar thon byung zhes/ ni sgra las gi sgra bod skad rang la mi 'thob bo/ /kho na re/ mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan la 'jug pa/ tshig don snga phyi gnyis gzhi gcig tu mi mthun pa ston pa mi mthun pa'i rgyan zer ba phyogs tsam yang ma go ba gsal te/ mi mthun pa'i rgyan ni gong du bshad pa ltar mi mthun pa'i chos gnyis gzhi gcig tu sdud cing tshig mdzes par byed pa zhig dgos te/ dmangs la brtse'ang dgra bo 'joms/ /zhes brtse ba dang 'joms pa gnyis gzhi gcig gi steng du sdud cing tshig mdzes par byed pa lta bu zhig dgos/ des na/ khyod kyi dpe brjod dag gcig kyang dpe brjod du ma song / don ma go bzhin du/ bod kyi brda sprod rnying ba'i bshad lugs/ zhes dgag pa ni bab col lo/ /mi mthun pa'i rgyan la/ tshig don snga phyi gnyis gzhi gcig tu mi mthun par ston pa zhig dgos na/khyod rang gi dpe brjod dang 'gal te/ dpe brjod du nga tsho'i las kar grub 'bras ha cang chen po cig thopa pa'i dbang du btang na'ang nga rgyal dang rang che byed yas gi rgyu mtshan gang yang 185

mid/ cis daspa brjod du bzhag pa'i 'ang sgra des/ grub 'bras ha cang chen po thob pa dang / nga rgyal byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med pa gnyis gzhi gcig la mi mthun par ston pa red dam/des na gzhi rang re la gcig yod na gcig med dgos pas/rang rgyal la bskur 'debs su mi 'gyur ram/ dpe brjod gzhan dag kyang de lta bu'i nang 'gal can no/ / lhag bcas skabs de nyid las/ lhag bcas ni ston bya'i don ma rdzogs par tshig don gi lhag ma 'dren pa'i don bstan pa de la zer/ zhes don bshad pa ni tshig rdzob par ma zad/ lhag ma 'dren pa'i don bstarne pa/ zhes lhag bcas kyi don bshad pa ni mtshan mtshon go ldog pa yin te/ tshig don lhag ma 'dren pa'i phrad ni lhag bcas kyi don dang / don de nyid ston pa'i gzhung la lhag ma 'dren pa'i don ston pa'i gzhung ngam tshig zer ba las/ lhag bcas rang nyid kyis lhag ma 'dren pa'i don mi ston te/ tshig phrad rang gis rang nyid kyi don bstan pa mi srid pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / rang gi 'jug yul gi rjes 'jug ces zer ba ni bod kyi spyi skad mi na te/ bod rang gi brjod tshul la/ sngon 'jug dang rjes 'jug ni rang gi 'jug yul gyi ming gzhi la 'jug pa las/ lhag bcas la ni rang gi 'jug yul gi rjes 186

'jug mi zer lags/ khyed kyis deng skabs/ te ma gtogs ste dang de gnyis bed spyod gtong mkhan ha cang nyung ba/ zer ba'ang tshig don gnyis cha nas shin tu mi 'thad de/ bed spyod mkhan mi zer bar bed spyod gtong mkhan zhes byed tshig gnyis brtsegs kyis tshig je rdzob tu btab ba dang / bed spyod mkhan nyung ba ma yin te/ rgya chen bod mang tshogs kyis 'bri 'don sogs la rjes 'jug gi sgra drag zhan byed rtsol drag zhan sogs kyi dbang gis ste te de gsum sgra mtshungs 'dren zhing ngag tu thon pa bzhin du 'bri bar byed bzhin no/ /ste dang de gnyis 'dor dgos don ci red/ skad cha'i nang la cher med do zer na/ skad cha'i nang la mang che bar nas kho na yong / zhes khyed kyis khas blangs pas/ des na te sgra yang 'dor rigs so/ /ma dor na gnod pa ci yod/ stabs mi bde'o zer na/ 'o na te yang dor nas nas gcig pus chog par byed rigs so/ /ste te de gsum sgra gcig pas gcig gis chog par byed rigs she na/ sgra mi gcig ste/ ste ni sa dang te'i sgra bsdoms pas cung zad zhan pa dang / te ni drag paridang / de ni zhan pa yin gshis/ 'dren byed kyi rjes 'jug kyang so so bar gyur/ de'i stabs kyis phrad gzhan dbang can du gyur pa red do/ /mthar nged cag rig 187

gnas la cher ma byang ba dang skad gdangs cher mi dag pas/rtags mtshungs dang sgra mtshungs 'dren tshul sogs chen po ma shes stabs dka' tshegs che'o zer rgyu las gzhan med do/ / yang de nyid las/ 'dir mtshams sbyor zer ba ni gtso bo bya ba gnyis phan tshun mtshams sbyor byed pa de la zer/ zhes brjod bya la sbyar ba dang / yang bya tshig phyi ma de bya tshig snga ma'i 'bras bu yin pa de la zer/ zhes rjod byed la sbyar ba dang /dpe brjod la/ shing bcad de chad song zhes pa bzhag de ni brjod bya la sbyar na/ chad song ba bcad pa'i 'bras bu min te/ma bcad kyang rul song ba sogs kyi dbang gis chad pa yod pa'i phyir/ rjod byed la sbyar na'ang mi 'grig ste/ chad song zhes pa'i tshig de/ bcad ces pa'i 'bras bu min pa los shes/ yang kho na re/ gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i 'og bya tshig snga ma mang che ba bya yul dngos su 'brel ba'i bya tshig yin pa dang / bya tshig phyi ma mang che ba bya yul dngos su ma 'brel ba'i bya tshig red ces zer/tshig gi phreng ba 'di ni yig thog tu 'di 'dra 'bri ba'i srol med la/ mang tshogs kyi skad dang yang mthun tshul med/ gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i 'og zer bsam pa 'dra'ang / 'di sgra snyegs sa med pa'i stong tshig tu gyur 'dug yang / snga rting rim gis zhes/glu88

gang gi skad yin mi shes pa zhig bris mod/ don la/ snga phyi rim pa'i mtshams sbyor zer 'dod pa 'dra la/ de ltar na dpe brjod dang nang 'gal te/ khyed kyis dpe brjod la/ mar khe si le nyin ring lugs spel rgyu rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ bzo bcos ring lugs la dgag pa rgyag dgos/ zhes pa bzhag 'dug pas/ de ltar na dpe brjod mi 'grig ste/ de ltar na/ mar khe si le nyin ring lugs spel rgyu rgyun 'khyongs byed pa dang / bzo bcos ring lugs la dgag pa rgyag rgyu gnyis snga phyi rim can yin dgos la/'o na da skabs mar khe si le nyin ring lugs spel rgyu rgyun 'khyongs byed bzhin pa yin gshis/ mezo bcos ring lugs la dgag pa rgyag ma ran pa red dam/ nged cag gi rang lugs la/ 'di'i te sgra de/ mig bgrad de bltas/ zhes pa'i de sgra ltar/ gcig car du mtshams sbyor ba'i lhag bcas yin no/ / —'byed sdud kyi skabs/ 'byed sdud la/ gam ngam dam nam 'am sam ma gtogs med zer nas/ bam mam ram lam bzhi zur 'phud btang yang bzang bor 'gyur thub bam zhes/bam la dpe brjod bzhag ste rang rkub rang gis phud pa dang /gam ngam dam nam sam rnamaso rtags mtha' nges med du 'jug zer yang / sngar med gsar bskrun de la dpe brjod gcig kyang 189

ma rnyed pa dang / 'byed sdud la spyir btang yin na/ dang sgra bzhag chog zer nas dmigs bsal yin na mi chog par byas pa dang / dri ba'i sgo nas rnam grangs gzhan dang 'byed pa zer ma shes par/ gzhan pa dri ba ston pa'i don dang skabs rer the tshom gi don zer ba dang / gzhan la zhes rnam dbye la yig nges par thob pa la/ gzhan pa dri ba ston pa'i tshig ces la yig gi tshab tu pa sbyar ba dang / dri tshig dang dri ba ston pa'i don gnyis gcig tu 'khrul ba dang / the tshom pa'i tshig dang the tshom gyi don gcig tu 'khrul ba sogs nang 'gal dang 'khrul ba'i phung bo 'ba' zhig tu 'dug pas brjod kyis mi lang mod/ dpe gcig bshad na/the tshom gyi don ni blo rtse gnyis bar byed pa'i sems byung yin pa sgra tshad spyi lugs yin pas u tshugs ma byed cig gam ngam dam nam 'am sam rnams las 'am ma gtogs gzhan lnga rjes 'jug la ltos mi dgos par brjod bde lugs la gzhigs nas sbyar na 'grigaces bshad kyang / re'u mig gi skabs 'am yang rtags mtha' la ltos mi dgos pa'i grangs su bzhag pa dang / brjod bde lugs la gzhigs nas sbyar ba'i dpe brjod gcig kyang 'god rgyu ma rnyed 'dug go/ /rtags mtha' la ltos mi dgos na stag ngam/ gang gam/ yod sam/ yin gam/ 'bar mam/ dpal gam/190

yus bam sogs brjod bde lugs gang red/ brjod bde lugs la sbyar na 'grig pa gang red/ su'i kha skad kyi 'gro lugs dang bstun pa red/ zhib gsal gsung bar zhu/ brjod bde lugs ngo ma ni rtags mtshungs 'dren pa dang / sgra mtshungs/ 'dren pa yin pas 'dir yang rjes 'jug rang 'dra 'dren pa ni/ rtags mtshungs dang / sgra mtshungs ci rigs yin pas bod rang mtshan pa zhig yin tshe brjod bde shes sla'o/ / sngar 'brel sgra'i skabs khyed kyis mtha' med mtha' dang 'a mtha' can la 'i 'thob/ ces bshad nas 'dir gdam nga gi don la 'jug pa zhes mtha' med mtha' la gi sbyar ba dang / dang /yang na/ yin na'ang / 'dra gcig byas na rnams kyang gam sogs dang 'dra bar bshad pa ni gzu lum mo/ /gdam nga'i sgo nas rnam grangs gzhan dang 'byed pa ni/ dper na/ gser len nam dngul len/ zas dgos sam gos dgos/ zhes pa lta bu yin la/ khyed kyis dpe brjod la/ skyon brjod dam 'thab rtsod byas nas 'gal ba rnams sel thub pa byas te/ zhes pa bzhag mod/ de'i dam de gdam nga'i sgo nas rnam grangs gzhan dang 'byed pa'i phrad min zhing de ni 'byed sdud gnyis kyi nang gi sdud pa yin la/ rtswad pa'i nang gses kyi phyogs gcig tu sdud /9/

pa'i sdud pa yin te/ skyon brjod dang 'thab rtsod gnyis ka 'gal ba sel ba'i thabs su bsdus pa yin no/ /tshig phrad zhing sogs kyi skabs su sngar mtha' med mtha' la 'a dang sa sbyar dgos par bshad nas/ 'dir/ sa gi/ ba gis/ na gis/zhes mtha' med mtha' la gi dang gis sbyar ba ni/ lag rjes rkang bas bsub pa'o/ /yang khyed kyis/ zhing cing shing gsum zhing ma gtogs be+ed spyod byed ki med la/ zhes pa'i gsum las zhes dgar sgra las sbyar dargos pa la de chad pa dang / zhig cig shig gsum ni cig kho na tshad tshig gi 'jug pa ma gtogs/ zhes brise pa'i gsum las cig tshad tshig gi zhes dgar sgra mes sbyar dgos pa la/ las kyi tshab tu ni bzhag pa sogs ni kha skad dang gzhung lugs gang dang yang mi mthun stabs mang tshogs kyis go mi thub pa'i tshig rdzob bo/ /zhig cig shig gsum ga skul tshig skabs spyod chog la skabs gzhan du cig kho na las gzhan gnyis spyod mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci red/ kha skad la med do zer na/ yod de mi zhig yong gi 'dug khyod 'gro sa gang zhig red/ nyung shos shig nyung shas shig zer ba lta bu/ de ni 'brog skad red do zer na/ 'brog pa ma zad rong phyogs kyi yul gru ches mang bos de ltar bshad bzhin 19 lha

yod/ bod mang phyogs kyi skad de bod skad ma red zer thub bam/ khyod kyes de 'dra cig zer ba kha skad la yod zer ba dang /cig ni tshad 'dzin kho na la 'jug zer ba nang 'gal la/ gzhan yang gzhan la ku re'i tshul dang / smon pa la de 'grub/ par gyur cig ces da drag gis rtags mtha' drangs pa ngag tu thon bzhin yod pa ni/ brjod bde ba'i dbang gis yin gyi/ brjod mi bde'ang gzhan zhig gis gsar brje yin pas 'gro phyogs ma nor zer nas btsan shed kyis mgor bzhag pa zhig min no/ /zhes ces gnyis dang / zer mi 'dra ste zhes zer/ ces zer/ zhes gnyis gnyis yod pa'i snga ma ni tshig phrad yin la phyi ma zer ni byed tshig yin/ de yang yin te/ zhes dang ces kyis tshig gi don dang rnam pa de 'dra zhig ces pa'i nus pa 'don la/ zer zhes pas smras pa tsam bstan pa'i phyir/ zhe'o ce'o she'o gsum ni zer 'dug dang 'dra/ zer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ zhe'o sogs ni phrad tsam yin la/ zer 'dug ces pa ni byed tshig red/ zhe'o sogs phrad de dag gi nus pa ni/ 'bel gtam sogs kyi skabs su/dam bca' dang dgag sgrub sogs kyi rnam pa de lta bu zhig go/ /zhes rdzogs tshig dang bcas pas don ston par 'gyur la/ zer 'dug ces pa'i/ bshad 'dug ces pa tsam las mi ston/ de tsho 193

dag las zhe'o lta bu'i 'ga' zhig kha skad la cher mi 'ong na'ang /gzhan dag kha skad la gtan med pa'ang min la 'bel gtam dang / zlos gar dang / snyan ngag bcad lhug dag dang / glu gar dang / sgrung sogs kyi tshig la nyams dod pa sogs kyi skabs su yod la mkho ba zhig yin pas/ mes rgyal gyi rig gnas bzang bo'i ya gyal phyi rgyal gyis kyang zhib 'jug byed bzhin pa'i bod kyi rig gnas de brlag par mi byed par zhu/ des na de dag dor ba la dgos pa med par ma zad gnod pa shin tu che'o/ /nga na ma gsum gyi rjes su zhing sogs drangs pa dang / da ba gnyis kyi rjes su cing sogs drangs pa ni rtags mtshungs yin la/ ga'i rjes su cing sogs drangs pa dang / sa'i rjes su shing sogs drangs ba ni sgra mtshungs yin/ des na cing sogs dor nas zhing gis tshang ma'i tshab byas tshe/ brjod zhing / byed zhing sogs 'bri dgos la/ de ltar du khyed cag gis 'bri gyin 'dug 'on kyang /btsan shed kyis bris pa ma gtogs ngag tu mi thon zhing / shin tu brjod mi bde ste/ byed zhing zhes pa'i zhing sgra thon tshe snga ma'i rjes 'jug gi da sgra 'bor zhing / byed kyi rjes 'jug gi da sgra thon tshe/ zhing sgra mi thon par cing sgra rang shugs kyis 'byung bar 'gyur bas/ klog mkhan dag kyang sun snang skyes 'dug de'i rgyu /94 ri

mtshan ni/ da rjes 'jug gi pho dang / zha ming gzhi'i mo yin phyir rtags mi mtshungs pa dang / da rjes 'jug gi pho yin ga shis rjes 'jug tu song tshe sgra drag par 'gyur ba dang / skye gnas so yine stabs lce'i rtse mo so la sbyar nas sgra 'byung ba dang / zha ni skye gnas rkan yin pa dang / ming gzhi'i mo yin zhing sgra shin tu lhod pas/ sgra yang mi mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /da rjes 'jug gi pho yin pas rjes 'jug tu song tshe/ de'i dbang gis rang nyid gang la zhugs pa'i ming dang tshig de nyid sgradrig par 'gyur la/ca'i skye gnas rkan yin yang ming gzhi'i pho yin gshis/ brjod tshul dam pa yin pas rtags mtha'i da dang sgra mi mtshungs par med par ma zad/ rtags kyang mtshungs pas rtags mtshungs drangs pa yin no/ / gzhan yang khyed kyi dpe brjod du/ mi 'dra sa ni dbang ba'i lam lugs gyur pa de red/ ces pa'i gyur la 'as 'phul chad pa dang / khyed rig gnas la slobs shig ces pa'i khyed la gsum pa byed pa chad pa dag ni kha skad dang ji ltar mthun/ tshad tshig ston pa zhes tha snyad gsar ba zhig btags mod/ don ni tshad 'dzin la 'jug pa zer bsam pa yin pa 'dra/ de yin na'ang / dpe brjod mi 'grig ste/ rtsom yig cig bris zhes 195

pa'i cig de tshad 'dzinamin zhing / de ni bya byed las gsum gyi nang gi las dngos 'dzi na pa'i tshig phrad tsam yin/ dper na de 'dra zhig red ces pa'i zhig de tshad 'dzin min pa dang 'dra/tshad 'dzin ni/ dper na gsum tsam/ brgya tsam zhes pa'i tsam sgra lta bu'o/ /gong du mtshams sbyor la 'jug pa'i zhing sogs gsum/ zhing ma gtogs bed spyod byed ki med ces bshad mod/'og tu tshig phrad cing de skad cha'i 'gro lugs dang bstun nas mkho dgos ltar gang 'tsham spyod chog ces zer ba rang lugs gtad so med pa'i rtags so/ /rdzogs tshig skabs su/ red/ 'dug yin/ yod/ song /rung sogs skad dang mthun pa'i rdzogs tshig yin zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ de ltar na/ tshig mthar byung ba'i ming tshig gang rung yin na rdzogs tshig yin pas khyab par thal lo red/'dug sogs kyis tshig de'i brjod bya re zhig rdzogs par ston pa'i nges pa med la/ — rang gi zla bo tshig grogs gzhan 'byung ba mi 'gog pas/ go sogs dang 'dra tshul gtan nas med/ yang kho na re/ —pe cin du chas so dang / ngas slob sbyong byed bzhin no/ /zhes pa ni gna' rabs kyi bod yig yin zer ba ni 'chol gtam yin te/ rig gnas gsar brje sdon gyi lo bcu bdun ring la 196

slob grwa sogs su de ltar 'bri spyod byas par ma zad rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i nang du'ang mang tshogs nang du de ltar 'bri klog byed pa bar ma chad par yod gshis/ yi ge shes mkhan tshang mas de dag gi don go zhing shes pa dang / yul gru du mar kha skad la'ang yod pa'i spyi skad cig yin/ khyed kyis gna' rabs dang deng rabs kyi sa mtshams gang nas 'dzin smra rigs la/ phe cin la phyin pa red ces yul skad ring bo khyer ma yong bar/ pe cin la phyin zhes smras na'ang spyi skad yin gshis— kun gyis go nus so/ /gzhan yang / khyim ni thor zhes pa'i 'thor gyi 'as 'phul chad pa'ang / ma dgongs par gsal te/ gtor zhes pa byed pa bo gzhan dang 'brel ba dang / 'thor zhes pa byed pa bo gzhan dang ma 'brel bas 'thor zhes pa'i skad kyi gdangs la 'as 'phul nges par/ thon gshis/ 'as 'phul 'jog pa spyi lugs yin/ 'on kyang byarnyeskushākyi tshig min par ming tsam du song tshe 'as 'phul med deṇa khṛ ṭhadaper na/ thor bu/ thar thor/ gsung thor bu sogs kyi skad kyi gdangs la 'as 'phul mi thon gshis/ 'as 'phul mi 'bri ba spyi srol yin mod/ khyed cag la nges pa ci yod/ dang sgra'i skabs/ sngar bod gi brda sprod pa'i gzhung ltar na/ dang sgra ni sdud pa dang / 'byed pa/ rgyu mtshan/ tshe skabs/ gdams 197

ngag skul tshig bcas lnga la 'jug gi yod kyang / dngos gnas byas na deng skabs dang sgra'i nus pa gtso bo ni 'byed sdud sogs tshig dang tshig tshogs phan tshun mtshams sbyor byed dang bskul tshig gi tshig rogs la 'jug pa de red/ ces pa'i sngar bod giñcabarda sprod pa'i —gzhung ltar na zhes dang / dngos gnas byas na deng skabs/ zhes bod kyi brda sprod gzhung gi bshad tshul de/ dngos gnas min par rdzun pa yin par 'dod mod/ don gtan nas ma go bar gsal te/ 'byed sdud sogs ni mtshams sbyor min te/ mtshams sbyor ni lag pa bsnyal la zas za lta bu'i la yig gis tshig gong 'og mtshams sbyar te lhag ma 'dren pa tsam las/'byed sdud kyi nus pa gang yang mi 'don/ khyod kyi dpe brjod kyang mi 'grig ste/ nga tsho'i tang ni rlabs chen gyi tang dang / gzi brjid ldan pa'i tang dang / yang dag pa'i tang zhig yin/zhes pa'i dang sgra gnyis ka mtshams min zhing sdud pa yiskurmikhyu zakyakhyad gzhi gcig gi steng du khyad chos gsum sdud pa'i —tsahāpa yinaḍopa shin tu gsal/ nga tsho ni 'byor med gral rim dang mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi langs phyogs su langs yod ces pa'i dang sgra'ang mtshams sbyor min la/ 'byed pa yin te/ langs phyogs kyi dngos po de la rnam grangs gnyis su 'byed pa'i 'byed pa yin 198

no/ /cho.oṃloṭ+wāṃrlabs chen gyi tang / 'di'i 'brel sgra ni/ rang/bzhi na dang rang bzhin can gyi 'brel sgra red/ tsholkotshiṭ+wāṃgazi bajid ldan pa'i tang / 'di'i 'brel sgra ni khyad gzhi dang khyad chos kyi 'brel sgra red/ chatshotshiṭ+wāṃyang dag pa'i tang / 'di'i 'brel sgra ni rang bzhin dang rang bzhin can gyi 'brel sgra red/des na bar ma de‘‘gzi brjid gi tang zhes bsgyur ba mi 'grig ste/ dper na/ yon tan can gyi mi zer 'dod nas yon tan gi mi zer ba dang 'dra'o/ /gzhan yang / ltos dang zhes pa'i dang sgra de skul tshig gi tshig grogs yin zer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ ltos ni skul tshig dang /dang ni gdams ngag ston pa'i tshig yin/ gdams ngag gam gdams pa zhes pa ni/ thabs zab mo'am thabs legs pa'i ming yin la/ dper na/ brtson 'grus rtsoms dang mkhas par 'gyur/ zhes pa lta bu la mtshon nas bshad na/ mkhas par 'gyur ba dmigs yul yin la/ dmigs yul de 'grub pa'i thabs sam gdams ngag ni brtson 'grus byed pa yin pas/ dang sgras brtson 'grus byed pa'am brtson pa de mkhas par 'gyur ba'i gdams ngag yin par ston pa'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan zhig la bslab bya zhig bstan nas/ de yid la zungs dang rang la phan trī99

zheyobarjod tshe/ zungs dang zhes pa'i dang sgras bslab bya rnams yod la 'dzin pa de/ rang la phan pa'i thabs sam gdams ngag yin par ston pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ ltos dang gnam 'og tu 'gran zla byed phod mkhan su yod/ ces pa'i tshig gi ltos dang zhes pa'i dang sgras legs par brtag pa dang blta bar bya ba ni/gnam 'og tu 'gran zla byed phod mkhan med pa shes pa'i gdams ngag yin par ston pa'o/ /rgyu mtshan la 'jug pa dang mi 'dra ste/ de ni gtan tshigs ston pa ste/ dper na/ du ba mthong ba dang me yod pa shes so/ /zhes pa'i dang sgras du ba mthong ba de me yod pa shes pa'i rgyu mtshan yin par ston pa dang / brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang mthar phyin/ zhes pa'i dang sgras brtson 'grus brtsams pa de mthar phyin pa'i rgyu mtshan yin par ston pa las/ rgyu yod pa dang 'bras bu 'byung / zhes pa'i dang sgras rgyu yod pa de/ 'bras bu 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan du ston pa yin la/'di 'dra ni dus dang rgyu mtshan lhan cig ston pa'ang yod do/ /brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang mthar phyin zhes pa dang / brtson 'grus rtsoms dang mkhas par 'gyurarme/ zhes pa gnyis mi 'dra ste/snga ma'i brtsams zhes pa 'das tshig yin pas/ skyes bu 'di chos can/ rig gnas sbyang ba mthar phyin te/ brtson 'grus 200

ba rtsams pa'i phyir/ zhes rgyu mtshan du bkod pa yin la/ phyi ma'i rtsoms zhes pa skul tshig yin phyir mkhas par 'gyur 'dod na/de'i thabs sam gdams ngag brtson 'grus rtsoms shig ces pa'o/ /yang kho na re/ dang sgra rgyu mtsham/ ston pa dang / tshe skabs ston ba ni/ sngar gi yi ge nang la ma gtogs deng sang skad cha'i nang la bed spyo da yas ha cang nyung nyung red/ ces zer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ khyod la rgyu mtshan bshad rgyu yod dang na bden kha 'thob rgyu red/ ces pa'i dang sgra dang / na sgra gnyis ka yod pa shin tu mang la shi rus gyis dang yon tan 'byar rgyu red/ ces dang / la lar brda cung zad 'gyur nas/ shi rus gyis da yon tan 'byar rgyu red/ ces dang / sgug sdod dang nga da yong / zer ba dang / la lar brda cung zad 'gyur nas/sgug sdod da nga yong zer ba sogs ha cang nyung nyung min par ma zad/ mang bo yod pas/ khyod kyis mi shes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis med mi dgos te/ ma mthong phyir na med pa min/ /gsungs so/ /de sgra'i skabs kho na re/ de sgra'i phrad la 'jug yul tha snyad dbang du byas na gsum dang / dngos po'i dbang du byas na bzhi/dus kyi dbang du byas na gnyis te sdom pa'i 'jug yul dgu 201

rigs so sor 'byed yod pa red/ 'byed stangs dang 'grel bshad rgyag stangs ha cang nyag nyog yod zhing go dka' ba cig red/ ces yang rang nyid kyis mi shes pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas legs bshad zhib cing phra ba dag nyag nyog dang go dka' ba zhes dma' 'bebs byas mod/ rang gis tshig kha shas rtsom rgyu'ang mi 'byor te/ rigs so sor 'byed yod pa dang / zhes 'das pa'i tshab la ma 'ongs pa sbyar ba dang / de ni ming tshig dang / yang na ming tshig 'ga' shas/ thog mtha' bar gsum ci rigs la sbyar na nges bzung gleng mol bya yul/ 'das pa'i tha snyad ston pa yin/ zhes pa'i ming tshig 'ga' shas/ thog mtha' bar gsum ci rigs la sbyar na/ zhes sbyar rgyu dang sbyar yul gnyis go nor ba dang / 'ga' zhig ces zhig gi gong du 'ga' thob pa dang /kha shas zhes shas kyi gong du kha thob pa ni/ kha skad kyi 'gro lugs dngos ltar brda sprod gzhung gi dgongs pa yin mod/ 'dir shas kyi gong du 'ga' bzhag pa dang / nges bzung gleng mol bya yul zhes go rgyu med pa'i tshig rdzob dang / ‘‘'das pa'i tha snyad ston pa rizhes tha snyad 'das pa dang / 'das pa'i tha snyad gnyis gcig tu 'khrul ba sogs la zhib dpyad ci la dgos/spyi sgra'i skabs/ bod spyi'i skad kyi 'gro lugs ltar na/lha0lha

gsung rtsom de su'i red/ su'i yin ngas ma shes/ zer rgyu yin mod/ ‘‘gsung rtsom de su gi red’’dang / su gi yin min ngas ma shes/ zer ba ni rgya ma bod cig gi skad yin na ma gtogs bod kyi spyi skad min no/ /gangs ma char/ rong ma 'brog ra ma lug ces pa'i ma yig ni dgag sgra yin zer ba mi 'thad de/ gangs kyi cha yod la char gyi cha yang yod pa/ ra'i rnam pa yod la lug gi rnam pa'ang yod pa/ rong las yod langa'abrog las kyang yod pa la zer ba yin te/ dper na rgya skad la/ ༈lkoshiṣ+ṭhasnuzer ba dang 'dra/ ma yig yin tshad dgag sgra yin mi dgos pa gong du bshad zin to/ /yang kho na re/ nges par shes dgos pa ni ma mo'am bdag po'i tha snyad la 'jug pa yin/ zhes dang / bdag sgra dngos gi ma red/ ces pa'ang su'i skad red ces 'dri bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang / bya ba bya rgyu ni dus ma 'ongs pa dang / bya ba byed bzhin pa ni dus da lta ba/ bya ba byas zin pa ni dus 'das pa bcas dus gsum zer yas gcig nedang / zhes ma 'ongs pa'i dngos po dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus gnyis gcig tu 'khrul ba dang /nga slob sbyong byed rgyu yin/ zhes gsum pa byed pa chad pa dang /skul tshig la byed shig ces dpe brjod bzhag pa sogs 'khrul ba 203

ha cang rags pa'o/ /‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i ’sngon dang / rjes su'ang mang tshogs kyis bed spyod byed bzhin pa'i bod kyi spyi'i skad yig la gna' rabs gi yi ge zer zhing / dbus khams mdo gsum gyi 'brog 'bangs rgya chen po'i skad de gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi skad red zer gyin yod pa sngar nas thos la/ 'dir yang bod skad kyi 'gro lugs nang zer ba sogs zur za'i rnam pa shin tu mang mod/'on kyang / bod skad gi 'gro lugs nang zhes bod kyi 'dod pa bkod pa'i re'u mig spyang chal chol du gda' ste/ rags rim zhig brjod na/ sa bon 'debs pa'i ma 'ongs pa la/ gdab/lam sna 'dren pa'i ma 'ongs pa la drang / 'og tu gnon pa'i ma 'ongs pa la mnan/ bkod pa dag ni spyi skad la med pa dang /thor/ gtor/ 'thor/ gsum ni rim bzhin 'das dang skul tshig ma 'ongs pa/ da lta ba/ gsum gyi dper bzhag pa ni/shin tu ma brtag par gsal te/ gtor zhes pa byed pa bo gzhan dang 'brel ba'i bya ba brjod pa'i tshig yin la/ 'thor zhes pa ni/ byed pa bo gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i bya ba brjod pa'i tshig yin/ thor zhes pa ming tsam las bya byed gang la'ang mi 'jug mod/ khyed cag gi 'bri lugs la nges pa ci yod/ rtsa bar/ ma 204

ning gnyis ka da ltar ched/ /gsungs pa ltar/ gtor zhes pa da lta ba dang / 'das pa dang / skul tshig la'ang 'jug la da dung brda cung zad kyang 'gyur med/kho na re/ 'di gar bshad dgos rgyur/ sngon chad rtsom pa'i dag yig dus gsum gi rnam bzhag mang bo'i nang / gzugs 'gyur yod pa'i bya tshig cha shas la 'bri stangs gcig gyur med pa'i thog kha shas ni khyad par chen po yod pas gang la stun dgos min mi shes par gyur ba red/ zang zing che ba'i gnas tshul de ni/ yig thog gi 'bri stangs dang skad lugs gi 'phel rgyas gi rjes snyeg mi thub par rang shugs gis byung ba'i rkyen gis red/der rten/ yi ge bcos sgyur byas na ma gtogs gcig gyur byed thub gi ma red bsam gi 'dug zer ba ni/ nga'i gdong gi dri ma nag po de khyod kyi ngo la yod pa red/ zer ba dang 'dra ste/ tshig phreng dum bu 'di kho na la bshad na/ sngon chad rtsom pa'i zhes 'das tshig gi tshab la rtsom sbyar ba dang / dag yig dus gsum gi rnam bzhag ces rnam dbye chad pa'am gonga'og bsnol bas gang yin mi go bar gyur pa dang / bya tshig cha shas la zhes kha shas dang cha shas nor ba red/ kha shas ni khyad par chen po yod pas/zhes la'i tshab tu ni sbyar ba dang / zang zing che ba'i gnas tshul 20bya

de ni/ zhes pa dang / der rte—na/ zhes bas 'phul chad pa dang / rjes snyeg mi thub ces snyeg yod pas/ gong du gsum pa byed pa chad pa dang / rjes snyeg mi thub par rang shugs gis byung ba'i rkyen gis red/ ces ru bsdus pa'i ra yig sbyar bas/ci zer 'di zer med par gyur pa dag ni/ khyed kyis skad lugs gi 'phel rgyas zer ba de red dam/da ni khyod kyis bcos sgyur byas pa'i re'u mig la cung zad dpyad na/ blta/ brnga / bza'/ dgag gzhug bya ste dus gsum gyi nang gi ma 'ongs pa dang / bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang gi gzhan dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang gi bya ba yul la 'jug pa 'di rnams la khyed kyi bka' chad phog nas phyir 'phud gnang ba ma gtogs nged cag gi skad kyi nang du ma 'gyur bar yod pa bzhin du yig thog tu 'bri bar byed cing klog bzhin pa'o/ /'on kyang / zas/ zhes pa 'das tshig tu bzhag pa ni yig nor yin na ma gtogs/ 'das pa la/ zos/ zhes 'bri zhing brjod la/ zas zhes pa ni zas kyi ming tsam yin te/ dper na/ kha zas/ zer ba dang khyod kyis zas e zos/ zhes 'dri ba ltar ro/ /deng sang khyed cag gi 'bri lugs la nges pa ci yod/sa bon gdab dang / gdan gting ni khyed kyi thugs mad de/206

ding dus skad yig gnyis char la baid spyod kyin med do/ /bklagabaklags/ bsgrong / bsgrengs/ bsgrub/ bsgrubs/ bsnam/bsnams/ rnams la khyed kyi bka' chad phog mod/ nged cag gi ngag thog tu yod bzhin pa'i skad yig yin gshis/ ngo chen re gnang bar zhu/ 'on kyang / ral gri sogs snom zer ba ni/skad yig gnyis char la med pa'i rang bzo 'ba' zhig yin la/skul tshig la/ snoms/ zhes sa mtha' yod/ bskyabs/bskyangs/ bsnyams/ brtsams/ rnams kyang phud yod mod/bskyabs zin dang bskyab bya gnyis la khyad par yod gshis/rtags mtha' 'dren tshul yang mi 'dra/ des na de dag bsgyur na stabs bde ba phar zad mgo rnyog par 'gyur ro/ /'khrid dang khrid/ 'thebs dang thebs la 'as 'phul gyi dbang gis sgra mi 'dra zhing / yig gzugs kyang mi 'dra ba 'bri ba —ni skad kyi dbang gis so/ /yang 'jug sa'i sgra'ang smra dag pa'i yul du gsal zhing /de'i dbang gis rtags mtha' 'dren tshul yang mi 'dra'o/ /brten dang bsdur ni 'das tshig gi skabs skad gdangs la nges par bas 'phul thon zhing / rten dang sdur gyi sgra dang mi 'dra gshis yi ge la'ang so sor 'bre bzhin yod pas/ bka' btsan po zhig phab lha07

na ma gtogs bsgyur rgyu dka' ba 'dra/ 'chos dang 'chad gnyis skad kyi nang mang bo mi thon na'ang gtan mi thon pa min te/ mar le ring lugs kyi 'chad nyan zer ba lta bu'o/ /yang btsal gcig pus dus gsum ga'i skabs go chod pa byed dgos zer ba ni/ khyod bod byings kyi skad la 'dris cha che ba'i rtags yin nam/ nged cag rgyus yod kyi bod kyi yul gru phal mo cher/ bdag po la 'tshol ba bo dang 'tshol ni bo/ gzhan la btsal bya btsal rgyu bo/ 'das pa la btsal nas/ btsal zin/ da lta ba la 'tshol bar byed/ ma 'ongs pa la ngas 'tshol rgyu yin/ skul tshig la tshol zer ba sogs khyad par yod 'dug yul gru 'ga' zhig la khyad par med pa'ang yod mod/ yul gru 'ga' re'i skad de khyer yong nas spyi skad byed rgyu ni dka' 'o/ /ma 'ongs pa la byung zhes bshad mkhan dang 'bri mkhan khyed lta bu las ma tshor/ klog sgrub/ sgrong / snom rnams kyis dus gsum skul tshig dang bcas pa la go gcig chod byed dgos zer ba yang mi 'thad de/ bdag la 'jug pa sgrub dang / gzhan la 'jug pa bsgrub gnyis bas 'phul gyi dbang gis skad kyi gdangs mi 'dra zhing / don la 'jug tshul yang mi 'dra bas tshig don gnyis char la rnyog dra bzos par ma zad/ 'das tshig dang / skul 208

mispu/ sogs rtags mtha' 'dren tshul la yang dzhag dra bzos te/mang tshogs kyi skad dang thag nye bar byed dgos zer nas/ mang tshogs kyi skad kyi gdangs la yod pa rnams dor nas/ mang tshogs kyi skad dang mi mthun pa'i tshig nyog re khyer yong ste/ 'di ni yi ge bcos sgyur byas pa yin no/ /gsar brje yin pas 'di'i kha phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos/ ltag log rgyag mi rung ngo / /zhes 'jigs ngom dang bcas te ngo so byed pa ni/ mang tshogs kyi skad la rgol ba yin te/ dpe 'ga' zhig bshad na/ shog grangs 97par dus gsum 'gyur ba'i bya tshig sngon ma'i yi ge 'bri stangs la cha mtshon na/ zhes bris 'dug bya tshig sngon ma gang red/ bya tshig phyi ma gang red/ shog grangs98yul skad kha shas nang du da dung da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa zhes dang / 'das pa'i bar gzugs 'gyur gi dbye ba phye yod pas/ zhes pa'i don/ dbye ba phyes yod pas zer bsam pa e yin/ yin na phye mkhan su red/de min na/ dbye ba yod pas zer 'dod pa e yin/ go mi thub/shog grangs99'on kyang da lta yul skad so so'i nang la gzugs 'gyur gang yang med de skyor klog stabs bde shos gcig rang 'jags su bzhag yod par rten/ zhes dang / yang 'bri lugs stabs bde bo'i ma 'ongs pa dang da lta ba gnyis rang 'jags su 209

bzhag dargos nes pa'i 'asri lugs stabs bde bo'i 'das ma / / lha 'ongs de gang red/ stabs mi bde ba'i —'das ma 'ongs gnyis gang red/ shog grangs100rjes 'jug ma dang 'a yod mkhan gnyis de da dung zhib 'jug byed dgos/ zhes zer/ mkhan zhes pa gang zag gi bdag sgra yin pas/ ma dang 'a yod mkhan zhib 'jug byed dgos sa'i gang zag de su red lags/ yang 'bri stangs stabs bde bo de rang 'jags su bzhag pa ma gtogs yig gzugs gzhan zhig phyir 'bud byed dgos/ zer/ bzhag pa ma gtogs zhes pa'i bzhag 'das tshig yin pas/ 'jog mkhan su red/ bzhag pa ma gtogs ma bzhag na kho rang shi rgyu e red/ shog grangs101dus gsum yi ge dang kha skad nang tshang ma/ zhes bris 'dug dus gsum yi ge zhes pa'i 'das pa'i yi ge bod kyi yi ge dang da lta ba'i yi ge dang ma 'ongs pa'i yi ge de gang red/ shog grangs102yig gzugs kha shas/ rjod tshig nang dus gsum ston dus/ spyir btang thog mi spyod pa yin na'ang stabs bde bzo dgos/ 'on kyang tshig grub bzo dus sngon mar bed spyod byed myong ba'i yig gzugs/ zhes pa'i skabs su'ang /'ang sgra dang ra sgra sogs yod 'dug pas don ci yin/ shog grangs103par bzhag dgos/ zhes dang / bed spyod btang mi 310

dgos/ zhes dang / be+ed spyod btang na ma gtogs sogs/shog grangs104bya tshig stabs bde bo bzo dgos na/ gtso bo dus gsum la gnad chen por bzung dgos/ 'on kyang skul tshig yang stabs bde bo bzo chog sngon ma'i yi ge'i nang gi skul tshig klog stangs dang stabs bde bo bzos tshar ba'i dus gsum gi klog stangs khyad par med na/ stabs bde bos bzos chog kha skad nang gi stabs bde bo bzos tshar ba'i dus gsum klog stangs khyad par yod na/ sngon ma'i skul tshig gi yig gzugs rang 'jags bzhag pa las stabs bde bo bzo mi dgos/ zhes sogs ni/ yi ge mi shes pa'i mang tshogs kyis go rgyu phar zad/ yi ge shes pa dag gis kyang mi go bar 'dug 'di lta bu'i ci yin 'di yin med pa re bris nas mang tshogs kyi kha skad dang bstun pa yin no/ /zer ba ni/ mang tshogs kyis dga' bsu zhu ba phar zad/mang tshogs zhe khyel ba'i rgyu yin/ yi ge bcos bsgyur ma byas na mi 'grig snyams zer zhing / yi ge gcig kyang bcos bsgyur byed rgyu ma rnyed par bod kyi skad btsan bsgyur byas pa'o/ /deng skabs phyogs gang thad nas yar rgyas 'byung bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir/ yig rigs gzhan dag las kyang ming dang tshig mang bo zhig bsgyur dgos 'byung la/ de la'ang zhwadape lham 211

'geb byed rgyu med par bod rang gi skad kyi khyad chos dang bstun dgosamigashis/ sngar bshad pa ltar yi ge so so'i skye gnas/ byed pa/ 'byin par byed pa'i rgyu/ skyod par byed pa'i rgyu/ skul bar byed pa'i rgyu/ nga ro sogs shes dgos par ma zad/ bod skad rang la yod pa'i dzig sdud rnams kyang shes dgos/ tshig sdud kyang / sgra mdo las/ ming rnams kyi phan tshun bsdu ba yang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ming la rnam dbye sbyar bas tshig tu grub pa de 'dra gnyis sam mang bo bsgrigs kyang rung ste/ dzig de dag gi phrad dang yan lag rnams bsdus te/ sngar phan tshun ma 'brel ba rnams gcig tu sbyor ba'i tshul gyis mang bo rnams nyung ngur bsdus pa la/ tshig rgyas pa'i don thams cad kyang ma tshang ba med pa de ni tshig sdud kyi don yin no/ /tshig sdud delayang don 'gal ba gnyis bsdu mi rung ste/ de bsdus na brjod don shes bya la mi srid pas/ brjod byas stongs par 'gyur mod/ deng dus gang byung byed pa dag la ya cha/ des na bod rang skad la tshig sdud yod pa dag mdo tsam bshad na/ lcags kyi smyu gu/ zhes pa tshig sdud byas tshe/ lcags smyug ces 'brel sgra kyi bsdu zhing / smyu la rjes 'jug ga thon pa ni smyu gu zhes pa'i gu sgra bsdus te rjes 'jug byas pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ zha nye'i sgyu gu zhes pa tshig 312

sdud byasajitshi/ zhan smyug ces zha la na rjes 'jug yod pa ngag tu thon pa yang / zha nye zhes pa'i nye sgra'i dbang gis zha la rjes 'jug na drangs pa yin la/ yi ges skad la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pas 'bri ba'i tshe na'ang / zhan smyug ces 'bri dgos so/ /bod kyi yi ge zhes pa tshig sdud byas tshe/ bod yig ces yi la rjes 'jug ga thon pa'ang ge yig bsdus pa'i sgra'i dbang gis yin la/de bzhin du stag gi pags pa/ zhes pa tshig sdud byas tshe/ stag lpags/ zhes 'brel sgra gi bsdus pas 'brel sgra gi de'i sgra gdangs kyi dbang gis pa la la mgo byung ba/ skad kyi gdangs ltar yi ge 'bri ba'ang phyag srol rnam par dag pa'o/ /yang tshu rol du shogapha rol du song / zhes pa tshig sdud byas tshe/ tshur shog phar song / zhes tshu dang pha la ra mtha' byung ba'ang / rol gyi sgra bsdus pa'i shul yin/ de bzhin du dngul gyi bu lon/ zhes pa la/ dngul bun/ zhes bsdus tshe/ bun zhes na rjes 'jug thob pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ zhes pa bsdus nas/ sher phyin/ zhes shes kyi sa mtha' phyis nas ra mtha' thon pa'ari / rab kyismopha rol tu/ zhes pa bsdus pa'i gdangs thon pa yin la/ shes rab grags pa la/ sher grags/ shes rab bstan pa la/ sher bstan zer ba'ang de dang 'dra/ de lha13

bzhin du/ bde mchog zer ba'i mi la chung dus gces 'bod byas te/ a bdem/ zhes brjod pa'ang / mchog ces pa bsdus pas de'i mas 'phul gyi sgra'i dbang gis bde la ma mtha' byung ba dang / de bzhin du/ 'jigs rgyam/ mkhas rgyam/ — blo rgyam sogs la/ 'jigs med rgya mtsho sogs kyi mtsho'i sgra bsdus pas mtsho'i mas 'phul gyi sgra'i dbang gis/ rgya la rjes 'jug ma byung ba'o/ /rdo rje dang dril bu la/ rdor dril/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la/ 'jam rdor/ zhes pa'i rdo la ra mtha' 'byung ba sogs dang / gzhan yang / rtags mtha' 'dren tshulagyigyi dbang gis sngon 'jug kyang tshig sdud sogs kyi skabs su dbyi ba yod de/ dper na/ lo gsar ba dang / gos gsar ba sogs tshig sdud byas tshe/lo sar/ gos sar/ pho sar/ mo sar/ bag sar/ rta sar/mdzo sar/ g.yag sar sogs la gas 'phul mi dgos pa'i stabs kyis/ dag yig mkhas pa dga' bskyed sogs su/ sar ba lta bu gang yang rung / gsungs don yang de yin mod/ yig tshogs rdzob dgos pa dag la ci cha/ 'di dag la sogs pa'i tshig sdud dang / tshig gi 'gyur ba ni legs sbyar la'ang mang ste/ sgra 'grel las/ ji yi ge glo bur yi ge bsnol ba dang / /nyams da nga lha14

yi gi rnam 'gyur gnyis ni gzhan/ /phroṃngs de'i ldan la phulo byung storopa ste/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga lnga bo nges par bshad / /ces gsungs pa ltar/ glo bur ba ste/ yi ge gsar ba bsnan pa ā ga ma dang rkyen rnams dang / yi ge bsnol ba ni/ snga ma'i gsal byed phyi mar spos pa dang phyi ma'i gsal byed snga mar spos pa yin/ yi ge nyams pa ni dbyi ba la zer/ yi ge rnam par 'gyur ba ni/ mtha' 'gyur ba dang / ngo bo 'gyur ba 'brel ba can dang / 'brel ba med pa sogs sna tshogs yod/ bod yig la'ang de 'dra ba yod de/ yi ge glo bur ba'am bsnan pa ni/ dper na/ bde bar gshegs pa/ tshig sdud byas na/ bder gshegs/ zhes brjod tshe/ bde la rjes 'jug ra glo bur ba ste bsnan pa yin la/ de 'dra gzhan yang yod do/ /snga ma'i gsal byed phyi mar spos pa/ dper na/ stag gi pags pa zhes tshig sdud byas pa/ stag lpags/ zhes pa rnam dbye gi'i gsal byed ga'i sgra gdangs kyi dod phyi ma pa'i mgo la spos te la mgo byung ba smo dang / phyi ma'i gsal byed snga mar spos pa ni/ dper na/ zha nye'i smyu gu zhes pa tshig sdud byas nas/ zhan sgyug ces brjod tshe/phyi ma nye'i gsal byed nya'i sgra gdangs de nyid snga ma zha'i thog tu spos te/ zha la na rjes 'jug byung ba dang / yi ge nyams pa'am 315

dbyi ba ni/ daspir na/ shis rab grags pa/ zhis pa tshig sdud byas nas/ sher grags/ zhes brjod tshe/ shes kyi rjes 'jug sa phyis nas ra ā ga ma byung ba lta bu/ sher phyin zhes pa'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /mtha' 'gyur ba ni/ dper na/ lcags kyi smyu gu/ zhes pa tshig sdud byas nas/ lcags smyug ces brjod tshe/mtha'i gu 'gyur te smyu la rjes 'jug ga byub ba dang / 'jam dpal shes rab la/ 'jam sher/ zhes dang / bod yig ces pa'ang de dang 'dra/ — ngo bo cha tshang 'gyur ba ni/ dper na/dkon mchog rgya mtsho zhes pa tshig sdud byas nas/ dkom rgyam/zhes par 'gyur ba lta bu sogs yod/ tshig sdud byas kyang mi 'gyur ba'ang yod de dper na/ 'jigs med grags pa zhes pa/'jigs grags zhes tshig sdud byas tshe/ med dang /dzi pa bsdus mod/ med kyi rjes 'jug gi da de rjes 'jug gi pho yin la/'jigs kyi yang 'jug gi sa yang pho yin gshis/ gnyis ka'i rtags mtha' sgra dang rtags mtshungs phyir/ med ces pa bsdus na'ang 'jigs zhes pa'i sgra mi 'gyur la/ de bzhin du grags la'ang pa bsdus pa'i dbang gis sgra mi 'gyur te/ grags kyi yang 'jug kyang rjes 'jug gi pho yin pa dang / pa ming gzhi'i pho yin pas/ rtags dang sgra mtshungs yin pa'i phyir/ pa la 'a rjes 216 ri

'jug thob mod/ drag dang phrad na drag par 'gyur gsungs pa ltar/ rang dbang gi nus pa med do/ /sbyor klog can gyi yi ge phal cher la/ tshig sdud kyi skad gdangs la bstun nas yi ge yang 'gyur ba yod snyam/ rgya'i skad la'ang tshig sdud sogs kyi dbang gis gdangs 'gyur ba yod srid/ 'on kyang yi ge la sbyor klog med pas/ 'di 'dra ba'i sgra sgrub kyi bya ba yod med cha ma 'tshal ces/ /da ni yi ge bcos bsgyur byed dgos zer ba'i gtam las 'phros te gleng bar bya ba ni/ spyir bod yig 'bri tshul 'di/ rgyal bo srong btsan gyi dus su dar ba yin te/ rgyal bo 'di'i mdzad pa'i gtso bo ni/ mtha' bzhi dbang du bsdus/ dam pa'i chos spel/ yi ge'i srol btod pa gsum yin/ zhes grags/ de yang spyi lo brgya phrag bdun pa'i smad tsam la slob dpon thon mis bod yig gi dbyangs gsal dang mgo 'dogs sngon rjes sogs kyi srol btod nas yi ge'i ma dpe lha sa'i rdo ring la btab ste bris pa la sbal nag na la bgrad 'dra/ zhes grags zer/ de'i rjes su mang srong mang btsan gyi dus su yig mkhan cha ngar rin chen 'bar zhes bya bas bris pa la so phag gshib 'dra/ zhes par grags/de'i rjes su 'dus srong mang rje'i dus su yig mkhan chab dkar 217

bam̐'u tshi zer bas bris pa la bya pho 'jol ba 'dra ba/ zhes par grags/ de rjes mes ag tshom gyi dus su yig mkhan dge bsnyen dkon mchog rīdabang zer bas bris pa la nas sngon phying dkar gyi steng du bkram pa 'dra ba/ zhes par grags/ de'i rjes su khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su yig mkhan bhe sho khram zer bas bsam yas kyi rdo ring la ma dpe bris par mu tig star la rgyus 'dra/zhes par grags/ de rjes mu ne btsan po'i dus su yig mkhan tshe spong byang chub zer bas bris pa la sbrur nag bgrad pa 'dra ba zhes par grags/ de rjes mu tig btsan po'i dus su yig mkhan 'bre ba yon tan zer bas bris pa la nya mo chu nang nas phyung ba 'dra ba/zhes par grags/ de rjes khri ral ba can gyi dus su yig mkhan mkhas pa gra shod rnam gnyis kyis bris pa la seng ge gnam du 'phyongs 'dra zhes par grags/ 'di dag ni rig gnas sogs snga dar gyi dus su byung ba yin/ de'i bar nas glang dar gyis rig gnas sogs bsnubs te thon mis gsungs pa'i brda sprod pa'i gzhung du ma rmeg med du gyur/ de rjes bod kha 'thor gyi skabs shig lo chen rin chen bzang bo sob/sa lo tsā ba mkhas pa mang bo byung ste/ rig gnas sna tshogs sgo kun nas dar bar byas pa la phyi dar gyi skabs zer/ phyi dar gyi skabs su yig mkhan 218

sgro gnya' khri zhe r+pās gra shod kyi rdo ring la gzhi byas te bar gsar zephreba'i yi ge bris/ de rjes yig mkhan shākya rdo rje/ de rjes khyung bo g.yu khri/ sna nam zhang btsun/ sum bha gnod sbyin sogs las yi ge'i 'bri rgyun dar zhing rgyas pa byung / khyad par du khyung lo g.yu khri la slob ma yig mkhan bzang ba bcu gnyis byung zhing /yang slob mkhas pa chen po rong bo sogs byon par grags/ de dag las dar ba'i yig gzugs kyi rdzab che chung la pa tra/ dung /nas 'dru gsum dang / 'bru che chung la'ang tshag r+sha zlum/ dpe bris gsum dang / yang li lugs/ ldan lugs/ 'bru tsha/'phrin yig sogs byung / da lta'i 'bri rgyun la/ yig dkar/ yig nag gnyis/yig nag la'ang 'don bris gru bzhi ma/ 'di la'ang yul so so'i bris rgyun mi 'dra ba legs shing bzang ba yod/ gzhan yang /sug ring / sug thung / tshugs bris/ rgyug bris/ 'bru tsha sogs yod/ 'di dag gi steng du lañca dang wartu bzhag pa'i bris rgyun cha tshang ba zhig da dung yang yod/ g.yu khri'i rdzab la thig khongs nas drangs te cha tshad bgos pa rags tsam ni/ de'i rin chen sgrom bu zhes bya ba'i gzhung las/ pyi ni mgo ring yin pa lar+sā/ /de yi phyed tshad mche ba gnyis/ /ṅkang ba mgo yi lha19

phyed dang gnyis/ /bar gnyis mnyam zhing dbucadakar rno/ /kha ni leb 'jog ka mnyam las/ /lag pa ka rkang gsum gnyis snyeg /dpung ba dkyil du phyung ba las/ /khog pa'i zags mchu mig dang mnyam/ /ga ni dum bu bdun pa ste/ /zheng ni gong ma gnyis dang mnyam/ /dpung ba dkyil ni sum char dbyung / /mgo zur mnyam zhing dkyil ba byal/ /nga mgo gong las tshag gang thung / /gsum po mnyam zhing rked pa drang / /mgo rgyas dpung thung thon par bya/ /zag mchu'i sna ni zag zur gtad/ /ca ni dum bu lnga ba ste/ /cha gsum drang la cha gnyis sgur/ /phyi ru brgyad la nang du zad/ /thig bzhi gru gsum zla tshes tshad/ /cha ni gru bzhi rlum po ste/ /thig lnga bsnol ba'i ling tshe bzhi/ /mgo 'og dkar gnyis mig dang mnyam/ /mgo zur dpung thig mig dkar mnyam/ /ja ni rked ring cha dang mnyam/ /rked pa'i zur dang mgo zur mnyam/ /dpung thung thon zhing rked ldem drang / /nag gsum mnyam nang dkar gsum mnyam/ /nya ni mgo 'bring stod phubs can/ /kha gang blang la cha gcig dgyel/ /dbus lag drang zhing dkar gnyis mnyam/ /gzhung thig tshang zhing phyi sgros mnyam/ /ta rked ldem drang dpung thung thon/ /ring thung zag mchu'i dkar dang mnyam/ /phyi sgros gzhung thig khong 'dren lhanyu0

skum/ /dpung gar phubs kyi gnag lam dkyil/ /sdi jig lnga btab cha bzhi ba/ /zur bzhi ma nyams g.yas phyogs drang / /thig lnga gzhol ba'i ling tshe bzhi/ /tha stod zur gsum gru bzhi ste/ /gzhung thig rked ldem nya mo khyur/ /da dpung dkyil nas sum cha phyung / /ring thung mgo dang mnyam pa ste/ /lag pa sum gnyis mgo zur mnan/ /gī mgo'i dkyil nas rked pa drang / /rked pa'i phyed tshad mig tu dril/ /mgo zur mig gi nang dkar rnan/ /lag pa da dpe 'dra ba yin/ /༷ ni mgo thung dpung ba can/ /dkyil 'dzin mgo zur dpung zur mnyam/ /sbo thag thung zhing chu 'babs drang / /dpung ba'i zur dang dkar rtse mnyam/ /pha ni mgo thung dpung thung can/ /rked pa drang zhing nang nas zad/ /sbo ni mgo bo'i sum gnyis drang / /'phred chod mgo yi dkyil du bzhag /ba dpung dkyil nas sum char dbyung / /phyi zur btul la rked gu no/ /zur gsum thon la ha gnyis brgyad/ /yar 'phul nang drang phyi sgros rgyas/ /ma ni mgo thung mig skum can/ /rked pa phyed tshad mig tu gril/ /zag mchu'i dkar snar tshag zur gtad/ /wa ni mgo 'bring mkhar log 'ong / /bad chung dag dang ldan pa ste/ /sbo thung chu 'babs drang ba la/ /sdem na bag gzhol drang la rgyas/ /221
