zhu ni phubs dang snag mchu mnyam/ /stod phubs nang dkar na dang mnyam// /rked pa'i drang 'then tshag gang ste/ /rked pa phyed tshad mig tu 'dril/ /za ni nag gsum dkar gnyis mnyam/ /rked pa drang zhing mthar rgyas gces/ /nag sna sbom phra rim gyis rlum/ /'phred 'dren 'og ma sba dang mnyam/ /'a mgo'i zur gseg kha phyed yin/ /stod phubs sgab med thig khar skum/ /phubs kyi phyed tshad pho ba yi/ /le gu'i zur dang tshag zur mnyam/ /ya ni phubs can mgo thung yin/ /gsum po mnyam zhing dbus lag drang / /phubs kyi dkar mnyam dbu sa dkar mnyam/ /leb 'jog la dang mnyam pa yin/ /ra ni dumaribu bzhi ba ste/ /bzhi bo mnyam zhing rked pa drang / /sum cha nas bzung dkyil du dbyung / /drang bor 'then la snga zur 'then/ /la ni phubs can mgo thung yin/ /thig lnga bsnol ba'i gru bzhi ba/ /pho ba drang zhing 'phred 'dren mnyen/ /g.yas phyogs drang zhing nang du rgyas/ /sha ni mig can mgo thung yin/ /le gu la yi 'phred 'dren yin/ /yang 'phul chung zhing mig sha skum/ /rkang ba phyi nang mi 'khyor drang / /sa ni thig lnga gru bzhi la/ /dkar gnyis mnyam zhing gru bzhi 'jog /le gu'i mnyen ni bsnol mtshams te/ /rgyab lag 'chos zhing dbus dkar 222

gtsang / /ha ni mgo 'bring smad bub can/ /dpung ba sa 'dra en tsam mtho/ /le gu mnyen la mgo dkyil bzhag /smad phubs skum la mgo dkyil bskyal/ /a ni mgo thung thu ba can/ /thu ba'i gsegs sbyor thum bar bya/ /'dzin po dang ni lhag po mnyam/ /mthu ba'i sgros dang dkar rtsa mnyam/ /tshag ni ma 'byar gong ma'i rtsar/ /zur gsum bra bo'i dbyibs su bzhig /shad ni rgya khab bslang ba 'dra/ /nag shad tshad ni snag lam shad/ /dkar shad tshad ni thig bar te/ /tshigartashad rnams la de phyed spang / /gi gu zlum thung 'gril la 'khyug /phyed dang gnyis chod mnyen la drang / /na ro ge ges pad+ma'i mdongs/ /gnyis chod 'dzum la mtho dman med/ /'greng bu nas 'phur babs kyis gzhol/ /thig chod kha phyed mtho ba yin/ /zhabasdu kyu zlum 'gril cu bag chags/ /gedan thabs mdung tshugs gdan la 'dril/ /ya sta 'khyug snyoms 'dogs mtshams gtsang / /'phyang ya dkyil ya 'phyang ma bskyil/ /rkyang ba'i ya sta 'phyang ya yin/ /gdag pa'i ya sta bskyil ya yin/ /'byung 'gyur 'dogs 'brel 'phyang ma bskyil/ /rkyang ba'i zhabs kyu mdung tshugs yin/ /gdag pa'i zhabs kyu gdan thabs yin/ /sum 'brel can rnams gdan la 'dril/ /zhis dang / gnon pa nyulha3

bcu dang gcespra pa brnyid/ 5 /ma chos nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /bu chos bcu drug spyi chos gsum/ /bzang ni mgo dang dpung la gnon/ /'dam dkar sna la'o sgros sbo ldem/ /grung zags mchu la'o g.yer yar 'phul/ /rlusdu ni phubs can hung mig 'khor/ /drang ni mar 'then sbyang khoswā par/ /mnyen bsnol 'tshams la'o 'khyug yan lag /snag lam skum la sgros chags gces/ /tshigs 'khor skyes la dpung thung gces/ /sngags pa can la zur thig gces/ /stod phubs can la pho ba gces/ /smad phubs can la khong 'dren gces/ /rkang ba rtar bzhon phyi 'brang gces/ yar 'phul mthar rgyas sgros gnon gces/ /mig cha can la sked gtsang gces/ /mgo rab thag thum gris bcad 'dra/ /mgo 'bring ka gzhu mtha' tshag mgo/ /dpung rab thugs kar rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpung 'bring skyes pa mda' 'phen 'dra/ /dpung tha lag chag 'phred la nyal/ /sdo rab sgros chags gri ltag 'dra/ /sbru thag grim 'bring grig rked tha/ /za ga mchu gsegs sbyor thung rno rab/ /phag dgye'o phag sna zag mchu 'bring / /dgur bo glang sna tha ma'o/ /rgya khab bslang 'dra rnga dbyug 'phyang / /lag mgo bcad 'dra'o yar 'atwen gsum/ /sgrog ཿ34

lcags rkang 'dra khyi gu'i mjug /'bu mjug sbrang rkang mar 'then gsum/ /mig rab nya mi3 'bring nas 'dra/ /zur gsum khro mig mig mtha'o/ /na ro'i chos gsum 'greng bu'i gnyis/ /gi gu'i gsum ste steng chos brgyad/ /zhabs kyu ya statwa chos gsum ste/ /ra sta'i gnyis so 'og chos brgyad/ /gzugs nyid dkyus su ma log dang / /dkyus nyid tshad las ma yal dang / /gzugs dkyus 'dres la shad phyed pa/ /bde bas 'byong ba'o chos bzhi bcu/ /'dogs dang cha'i bye brag ni/ /phubs dang dpung ba cha gcig dang / /zag mchu cha gnyis rkang cha gsum/ /'dogs 'brel cha ni bzhi ba ste/ /steng gi yan lag cha gnyis dang / /thig shing logs la cha drug yin/ /ring la thung btags rnga ma thung / /ring la thung btags ring dang mnyam/ /ring bo nang btags bod na med/ /ces sogs dang / yang / yig mgo bse ru 'dra gcig zer/ /sbrul sna gnyis ldan pa ṭa 'dra/ /yig kun thig sgrom gru bzhi ba/ /cha mang ngam nyung bgos nang 'bri'o/ /ring skyon can lnga thung skyon gsum/ /gnyis ka'i skyon can gsum 'dor dgos/ /rkang ba can kyi yi ge dgu/ /dpung shāng can gyi yi ge bzhi/ /zag mchu lha25

mig cha can lnga lnga/ /smad phug can gyi yi ge gsum/ /stod phug can drug shes 'bri'o/ /zhes dang /mgo bo gru bzhi sho bsgrig 'dra bcu gsum/ — /rked pa'i phyi nyag lha'i 'dzum mtshungs nyi shu/ /'bri gsham rlum po sgong 'dra bcu bdun dang / /lag 'dzag zla phyed 'dra ba'i yi ge lngi / /gsham gyi har 'dzum ral gri lta bu bcu/ /rked pa 'gyed mtshams rgya gram 'dra bcu gnyis/ /'bru gsham bra bo mtshungs pa'i yi ge brgyad/ /mig 'gril yongs 'bru lta bu'i bcu gcig yod/ /ces pa la sogs pa da dung zhib cing rgyas pa dang / thig khongs nas 'dren tshul sogs yod mod/ mdo tsam zhig rnamardzidapyod can dag la dpyod pa'i sgo tsam zhig bstan pa yin la/ deng dus 'ga' zhig sngon gyi rig gnas dag la rtog dpyod zhib phra byed pa lta ci/ mthong thos tsam yang med par thams cad rnying bzhi'i khungs yin pas gtor dgos so zer ba ni srog rlung g.yo ba'i zlos gar ro/ /bod yig gi srol btod pa nas bzung legs bcos byas pa de ltar yin mod/ 'on rkyeng / deb dkar las gsungs pa lhar/ brda dang yig gzugs la legs bcos byung ba las 'gyur ba ha cang chen po byung med de/ deb dkar du bkod pa'i gusta'i yig gzugs dang / sngon gyi rdo ring gi yi ge dang / yu gur lhalha6

sogs nas phyi mis rnyed pa'i bod yig sogs la bltas na shin tu gsal la/ mkhas pa rim byon gyis yi ge legs bcos byas pa'ang / deng dus 'ga' zhig gis/ bod yig bcos bsgyur byed do zer nas/ bod skad btsan bsgyur byas te/ deng rabs can gyi bod yig ces mgo skor gtong ba dang mi 'dra ste/ mkhas pa de dag gis yi ge legs bcos byas pa'i legs pa'i cha mig mthong lag zin du yod la/ khyed cag gis yi ge je legs la gto nga rgyu phar zad/ yig gzugs cha snyoms po zhig 'bri mi shes par/ nged cag gis yi ge bcos bsgyur byas so/ /gsar brje byas pa yin no/ /zer/ thon mis srol btod de yar rgyas byung ba'i bod yig sbyor klog gi nus pas/ bod rang gi skad la mi 'dang ba med/ bod rang gi yi ge'i sgo nas skad rigs gzhan 'bri ba la/ sdeb sbyor gyi nus pa snon dgos stabs/ legs sbyar bod yig tu 'bri lugs ni/ thon mi sogs lo paṇa rnams kyis bkod zin pa ltar yin la(sngags yig kyang zer) rgya skad dang sog skad dag kyang bod yig tu 'bri thabs sngon nas yod pa/ dper na/ h+pha/twen/ sh+ya/ shwad/ bzhwan/ tshwan/ khyo/ ṭi/ ten/ hwan sogs chos 'byung / deb ther/ sman yig sogs su shin tu mang 227

la/ de dag gi mthong thos tsam yang sdid par/ tshang ma deng dus gsar bzo yin snyam ste/ h+pha yi yi ge gsar du btod/ ces sogs zer ba ni rang rtogs mngon par zad de/ h+pha yig ni/lnga ba blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung dang / grub mtha' shel dkar me long / bstan 'gyur dkar chag nod bu'i 'phreng ba sogs su gsal lo/ /ma mthong phyir na med 'dzin pa/ /khron par zhen pa'i rkyal rtsal can/ /dgung sngon mtha' yis rgyus gtam gyis/ /dran pa stor ba'i byung ba yod/ /da lta'i brda sprod 'ga' la dpyad pa re zhig bshad zin to/ / zhar byung / rtsom lugs kyi rnam bzhag cung zad bshad pa/spyir rtsom zhes pa tshig gi brjod tshul —te/ de yang snyan zhi nga 'jebs pa'i gtam zhig dgos la/ de la snyan ngag zer/ de'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs ston pa'i gzhung la snyan ngag gi gzhung zer/ de'i rtsa ba lta bu grags che ba ni/ slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag me long le'u gsum pa can yin la/de gzhir bzung nas bod shin tu mang bos bod rang gi lugs bzhin brtsams pa'i gzhung dang dpe brjod sogs dar rgyas shin tu che/ de'i don bsdus na/ lus/ rgyan/ skyon selu dang 228

gsum du 'du/ dang bo ni/ srog lta bu brjod bya dang ldan pa'i lus lta bu'i rjod byed kyi tshig ste/ de la lhug pa dang / tshigs bcad/ bcad lhug spel ma gsum yod pa'i snga ma la bsdod pa dang / gtam gnyis yod/ gnyis pa lus de mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan la dpag tu med pa yod la/ me long gis dngos su bstan pa'i rgyan la/ shar lho thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan bcu dang / thun mong gi rgyan don rgyan so lnga dang / sgra rgyan so gnyis sogs yod/ gsumi pa skyon sel ba ni/ don nyams don 'gal don gcig pa/ /the tshom can dang rim pa nyams/ /sgra dam na gcod mtshams nyams pa dang / /sdeb sbyor nyams dpa mtshams sbyor bral/ /yul dus sgyu rtsal 'jig rten dang / /lung rigs dag dang 'gal ba ste/— /skyon bcu de dag snyan ngag la/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyis spang bar bya/ /zhes snyan ngag rtsom pa la skyon de bcu'i gang rung zhugs na r+shamadzes pas/ de gang dang yang mi ldan par byed dgos par bshad do/ /snyan ngag gi gzhung de dag dang mthun par brtsams pa'i tshig snyan zhing 'jebs pa dag la snyan ngag zer ro/ /snyan ngag gi 'grel ba dang dpe brjod rgyas pa gzhan zhig 'bri 'dun gyis/ 'dir rtsom tshul tsam zhig mdor bsdus pa'i tshul du 'god par bya'o/ / 229

blob dpon la bstod pa sogs/ slob dpon la bstod pa / bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyis thugs rgyud phyug/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpal gyi lus stobs rgyas// gzhan phan 'od zer stong gis sa gzhi khyab// 'gran bral slob dpon chesapo nyi na mo'i mgon// —'di'i tshig rkang dang bo rigs rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan yin la/ tshig rkang gnyis pa 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpal lam phun sum tshogs pa de lus stobs kyi gzugs su bkod pas/ gzugs can gyi rgyan yin zhing / tshig rkang gsum pas gzhan la phan gdags pa ni 'od zer stong gi gzugs su bkod pas gzugs can gyi rgyan dang / 'gran zla bral ba 'i slob dpon chen po de nyi ma'i gzugs su bkod pas gzugs can gyi rgyan yin/ nyin mo'i mgon ni nyi ma'i mngon brjod do/ /de tshig lhug tu byas na/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi rin thang gzhal med nor gyis thugs rgyud rab tu phyug cing / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpal gyi lus stobs bla lhag tu rgyas te/ skye bo gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer stong phrag 'bar bas sa chen khyab pa'i 'gran zla dang bral 230

ba'i slob dpon 'di ni nyin mo'i mgon po nyi ma lta bu'o// snaX ཿdze — grogs po la bstod pa/ tremi gshis rang bzhin smyug ma'i mda' bzhin drang // gsang bor smra zhing 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis bsu// tsho phyi thag ring zhing grogs byedatsho skyo ngal bral// dze dga' sdug bral ba'i grogs 'di dpag bsam shing // —'di'i rkang ba dang bos/ mi'i gshis ka drang ba smyug ma'i mda' dang dpe sbyar bas dpe rgyan yin la/ bzhin/ 'dra/ltar/ mtshungs sogs la mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra zer/rkang ba gnyis pa bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan yin/ rkang ba gsum pa ni rigs rang bzhin brjod pa dang / rkang ba bzhi bas grogs po 'di dpag bsam shing red do/ /zhes bshad pas gzugs can gyi rgyan yin no/ /dpag bsam shing ni/ sngon gyi gtam rgyun las/ lha'i ljon shing yal ga thams cad las dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du 'bab pa'i ljon shing rin po che zhig yod do zer/ de dngos don la yod med khas len min ji ltar yang snyan ngag gi dper bkod chog ste/ mkhasapas bshad na cir yang bden/ /snyan ngag mkhan la cir yang rgyan/ /rilha3 /

zir ba'ang de'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /snyan tshig de tshig lhug par brjod na/ mi gshis rang bzhin smyug ma'i mda' ltar drang la/gtam bden pa gsang bor smra zhing smra tshe 'dzum pa'i mad)ngas kyis bsubyubar byed la/ gsar 'grogs med par phyi thag ring zhing gzhan la grogs byed pa'i skyo ngal dang bral ba/ dga' sdug dang yang bral ba'i grogs po 'di ni/ yongs 'du dpag bsam gyi ljon pa'o// sa gzhi la bstod pa/ 4 mi nub brtan cing brling ba rin chen gru//rgyu dang mi rgyu'i rten byed pha dang ma// 'bru rigs 'bras bu'i dngos grub stsol ba'i lha//rin chen gter gyi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba//'di'i tshig rkang bzhi ka rgyu'i gzugs can/ de tshig lhug tu bkod na/ sa chen 'di ni brtan cing brling bas rin po che'i gru dang rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi rten byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis pha dang ma yin la/ 'bru rigs dang 'bras bu sna tshogs pa'i dngos grub ster bas lha dang / rin po che'i gter rdzas sna tshogs pa'i 'dod pa 'jo bas 'dod 'jo'i ba'o/ /rgyu lha33

ba ni 'gro thub pa'i sems can dang / mi rgyu ba ni ri dang ljon shing khang khyim sogs/ 'jig rten ni ri ra ba khang khyim sems can dad+ngha bcas pa'o// sa gzhi la bsdigs pa/ri bo 'ba' 'bur sdang mig drag pos lta// gcong rong shur mo'i khro gnyer kun nas bsdus//skabs 'gar khros pas yom yom g.yo zhing 'dar//sa chen khyod ni 'jigs rung gshin rje 'dra//'di'i rkang ba dang bo gsum ni gzugs can gyi rgyan rab btags dang 'dres pa yin la/ tha ma dpe rgyan yin no/ /de lhug par brjod na/ ri bo 'ba' 'bur gyi sdang mig gis lta zhing /gcong rong shur mo'i khro gnyer kun nas bsdus te skabs 'gar khros nas yom yom 'dar bar byed pa'i sa chen khyod ni 'jigs su rung ba'i gshin rje dang 'dra'o// ni nyi ma la bstod pa/ gser 'od spros pas smagachen dgra bo bcom// chu skyes dga' bas ge sar so phreng ngom//tā3 3

rtsi shing sna tshogs mgo bo btegs te lta// rta bdun dbang bo'i ngo mtshar e ma rmad// 'di'i rkang ba dang bos smag rum chen po dgra bo'i gzugs su bkod pa dang / gnyis pas ge sar so phreng gi gzugs su bkod pa dang rab btags dang 'dres/ rtsi shing sna tshogs rgyas pa ni rtsi shing sna tshogs kyis mgo bo btegs te lta bar byed ces rab btags kyi rgyan no/ /tshig lhug par byas na/ gser mdog can gyi 'od zer spros nas smag rum dgra bo bcom pas/chu skyes rnams dga' zhing bzhad de ge sar gyi so phreng ngom zhing /rtsi shing sna tshogs pa'i mgo bo yar btegs nas lta bar byed pa'i rta bdun dbang bo 'di ni e ma ho rmad du byung ngo // zla ba la bstod pa/zhergyu skar 'khor tshogs dbus na rab tu brjid//chu shel dkyil 'khor bzhin ras rab tu mdzes//'od dkar bdud rtsi'i zer brgya sbo ba des//skye dgu'i tsha ba'i gdungs pa lhag med 'joms//rkang ba dang bo rang bzhin dang / rkang ba dang bo gnyis tshig mnyam rab tu gnyis yod pas zung rgyan/ 'od dkar la 234

bdud rtsi'i 'od zer zhes tshig gi nyamasamibatod de/ bdud ces pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang / sdug bsngal dang / nad bla sogs par bya zhing / rtsi ni de'i gnyen po yin la tsha bas gdungs pa'i tshe na mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od zer shar ba'i tshe bsil ba'i snang ba 'byung stabs/ zla ba'i 'od zer la bdud rtsi zer zhing /snyan ngag mkhan dag gis/ nyi mas dus spro ba/ zla bas bdud rtsi spro ba zhes tshig gi rgyan du 'jog la/ da dung zla ba las ga bur gyi thigs pa 'dzags zhes rgyan byed/ ga bur ni sman ga bur dri bzang can de yin/ sman la'ang bdud rtsi zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / nad ni bdud dang sman ni de 'joms byed yin phyir/sman la bdud rtsi zhes bya'o// nam mkha' la bstod pha/in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs kyis lus mdzes shing //nyi zla nor bu'i rna cha res kyis 'dogs//rgyu skar nor bu'i do shal sku la brgyan//kun gsal sgeg mo 'di ni mdzes pa la//rkang ba dang bo rang bzhin dang / gnyis pa gsum pa gnyis kyis nyi zla gnyis nor bu'i rna cha ste rna rgyan gyi gzugs su 235

bskud la/ rgyu skar ni nor bu'i do shal gyi gzugs su bkod/'dogs pa dang sku la brgyan zhes rab btags 'dres so/ /de tshig lhug byas na/ in+d+ra rī la'i mdangs kyis lus rab tu mdzes shing / nyi zla nor bu'i rna cha dag ni res mos kyi tshul du 'dogs par byed la/ rgyu skar nor bu'i do shal gyis sku la brgyan pa'i kun gsal sgeg mo 'di e ma mdzes pa la/ kun gsal nam mkha'i ming dang / sgeg mo ni/ nga ni lang tsho dar la bab pa'i mdzes pa dang ldan no snyam pa'i khengs pa dang ldan pa'i bud med yin la/ nga ni gzugs lang tsho can no snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyi rnam 'gyur phyir thon pa'i nyams la sgeg nyams zer ro// 'brug sgra la bstod pa/chu 'dzin g.yo ba'i gling nas ldir ba'i sgra//rnam par rgyal ba'i rdza rnga brdung ba bzhin//rma bya dga' ba'i zlos gar bsgyur ba'i dpal//dpyid kyi dga' ston 'brug sgra snyan cing 'jebs//chu 'dzin ri sprin/ sngon dus g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dga' ston gyi tshe rdza rnga chen po zhig brdung / de'i sgra dang sbyar/rdza rnga'ang rdza ma'i rang bzhin gyi rnga zhig yin pa 'dra/ rma bya ni 236

'brug sgra la shin tu dga' zhing chags pas/ 'brug sgra grags tshe sgro gur 'phub/ 'brug sgra la brten nas mngal 'dzin par bshad pa sa/ 'brug sgra mngalka 'dzin yang zer ro tsho sprin la bstod pa/ — 'gro rnams tsha ba'i zer gyis gdungs pa'i tshe//sprin dkar yol ba 'di ni rab tu sman//sa yi rtsi bcud skom pas gdungs pa na//sprin dkar 'di yis sprang char dngos grub ster//'di tshig lhug tu byas na/ 'gro ba rnams tsha zer gyis gdungs pa'i tshe na/ sprin dkar gyi yol ba 'di ni rab tu sman zhing phan la/ sa'i rtsi bcud dag skom pas gdungs pa na sprin dkar 'dis sbrang char ste char bzang bo'i dngos grub ster bar byed do// sprin la smad pa/nyi mas zer brgya spro ba na//sprin nag yol bas nam mkha' 'gebs//khros pa'i ngar sgra sgrog bzhin du//23rte

gnam lcags thog dang ser zhags 'phen// tshig rkang gnyis pas sprin nag yol ba'i gzugs su bkod/sprin na ga gi yol ba zhis pa'i gi sgra 'brel sgra yin la de bsdus pas bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyi rgyan zer ro/ /khros pa'i ngar sgra sgrog ces rab btags dang / ser zhags 'phen zhes ser ba zhags pa'i gzugs su bkod de tshig gi nyams btod pa'o//'ja' la bstod pa/ mkha' dbyings dwangs mo'i nyi zer dang // sbrang char zim bu'i sil ma dag/ 'phrad pa'i rten 'brel dbang gzhu 'di//rkang gnyis dag gi yid du 'ong //'di ni rigs rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan yin/ tshig lhug byas na/ mkha' dbyings dwangs pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer dang /sbrang char zim bur 'bab pa 'phrad pa'i rten 'brel las byung ba'i dbang bo'i gzhu 'di ni rkang gnyis can rnams kyi yid du 'ong zhing mdzes so/ /dbang gzhu ni 'ja'i mngon brjod do//ri bo la bstod pa/238

rin chin rdul brtsegs lhun po mtho zhing brjid//dgun gsum kha ba'i gos dkar gyon pas mdzes//dbyar gsum rin chen g.yu yi mdangs gsar 'dzin//sa yi rgyan gcig ri bo zhes su grag sa// chu bo la bstod pa/chu phran sngon mo 'dus pa'i chab kyi rgyun//bab chags dal gyis 'bab pa'i chu bo che// skye dgu'i btung bar bdud rtsi'i mchod yon 'dra//skyel zhing 'dren la rta mchog sngon mo 'dra// 'di'i rkang ba phyi ma gnyis la 'dra zhes pa re re yod pa ni mtshungs pa gsal byed yin pas/ tshig rkang de gnyis dpe rgyan yin la/ de tshig lhug byas na/ chu phran sngon mo du ma 'dus pa'i chab kyi rgyun bab chags shing dal gyis 'bab pa'i chu bo chen po 'di ni/ tho skye dgu'i btung ba'i ched du bdud rtsi'i mchod yon bshams pa dang 'dra la/ skyel 'dren gyi ched du rta mchog sngon mo dang 'dra'o// chu bo la smad pa/239

skabs 'gar dal zhing in+d+ra ri la'i mdog/'a skabs 'gar khros nas kham nag mchong 'gros kyis//lo tog rtsi shing thams cad 'joms mkhan gyi//chu bo 'di ni gdug pa'i gshed ma 'dra// chu bo bcos pa la bstod pa/ cigashed ma 'dra ba'i chu bo gdug pa can//'phrul gyis phug pa'i ri yi sbubs su drangs//lcags dang rdo yi zam chen 'og tu drangs//gang 'dod kha lo bsgyur ba'i ngo mtshar rmad//gzhan yang don de tshig lhug gi sgo nas de las rgyas tsam brjod na/ gshed ma dang 'dra ba'i chu bo gdug pa can dag ni/rdo dang ar 'dam gyis brtsigs pa'i chu rags kyi yur bar drangs te gang 'dod du bzhur ba'i rang dbang phrogs pa dang / 'phrul 'khor gyis phug pa'i ri yi spubs su drangs shing / ra ba rab tu brtan pa'i chu mdzod nang du btson du bcug la/ lcags dang rdos bzos pa'i zam chen brtan cing che ba'i 'og tu mgo bo sgur nas zhi dul gyis 'gro ru 'jug pa'i byed las 'di ni ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung ba'o// 240

spang ljongs la bstod pa/g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal phyis 'dra la//rin chen phra tshom me tog bzhad// rdo sbra ma ra yis glu dbyangs len//bye ma leb kyis bro gar 'cham// tshig rkang dang bo ni dpe rgyan/ rkang ba gnyis pa gzugs can gyi rgyan/ gsum pa bzhi ba rab btags kyi rgyan dang 'dres so//phyugs rigs rgyas pa la bstod pa/spang ljongs g.yu/yi sa gzhi la/ /g.yang dkar lug sogs phyugs kyis gang //mar phyur bal sogs rin chen nor//gang 'dod stsol ba'i dge mtshan rgya sa //dkar chu rgyas pa la bstod pa/rab dkar 'o ma'i chu rgyun las//snying bo mar gyi nor bu byung // bdud rtsi'i zas la longs spyod pa'i//24glu

mi sir rnams gi ts+tsha zhing bajid//rkang ba dang bos 'o ma chu rgyun gyi gzugs su bkod la/ de yang 'o ma'i zhes rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra ma bsdus pas/ ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyi rgyan zer/ rkang ba gnyis pa dang gsum pa yang de dang 'dra ste/ rnam dbye drug pa ma bsduse shing mar nor bu'i gzugs su bkod la/ dkar zas ni lha'i bdud rtsi'i gzugs su bkod pa dang / rkang ba bzhi ba ni rigs rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan no/ / snye ciwa char la bstod pa/ nyi mas tsha zer ngom pa yis lo 'bras rtsi thog gdungs pa na //chu 'dzin phrag dog rab rgyas te// ri bdud rtsi sil ma'i char ba phab//rkang ba gsum pa ni rab btags so//lo tog la bstod pa/ chu lud 'dzoms pa'i sa zhing la//ri gro nas 'bras sogs snye ma rgyas// 24lha

'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i tshe// mi rnams dga' ba'i glu dbyangs snyan//gser gyi dpal la 'gran pa yi//'bru yi khur ldan snye ma dag/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i rirlabs shugs des// rgya mtsho'i rlabs la 'phya bar byed//sho lo ka dang bo rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan dang / sho lo ka gnyis pa'i rkang ba dang bo'i 'gran zhes pa mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra yin gshis dpe rgyan yin la/ de'i rkang ba bzhi ba'i 'phya bar byed ces pa'ang mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra yin stabs/ dpe rgyan yin no/ /tshigs bcad phyi ma de lhug par brjod na/ gser gyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i kha dog la 'gran bzod pa'i snye ma ser bo 'bru yi khur shin tu lci ba de dag tshung gis bskyod paṅge rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i shugs des rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba la 'phya bar byed do// zhing ba la bstod pa/ 8 zhing ba'i 'tsho ba dpyid kyi dpal la 'gran//zhing ba'i brtson sems dbyar gyi chu bo bzhin//243

zhing ba'i thon skyed yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel//zhing ba'i bang mdzod 'bru yis phyur bur gtams//'di'i rkang ba dang bo gsum ni dpe rgyan dang / bzhi ba rang bzhin gyi rgyan/ rkang ba bzhi ka'i thog mar zhing ba zhes pa'i tshig 'dra ba yod gshis/ sgra rgyano yin la/ de'i nang nas bar du chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan yin sdo// rig gnas rgyas pa la bstod pa/srid jus nyi ma gsar ba'i 'od snang gis//log spyod smag rum lhag med bcom dang lhan//tshan rig rig gnas chu skyes 'bum phrag gi/ / 'dzum zhal lhag lhag rgod pa'i dga' ston shar//rkang ba dang bo bsdus pa'i gzugs can dang / gnyis pa dang gsum pa yang bsdus pa'i gzugs can yin gshis bsdus pa'i gzugs can zer/ lag rtsal la bstod pa/rig gnas rin chen gser gyi lde mig gis//blo yi sgo mo 'bum phrag yongs phyes te//244

— thabs tshul lag rtsal nor bu 'bum phyung nas//'jig rten gsar bar bsgyur la cis mi bstod//de tshig thung bu byas na/ rig gnas gser gyi lde mig gis // / blo yi sgo mo 'bum phyes te// thabs tshul nor bu 'bum phyung nas//'jig rten gsar bar bsgyur la bstod//'phrul gyis bskyed pa'i glog la bstod snyepa/'di ni 'phrul gyis bskyed pa'i glog 'od yin//nyin mor rgyu ba'i nam mkha'i nor bu min// d+nghamatshan mor rgyu ba'i ri bong can yang min//sprin stug gseb nas 'khyug pa'i glog 'od min//nam mkha'i nor bu ni nyi ma dang / ri bong can ni zla ba'o/ /'di ni de nyid brjod pa'i dpe'o// glog sgron la bstod pa/ 'phrul gyis bskyed pa'i grog gi sgron me yis//yangs pa'i sa chen 'di ni khyab pa'i tshe//lha45

rang 'od spro ba'i nam mkha'i skar tshogs rnams//skyengs nas dgung sngon dbyings su yib grabs byed//'phrul glog gi 'od shin tu gsal ba'i tshe/ skar ma'i 'od kyang mi gsal ba lta bur gyur pa la bsam nas rapa btags kyi rgyan byas pa'o // glog 'phrin la bstod pa/mdzub rtse g.yo ba'i 'phrul 'khor gyis//ang yig 'phur ba'i bya ma rta//dmangs kyi re ba skong byed kyi//glog 'phrin 'di ni e ma mtshar//bya ma rta ni mngag gzhug pa'i ming yin la/ glog 'phrin gyi ang yig ni/ 'phur ba'i mngag gzhug pa'i gzugs su bkod pa'o// glog skad la bstod pa/spyi le 'bum phrag brgal ba'i yul dag tu// rno skud yod med rkyen la ma ltos par//gang 'dod gtam gyi sbyor ba skyel byed pa'i//246

glog skad 'di yi thabs 'phrul blo las 'gongs// tshig thung byas na/ spyi le 'bum phrag pha rol tu//rno skud rkyen la ma ltos par//gang 'dod gtam de skyel byed pa'i// glog skad 'di ni blo las 'gongs//blo las 'gongs pa ni/ blo yul las 'das pa'i don yin la/ 'dir blo la 'char dka' ba'i don la tshig gi nyams btod pas tshig rgyan du gyur pa'o// gzugs mthong glog 'phrul la bstod pa/ me long dwangs ma'i ngos la rang gzugs—bzhin//yul gyi bskal ba'i dngos po che phra dag/gsal bar mthong ba'i 'phrul gyi sgam chung 'di'i//ngo mtshar 'phrul 'di phal ba'i blo las 'das//yul gyi bskal ba ni/ yul shin tu thag ring ba'i don yin la/ dus shin tu thag ring ba la dus kyi bskal ba zer/ dngos po shin tu phra ba phal bas mthong ba dang shes mi thub pa dag la bskal don zer/ dper na tshad shin tu mtho ba'i phra mthong che 247

shil mid par mthong mihothub pa'i srin bu lta bu'o/ /me long gi rang gzugs 'char ba'i ca lag cig ste dngul dang li dad zangs dkar bo shel la sogs pas bzosapa/ — deng sang bcos ma'i shel gyis bzos pa'i me long la shel sgo dang ngo lta sogs ming 'dogs par byed/ me 'khor la bstod pa/ mdzes pa'i khang bzang du ma rab sbrel ba// me shugs gcig gis 'then pa bya ltar myur// yid la bsam pa'i gnas su bgrod byed pa'i//me 'khor 'di yis skye 'gro'i re ba bsgrub//'di ni bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan yin mod/ rkang ba gnyis pa'i bya ltar myur zhes pa dpe rgyan yin no/ /rlangs 'khor la bstod pa/thabs mkhas 'phrul gyis rlangs pa dag/ rab tu bkol ba'i nus shugs kyis//rta mchog stong gi 'gros bzang bzhin// ci le bar brgya phrag yud kyis bgrod// 248

mig rkang gsum pa ni dpe rgyan yin la gzhan rnams rarnga bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan yin/ ci gnam gru'am lcags bya zhes pa'i 'phrul 'phur la bstod pa/ gnam 'phang gcod pa'i 'phrul 'phur la//gnam gyi gru'am lcags bya zer// de lta'i sngon med khyung chen des// sgru dpag tshad 'bum phrag yud kyis bgrod//'bangs la 'tshe ba'i dgra bo la//gnam lcags thog gi dpari'e rtsal ngom//'grul bzhud mkhan dang mkho dngos dag/'dod pa'i gnas su yud kyis skyel// 'di'i tshigs bcad dang bo'i rkang ba gsum pas khyung chen gyi gzugs su bkod pas gzugs can dang / tshigs bcad gnyis pa'i rkang ba gnyis pa'i dpa' rtsal ngom/ zhes pa'i ngom de mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra yin pas dpe rgyan red snyam mo/ /'dir dpag tshad ces pa sogs zhar byung du bshad na/ mdzod las/ gzugs ming dus mtha' rdul yig dang / /skad cig phra rab rdul dang ni/ /rdul phran dang ni de bzhin du/ /lcags chu 249

ri bong lug dang glang / /nyi zer rdul dang sro ma dang / /de las byung dang de bzhin nas/ /sor tshigs zhes bya gong bdun bsgyur/ /sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru/ /khru bzhi la ni gzhu gang ngo / /de dag lnga brgya rnamyo/sa la ni/ /rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod/ /de brgyad dpag tshad ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzugs kyi chung mtha' la/ rdul phra rab bam phra rab rdul zer/ phra rab kyi rdul bdun gyi tshad la rdul phran gcig zer/ rdul phran bdun gyi tshad la lcags rdul zer/ lcags rdul bdun gyi tshad la chu rdul dang / chu rdul bdun gyi tshad la ri bong gi rdul dang / ri bong gi rdul bdun gyi tshad la lug rdul dang /lug rdul bdun gyi tshad la glang rdul dang / glang rdul bdun gyi tshad la nyi zer rdul dang / nyi zer rdul bdun gyi tshad la sro ma zer zhing / sro ma bdun gyi tshad la shig zer/ shig bdun gyi tshad la nas zer zhing / nas bdun gyi tshad la sor mo gang zer/sor mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi la khru gang zer/ khru bzhi la gzhu 'dom gang / gzhu 'dormā lnga brgya la rgyang grags gcig rgyang grags brgyad la dpag tshad gcig zer ro/ /ming gi chung mtha' ni yi ge gcig yin te/ yi ge gcig las nyung ba'i ming med pa'i phyir/ dus ni mdzod las/ skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la/ /de yi ཿ50

skad cig de dag kyang / /drug cu la ni thang cig go/ /yud tsam nyin zhag zla gsum ni/ /gong nas gong du sum cur 'gyur//zhag mi thub dang bcas pa yi/ /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ skyes bu stobs ldan zhig gis se gol gcig gtogs pa'i yun la cha drug cu rtsa lnga phyes pa'i cha gcig la thung mtha'i skad cig ma zer/ (cha sum brgya dang drug cu phyes pa zer ba'ang yod/ ) de lta bu'i thung mtha'i skad cig ma brgya dang nyi shu la/ de'i skad cig ma dang / (bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma'ang zer/ )de'i skad cig ma drug cu la thang cig thang cig sum cu la yud tsam dang / yud tsam sum cu la nyin zhag gciganyin zhag sum cu ni/ nyin zhag gi dbang du byas pa'i zla ba yin no/ /'on kyang snyan ngag sogs kyi skabs su mgyogs pa la skad cig thang cig sogs dang / mang ba la khri 'bum bye ba sogs dang / rgyang ring ba la dpag tshad sogs tshig gi rgyan du sbyor ba la grangs sogs ji bzhin yod dgos pa'i nges pa med do/ /'drud 'then 'phrul 'khor la bstod pa/lcags khrab 'khor lo 'di yi stobs shugs ni//rta mchog stong gi stobs las drangs mtshungs la//251

ldir ba'i sgra dbyangs dal gyis dgod pa 'di//rnga gsang ldir ba'i sgra las blangs pa bzhin//'di ni dpe rgyan gyi nang gi rnam 'gyur gyi dpe zhes pa yin/ rnga gsang ni 'brug sgra'i mngon brjod/ 'phrul chas can la bstod pa/ srid pa'i khams na bzo las mang mod kyang //'phrul chas can la 'gran nus gang zhig yod//mkha' la rang 'od spro ba mang na yang // rta bdun dbang bo 'dra ba 'ga' yang med// 'di ni dpe rgyan gyi nang gi zla bo dngos po'i dpe yin/ rta bdun dbang bo ni nyi ma'i mngon brjod do/ /dmadzongs kyi stobs shugs la bstod pa/dgung sngon dbyings kyi pha mtha' gzhal mi nus// rgya mtsho chen po'i chu la zad mtha' med//de dag nyid dang dmangs kyi stobs shugs ni//rnam pa kun tu mtshungs so grogs po dag/'di dpe rgyan gyi nang nas bsngags pa'i dpe'o//252

rgya mtsho la bstod pa/ nam mkha'i nor bus tsha zer spro che bas//gnam sngon ltem gyis zhu nas 'khyil 'dra ba//an da snyil gyi mdangs 'dzin rgya mtsho che//gting dpag dka' zhing phyogs cha gzhal du med//'di dpe rgyan yin no// — cho gangs ri la bstod pa/ — lha ske 'bum gyis brtsigs pa yi// mchod rten bzhin du brjid kyang mtho//'jig rten kun gyi dkar mdangs bcud//bsdus pa ji bzhin dkar zhing 'tsher//dpe rgyan no// spang ri la bstod pa/ mar gad khu bas lus la byug/chu skyes sna tshogs rgyan du gsol//sprin dkar nor bu gtsug tu bcing sa// 253

spang ljongs dbas kyi lhun po brjid//༄ gzugs can gyi rgyan no// srid jus la bstod pa/srid jus nyi ma gsar ba'i 'od snang gis//log spyod smag rum bsal dang chabs cig tu//bde skyid pad mo'i 'dab brgya kun nas bzhad//bstod bsngags sbra ma ra yi glu dbyangs snyan//bsdus pa'i gzugs can no//'di yang srid jus la bstod pa/srid jus log par spyod pas mnar ba'i tshe/srid jus gsar bas rtse dga' ngom gyur pas//bde skyid gsar bas kun gyi yid tshim nas//dga' zhing spro ba'i rnam 'gyur cir yang ngom//'di ni sgeg pa'i nyams zhes bya ba'i rgyan no//thabs rtsal la bstod pa/sa la dpung gi 'jigs zil ma ngom zhing //254

konam nas 'phrul 'phur bya yis ma bskor la//tha na me mda' gcig kyang ma 'phangs par//dgra bo mi bzhi dpung bcas rdul du brlags//'di ni dpa' ba'i nyams zhis bya ba'i rgyan no//skra yi lan bu se cho 'thor zhing gnar//mig gnyis mig skyag gis g.yogs mig chu bzhur//mya ngan gdong gi kha nas sme sngags 'don// rus dkar bdud mo'i snang tshul 'di la ltos// 'di ni mi sdug pa'i nyams zhes bya ba'i rgyan no//dmag la bsngags pa/lcags khrab 'khor lo'i me skyogs nags bzhin 'khrigs//mtshon cha drag po'i rlangs 'khor sa gzhir khyab//me mda' can gyi dmag ni rtsi thing bzhin// dgra bos mthong tshe snying rtsa dum bur 'chad//'di ni 'jigs rung gi nyams zhes bya ba'i rgyan no//bzo rig pa la bsngags pa/lcags shing rdo sogs srid pa'i dngos po dag/ 355

ngo mtshar thabs kyis bsgyur ba'i rig pa 'dis//'gro ba dbul ba'i gdung ba sel byed cing //bde skyid 'tsho ba'i dpal la spyod par byed//'di ni bya ba rang bzhin rbarjod pa'i rgyan no// gso ba rig pa la bsngags pa/ gso rig ring lugs dar zhing rgyas//rgyud pa so so'i 'tsho byed kyi//sman dpyad ral gri ches rno bas//nad rims bdud kyi sked pa bcad//bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ de tshig lhug tu bkod na/gso rig sman gyi rang lugs 'di ni dar zhing rgyas te/ rgyud pa so so nub rgyud krung rgyud bod rgyud kyi 'tsho byed sman pa dag gi sman dpyad kyi ral gri de ches rno ngar dang ldan pas/ nad rims bdud kyi sked pa dusda bur bcad do//sgra rig pa la bsngags pa/gsal byed phung bor rjes 'jug dbugs thogs shing //'phul dang mgo 'dogs gos kyis legs par bklubs//ཿ56

dbyangs kyi zhwa lham mdzes pa'i gzhon nu des//srid pa'i dngos po thams cad ston par byed//'di ni gzugs can gyi rgyan yin la/ de tshig lhug par bkod na/ gsal byed sum cu'i gzugs phung dar la babs pa la/ rjes 'jug gi dbugs zhugs shing 'phul te sngon 'jug dang mgo 'dogs kyi gos bzang mdzes pas legs par bklubs la/ dbyangs bzhi'i zhwa lham rab tu mdzes pa'i sgra rig gzhon nu des/ srid pa'i dngos po mtha' dag ston par byed do//gtan tshigs rig pa la bsngags pa/lung rigs sprin stug rngam zhing brjid//sbyor ngag 'brug gi sgra brgya rgod//thal 'gyur thog ser drag 'khrug 'dis//rgol ngan mtha' dag rdul du rlog/tshusmyor gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs kyi//'od zer brgya stong spros pa na//brtan dang g.yo ba'i shes bya yi//rang bzhin gshis lugs lhang nger gsal//'di'i tshigs bcad dang bo gzugs can dang 'dres pa'i lha57

drag shul gyi rgyan yin zlo/ phyi ma ni shes byed kyi rgyu'i rgyan no//snyan ngag la bstod pa/brjod don dar la babs pa'i mdzes ma'i lus//sgra don sna tshogs rgyan gyi dar gos dang //rin chen rgyan gyis spras pa'i mdza' na mos//shes rig chags ldan 'di yi yid dbang 'phrog/rtsis kyi sa ris la bstod pa/mthong med yid kyi khye'u rtsal ldan des//lag pa'i ljon shing rab tu bskul ba na//sor mo'i yal 'dab g.yo ba'i ang yig des//srid pa'i dngos po mtha' dag grangs kyis gzhal//skar rtsis la bsngags pa/gza' skar 'khor ba'i tshul la phra zhib kyis// brtsi ba'i ngo mtshar rig pa'i mthu 'di yis// / 'ongs gnam gshis 'gyur ldog zla nyi sogs//sgrib dang 'byung ba'i phan gnod cir yang shes//258

blos gar la bstod pa /gna' bo'i byung ba mtshar ba'i gtam de dag/bskyar zlos gar gyi nyams dang gtam brjod nyams//brjid cing mdzis la yid du 'ong ba yis /mthong thos can gyi skye bo'i yid dbang 'gug/sdeb sbyor la bstod pa/tshig gi gcod mtshams mdzes shing lci yang mnyam//rjod bde ngal gso'i tshig dang 'gyur khug ldan//bskyar zlos med kyang snyan ngag nyams ldan pa'i//tshig gi sbyor ba 'di ni yi gar 'ong //mngon brjod la bsngags pa/dngos po'i ming gi rnam grangs brgya stong phrag/tshig gi nyams la gang 'asrod sbyar ba dang //gsang dang ku re'i gtam gyi sbyor ba dang //tshig gi ring thung snyoms la'ang med mi rung //rang bzhin brjod pa/259

dpyid dus la bsngags pa/ri bos g.yu gos gyon pas sngo// sngo ljang spang la chu skyes bkra// — bkra shisarage mtshan rgyas pa'i dus // dus bzhi'i dang bo dpyid dus skyid// ci mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan/ — riri dbyar dus la bsngags pa/ rkang 'thung g.yu lo rgyas pas sngo ljang ljang // 'dam skyes sna tshogs bzhad pas khra lam lam //khu byug mgrin rnga brdung ba'i sgra lhang lhang //lo legs snye ma 'i mgo bo 'dar shig shig/sgra rgyan bzhi ka'i mtha' chod cing ma chod pa'i zung rgyan no// ston dus la bsngags pa/rab rgyas shing 'bras g.yur du za//za 'bru smin pa'i snye ma ser//ser mdangs rgyas pa'i zhing kha mdzes //260

mdzis pa'i ston dus snang ba skyid// rīsgra rgyan thog mtha' sbyar ba'i zung ldan no// dgun dug la bsngags pa/ rab tu brjid pa'i sa 'dzin gyis// — rab mdzes kha ba'i gos dkar gyon//rab med chu bo mtha' dag la// rab tu sra ba'i dar zam chags//sgra rgyan bzhi ka'i thog ma la yod pa'i zung ldane gyi rgyan no//'dir smras pa/ rnam dpyod chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i ba gam las//snyan tshig dbyar gyi rnga gsang dal gyis dgod//blo gsal mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i sgro gur phub//rig gnas gon tan mngal gyis lci bar 'gyur//'bad brtson drod gsher 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel las//blo gros dpag bsam ljon pa'i kho lag rgyas//sgra dang snyan ngag 'bras bu g.yur du za// gzhan phan bsil grib skye 'gro yongs la sman//'og 'gyu g.yo ba'i rlung shugs kyis// 261

lag pa'i yal ga rab bskul tesmo sug pas ri mor phab pa 'di//phan 'dod bsam pas spel ba lags//rig gnas mdzod la mnga' bsgyur ba'i//mkhas dbang dag la mkho min yang //rig pa gsar slob gzhon nu 'gar//phan pa cung zad 'byung snyam mo// brjod bya'i srog dang ldan na yang //'phrad dang sdeb spyor nyams gyur na// yan lag rengs pa'i skyes bu bzhin //snyan pa'i tshig gis ma brgyan na//dar la bab pa'i mdzes ma de//gos bral glen mor rgyu ba bzhin// des na sdeb sbyor snyan ngag dang //mngon brjod sogs la sbyang ba gces//zhes pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//glu tshig dang / mgur dzig rtsom tshul cung zad brjod pa/dang po glu dzig gi dbe/dgung a sngon dbyings kyi g.yu 'brug gi// 262

sgra snyan pos sa gzhi yongs la khyab// yul rnam rgyal khang bzang rgyal bo de'i//mtshan snyan grags 'dzam gling yongs la rgyas//'od che ba'i nam mkha'i nyi ma la//kho me tog nyi dga' 'khor ba bzhin//sa chen por gnas pa'i skye dgu rnams//yul byang sems can la lhag ger 'khor//dri bzang bo can gyi me tog la//gser mdog can sprang ma 'khor ba bzhin//dmangs yongs la phan pa'i srid jus la//sa chen po'i mi dmangs yongs su 'khor//'di ni bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan yin no//sa chen po krung go'i sa gzhi la// deng bde zhing skyid pa'i nyi ma shar//zhing grong gi zhing la lo tog legs//grong khyer gyi grong la bzo las dar//dpal 'byor ba dbyar gyi chu gter 'dra//bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba mtsho ltar rgyas//mi spun gyi bzhin la 'dzum mdangs shar//lha63

mi kun gyis dga' ba'i glu dbyangs len//a la la 'di 'dra'i skyid pa la// a ho la dga' ba'i bro zhig rdung // 'di rgyan 'dres ma'o// / ri mthon po'i sgang nas rgyang glu len//yar 'brog pa'i thang la rgyang lta byed//nor rta lug mang bos spang ljongs khyab//glu snyan po rgyang glu'i sgra lhang lhang //ri mthon po'i sgang nas rgyang glu len//mar rong ba'i zhing la rgyang lta byed//'bru snye ma'i snye zhag rba rlabs 'dra// glu snyan po rgyang glu'i sgra lhang lhang //ri mthon po'i sgang nas rgyang glu len//phar bzo las grong la rgyang lta byed//'phrul sna tshogs 'khor lo'i sgra skad ldir//glu snyan po rgyang glu'i sgra lhang lhang // 'di ni kun tu zung ldan gyi rgyan no// gangs dkar bo'i rtse la nyi 'od phog/shel dkar bo'i mchod rten lta bur mdzes//lha64

spang sngo ljang thang la nyi 'od phog/g.yu rin chen maṇ+ḍal lta bur mdzes// —mtsho chestopo'i gzhung la nyi 'od phog/ nor baiḍūr sa gzhi lta bur mdzes//bod gangs can yul la nyi— 'od phog/dam ngas bde skyid dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyas/'di ni dpe rgyan mtshungs sbyor sgra rgyan sogs bsres ma'o//yul rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang na//yang dag pa'i gtso 'dzin lham mer bzhugs//yul chen po gser ldan mdzes ma'i ltor// las thon skyed don la 'gran sdur byed//'bangs dpal 'byor 'tsho ba yar la rgyas//dmangs kun gyi bzhin ras 'dzum shig shig//dmangs tshang ma'i sems pa dga' lhang lhang //srid jus la bstod sgrartsodi ri ri//deng skyid pa'i gtam gleng 'u ru ru//'di yang rgyan 'dres ma'o// shar gser gyi nyi ma'i 'od zer de//kho 'dzam gling yongs la drin du che//365

dpon bzang bo'i gsung gi 'od zer de//nged mi rigs kun la drin du che//bdud gnod bzhi brlags pa'i sku drin la// 'bangs yongs kyispobastod glu rgyun mi 'chad //tang krung dbyang deng sang ri rgyal bzhin// —tang krung dbyang deng sang brtan zhing brjid//'di yang rgyan 'dres ma'o//rnga 'dra ba'i g.yu yi thang gzhung la//phra 'dra ba'i grong rdal khra lam mer//stag 'dra ba'i mi ser mi dmangs tshos//gser 'dra ba'i gro nas rnga bsdu byed//blo gsal ba'i bod rigs slob ma tshos cibod yig la spyang ba'i brtson 'grus rtsom//mgo khrid dang slob dpon slob ma bcas//mthun sgril gyi dga' sbos lhag lhag dgod//rgyan 'dres ma'o// tang krung dbyang gi mi rigs srid jus de//nged mi rigs kun dga' ba'i rgyu rkyen red//da rang skad dang rang yig spyod pa la//'i66

da rang dbang de yod snyam spro dga' rgyas//da mi rigs kyi mthun sgril lhag par bzang //da spro dga'i ngang zhing 'brog thon skyed byed//da bde skyid ngang rig pa'i gnas la slob//da deng rabs can bzhi bo mngon 'gyur byed//rigs rang bzhin dang bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'o//lho sprin gyi rgyu ba la ma ling // sprang char gyi zil ba za ma zi /spang me tog mgo lcog lda ma ldem//sbrang rkang drug glu dbyangs da ra dir//dus dbyar gyi dge mtshan rgyas pa la// mi kun gyis dga' bas bro gar 'cham/ /deng rgyal 'bangs dpal 'byor rgyas pa la//mi kun gyis dga' bas glu dbyangs len//tshigs bcad snga ma ni sgra rgyan dang phyi ma rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan no// 4dpon bzang bo'i srid jus nyi ma'i 'og/krung go yi dga' tshal rgyas na yang //'dre mi bzhi yi 'khun sgra di ri ri//267

sprin oṃge po'i dud pre gyi li li// 'dre bya yi tshogs rnams cag dir dir/ /krung go yi phun tshogs nya la la// dpon bzang bo'i gtsor byas mi dmadz+was kyis// thabs zab mos dgra bo thal bar brlags// bdud mo yi mig chu tha ra ra// —khyi gdong can ngu zug kung kis kis// rig skran gyi skrang ba 'bu ru ru// gsar byung gi 'byor ldan ngu dir dir//mi dmangs kyi mgo bo zeng se zeng /dga' spro yi glu sgra lhang se lhang //'bru rigs kyi phung bo bong se bong /dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho ba phyur se phyur//dga' spro yi bro rdung chem se chem / rig gnas kyi me tog ldem se ldem//a la la 'di 'dra'i skyid pa la//a ho la dga' ba'i glu zhig len// 'di ni sgra rgyan gtso bor gyur pa'o// 'go khrid kyi nus pa ches che bas//ki 68

mi dmangs kyi bde 'jags mthun sgril byung ///'thab jus kyi nyi ma 'od che ba sa//mi dmangs kyi dgra ribo rab tu sreg/ tshan rig gi nyi ma 'od che bas// lag rtsal gyi pad ma rab tu bzhad//'phrul 'khor gyi nor bu mthu che bas// dpal 'byor gyi dgos 'dod char bzhin 'beb//mi dmangs kyi stobs shugs ches che bas//stobs ldan gyi rgyal khab 'dzugs skrun byed//deng rabs kyi rgyal khab stobs ldan 'di//shar ya gling gi dbus na brjid kyang bajid//'di ni yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa dang gzugs can gyi rgyan sgra rgyan sogs bsres pa'o// mthongs nam mkha'i nor bu 'od po che//nged pad mo'i tshogs rnams bzhad pa'i gnyen//khong rgyu skar mgon po 'od dkar can// nged ku mud tsho gas rnams bzhad pa'i gnyen// cikhong dbyar skyes rnga gsang ldir sgra can// nged mdongs mtha'i tshogasarams dga' ba'i gnyen//269

dpon bzang bo'i mi rigs srid jus de//nged mi rigs tshogs rnams dga' ba'i gnyen//'di bskor ba'i rgyan no//shing g.yu lo rgyas pa'i sdong rtse nas//bya ko ki la yi skad lhang lhang // kho dpyid kyi dpal yon rgyas pa'i rtags//mkhar gser gyi 'od can pho brang nas//dpon bzang bo'i gsung gi sgra lhang lhang //rgyal khab kyi dpal yon rgyas pa'i rtags//mtha' mtshams kyi gangs ri spang ljongs nas//mi rigs kyi glu gar sgra lhang lhang // mi rigs kyi mthun sgril che ba'i rtags// 'di'ang bskor ba'i rgyan no//gnyis pa mgur tshig gi dpe/thog mar ka mad sum cu dang sbyar ba'i dpe 'god par bya ste/ tshig bcu gcig pa tshig dgu ba la ngal gsos pa/ rgan po'i gang shar mgur dbyangs zhes bya ba/ka ma la ltar dkar ba'i lhag bsam sdi ngang nas//370

kha ba ri ba'i ljongs kyi yi ge dang brda sprod// ga bur dri ngad 'thul ba'i spadza ljongs sdi grong 'dir//nga yis ngag bshad brda bkrol byed dgos shig byung song //ca ril bzhin du gum nas sdod pa deg mi 'ong /cha lugs gang ltar yul dus mthun pa zhis byas te//ja chang 'thung nas sos dal sdod pa zhig min par//nya mo chu nang 'khyug 'dra'i bsam blo re btang nas//ta la'i 'dab ltar rgyas pa'i sems hūṃ spyig bskyed de// tha mal nga 'dras 'bangs don sgrub dgos shi3 byung na//da nas hur brtson hur thag rbad thag sdig los byed//na rgas lus sems gdung ba bcos med ci3 med na//pa ba sangs ltar dkar ba'i lhag bsam zhig los bskyed//pha rol gzhan don byed pa'i skyo ngal rdu spajes nas//ba rgya can gyis ba thag 'dren pa yi dpe ltar//ma lus nus pa yod rgu gzhan don sto phul na//tsa tur deng rabs can la lag rjes twe los zhog/tsha grang khyad du gsod pa'i dka' spyad re med na//dza lung nyul yang don gnyis 'grub pa t+t+waṃg dka' 'o//wa mo zas la sred bzhin rang don zhig bsam nas//3lhalha

zha 'thing yin yang gang sar 'gro bzhud kyis brel na//bra ma lto gos 'dzom pa'i rang skyid kyāng 'aspob dka'//'a 'ur don med gang sar 'khyam skyod sdi ngang nas//ya so ldan pa'i phyugs kyi rnam thar de bskyangs na//rwa co ldan pa'i kog 'gro'i spun zla ste 'gyur ro// la lung brgal yang spyi don kho na lta bsams na//sha khrag gdos bcas lus 'di don ldan zhig red do//sa chen krung gor skyes pa'i dgos pa zhig rmogrub bo//ha ha don med yid la gang shar gyi mgur 'di//a la don med mi rgan mgo se rduzlo smras so//ka mad sum cu la dbyangs e spyar ba'i mgur ma'i dpe/rgan po snang ba skyid pa'i mgur glu —zhes bya ba/ ke la sha yis bskor ba'i yul// khe tshong byed pa'i don min par// ge sar gna' dus rgyu ba'i sar//nge rang da lo yong dgos byung //ce spyang zas 'tshol ltar min par//che chung 'ga' la brda sprod slob//je bzang 'gro ba'i slob ma la// 272

nyi du lta bu'i bsam pa 'ardzon// te sogs lhag bcas tsam min par//the tshom med par tshang ma slob//de ltar slob tshe dge slob kun/ / ne gsing spang ljongs 'di ru skyid// pe har mi 'dra'i dpon chen la// rte phe ro min par snying nas gus// be lug rtse ba'i sa cha 'dir//me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i dbus// tse le tso le 'khyam min par// tshe mjug 'di ru spyi don byed//dze ra'i skad kyis bka' mi bkyon//we zhes 'bod pa'i skad mi rgyag/zhe sa mgo slob kun la byed// ze ba yar 'then nus med kyang //'e phan bsam pa kun la 'dzin// ye re yo re'i lus lci yang // re thag da dung chad pa med// —le lo g.yeng ba'i skyon spangs nas// ཿ73

shi 'u rgyug 'dur bzhin du 'bad //se 'bru rgyas pa'i ljon pa bzhin// he he rang sems dga' ba rgyas//e ma 'di 'dra'i skyid pa la// mgur tshig dgu ba/ tshig bdun pa la ngal gso thob pa'i dpe/ gang dran thol byung gi mgur glu zhes bya ba/rgya zheng che ba'i rgyal khab kyiX sa 'di//mi rigs sna tshogs 'dus sdod sdi sa cha/ /rig gnas sna tshogs dar ba yi yul gru//gshis rgyud bzang zhing thon skyed lha dga' ba'i//mi rigs tshang mas mthun sgril gi ngang nas//dmangs kyi dgra bo'i bar chad kyān gtor te//'bad brtson byed pa'i ngang tshul ༷ ltos dang //rang sems dga' ba'i mgrin glu zhig los len//mi bzhi'i dpung gi spyo spyod sdi dus su//rig gnas slob pa'i rang dbang niX med la//thon skyed byed pa'i rang dbang yad med do//mi yi bsam blo rnyog 'dzing du gyur nas//rang sems skyid pa'i go skarbos rad med do//274

mkhas mdzangs ldam pa'i gtso 'dzin de'i nus pas//bdud bzhi dpung bcas thal ba dz+wa brlags pas//gnam gyi sprin nag gtor ba dad lhaskacig/nyi ma'i 'od kyis sa steng kun khyab bzhin//srid jus gsar ba'i magles zhal de mthong song /da ni kun gyi blo bde yiX ngang nas//༷ bdud nag bzhi yi dug rgyun la 'thab cing //rang re'i rgyal khab stobs ldanaX zhig byed do//rang res nus pa ci yod twe phul rnos// deng rabs can bzhi mngon gyur ༷ 'bad rdo// mgur tshig drug ma ngal gso med pa'i dpe/ skad yig la rang dbang thob pa'i mgur dbyangs zhes bya ba/ gangs can bod kyi yi ge/ dbyangs bzhi gsal byed sum cus//brda don ma lus gsalabs//thon mi bka' drin che'o//sdeb sbyor snyan ngag skar rtsis// gso rig zlos gar mngon brjod//srid srung rig pa'i gzhung lugs//275

— kun gyi gzhi ma yi ge/ snye slob sbyong rdo rus thug na//mkhas par mi 'gyur mi srid/ / rnam dbye tshig phrad sbyor tshul// — 'phul dang mtha' rten thob tshul// bdag gzhan dus gsum sogs kyi//brjod bya ston pa'i nus pa// rtags mtshungs sgra mtshungs 'dren tshul//kun la sbyang ba gces so// gnas dang byed pa rtsol ba//shes na bod skad rang yin//mi bzhi'i 'dre lag rkyong dus// rībod la dma' 'bebs tshig ngan//bod kyi skad dang brda sprod//kun kyang rnying bzhi'i khongs bzhag/bod skad mi chos bzhin du//bod skad gang 'dod bsgyur to// blo gros ldan pa'i dpon dang //snying stobs ldan pa'i dpung gis// 276

bdud nag thal bar brlags nas//skad yig rang dbang thob song blo ldan dga' drin che'o// sde gzhung dga' drin che'o// ka mad sum cu la dbyangs o sbyar ba'i mgur/ tshig dgu ba tshig bdun pa la ngal gso thob pa'i dpe/ rgan po'i spro glu zhes bya ba/ ko ki la yi glu dbyangs kyi sgra de// kho lag rgyas pa'i ljon shiXng gi rtse nas// go thos can la bsgrags pa bla tshul 'di//ngo mtshar che ba'i sgra skad cirge red do// co ka'i skad ltar cag dir ༷zhig min par// cho lo can gyi dbyangs mkharno gyi ngag bzhin//jo lags bstod pa'i snyan tshigaX gi glu 'di//nyo tshong byed pa'i bsam pa yis blan no// to la dngul sogs thob 'dz+wad gi bsam pas//tho co rtsom pa'i ngang tshul dang mi mtshungs//do mo can gyi rtsom pa zhig ṣ+pen no// no yon mi 'dod 'bangarmo don zhisha bsgrubs na//— 377

po ti brgya phrag nang don yang de yin//pho rgod skyes pa'i rnam thar ༷kyang de yin//bo bongs che ba'i shom can yaje de yin //mo la bu skyes dgos pa rding deX yin/ / tso tsi bzhin du dmar ba yi sems de//tsho ba'i sha la sred pa tsūrme min no//dzo ki bzhin du dma' sems de bzung nas//wo re wal le spyi don zhig bsgrubs na//zho shas 'tsho ba kho na rnong min no//zo mdog bzang ba'i rtsos skabs kyi ring la//'o skol mnyam du slob sbyong re byedaX do//yo lang don med mi tshe de bskyil na//ro zan bya yi spyod tshul di5 ci khyad//lo nar son tshe spyi don swā rem na//sho rgyal skug pa'i lad po dang mi mtshungs//so rnying rig pa'i nor mchor+ghaṃ gis tshim nas//ho ya zer ba'i dga' glu zhig blanges te//o ha skyid pa'i rkang bro zhigaX rdung ngo //mgur ma tshig lnga ba can gyi daspo/ dpon slob skyid glu zhes 378

pya ba/'e cag skyid pa'i glu// deng skabs dga' bas len//bod kyi brda sprod gzhung //tsho go ba rags tsam chags//rjes sor tshe mjug bar// rig gnas 'bad pas sbyang // gsar brje'i spyi don sgrub//dmangs kyi zhabs 'degs byed//zhing las dbyar masma ltar// bzo las yar zla bzhin//'tsho ba'i chu gter rdol// bde skyid nyi ma shar //rig gnas me tog bkra//phan pa'i dri bsung 'thul// snyan ngag phang 'gro'i sgra//rna ba'i dpyid du shar//glu tshig rgyud mang sgra//dmangs kyi rna bar 'jebs lha7smo

mig stor bde ba'i rtsom//ka la ping ka'i dbyangs// kun gyi rna bar snyan// kun gyis dga' —bsu byed//'khrul med rig gzheng la// mo slob pa'i go skabs thob// slob dpon slob ma rnams// dga' spro dpag med rgyas//spel 'dod slob 'dod kyi//bsam pa mtsho ltar 'phyur/ /brtson pas slogesbyong la//thang lhod spu tsam med//'di 'dra'i go skabs de//tang gi drin las byung //log spyod mun nag dus//'byung byas than skad sgrog/rgyal khab bcos skyong gi//'od zer stong phrag —'bar// 'byung po than bya'i tshogs//

mi mngon dbyings su nub//sku drin chen po de// nam yang brjed pa med//e ma skyid pa'i glu//e ho dga' bas len//tshig bzhi ba'i dpe brjod/ snyon pa'i gar la skye bos 'phya ba zhes bya ba/slob dpon thon mi'i//zhal rgyun gzhung gi// dgongs don shes ched//slob sbyong byas so//rnam dbye brgyad dang //tshig phrad gzhan gyi// sbyor tshul shes na// bshad dang rtsom la//rang dbang thob tshe// mkhas pa'i gral tshud// gzhan yang rtags mtha'//'dren tshul sogs la// 281

zhib par dpyad nas//sgro 'dogs chod dgos//de ltar min par// thos lo shes los//pho tshod tsam gyis//gar yang mi phyin//g.yam rgyug ham pas//gzhung 'grel byed pa// spyon pa'i gar la//skye bos 'phya 'o//tshig gsum pa'i dpe brjod/rang rgyal mi//brtson 'grus che// yon tan ldan//gsar brjer dga'//mthun sgril che//bka' khrims brtsi// ri'agrig lam srung //rgyal khab gces//282

dpa' zhing brtul//zhes pa lta bu'o// —bcad lhag spel ma rtsom lugs kyi dbai cung zad 'god par bya ba/ 4 'di ltar dar tshozhing rgyas pa'i rgyal khab 'di nyid kyi snyan pa'i grags pa 'dzam gling yongs la khyab pa'i rgyal khab chen po 'di ni 'dzam gling du gzengs su mtho bar gyur pa'i rgyal khab chen po zhig yin la/ sa rgya che zhing spyi le gru bzhi sa ya dgu dang 'bum drug yod pa'i sa gzhi la khod snyoms shing rgya che ba'i zhing las sa khul nas/ 'bras sa lu la sogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs pa 'byung zhing / rtswa chu phun sum tshogs pa'i spang ljongs me tog gis brgyan pa'i 'brog khul rgya chen por rta dang bra lang dang g.yang dkar lug la sogs pa'i phyugs rigs sna tshogs pas gang zhing sa phyogs du mar rin po che spug dang g.yu dang shel dang rdo rje pha lam dang gser dang dngul dang zangs dang lcags dang ha yang dang gsha' dang ti tsha zha dkar nag rdo snum rdo sol la sogs pa 'byung ba'i gter kha grangs med pa yod la/ gangs kyi ri dang spang ri dang g.ya' ri la sogs pa'i ri bo brjid kyang mdzes pa dag las 283

dkar bo chig thub la sogs pa'i rtsa ba dang lo ma dang rdzum bu'i sman bzang bo dpag tu med pa 'byung bas srid pa'i rims nad mtha' dag 'joms par byed do/ /gzhan yang tsha ba'i nad 'joms par byeg/pa'i gangs zhechu dang rdza chu lhung lhung 'bab cing /g.yu 'brug sngon mo sa la rgye ba lta bu'i chu klu/ nga che chung du ma rab tu rgyu ba la rin po che sna dgu 'byung zhing gru dang gzings dang gru rdzings la sogs pas 'dod pa'i gnas su skyel ba'i bya ba byed do/ /gzhan yang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i nags tshal gyis kun nas brgyan cing tsan dan dkar dmar dang /tsho a gar dang ar nag sogs ljon shing rin po ches gang la/ gzhan yang /khang shing dang yo byad kyi shing dang 'bud shing la sogs pa'i mkho dgu rab tu 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang mtsho dang mtshe'u du mas sa gzhi chen po brgyan cing / shar lho'i mtha' kun tu mtha'i rgya mtsho chen pos yongs su bskor ba las rin po che mu tig dang dung dang byu ru la sogs pa'i mtsho rdzas sna tshogs pa 'byung la/ 'bras ldan gyi shing ljon pa sna tshogs pa lasaciro bcud can gyi bca' ba'i shing 'bras za da mi shes pa 'byung ngo / / de dag tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis brjod par bya ste/dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyal khab 'di nyid kyi/ / lha84

snyan pa'i grags pa 'dzam gling yongs la khyab/ /'dzim gling zhes pa'i gling chen 'dzin ma yi/ /dbus su mngon par mtho ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dra/ /rgya chen sa gzhi spyi le gru bzhi ma/ / sa ya du ma yod pa'i gser ldan dbus/ /rgya che khod snyoms zhing sa las/ / — sa lu la sogs 'bru sna 'byung // rtswa chu phun sum tshogs pa yi// spang ljongs me tog bkra ba las// rta nor lug sogs phyugs rigs kyis// kun bzod ma yi lto ba khengs// rin chen gser dngul lcags rigs dang //rdo rje pha lam rdo snum sogs// —gzhal med nor gyi gter kha yis// sa chen 'di ni yongs su bzung // zla ba'i 'od kyi mdangs 'phrog pa'i//gangs kyi ri bo tshar du dngar//mar gad ri bo'i spun zla yi// spang ri dang ni g.ya' ri las tsho 285

dker bo tshig thub la sogs pa'i//bdud rtsi sman gyi gter brdol te//bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams kyi//bdud dpung ma lus cham la phab//lhung lhung 'bab pa'i gangs chu dang //rdza chu dag gi rngam shugs la//ma bzod tshad pa'i nad rims dag/dmigs med dbyings su yal te thal//g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i dpal 'phrog pa'i//chu klung du ma'i 'bab shugs kyis//gru dang gru rdzings la brten pa'i//skye bo rnams ni gnas su 'dren//tsan dan dang ni a gar dang //shug pa stag shing thang shing sogs//rin chen rkang 'thung sna tshogs pa'i//nags tshal chen pos sa gzhi brgyan//khang shing 'bud shing la sogase pa'i//dgos 'dod shing gi dngos grub yod//mtsho dang mtshe'u la sogs pas// 286

nor 'dzin bu mo'i lto ba brgyan// ( gnam sngon yol lhung 'dra ba'i// shar lho'i mtha' yi rgya mtsho las mu tig dung dang byu ru sogs//rin chem/ sna dgu'i dngos grub 'byung // yal ga lo 'dab rab rgyas pa'i// 'bras ldan shing gi yal ga las// ro bcud lda na pa'i shing 'bras dag/'bad med rtsol ba'i dge mtshan rgyas/ /de lta bu'i sa chen po la gnas pa'i skye bo dag ni gshis rgyud bzang zhing rig pa'i gnas du ma la blo gros kyi 'jug pa mchog tu rgyas pa yon tan dang thon skyed la brtson 'grus che zhing / phyi nang gi dgra bo dag gis tshur rgol dang gtor rlag byed pa la phar rgol gyi snying stobs dang ldan pas dpa' zhing brtul phod pa/ mi rigs mtha' dag gis gcig gis gcig la bya ba gang thad nas rogs ram dang phan tshun mdza' zhing brtse ba gnyen nye du ltar gnas te mthun sgril gyi ngang nas rang rgyal 'dzugs skrun la brtson zhing 'dzam gling gsar bze'i don la spyi sems dkar bo 'chang ba sha stag las/ la la ni tshan rig zhib 'jug la lhag par mkhas lha87

pa'i stabs kyis/ tshan tshan rig pas gsar bkod dang / gsar skrun du ma bton te/ mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs gzengs su mtho ba'i lag rjes mngon pa/ la la ni lag rtsal shos rig nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'bar te/ 'phrul 'khor gsar bzo/ lag rtsal gsar bcos la sogs pa'i dbang gis/ thon skyed kyi las chod ldab stong phrag du ma 'phar te/ nyin mkho dang rgyun mkho'i dngos rdzas dang / zas gos yo byad gosogs pa'i longs spyod mtha' dag rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin gcig rjes gcig mthud de tshong khrom mtha' dag mer gyis gang / la la dag ni gso ba rig pa la ched du mākhas pa sa/ nub lugs/ krung lugs/ bod lugs kyi gso rig shes bya mtha' dag khong du chud pas/ nad rigs mtha' dag gi sked pa gso dpyad ral gri rnon pos dum bur bcad pas/dus min gyi 'chi ba mi mngon dbyings su ba skrad de skye bo kun— gyi lus khams dwangs shing bde thang ngang rang 'gan gyi las la gzhol ba/ skye bo la la ni yig rigs du ma la mkhas shing brda sprod pa'i gzhu nga lugs rul nang byan chud pas slob gso'i las don gyi sgo nas skye borag yig rigs la rmongs pa'i mun pa mtha' dag lhag med du bsal te/ mkhas shing bzang ba'i mis sa steng gang bar byas so/ /gzhan yang snyan ngag dang sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa'i gang ཿ88

zag bgrangs kyis mi lang ba byung ste/ sdeb sbyor sogs bla na med pa'i srid srung dang zlos gar dang lo rgyus la sogs pa'i rtsom pa me tog gi dga' tshal rab tu rgyas te/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi shes ldan mtha' dag gi yid rang dbang med par 'gugs par byed la/zlos gar dang glu gar dang rol mo dang bro gar la sogs pas skye bo rnams dga' zhing spro bar byed do/ /de dag ni tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis brjod par bya ste/ tsa de lta'i rgya chen kun bzod ma yi lto ba la gnas skye bo dag/gshis rgyud bzang zhing rig pa'i gnas la blo gros pad ma'i 'dab ltar rgyas/ / yon tan thon skyed la ni brtson pa'i brtson 'grus ri bo'i gtos la 'gran/ / dgra bos mi tshugs snying stobs rab ldan dpa' brtul go cha rab tu btsan—/ /der gnas mi rigs mtha' dag ni/ / phan tshun mdza' ba gnyen nye ltar/ / gcig gis gcig la phan sems kyis/ /bya ba gang la'ang rogs ram byed/ / 289

mthun sgril gong bu gcig gyur dang / /mes rgyal 'dzugs skrun la brtson zhing / / 'dzam gling gsar brje'i spyi don la/ / dung ltar dkar ba'i bsam pa 'chang / /la la dag ni tshan rig gi/ / shes yon dpyid kyi dpal ltar rgyas/ /gsar—btod dang ni gsar bskrun gyis/ /mi dmangs zhabs 'degs gzengs mtho ba'i/ /lag rjes mngon zhing brtan par byas/ /la la'i lag rtsal shes rig gi/ / nyi ma'i 'od zer stong 'bar te/ / 'phrul 'khor gsar ba'i dge mtshen dang / /lag rtsal gsar bcos mthu checibs/ / thon skyed las chod yar zla bzhin/ /gong du 'phel ba'i dpal yon bzhad/ /dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho dang / /zas gos yo byad la sogs pa'i/ /gang la gang mkho'i dngos rdzas dag /rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin mkha' la 'phywar/ /lha90

— la la gso ba rig pa la/ / ched du mkhas pas nub lugs dang / /krung lugs bod lugs la sogs pa'i/ /gso rig shes bya mtha' dag pa/ / khong du chud pa'i gso rig gi/ / sman dpyad ral gri rnon po yis/ / nad rims bdud kyi ged pa bcad/ /nad phran dag ni cham la phab / dus min 'chi ba dngangs gyur nas/ / mi mngon dbyings su bros nas yib/ /skye bo kun gyi 'du phung khams/ /bde zhing thang la dar che bas/ /rang rang las 'gan sgrub pa la/ /brtson pa chen pos gzhol bar gyur/ /la las brda sprod rig pa la/ /nang byan chud pa'i spobs pa thob /skye bo'i yig rmongs mun pa dag /slob gso'i 'od kyis lhag med bsal/ /mkhas shing gshis rgyud bzang ba yi 291

mi yis sa steng gang bar byas/ / gzhan yang snyan ngag sgyu rtsal sogs/ / shes pa'i gang zag bgrangs mi lang /zhe/ tshig sbyor sdeb sbyor phun tshogs pa'i/ / — srid srung dang ni zlos gar dang / / lo rgyus rig gzhung legs bshad kyi/ /rtsom yig me tog dga' tshal gyis/ / rgyal khab phyi nang shes ldan tsho'i/ / — yid kyi bung ba dbang med 'gugs / / zlos gar dang ni bro gar dang / / glu gar rol mo la sogs pas/ / mthong thos can gyi skye bo dag / dga' spro'i gnas la 'god par byed/ /de lta bu'i snod bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyal khab chen po 'di bla na med pa'i blo gros ldan pa'i dpon dang / yang dag pa'i srid la brten nas/ chab srid dang dpāl 'byor dang rig gnas dang 'tsho ba sogs phyogs kun nags dbyar gyi chu augater dang / yar ngo'i zla ba ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas bzhin pa'i skabs shig tu bdud rgan gshin rje dang / dga' rab dbanga.ug 292

dpung tshogs dang bcas pa lhajibujidakor bor brdzus te chab srid kyi nang du 'dzul nas/ bdud pho dang bdud mo'i dug gi rlangs pa mkha' la btang ste nam mkha' gang bar byas pas/ yang dag pa'i srid jus nyi ma'i 'od zer ni bsgribs/ yang dag pa'i 'gro lam chen po ni mi mthong bar byas/ dpa la dang 'byor ba'i lo tog rnams ni skam/ rig gnas kyi me tog sna tshogs pa'i 'dab ma ni zum/ rgyal 'bangs dpal 'byor gyi chu 'go ni 'gagadamangs kyi 'tsho ba'i rgya mtsho ni thag mi rnams smag langs te mgo bo ni 'khor/ spyi tshogs bde 'jags kyi srog rtsa ni 'chad la khad/khu byug dang rma bya dang ka la ping ka bye'u skad snyan par sgrog pa rnams kyi skad ni 'gag 'byung bya 'ug pa— dang 'dre bya byi la'i mgo can la sogs pas than skad ni sgrog ri rgyal lhun po dang 'dra ba'i rgyal khab chen po snyil la khad par gyur to/ /de dag ni tshigs su bcad pas smra bar bya ste/bla med blo gros ldan pa'i dpon gyi dbu khrid dang / /bla na med pa'i yang dag srid jus la brten nas/ /srid dang 'byor ba rig gnas la sogs yar zla dang / /dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin du dar zhing rgyagapar gyur/ /de ltar dge mtshan rta bdun dar+pāng bo'i 'od zer stong phrag 293

rab tu 'bar ba la rab tu sdang ba'i bdud rgan gshin rje dang ni dga' rab dbang rgyug dpung tshogs bcas/ /bdu da kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis ni lha bu dkar bor brtsas te srid —gzhung nang du 'dzul/ / bdud rgan mi zan dag dang bdud mo khrag 'jib ma sogs bdud kyi dpung tshogs kyis/ /dug gi kha rlangs btang ste dug gi sprin pa nag pos nam mkha' yongs su gang / /yang dag kun phan srid jus 'jig rten mig gi 'od zer 'bar ba kun nas bsgribs/ /gtan gyi bde ba'i 'gro lam chen po de ni smag gis khyab pas mi mthong zhing / /dpal dang 'byor ba'i lo tog rnams ni sad dang ser ba btsa' than gyis ni bskams/ / rig pa'i gnas kyi chu skyes sna tshogs dag gi 'dab ma kun nas yongs su zum/ / rgyal 'bangs dpal 'byor chu 'go 'gag ste 'tsho ba'i rgya mtsho dag ni skam par gyur/ /294

rīmi rnams la ni smag chen langagate mgo bo dag ni rab tu 'khor ba dang / / spyi tshogs bde 'jags tshe srog gser gyi thag pa de ni 'chad la khad par gyur/ /dpyid kyi dpal mo dang ni 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin ka la ming ka la sogs pa'i/ / jiskad snyan 'byin pa'i bya tshogs dag gi mgrin pa'i rgyud mang sgra ni yongs su nyams/ / 'byung bya 'ug pa dang ni 'dre bya rnams kyis than skad yongs su sgrog par gyur/ /ri rgyal lhun po 'dra ba'i rgyal khab chen po snyil la khad pa'i nyen khar lhung / /sa chen la gnas dkar phyogs la dga'i mi rnams mya ngan khung bur gzim par gyur/ /de ltar rgyal khab chen po 'di nyid nyen kha rab tu che ba'i mun pa stug po'i nang du lhung ba'i skabs der/ mkhas shing mdzangs la snying stobs kyi go cha rab tu bgos pa'i bla na med pa'i rgyal blon dag nyi gzhon gsar ba nam mkha'i mthongs nas shar ba bzhin du rgyal sa chen por lhang nger langs te/ thabs jus 295

nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shin tu rgyas pa las/ 'phral sgrub kyi byed thabs 'od zer stong phrag glo bur du 'bar nas/ dga' rab dbang phyug dpung tshogs dang bcas pa gzhob thul gyis bsregs pas/ nam mkha' dwangs pa la 'ja' tshon gyis khyab/ yang dag jus bzang gi sbrang char snyoms por babs pas/ rtsi shing lo tog rnams phyir gson/ me tog rnams kyi kha phyes te ra yig gnyis pa rnams kyis ni 'phur lding gar gyis rol bzhin glu dbyangs snyan par sgrog 'dre bya 'ug pa sogs mya ngan gyi khung bur yib/ ko ki la dang mdongs mtha' mo dang ka la ping ka la sogs pa'i bya rnams kyis mgrin pa'i rdza rnga brdung bas/ mi rnams kyi skyo ba sangs par byas/ mi rnams kyis yang dag pa'i gtan bderdzi'agro lam mthong ste dga' ba'i ca co sgrog rgyal 'bangs dpal 'byor gyi chu 'go brdol te/ bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba'i rgya mtsho rab tu gang bar gyur to/ /de lta bu'i gnas tshul gyi bskal ba bzang bo de mi rnams kyis mthong ba la brten nas/ dga' ba'i glu len skyid pa'i bro rdung zhing / rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi kun gyis/ mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i rgyal blon dang / srid gzhung gi jus bzang yang dag cing bla na med pa la rab tu gus shing bstod bsngags kyi rol mo rab tu sgrog par byed do/ /de dag ni tshigs su bcad pa'i 396

dbyangs kyis brjod par bya ste/ de ltar rgyal khab chen po 'di nyid mun pa stug po'i g.yang sar lhung ba'i nyen la thug pa'i skabs/ /mkhas shing mdzangs la snying stobs go cha rab tu bgos pa'i rgyal blon chen po dag dang blon 'bangs bcas /nyi gzhon gsar ba nam mkha'i mthongs nas shar ba bzhin du rgyal sa chen por lhang nger lham mer langs /thabs jus nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shin tu rgyas las 'phral sgrub byed thabs 'od zer stong phrag gro bur du/ /'bar ba bskal ba'i me dpung lta bur gyur la 'gran bzod gang zhig srid pa'i khongs las rnyed min pas/ /dmangs dang rgyal khab phongs la sbyor ba'i bdud chen dpung dang bcas pa gzhob gzhob thul thul sreg par gyur/ / de ltar gnod chen bsal dang lhan/ /nam mkha' dwangs la 'ja' tshon shar/ /yang dag jus bzang sgrang char babs /rtsi shing rnams ni slar yang gson/ /me tog rnams ni kha 'bus te/ / rmedze 297

ra yig gnyis pas glu dbyangs len/ /than bya 'ug pa la sogs pa/ /mya ngan mun pa'i khung bur yib/ /ko ki la dngangarma bya dang / la /ka la ping ka la sogs pas/ /mgrin pa'i rdza rnga rab brdung ste/ /mi yi skyo ba sangs par byas /yang dag gtan bde'i 'gro lam de/ /snyi rnams kyis ni mthong ba na/ /rab tu dga' ba'i dga' mchong byed/ /rab tu dga' ba'i ca co sgrog /rgyal 'bangs dpal 'byor chu 'go rdol/ /'tsho ba'i rgya mtsho gang zhing 'phyur/ /de lta'i bskal ba bzang bo de/ /mi rnams kyis ni mthong ba las/ /shin tu dga' ba'i dga' glu len/ /ha cang skyid pa'i rkang bro rdung / /rgyal khab phyi nang mi kun gyis/ /mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i rgyal blon dang / /ཿ98 —

srid gzhung jus bzang yang dag la/ / rab tu bsngags pa'i dus 'da' 'o/ / de ltar rgyal khab chen po 'di nyid/ gcig sdud yod la/dmangs gtso yang yod pa/ 'grig khrims yod la rang dbang yang yod cing / nyi mas zer brgya spros pa de nyid/ pad mo'i dga' tshal mtha' gcig tu sman pa de bzhin du/ rgyal blon dam pa rnams mi dmangs la snying brtse zhing / 'tsho ba la thugs khur bzhes pa'i thabs jus mtha' dag ni 'bangs mi'i bde skyid kyi gsos sman du gyur la/ nyi zer phog pa napad mo'i 'dab ma rab tu bzhad cing nyi zer la 'khor ba bzhin du thabs jus dang srid jus mthong zhing thos ma thag tu tshad med pa'i dga' spro skyes te/ srid gzhung rgyal blon bcas la bkur zhing / rgyal khab la dga' zhing gces la/ mes rgyal 'dzugs skrun gyi bya bar brtson sems me ltar 'bar bar gyur to/ /de lta bu'i mthun rkyen las tshan rig dang rig gnas kyi bya ba char rjes kyi myu gu bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas nas yon tshad rab tu mtho ba'i skye bos sa chen gang bar gyur/ de ltar tshan rig dang rig gnas 'phel ba'i stobs kyis/ sa bon chu lud drod gsher rnams 'dzoms nas myu gu skye zhing rgyas pa bzhin du/ lag rtsal 299

dang gsarajigatod kyi shes rab rab tu 'phel te/ deng rabs can gyi 'phrul 'khor dag gis sa chen rab tu gang nas glog las can dang 'phrul chas rang 'gul can du gyur te zhing las dang bzo las dag las 'bru rigs dang dngos rdzas sna tshogs pa rgya mtsho chen po'i rba rlabs 'phyur ba bzhin du 'phyur te sa chen po yongs su gang bar gyur to/ /mi rnams kyang bde skyid bla na med pa'i 'tsho ba la rol zhing gcig gis gcig la bzhin 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis bsus te/ e ma/ lha'i bde skyid zer ba ni 'di'o zhes smra bar byed do/ /de dag tshigs su brtad pas brjod par bya ste/de lta'i rgyal khab chen po ni/ / gcig sdud yod la dmangs gtso yod/ / 'grig khrims yod la rang dbang yod/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer spros pa de/ / pad+ma'i tshal la sman pa bzhin/ / rgyal blon dam pa mi dmangs la/ /rab tu brtse zhing 'tsho ba la /thugs khur bzhes pa'i srid jus de/ /'bangs kyi bde skyid gsos sman gyur/ / pad+ma'i gnyen gyi zer brgya la/ /300

'dam skyes tshogs rnams dga' ba bzhin/ —/ thabs jus srid jus de dag la/ / mi yi rigs rnam/sa dga' zhing bkur/ /mes rgyal la dga' gces zhen che/ /'dzugs skrun bya ba'i brtson sems de/ri / me la bud shing bsnan pa bzhin/ /rab tu 'bar zhing 'phel bar gyur/ /char ba babs pa'i rjes su ni/ / myu gu 'phel zhing rgyas pa ltar/ /de lta'i mthun rkyen bzang bo las / /tshan rig rig gnas 'phel zhing rgyas/ /yon tshad rab tu mtho ba yi/ / skye bos sa chen gang bar gyur/ / sa bon chu lud drod gsher rnams/ /'dzoms na myu gu skye ba bzhin/ / tshan rig rig gnas 'dzoms pa na/ / lag rtsal gsar skrun shes rab 'phel/ /deng rabs can gyi 'phrul 'khor gyis/ / sa chen yongs su gang gyur te/ / 301

glog las can dang 'phrul chas can/ /rang 'gul can gyi zhing las dang / /bzo las la sogs dar gyur te/ /'bru rigs dang ni dngos rdzas dag /rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'phyur ba bzhin/ / sa chen 'di ni gang bar gyur/ /skye bo rnams ni bde skyid 'tsho ba la rol zhing / /gcig gis gcig la 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis rab bsus te//dga' ba'i gar dang skyid pa'i glu la rtag rol bas /e ma sum rtsen bde skyid zer kyang 'di nyid do/ /'dir smras pa/gangs kyi ri dang pad ma'i rtsa ba lta bur dkar ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /gangs can brda sprod rig pa'i tshul lugs gang shes mdo tsam bshad pa 'di/ /grags 'dod mtho 'dod nor gyi bya dga' thob phyir ngal ba byas min par/ /brda sprod gsar slob 'ga' la res 'ga' phan pa srid snyam brtsams pa lags/ /302

r+shas rgya zhan c-ing mthong rgya chung ba'i skyon gyis ni/ /ma rtogs log rtog 'khrul ba'i dri ma yod nges pas/ /ke ta ka yis chab kyi rnyog pa sel ba bzhin/ /dpyod ldan dag gis 'khrul ba'i dri ma sel bar mdzod/ /brda sprod rgya mtsho'i 'jings pa dag /ma brgal phyogs tsam mthong ba las rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' shes so lo/ / byis pa'i rtsed mo'i mched zla'o/ / dngos po'i rang gi gshis lugs de/ / ma rtogs zhwa dpe lham 'gebs kyi/ /smyon pa'i zlos gar 'di dag la/ / dpyod ldan su zhig yid ches 'gyur/ /rigs lam phra mo'i rnam dpyod dang / /gzhung lugs gdams pa'i khungs med par/ /gang shar ri mor phab pa dag / srin bu'i rjes la 'gran pa nyid/ /bdag gi sug las la sogs pa/ /rgyal khab chen po 'di'i mtshon pa'i/ /yangs pa'i sa la gnes pa dag /303

bde ba'i rgyu ru rgyur cig gu / / yi ge'i spyi rnam blo gsal 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba 'di ni dpyod ldan du mas bskul ba ltar/ bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas/ mkhas pa dag la mi mkho na'ang gsar slob 'ga' la phan srid snyam ste snga mo zhig nas mgo brtsams na'ang bar skabs shig nas rkyen dbang gis mtshams 'jog dgos byung / nye char rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi tang u'i chog mchan ltar dril bsgrags pus 'go khrid 'og bod yig sbyong brdar gyi gros tshogs 'tshogs dus phran gyis slob dpon gyi khur len dgos byung skabs mjug rjogs par bris pa'o/ /oṃ swa sti/ khams gsum dmu rgod 'gro ba mtha' dag gis/ /dge ba'i grib bsil dpal la hūṃd pa'i phyir/ /bkra shis 'khor loX'i dgon gyi chos grwa las/ /chos sbyin bdud rtso'i gru ༵ra zlodi ༷ ༷spros ko/ / / / 304

g.yo+o/ /bam̐d kyi brda 'i bstan bcos sum cu ba dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i tshig 'grel rab gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// smug sprin dbyings su dag pa'i nam mkha' la/ / 'od brgya'i dpal 'bar dkyidze+e'akhor yongs su rdzogs/ /tsha zer spros pas 'jig rten skyong ba la/ /blo ldan skye bo su zhig gus mi 'gyur/ /nelegs par rtogs na gzhung lugs rab 'byams la/ /'jug pa'i shes rab snang ba mchog ster zhing / /gzur gnas mkhas pa mgu ba'i legs bshad mchog /gangs can brda sprod tshig don cung zad 'grel/ /de la 'dir mkhas mchog thon mis mdzad pa'i sum cu ba dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i tshig don cung zad 'grel ba la/ dpe brjod sogs rgyas pa sngar yi ge'i spyi rnam blo gsal 'jug ngogs su spyi don gyi tshul du bshad zin pas/ der blta bar bya zhing /305

'dir rtsa ba'i tshig ldan 'gril ba la gasnyis/ sum cu ba'i mig don 'grel ba dang / rtags kyi 'jug pa'i tshig don 'grel ba'o/ /dang bo/ sum cu ba'i tshigadon 'grel ba la/mtshan gyi don dang / gzhung gi don dang / mjug gi don no//dang bo ni/ legs sbyar gyi skad du byā ka ra ṇa sku la tri shad nā ma/ bod skad du/ lung ston pa rtsa ba sum cu ba zhes bya ba/ zhes gsungs te/ rgya gar na skad rigs chen po bzhi yod pa'i legs sbyar gyi skad du byā ka ra ṇa sogs so/ /de bod gangs can gyi skad du bsgyur na/ lung ston pa sogs su 'gyur ro/ /de la byā ka ra ṇa ni lung ston pa'am brda sprod pa ste/ sgra'i mtshan nyid ming tshig yi ge'i rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas lung du ston pa'am brda sprod pas de skad ces bya'o/ /myu la ni rtsa ba/ tri shad ni sum cu ba ste/ bod kyi brda sprod pa'i rtsa ba'am phyi mo yin pas rtsa ba/ kā li sum cu bo'i sbyor ba rgya cher ston pas brjod bya'i sgo nas btags pa'o/ /nā ma ni zhes bya ba zhes pa ste/ ming de skad ces bya'o zhes pa'o/ /skad rigs chen po bzhi ni/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad/ yul mi rang bzhin pa'i skad/ zur chag pa'i skad/ bi sha tsi sha za'i skad de bzhi'o/ /'dir kā li sum cu 306

brjod byar byed pa'i cha nas sum cu ba zhes btags pa yin na/ rtags 'jug gi rtsa bas kyang kā li sum cu brjod byar byed pas/ de'i ming la'ang sum cu ba zhes 'dogs rigs so zhe na/ khyab pa ma nges te/ dper na/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi gsung gi dbu ma rtsa shes kyis sher phyin gyi mdo'i brjod bya gtso bor ston pas na/ rtsa ba shes rab ces ming btags mod/ sher mdo'i brjod bya ston pa'i gzhung yod tshad la ming de 'dogs dgos pa'i nges pa med pa bzhin no/ /sho lo ka sum cu yod pas ming de ltar btags so zer na/ de yang mi chog pa med de/ dper na/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi gsung gi nyi shu ba lta bu sho lo ka'i grangs dang le'u'i grangs dang bam grangs sogs kyi sgo nas btags pa'ang mang ngo / /'on kyang 'di la/ mchod brjod dang mjug smon brtsis na sho lo ka sum cu las mang la/ ma brtsis na'ang sho lo ka sum cu la rkang ba gcig gisami 'dang— ba mkhas pa snga ma dag gis bshad do/ /'gyur phyag gi tshul du/ smra ba'i dbang rgyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhos smos te/ smra ba ni ngag dang / dbang phyug ni dbang 'byor ba yin la/ ngag gi rang bzhin shes bya'i ngo bo dang rnam pa ma lus pa ji lta ba bzhin smra ba la thogs pa med par rang dbang du spyod pa'i 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo /307

zhis pa'o/ /phyag 'tshal ba ni 'dud pa ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi phyag gsum mo/ /'gyur phyag gi tshul du phyag 'tshal zhes—pa ni/ slob dpon rang nyid gtsor byas pa'i lo paṇa dag gis legs sbyar bod skad du bsgyur ba'i tshe/ 'gyur mthor phyin pa'i ched du 'dod pa'i lha la phyag byed pa bzhin du rang nyid kyis gzhung rtsom pa'i tshe na'ang de ltar byas so/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ pastan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo dang / sgo de dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos dngos bshad pa gnyis so//dang bo la/ mchod brjod dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba gnyis las/ dang bo dkon mchog la phyag bya ba ni/ gang la yon tan mchog mnga' ba'i/ /dkon mchog de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ gang zhes pa spyi sgra yin la/ la zhes 5 ni bdun pa gnas gzhi'i sgra yin/ yon tan zhes bya ba ni phan yon nam 'bras bu'i khyad par legs pa'i ming ste/ rgyu khyad par ba las byung ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /mchog ces pa ni rtse mo dang phul du byung ba'i don te tshig rgyan yang yin gsungs/ mnga' ba zhes pa ni/ yod pa'am ldan pa'i don/ mnga' ba'i zhes pa'i 'i ni gzhi mthun gyi drug pa 'brel sgra'o/ /dalko/na mchog ces pa ni/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkaun mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog 308

ste gsum la zer ro/ /de zhes bya ba ni nges bzung gi sgra yin la/la zhe sa bya ba ni bzhi ba dgos ched kyi sgra yin/ phyag 'tshal ba ni bshad zin to/ /don bsdus na/ gang la yon tan gyi mchog mnga' na/ dkon mchog de la spru༈nga' bas/ de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /'di'i la yig ni 'ga' zhig gis rnam dbye gnyis par 'dod de dkon mchog ni phyag bya ba'i yul yin pa las/ gang gi ched du phyag bya ba'i yul min te/ dkon mchog gi ched du phyag bya mi dgos so/ /sgra gzhung las phyag 'tshal ba sogs la bzhi ba/ zhes gsungs pa ni goms srol gyi dmigs bsal tsam yin no zer/ legs bshad gser phreng sogs phar phyin gyi 'grel ba rnams su/ shing gi ched du chu 'dren pa la shing la chu 'dren zer ba ltar/ sher phyin gyi ched du phyag 'tshal ba la sher phyin la phyag 'tshalalo zhes pa'o/ /zhes sher phyin rang rgyud la skye zhing 'phel ba'i don du sher phyin la phyag 'tshal bar 'dod pa dang / dkon mchog gi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du dkon mchog la phyag byas par 'dod de/ rgyu skyabs dang 'bras skyabs gnyis kyi nang nas 'bras skyabs la bsam par snang ngo / /legs sbyar gyi gzhung mtha' dag la/ phyag 'tshal ba la bzhi ba'o gsungs pa ltar phyag 'tshal ba la rnam dbye bzhi ba byin pa sha stag 'dug 30mi

pas/ dmigs bsal yin na/ spyir btang dang dmigs bsal gnyis las dmigs bsal khyab che bar 'gyur bas dpyod pa'i gzhi yin la/ rnam 'grel las/ sgra ni brjod 'dod rjes 'brang phyir/ /gsungs pa ltar brjod 'dod la sbyar na gnyis ka yod par snang mod/ kha tshon gcod dka' bas dpyod ldan dag gis dbyad par bya'o//'jam dbyangs la phyag bya ba ni/ gang gis sgra dbyangs gsungs pa yi/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ gang zhes pa spyi sgra dang / gis zhes pa rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa dang sgra dbyangs ni 'dir dbyangs yig dang / dbyangs yig thog mar gsungs pa ste/ sngon gyi gtam rgyud las/ dbyangs yig 'jam dpal gyis thog mar gsungs par ba shad pa dang sgo bstun nas/ gang gis sgra dbyangs gsungs pa/ zhes spyi'i tshul du smos pa/ de nyid ngos bzung ba'i phyir/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes smos te/ rgyu'i skyon nyon mongs pa'i rtsub reg dang / ngo bo'i skyon sgra dang ming tshig sogs mi snyan pa nyams pa ma 'byor ba dang ma 'brel ba sogs kyi rtsub reg dang bral ba'i 'jam pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i dbyangs de mnga' bas na 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ 'jam pa'i zhes pa'i 310

'i yig n+da khyad gzhi dang khyad chos gzhi gcig tu sdud pa'i 'brel sgra'o/ /sgra'i lha la phyag bya ba ni/ gang gis ming gzhi sngon gsungs pa'i/ /rtag zhi ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ba ste gzhan rnams gong ltar la/ ming gzhi ni/ ming gang las byung ba'i gzhi ste/ ka la sogs pa'i gsal byed rnams so/ /gang gis ming gzhi'i yi ge thog mar gsungs pa bo/ lha rtag zhi ba lta spyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /de yang yi ge sngon byung gi lo rgyus las/ yi ge khyab 'jug lha yis bkod/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyis nga ros drangs/ /zhes dang / sgra'i rig byed tshangs pas thog mar byas par grags pas phyi rol ba'i gtam rgyud de dag dang sgo bstun nas/ rtag zhi ba ste tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug la phyag byas pa'o/ /rtag zhi ba zhes pa'ang 'grel ba spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs su/ phyi rol bas tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug gnyis ka la rtag pa dang / zhi ba'i lus yod par 'dod par bshad pas/de gnyis ka la rtag zhi ba'i ming thob par bshad do/ / tha snyad kyi rig gnas la bka' drin che ba'i dngos brgyud kyi bla ma ste slob dpon rnams la yang phyag bya ba ni/ sdeb sbyor legs mdzad mkhas rnams dang / /bla ma la yang phyag 'tshal nas/ /zhes pa ste/ yi ge phan tshun rnam dbye tshig phrad rkyen la sogs pas/311

sdib cing stor ba'i sgra rig pa dang / snyan ngag gi rig gnas dang / phyi yang sdeb pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi rig gnas sogs mdzad pa'i mkhas pa rnams dang / slob dpon rang nyid la dngos su bka' drin che ba'i bla ma lha rig pa'i seng ge dang / yig mkhan legs byin sogs la yang phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'o/ /yang ni gong gi de rnams su ma zad pa'o/ / gnyis pa rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/ nas/ /bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing / /rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu/ /ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ de ltar mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' gnyis rgyun gcig tu sbyor zhing go rim ston pa'i phyir/ nas zhes smos te/ mtshams spyor ba'i sgra'o/ /spyir bslab pa ni/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ shes rab kyi bslab pa ste gsum yin la/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i bslab pa ni/ rtags 'jug gi skabs nas gsungs pa'i/ nyan thos kyi bslab pa/ rang rgyal gyi bslab pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bslab pa ste gsum mo/ /'di ni nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i chos skad yin/ phyi rol ba'i rig byed bzhi ni/ mchod sbyin/ nges brjod/ srid spung / snyan ngag gi rig byed de bzhi la zer ba yin la/ de yang 312

mchod sbyin ni/ mtho ris kyi phyir mchod sbyin byed pa dang / nges brjod ni/ sgra rig pa la zer/ srid srung ni/ rgyal srid dang chab srid srung ba dang spel ba la zer/ snyan tshig ni/ tshig rgyan gyi sbyor ba'o/ /ming ni ka la sogs pa'i yi ge du ma 'dus nas don gyi ngo bo tsam brjod pa/ khang ba/ bca' lag mi/ zog ces pa lta bu yin la/ tshig ni/ ming du ma 'dus nas don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par sbyar nas ston pa/ khang ba'i nang / bca' lag gi kha dog mi'i mgo/ zog gi ra zhes pa lta bu dang / brjod pa ni/ tshig gi rgyun no/ /des na/ nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i bslab pa kun te tshang ma smra bar byed pa'i gzhi'am rgyu byed pa dang /phyi rol ba'i rig byed kyi gzhung lugs smra ba'i rgyu'am rtsa ba yin pa dang / ming tshig brjod pa kun te mtha' dag gi rgyu'am rtsa ba ni yi ge yin pas/ de'i sbyor ba bshad par bya/ zhes pa'o/ /gzhung 'di'i dgos sogs chos bzhi mi// yi ge'i sbyor ba ni/gzhung 'di'i brjod bya/ gzhung 'di la brten nas/ yi ge'i sbyor ba shes pa ni/ gzhung 'di'i dgos pa/ yi ge'i sbyor ba shes pa la brten nas rang rang gi dmigs yul mthar thug 'grub pa ni/ gzhung 'di'i nying dgos/ de gsum phyi ma phyi ma/snga ma snga ma dang 'brel ba yin pas/ 'di la brjod bya/ dgos 313
